article.articleHeadline: Município registra novo caso de dengue em 10 dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipality records a new dengue case in 10 days.
article.articleSummary: Barretos, Brazil, recorded one new dengue case between July 3 and July 13, bringing total confirmed dengue cases to 233 among 2,046 notifications. By July 13, 1,774 cases had been discarded and 39 were under investigation; no dengue deaths have occurred this year. Despite the single-case increase, the Municipal Health Secretariat continues Aedes aegypti control efforts with fieldwork across neighborhoods, household visits, elimination of breeding sites, and resident guidance to prevent transmission. These figures suggest stable transmission with limited growth, reinforcing continued vector control and community outreach.

triage.headline_ja: 市が10日間で新たなデング熱症例を1件記録
triage.triage_reason: 地方都市における通常の季節性デング熱の推移であり、症例数増加も限定的で死亡例もなく、通常のベクター対策が継続されているのみで、特段の異常性・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの日常的な感染症サーベイランス報告であり、症例数の増加も1件と軽微。死亡例なし、通常のベクター対策が実施されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊环比增近3倍 病例数显著上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: June sees a nearly threefold month-on-month increase in new confirmed COVID-19 cases; case numbers rise significantly.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 saw 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases in China (June 1–30) across 31 provinces and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, with 130 severe cases and 1 death in a patient with underlying disease. This is a 3.61-fold month-on-month rise from May’s ~21,900 cases, yet still far below June 2025’s 333,000. Genomic surveillance reported 3,741 local SARS-CoV-2 genomes, all Omicron variants, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and sublineages; no evidence of new high-risk variants. Experts attribute the increase to waning population immunity (antibodies protecting 4–6 months), summer travel, and indoor, poorly ventilated environments; overall severity and mortality have not risen, indicating a temporary fluctuation rather than a pandemic. Shanghai’s Hu Yang and Peng Jie emphasize protection for immunocompromised individuals and those with underlying conditions. China CDC notes activity among influenza, rhinovirus, enteroviruses, parainfluenza, metapneumovirus, and SARS-CoV-2, and recommends masks, hygiene, and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ新規確定患者数が前月比で約3倍に増加、症例数が顕著に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 中国国内の定例サーベイランス報告であり、新規変異株の出現なし、重症化率・死亡率の上昇もなく前年同月比では大幅に低い水準のため、季節的変動の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 既知のOmicron系統（NB.1.8.1等）が優勢であり、新規高リスク変異株の証拠なし。免疫の減衰・夏季の人の移動・換気不良が増加要因とされ、パンデミックではなく一時的な変動と専門家は評価している。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Ebola training in Kenya prepares doctors for 'intense' job
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged since May, becoming the fastest-spreading on record with thousands of cases and deaths reported. International response is fragmented by political stances and funding shifts, threatening containment. Authorities and partners press for cross-border surveillance, rapid isolation protocols, and expanded training for frontline workers. MSF is expanding training and local engagement in Kenya to bolster frontline readiness amid the regional crisis. The WHO and Africa CDC coordinate cross-border efforts, while the United States has imposed stringent travel restrictions and reduced direct outbreak responses, complicating international aid. The report contrasts political action with on-the-ground preparation, noting questions about current hotspots, community reception of MSF training in Kenya, and changes in U.S. policy affecting outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、ケニアでエボラ対応訓練を実施し医師を『過酷な』任務に備えさせる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が続いており、国際対応の分断や渡航制限も生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでのMSF訓練を主題としつつ、実際の流行発生国はDRCであるため、ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Reports 7 Chandipura Virus Cases, 3 Deaths; Health Department Intensifies Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Gujarat reports seven confirmed Chandipura virus (CHPV) cases in the last few weeks, with three deaths among patients under 10 years old; four are under medical treatment. Health Minister Praful Pansheriya chaired a high-level meeting in Gandhinagar to review the outbreak. Eight suspected patients’ blood samples are awaiting results; overall, 27 suspected samples have been tested previously, with seven positives and 12 negatives. CHPV causes fever with flu-like symptoms and acute encephalitis. The virus belongs to Vesiculovirus genus in the Rhabdoviridae family and is transmitted by vectors such as mosquitoes, ticks and sandflies. Surveillance and control efforts continue across Gujarat.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症7例確認、3人死亡；保健当局がサーベイランス強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性」の2つに該当し、小児における急性脳炎による死亡例が確認されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはグジャラート州で毎年季節的に発生する既知の疾患だが、小児の高致死率と脳炎症状のため引き続き注視が必要。ベクター（蚊・サシチョウバエ・マダニ）媒介であり国際的拡大の可能性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: علماء أكسفورد يطورون لقاحاً واعداً لمواجهة أخطر سلالة من "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford scientists are developing a promising vaccine to confront the deadliest strain of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Oxford researchers have launched the first-in-human trial of a vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, in response to one of Africa’s deadliest outbreaks. The UK MHRA approved a Phase I study of 50 healthy adults (18–55) to assess safety and immunogenicity, with one-year follow-up. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector delivering Bundibugyo genetic code, a platform based on the technology behind the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Development occurred in 57 days after the WHO declared the Congo outbreak a public health emergency. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 625 deaths and 1,792 infections mark it as the third-largest Ebola outbreak. Serum Institute of India has produced about 620,000 doses; a second efficacy study is planned in Uganda. Prof. Teresa Lamb and Alex Sampson note rapid progress; preclinical tests in mice and macaques were promising. Rare adverse events like blood clots are acknowledged; safety remains a priority.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォードの科学者、最も致死性の高いエボラ株に対する有望なワクチンを開発中
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼はコンゴ民主共和国で進行中の既知のエボラ流行（WHOがPHEIC宣言済み）に対するワクチン臨床試験の進展報告であり、新規の疫学的シグナルではないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主にオックスフォード大学によるBundibugyoエボラ株を標的としたワクチンの第I相臨床試験（英国での実施）に関する報道であり、コンゴでの流行自体（625人死亡、1792人感染、史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行）はすでにWHOにより緊急事態として認識済み。インド（Serum Institute）は製造拠点、ウガンダは第II相試験予定地であり、いずれも流行発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: American cu Ebola, tratat în Germania: Costuri și riscuri mutate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American with Ebola, Treated in Germany: Costs and Risks Shifted.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) totals 1,926 cases and 702 deaths as of 12 July. The second American patient infected in this outbreak was transferred to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany after Samaritan’s Purse shifted care from the DRC; the first American, Dr. Peter Stafford, had already been evacuated to Berlin with care coordinated by the WHO. The shift away from domestic repatriation to European treatment centers redefines response timelines, logistics, and exposure risk, elevating dependence on external capacity. The move carries material implications for employers and donors in terms of costs, staffing, and mission continuity. WHO and Africa CDC call for accelerated, multi-country mobilization. The RDC outbreak, declared 15 May, is described as the third largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染したアメリカ人、ドイツで治療：コストとリスクの転嫁
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（1,926症例、702死亡、史上3番目の規模）であり、国際的な患者搬送も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行であり、ドイツは患者の搬送・治療先に過ぎず対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。CFRが約36%と高く、致死率の高さが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱のワクチン治験開始　コンゴ流行株で初、英大学
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vaccine trial begins; first against the Congo outbreak strain, UK university.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University announced on July 13 the world's first clinical trial of a vaccine against Ebola virus disease focused on the Bundibugyo strain circulating in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire). The study will enroll 50 participants aged 18–55, with vaccination expected within weeks. Developed by Oxford researchers and manufactured by an Indian institute, the vaccine will be evaluated for safety and immune response. The trial has UK regulatory approval and will be conducted in the United Kingdom, with preparations under way to conduct parts of the study in Africa. The Democratic Republic of the Congo Ministry of Health reported on July 12 that 1,926 infections and 702 deaths have occurred in the outbreak.

triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験開始が主題だが、DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（1,926症例、702死亡）の深刻さを示す情報を含む。インドは製造拠点であり発生地ではないため除外。英国も治験実施国であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford Begins World's First Human Trial of Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine as Congo Outbreak Continues
article.articleSummary: Oxford begins the world's first human trial of a vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, as a Congo outbreak in central Africa continues and has killed more than 700 people. The early-stage study will enroll 50 healthy adults to assess safety and tolerability; efficacy data are not yet available. This milestone marks the first clinical testing of a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola vaccine and signals intensified efforts to curb transmission in the Congo region as of 2026-07-14. The excerpt focuses on safety assessment and provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: Clinical trials offer hope as Ebola outbreak accelerates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported as of Sunday across 37 health zones in three provinces, 94% of cases in Ituri Province. Uganda has 20 mostly imported cases and has contained transmission through surveillance and contact tracing. No approved vaccines or targeted treatments exist for the Bundibugyo strain, but DR Congo launched clinical trials this month testing remdesivir, monoclonal antibodies, and combination therapies. An additional study enrolling about 800 high‑risk contacts to assess preventive therapies will begin this week. WHO and Africa CDC emphasize cautious optimism amid rapid spread, with an estimated reproduction number of 1.4 and roughly 1,600 cases in the first six weeks—far above the West Africa 2014–2016 pace.

article.articleHeadline: Oxford University begins human trials of new Ebola vaccine to combat fast-spreading Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine candidate from Oxford/Bundibugyo begins Phase I trials in the United Kingdom, testing safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, amid an active Bundibugyo outbreak in the Congo. The trial uses the same chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform as the Covid vaccine, with Serum Institute of India manufacturing and stockpiling 620,000 doses; 4,000 investigational doses are being administered in the study. Trials began eight weeks after a public health emergency was declared, as researchers push rapid development for later-stage testing. The outbreak persists in the Congo, with Ugandan partners preparing for trials in Africa and Uganda involvement noted. The effort emphasizes speed and safety monitoring to assess early signals of efficacy and plan potential expansion if results are favorable.

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: What's new and should we be worried
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 in Quezon City, Philippines shows a 265% rise over the past three weeks, up from 23 to 84 cases; total 146 cases in 2026 as of July 14, 2026. Most infections are outpatient; just over 10% require hospitalization; no deaths reported; about 70% recovered and 30% remain active. Nationwide, total cases stand at 719 as of June 20, 2026, down from 3,579 in 2025. Likely undercounting due to reduced routine testing and focus on high-risk patients; per-capita context noted for Quezon City’s ~3 million residents. Covid-19 remains endemic with seasonal fluctuations; no new local variant identified; the current Variant Under Monitoring is XFG (designated 2025). No local genomic data available. Vaccines remain unupgraded locally, though older vaccines reportedly still confer protection; mortality among the vaccinated remains low. Paxlovid remains effective and available; remdesivir is not locally available, though PS-MID is lobbying for its return; ensitrelvir is approved in Japan (not Philippines) and shows post-exposure prophylaxis potential, reducing RT-PCR positivity by ~67%; monoclonal antibodies for PEP are expensive.

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Ebola BVD Outbreak: LTC Situation Report (Telecoms) #6 (Reporting period: 06 - 12 July 2026)
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with more than 1,700 confirmed cases reported as of 09 July 2026. The surge centers on Ituri province, including Bunia, stressing surveillance, coordination, and information management. The Logistics & Telecommunications Cluster (LTC) Telecoms, in support of the humanitarian response, emphasizes the critical need for reliable telecommunications. LTC Telecoms and the United Nations Department of Safety and Security (UNDSS) have restored the dedicated UN security communications channel in Bunia after six months offline and are establishing a dedicated channel for NGO partners to strengthen security communications for responders operating across Ituri. The report covers planned and ongoing telecommunications activities for the week 06–12 July 2026 to support the ongoing response. Publication date: 2026-07-14.

article.articleHeadline: Leprosy declared Notifiable Disease in J&K
article.articleSummary: Jammu and Kashmir declared leprosy a Notifiable Disease across the union territory, enforcing immediate reporting of all diagnosed cases by public and private hospitals and healthcare providers. The order, issued under Section 2 of the Epidemic Diseases Act 1897, requires reporting to the Chief Medical Officer with copies to the District Leprosy Officer and State Leprosy Officer in the prescribed NLEP format, and takes immediate effect until further orders. This aligns with national and global strategies for leprosy control; India’s national prevalence has fallen from 57 per 10,000 people in 1983 to 0.57 per 10,000 in 2024-25. Leprosy is caused by Mycobacterium leprae and affects skin, peripheral nerves, mucosa of the upper respiratory tract, and eyes. It is curable, but delayed detection can cause permanent disabilities and ongoing transmission if not promptly identified and reported.

article.articleHeadline: आरोग्याचे 'बाळ'कडू : गोवर आणि लहान मुले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bitter Pill of Health: Measles and Young Children
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak is severe in Bangladesh, prompting the World Health Organization to issue heightened precautions for India, especially along the India–Bangladesh border, as of July 14, 2026. Measles is highly contagious and spreads via airborne droplets from coughing or sneezing. In young children, fever and rash are typical, accompanied by watery eyes, runny nose, and a troublesome cough. In measles, the rash usually appears on the third day of fever and then progresses from the face to the trunk and limbs, with fever often receding as the rash emerges. The report flags cross-border transmission risk in border regions; no lab-confirmed case counts or deaths are provided. The focus is on outbreak status, transmission mode, clinical features, and regional public health alerts.

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊环比增近3倍 专家称目前无需恐慌新冠
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: June sees a nearly threefold month-on-month increase in newly diagnosed COVID-19 cases; experts say there is no need to panic about COVID-19 for now.
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, China reported 79,000 new COVID-19 cases nationwide (June 1–30) across 31 provinces and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (underlying conditions). This followed eight consecutive months (Oct 2025–May 2026) of under 30,000 monthly cases; June's total is 3.61 times May’s 21,900 but far below June 2025’s 333,000. Peng Jie, deputy director of Infectious Diseases at Southern Hospital, Southern Medical University, cites waning antibodies over 4–6 months, summer travel, and prevalent indoor air conditioning with limited ventilation as factors in a temporary rise in transmission. The expert notes no pandemic signal, and no simultaneous increase in severity or mortality. Domestically, six oral antivirals are approved (RealBio’s Jiebei’an, Simcere’s Xianoxin, Junshi Biologics’ Mindwei, Zongsheng Pharmaceutical’s Leruling, Guangsheng Tang’s Taizhongding, Aisen’s Aowining); distribution is through hospitals or e-commerce, not yet widely sold in offline pharmacies.

triage.headline_ja: 6月新規コロナ確診が前月比約3倍増、専門家は「今のところパニックの必要なし」と表明
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な増加であり、専門家も重症度・死亡率の増加やパンデミックシグナルは無いとしており、既知の疾患の季節変動の範囲内と評価される。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に既知の流行性疾患であり、本記事は季節的な増加を報告する定例的な内容。専門家コメントにより深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念はないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận nhiều người bị giun lươn ở Khánh Hòa, bác sĩ cảnh báo mức độ nguy hiểm nếu không điều trị sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people infected with eelworms in Khanh Hoa Province, doctors warn of the danger if not treated early.
article.articleSummary: Strongyloides stercoralis infection (strongyloidiasis) is increasing in Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam. From March 1 to July 8, 2026, Khanh Hoa Provincial Tropical Disease Hospital performed 2,848 tests for eelworm, with 635 positives. The facility can diagnose, test, and treat parasitic infections, including strongyloidiasis, according to national guidelines. Clinicians warn the infection does not self-resolve or respond to standard dewormers; early diagnosis via ELISA serology and treatment with ivermectin are essential to prevent serious complications. The parasite’s life cycle starts when eggs in feces release larvae in soil; larvae penetrate the skin (often barefoot), migrate to the lungs, then to the small intestine, and can autoinfect, sustaining infection for decades. Preventive measures include personal hygiene, wearing protective footwear in soil-exposed settings, proper manure management, and screening before high-dose or prolonged immunosuppressive therapy.

triage.headline_ja: カインホア省で多数の糞線虫症患者を確認、医師が早期治療しない場合の危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: 土壌媒介性寄生虫症の風土病的な増加であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や急速な国際拡大のリスクは低く、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 糞線虫症は土壌媒介性の寄生虫感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。地域の医療機関が診断・治療体制を有しており、外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Corona Virus Returns: ಆಂಧ್ರಪ್ರದೇಶಗಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊರೊನಾಗೆ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಬಲಿ; ಕರ್ನಾಟಕಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಒಕ್ಕರಿಸಲಿದೆಯೇ ಕೋವಿಡ್ ಮಹಾಮಾರಿ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus Returns: Two people killed by coronavirus in Andhra Pradesh; has the COVID-19 pandemic reached Karnataka again?
article.articleSummary: Kadapa district in Andhra Pradesh reported two COVID-19 deaths and eight new positive cases, with five samples sent to NIV Pune for testing amid suspected emergence of a new Wuhan-origin variant; results awaited. In neighbouring Karnataka, concerns rise as cases increase: June saw 14 positives, while the last ten days brought the tally to 32 from among 193 suspected individuals tested. Health department commissioner Gurudatt Hegde said the Kadapa fatalities are under investigation and that the state's detected cases are not yet serious; asymptomatic infections were found primarily during mandatory testing in surgeries. Officials are coordinating with Andhra authorities, and daily monitoring continues; there is no need for panic. More than 30 people in Karnataka have tested positive to date.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルス再来：アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でコロナにより2人死亡；カルナータカ州にも再びコロナ禍が及ぶのか？
triage.triage_reason: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID-19による死亡例と新変異株疑いが報告され、隣接するカルナータカ州でも陽性者数が増加しているが、当局は「パニックの必要はない」としており、重症度・国際的拡大の証拠は乏しいため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 新変異株（Wuhan-origin疑い）の検体はNIV Puneで検査中であり結果待ち。現時点で確定情報はなく、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: After three deaths, TN allays Covid outbreak fears
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu reports no evidence of a high-severity Covid-19 strain; case numbers remain lower than in prior years. Whole-genome sequencing at NIV Pune shows the circulating strain causes only mild illness, and officials urge reliance on official updates. After two deaths in Andhra Pradesh and a third incidental case in Vellore, authorities are monitoring the situation. A 52-year-old man from Andhra Pradesh, moved from Tirupati to Vellore on June 26, was diagnosed with Klebsiella pneumonia along with Covid-19; he had diabetes and chronic kidney disease and died June 28 from complications of the bacterial infection and ARDS. People with fever, cough, sore throat, or respiratory distress should visit the nearest government hospital and take routine precautions; elderly, pregnant, and immunocompromised individuals should stay cautious. Monitoring continues as of 14 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 3人の死亡後、タミル・ナードゥ州がコロナ流行の懸念を否定
triage.triage_reason: 全ゲノム解析で軽症株と確認され、死亡例も基礎疾患・細菌性肺炎による合併症が主因とされており、当局も流行を否定している。IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも明確な該当なし。
triage.notes: 疾患名にNipahが含まれているが、記事本文にはNipahに関する言及は一切なく、誤タグ付けと考えられる。記事はCOVID-19軽症株に関する当局の火消し報道。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱ワクチンの臨床試験開始、コンゴ流行株で初、英オックスフォード大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clinical trials of Ebola vaccine begin, first for the Congo outbreak strain, at Oxford University, UK.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University, United Kingdom, announced on July 13, 2026, the world’s first clinical trial of a vaccine for Ebola virus disease targeting the Bundibugyo strain, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The trial recruits 50 participants aged 18–55, with vaccination expected in coming weeks. The vaccine, developed by Oxford researchers and manufactured at an Indian facility, will be assessed for safety and immune response. UK regulators have approved the study, which will be conducted in Britain, with preparations for Africa underway. Ebola remains active in eastern Congo since spring, with the WHO warning of strained health systems. The Congolese health ministry reported 1,926 infections and 702 deaths as of this month.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱ワクチンの臨床試験開始、コンゴ流行株で初、英オックスフォード大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で継続するエボラ出血熱流行（感染1,926例、死亡702例）を背景に、初のBundibugyo株対応ワクチン臨床試験が開始されたとの報道であり、既存の深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威に関連する重要シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はオックスフォード大学でのワクチン臨床試験開始を主題とするが、対象疾患は現在進行中のコンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱流行（Bundibugyo株）。ワクチン試験自体は英国内で実施され、製造はインドの施設だが、これらは発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Exclusive-US to block citizens in Congo from immediate travel home, citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: U.S. blocks American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from flying to the United States on commercial flights, placing them on a do-not-board list for 21 days in a third country under Title 49. The restriction follows a widening Ebola outbreak in Congo, with confirmed cases reaching 1,926 and 702 deaths across multiple provinces as of late Sunday. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, and bleeding. About two dozen Americans who recently traveled to Congo were set to depart for the United States, with the State Department offering support during the waiting period. The CDC confirmed a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus in Congo; one American treated in Germany (Frankfurt) and another, Dr. Peter Stafford, transported to Germany for care. Notably, risks include potential spillover to areas just hours outside Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: 独占：米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴにいる自国民の即時帰国便搭乗を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大し（症例1,926件、死亡702件）、米国が自国民の渡航制限を実施、ドイツへの患者搬送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの流行拡大が記事の主題であり、キンシャサ近郊への波及リスクも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: EXCLUSIVE: US to block citizens in Congo from immediate travel home, citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to widen, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across multiple provinces, including near Kinshasa. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus has been identified in U.S. cases linked to Congo; one American humanitarian worker tested positive, with another American patient evacuated to Germany (Frankfurt University Hospital). Dr. Peter Stafford, another American patient, was also brought to Germany for treatment. Roughly two dozen Americans who had traveled to Congo were set to fly home before new restrictions. To curb international spread, the United States is blocking U.S. citizens in Congo from commercial flights home, placing them on a do-not-board list for 21 days in a third country under Title 49. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, and bleeding; authorities warn of spread toward Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: 独占：米国、エボラを理由にコンゴにいる自国民の即時帰国便搭乗を禁止へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が拡大（1,926症例、702死亡）し、米国・ドイツへの越境感染例が確認され、米国が渡航制限措置を発動しているため、IHR基準を複数満たすフルRRA相当の事案。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツでの症例は輸入例であり、発生源はDRC。対象国リストに米国・ドイツは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: US to block citizens in Congo from immediate travel home, citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: U.S. blocks American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from travel home under Title 49, placing them on a do-not-board list until they spend at least 21 days in a third country before boarding to the U.S. The restriction comes as Ebola spreads to multiple Congo provinces, with 1,926 cases and 702 deaths. Ebola, transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids, causes fever, vomiting and bleeding. About two dozen Americans who traveled to Congo were set to board home, with State Department support. Health officials cited risks near Kinshasa; the order was signed by HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The CDC said a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus; one American treated at Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany, and another Dr. Peter Stafford was brought to Germany for treatment after Congo infection in May.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴ在住米国人の即時帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で複数州にエボラが拡大し1,926症例・702死亡と深刻な公衆衛生被害が発生、国際的な感染者輸送（独・米）も確認され、米国が渡航制限措置を実施しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 感染者はドイツ（フランクフルト）や米国にも渡航・搬送されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスであり、致死率・拡大状況から高いリスクと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉病毒！川普政府禁剛果美籍公民直接返美 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Block Ebola Virus! The Trump administration bans Congolese-American citizens from directly returning to the United States - Minshi News Network.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces a severe Ebola outbreak with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across provinces. In response, the Trump administration issued a Title 49 directive barring Congolese-American citizens from returning to the United States on commercial flights; they must spend 21 days in a third country before entry, effectively placing them on a no-fly list during incubation. About 24 Americans who had visited Congo were preparing to fly home, with the State Department assisting during isolation. HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. signed the order, citing rising risk as the virus has reached areas within hours’ drive of Kinshasa. The CDC said a U.S. citizen working for a Congolese humanitarian organization tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was treated at Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany; in May, another American doctor, Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola in Congo and was treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス阻止！トランプ政権、コンゴ系米国人の直接米国帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,926件・死亡702人という大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、米国が渡航制限措置（Title 49指令）を発動、ドイツでの症例治療も報告されるなど国際的拡大とIHR基準複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行であり、ドイツ・米国は治療・渡航制限対応先として言及されているのみで、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 中国で6月にコロナ感染者が増加、全国で7万9000件の感染確認
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 infections rose in China in June, with 79,000 confirmed cases nationwide.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections rose across China in June, with 79,000 new confirmed cases nationwide, including 130 serious cases and 1 death. The China CDC reported these figures on its official site. Sentinel hospitals showed increasing COVID-19 positivity among influenza-like illness outpatients: 2.9% in the first week of June, 4.1% in the second, 5.3% in the third, and 6.4% in the fourth. For the period June 29–July 5, respiratory specimens from ILI outpatients were most often positive for influenza virus (11.6%), coronavirus (9.6%), and enterovirus (9.1%). The China CDC urged the public to wear masks in healthcare settings and crowded places, including travel by airplane, train, or subway, and emphasized proactive vaccination for pregnant women, children, older adults, and people with chronic conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で6月にコロナ感染者が増加、全国で7万9000件の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的増加を示す通常のサーベイランス報告であり、重症度は低いが呼吸器系病原体の継続的曝露とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる公式統計に基づく季節性COVID-19増加の定期報告。重症化率・死亡率は低く、既存の対策（マスク着用、ワクチン接種推奨）で対応可能とされる。

article.articleHeadline: [건강칼럼] 해외여행의 설렘 뒤 숨은 위험, "감염병 이렇게 대비한다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Health Column] The Hidden Dangers Behind the Excitement of International Travel: How to Prepare for Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Pre-travel health management is essential as infection risk rises with changing environments. Vaccination and precautions depend on destination. Yellow fever vaccination is often mandatory for Africa and Latin America, given at least 10 days before departure with lifelong immunity. Hepatitis A, Typhoid, and Cholera vaccines are recommended for long trips to Southeast Asia, Africa, and Latin America: Hepatitis A first dose two weeks before travel; Typhoid one dose two weeks before; Cholera two oral doses 1–2 weeks apart completed by one week before travel. Meningococcal vaccine is advised for central Africa 10 days before departure. Malaria has no vaccine; use chemoprophylaxis (e.g., Malarone) starting 1–2 days before travel and continuing during and for a week after. Food/water safety: boil water, avoid street ice, eat well-cooked foods, peeled fruits. Mosquito protection: loose clothing, repellents every 3–4 hours, bed nets, avoid outdoor activity at dusk/dawn. Post-travel warning signs include fever ≥38°C after Africa/Southeast Asia/Amazon, rash, severe headache with altered consciousness, or persistent diarrhea; seek urgent care. Special groups (pregnant, infants, chronic disease) should prepare with English prescriptions and up-to-date vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: [健康コラム] 海外旅行のときめきの裏に潜む危険、「感染症はこう備える」
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、海外旅行前の一般的な感染症予防・健康管理に関する啓発コラムであり、シグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の国・地域での感染症アウトブレイクを報じたものではなく、渡航前の一般的な予防接種・感染対策に関する健康コラムである。発生地域として付与されたBrazil/Africaは記事内容と無関係。

article.articleHeadline: 以伊波拉疫情为由 美拟禁在刚果的公民立即回国 - 国际 - 带你看世界
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Using the Ebola outbreak as a pretext, the U.S. plans to order American citizens in Congo to return home immediately.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) expands to 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of Sunday. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain causes high fever, vomiting, and both internal and external bleeding. In response, a White House official announced a rule under Title 49 of the U.S. Code Transportation Authorization barring Americans in Congo or who have recently left Congo from boarding commercial flights to the United States until they spend 21 days in a third country. About 20 Americans in Congo were set to fly home on Tuesday; the State Department will assist affected individuals. Separately, the U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary signed an order citing rising risk with the virus approaching Kinshasa. CDC reports an American humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; another infected American was hospitalized at Frankfurt University Hospital, Germany. Earlier, CDC had confirmed Dr. Stafford’s Ebola infection among a mission group member treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行を理由に、米国はコンゴにいる自国民の即時帰国を計画
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス)の症例1,926人・死亡702人に拡大し首都キンシャサに接近、米国が渡航制限措置を発動するなど国際的対応が生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツでの感染者確認は帰国者・搬送例であり、発生地域は依然としてDRC。首都キンシャサへの接近が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliche Krankheit: Experte - Ebola-Ausbruch könnte bis nächstes Jahr andauern
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous Disease: Expert – Ebola Outbreak Could Last Until Next Year.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could last into 2027, according to Martin Grobusch, an Amsterdam-based tropical medicine specialist. The number of laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 1,926, with Bunia cited as a hotspot in the DRC. An imported case has reached Germany: a US physician flown to Frankfurt for treatment after contracting Ebola in Congo. The article highlights Bunia (DRC), Amsterdam (Grobusch’s base), and Frankfurt (Germany) among the key locations. Experts view the outbreak as ongoing, with no end in sight, given the large number of infections and sustained transmission in the region. The infection source is Congo, and the report notes international implications due to export of a case for care.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な感染症：専門家によるとエボラ流行は来年まで続く可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が拡大し確定症例1,926人に達し、さらに感染者がドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的拡大が実際に発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国人医師がコンゴでエボラに感染しドイツ・フランクフルトへ搬送された事例は、対象国リストに含まれないドイツ・米国での話であるため verified_locations には含めていない。感染発生地であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliche Krankheit: Experte: Ebola-Ausbruch könnte bis nächstes Jahr andauern
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous disease: Expert says the Ebola outbreak could last until next year.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (northeast region) driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The disease is life-threatening with transmission via body contact and bodily fluids. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo strain yet, though vaccine development is underway. Since early July, clinical testing has begun for two antivirals: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and Remdesivir. A US physician treated in Berlin’s Charité in May–June with a combination of these agents reportedly recovered. Africa CDC highlights challenges in contact tracing amid regional skepticism, and multiple treatment centers have been attacked to access deceased patients, who remain highly infectious and require burial under strict safety protocols. Some patients reportedly escape isolation. Latest government figures: 702 deaths and 318 recoveries as of 14 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な疾病：専門家はエボラ流行が来年まで続く可能性があると指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行が継続中（702名死亡）で、ワクチン・特異的治療薬が未確立、接触追跡の困難や隔離離脱例もありヒトーヒト感染拡大のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株はワクチン未整備で希少な株。ベルリンでの治療例はドイツ国内事例だが対象国リストに含まれず除外。DRC北東部が主要発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: Experte: Ebola-Ausbruch könnte bis nächstes Jahr andauern | Foto: Moses Sawasawa/AP/dpa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert: Ebola outbreak could last until next year | Photo: Moses Sawasawa/AP/dpa
article.articleSummary: 1,926 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 702 deaths and 318 recoveries as of July 14, 2026. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, remains hard to contain amid community resistance; treatment centers have been attacked and corpses are highly infectious, requiring strict burial measures. A US physician treated in Berlin’s Charité was flown to Frankfurt, where he recovered after receiving Remdesivir and MBP134, a monoclonal antibody, in a clinical trial. A Bundibugyo vaccine is not yet available, though development continues. Africa CDC cites challenges in contact tracing; authorities stress finding and treating patients and identifying contacts. An exported case in Frankfurt highlights cross-border risk. Expert Martin Grobusch of the University of Amsterdam projects the outbreak could last into 2027, depending on tracing roughly 90% of at-risk contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家:エボラ流行は来年まで続く可能性 | 写真:Moses Sawasawa/AP/dpa
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,926例・702名死亡の大規模エボラ流行が続いており、既に感染者がドイツへ越境搬送された実績があるため国際的拡大リスクが顕在化している。
triage.notes: 感染者の国際搬送（ドイツ・フランクフルトでの治療）が既に発生しており、越境拡大のリスクが実証済み。ワクチン未確立、地域コミュニティの抵抗、治療施設への攻撃など制御が困難な状況。Africa CDCも接触者追跡の課題を指摘しており、2027年まで長期化する可能性が専門家により指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliche Krankheit: Experte: Ebola-Ausbruch könnte bis nächstes Jahr andauern - Wissenschaft - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous disease: Expert says the Ebola outbreak could last until next year - Science - Rhein-Zeitung.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could last into next year, according to Amsterdam-based expert Martin Grobusch. The outbreak has 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with 318 recovered. One U.S. doctor treated in Frankfurt was among the exported patients, having contracted the virus in Congo. Despite ongoing public health work, identifying contact persons is improving, with about 90% of identified contacts now deemed at risk. Vaccination is not the central path to control; successful containment relies on thorough contact tracing and treating patients. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain lacks a vaccine or specific therapy, though new options are being tested. Since early July, clinical trials of MBP134 monoclonal antibody and Remdesivir are underway. Africa CDC warns of challenges in contact tracing and regional skepticism; several treatment centers have been attacked, and burials require special precautions due to high contagion of the dead.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な感染症：専門家「エボラ流行は来年まで続く可能性」 - 科学 - Rhein-Zeitung
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、既に感染者がフランクフルトへ搬送されるなど国際的拡大が実証されており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はワクチン・特効薬がなく、モノクローナル抗体MBP134やレムデシビルの治験が進行中。接触者追跡への抵抗や治療センターへの攻撃など対応の困難さが指摘されている。米国人医師がフランクフルトへ搬送・治療された事実は国際的拡大の明確な証拠。

article.articleHeadline: 노을 '마이랩', 하버드 의대 연구진 국제학술지 논문서 AI 말라리아 진단 핵심 사례로 조명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Noeul's 'MyLab' spotlighted as a key AI-based malaria-diagnosis case in a paper by Harvard Medical School researchers in an international academic journal
article.articleSummary: Noeul's AI-based malaria diagnosis solution miLab MAL is highlighted as a leading commercialization case in a Harvard Medical School-led scoping review published in npj Digital Medicine (Nature Portfolio). The review maps malaria diagnostics from microscopy, rapid diagnostic tests, and PCR to AI, praising miLab MAL for on-device AI and solid-stain imaging that automate microscopy-based steps, reducing reliance on skilled personnel and infrastructure. Global malaria burden is cited at about 260.3 million cases and 597,000 deaths. In validation, Labcorp reported 100% sensitivity and 100% specificity. A multi-center Ethiopian and Ghana study with 2,201 febrile patients (PCR reference) showed tropical malaria sensitivity 97.4% and specificity 98.8%, and vivax malaria 95.9% sensitivity and 97.8% specificity, with miLab detecting more PCR-confirmed infections than conventional microscopy. The article underscores miLab MAL’s real-world clinical value, scalability, and recognition by an authority-doctoral research team and Nature Portfolio journal (IF 18).

triage.headline_ja: Noeulの「MyLab」、ハーバード大学医学部研究チームの国際学術誌論文でAIマラリア診断の主要事例として紹介
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はAI診断機器の学術的評価・商業的成功事例の紹介であり、感染症の発生・流行に関する公衆衛生上の懸念は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア診断AI製品(miLab MAL)の学術論文紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ガーナ・エチオピアは過去の臨床試験実施地として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 这种蚊子咬出来的脑炎，最爱找孩子"下手"，家长要注意！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This type of mosquito-borne encephalitis is most likely to target children—parents, take note!
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis (JEV) is an acute central nervous system infection transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly Culex tritaeniorhynchus, with pigs as an amplifying host; humans are incidental hosts and there is no direct human-to-human transmission. In China, JEV incidence rises in summer to autumn, peaking July–September, with unvaccinated children as a high-risk group. The incubation period is 4–21 days (usually 10–14). Early symptoms resemble fever, headache, vomiting, and lethargy; progression can involve the brain, causing altered consciousness, seizures, coma, respiratory failure, and potentially death; about 30% of severe cases have long-term neurological sequelae. Prevention combines vaccination and vector control. China offers free vaccination for children under the national schedule (8 months and 2 years). Unvaccinated infants under 8 months, or adults in endemic areas or with pig-related exposure, should seek vaccination guidance; employ mosquito barriers and remove standing water.

triage.headline_ja: このような蚊が媒介する脳炎は子供を最も狙いやすい――保護者は注意を！
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、日本脳炎に関する季節性の一般啓発・予防知識を伝える記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は日本脳炎の一般的な疫学情報・予防啓発内容であり、具体的な発生事例や患者数の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果伊波拉疫情扩散 美国禁公民直飞返美
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads in Congo; U.S. bans direct flights for citizens returning to the United States.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts U.S. flight bans for citizens returning home. A White House directive places Americans currently in Congo or recently departing on a no-fly list, requiring at least 21 days in a third country before re-entering the United States. Roughly 20 Americans scheduled to fly home today are affected; the State Department will assist them during the ban. The CDC confirmed that last Friday a U.S. humanitarian worker in Congo was diagnosed with Bundibugyо ebolavirus and is being treated at Frankfurt University Hospital, Germany. A separate American Ebola infection in May was also treated in Germany. The report notes ongoing international response but does not provide a death count.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行拡大、米国は自国民の直行帰国便を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにより、米国が自国民に対する渡航制限（直行便禁止）を実施し、感染者がドイツで治療を受けているなど、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）の発生であり、米国・ドイツは感染者の避難・治療先として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。死亡者数など詳細情報は本記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Why the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history is becoming more challenging
article.articleSummary: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history is facing new challenges as it spreads to Goma, a major city and humanitarian hub, where rebels backed by neighboring Rwanda seized control over a year ago. In Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter, local responders are increasingly strained, with staff voicing pay and safety concerns. On Monday, employees at a treatment center in Ituri closed the facility, blocked access, and burned a tire, amid weeks of risky crisis work and little or no pay from the Congolese government. Striking personnel include epidemiologists, case investigators, drivers, and gravediggers, underscoring deteriorating morale and capacity to respond. The article notes the growing difficulty of outbreak response due to security disruptions and workforce unrest as of July 14, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行、さらなる困難に直面
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の主要都市ゴマに拡大し、治安悪化と対応要員のストライキにより公衆衛生対応能力が著しく低下している。深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクいずれも該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ゴマとイトゥリ州はいずれもDRC国内。ルワンダは反政府勢力の支援国として言及されているのみで、流行発生地ではないため対象国リストから除外。治安不安・給与未払いによる対応要員のストライキが対応能力低下の主因として強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola treatment workers strike in DR Congo over unpaid wages amid worsening outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) worsens as workers at Rwampara General Hospital protest unpaid salaries for two months, shutting the Ebola treatment center, blocking roads and burning tires. Ituri is the outbreak epicenter; authorities say the outbreak has spread to two additional provinces, with 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of 14 July 2026. The strike coincides with ongoing outbreak response, including a separate treatment center where two experimental Ebola therapies began clinical trials earlier this month. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 after initial cases went undetected, partly due to testing for a more common strain. WHO notes a second American humanitarian worker infected in eastern Congo has been transferred to Germany for treatment; the first American infected is also being treated there.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療従事者が未払い賃金を巡りストライキ、アウトブレイクは悪化
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例1,926件・死亡702件のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が拡大し、複数州への拡大や国際医療従事者の感染・国外搬送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 感染治療センターの閉鎖につながるストライキが対応能力に直接影響しており、承認されたワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株であることも懸念材料。ドイツへの搬送は国際医療従事者の感染例であり、DRC国内の流行状況が主題であるためドイツはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: UK Begins Human Trials of New Ebola Vaccine in Just 57 Days as Scientists Race to Stop Deadly Virus
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda prompts UK human trials. Since the WHO declared a public health emergency on 17 May, the outbreak has reported about 1,800 confirmed cases and at least 625 deaths. In Oxford, Phase 1 trials begin with 50 healthy volunteers aged 18–55 to assess safety and immunogenicity of an experimental Bundibugyo-targeting vaccine based on the ChAdOx1 viral vector, the same platform used for the Oxford–AstraZeneca Covid vaccine. The vaccine uses a harmless modified vector to deliver genetic instructions for a Bundibugyo virus protein, aiming to provoke immunity without infection. Serum Institute has stockpiled roughly 620,000 doses, including 4,000 investigational UK doses, funded by CEPI. If safe and immunogenic, larger trials are planned in Uganda with MRC and LSHTM; expansion in Africa could follow. No approved vaccine currently exists for the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、致死性ウイルス阻止へ科学者らが競う中、わずか57日で新型エボラワクチンのヒト治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定症例約1,800例、死亡625例以上）に関する情報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は英国での治験開始だが、背景にあるコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行がWHOによりPHEIC宣言されており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事象。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。UKも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Вакцину против нового штамма Эболы начали испытывать на людях
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A vaccine against a new strain of Ebola has begun to be tested on humans.
article.articleSummary: Vaccine against a new Ebola strain begins human trials. Phase I tests enroll 50 healthy volunteers to assess safety. The Serum Institute of India has produced about 620,000 doses for later phases, with 4,000 doses allocated for Phase I. The development follows a June 24 Ebola case in France involving a doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Japanese researchers warned that Ebola carriers from Africa could reach major European and Asian transit hubs within a month. In Africa, another Ebola outbreak prompted the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the DRC and Uganda, though it is not yet a pandemic. The article notes broader questions about the virus's characteristics and available treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 新型エボラ株に対するワクチンのヒト臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC/ウガンダでのエボラ流行がWHOによりPHEICと宣言されており、新株ワクチンの人体試験開始やフランスでの輸入症例など国際的拡大の懸念があるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は新型エボラ株ワクチンのPhase I試験開始（インドSerum Institute製造）だが、背景としてDRC・ウガンダでのアウトブレイクがWHOによりPHEICと宣言されている。フランスでの輸入症例（DRCから帰国した医師）も言及されているが、フランス・ウガンダ・インドは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外し、実際のアウトブレイク発生国であるDRCのみを列挙した。

article.articleHeadline: Número de mortes por ebola na República Democrática do Congo supera 700
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 700.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 700 deaths, reaching 702, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 318 recoveries. Five provinces remain under reinforced monitoring: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Health authorities noted the outbreak had spread to two additional provinces, Tshopo and Haut-Uele. The article cites the DRC Ministry of Communications and Media via Sputnik. Since May 17, the World Health Organization declared this DRC–Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing a high regional risk of spread. No specific symptoms, laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or imported/exported cases are provided in the article. Numbers reflect ongoing surveillance and cross-provincial spread within DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ流行で、死者700人超・複数州への拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行拡大を報告。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストにないため除外。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: US plans to bar its citizens in Congo from flying home directly amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: US imposes Title 49 travel restrictions on Americans in the Democratic Republic of Congo, barring US flights and placing those in Congo or recently out on a do-not-board list until they spend at least 21 days in a third country. Two dozen Americans were expected to board flights on Tuesday after traveling to Congo; the State Department will assist during the waiting period. A July 12 advisory warns that Ebola exposure could require quarantine for up to 21 days at the traveler’s expense, with insurance potentially not covering costs. The Congo Ebola outbreak has 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across several provinces. The CDC reported a US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola. An infected American was treated in Frankfurt, and Dr. Peter Stafford was evacuated to Germany. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴでのエボラ流行を受け、コンゴ在住米国人の直行便での帰国を禁止する方針
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,926症例・702死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が続いており、感染者がドイツ・米国関係者にまで及び国際的拡大とみられる事例が発生、米国は渡航制限（Title 49）を発動しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 感染者のドイツ搬送や米国人感染者の報告があるが、これらは流行地であるコンゴからの輸出例であり、発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみと判断。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rośnie obawa przed zabójczym wirusem z Afryki. USA zamykają granicę nawet dla Amerykanów
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over a deadly virus from Africa is growing. The U.S. is closing the border even to Americans.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 1,900 confirmed infections and 700 deaths since May, with no therapy or vaccine. The United States tightens travel rules: Americans who have been in the DRC or left must complete a 21‑day quarantine in a third country before boarding U.S. flights, per a July 13 order by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. As of July 14, over 20 Americans with DRC exposure were slated to fly to the U.S. but will be quarantined abroad with State Department support. CDC reports a U.S. humanitarian worker in DRC infected with Bundibugyo, arriving at Frankfurt University Hospital July 13; a prior case, Dr. Peter Stafford, was treated in Germany in May. Transmission is via bodily fluids; incubation up to 21 days; flu‑like symptoms can progress to hemorrhage. Outbreaks seed from wildlife, especially fruit bats; Bundibugyo mortality up to 30%.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ発の致死性ウイルスへの懸念が高まる。米国は自国民に対しても国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が1900人感染・700人死亡と深刻で、米国が渡航制限措置を発動し国際的な公衆衛生・渡航政策への影響が生じているため。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツでの症例は渡航者・医療従事者の輸入例であり、感染発生地はDRC。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine trial launched in Oxford in response to deadly outbreak
article.articleSummary: Phase 1 trial in Oxford evaluating safety and immune response of the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55, amid Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization had declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern 57 days earlier. Developed by the Oxford Vaccine Group and Pandemic Sciences Institute, the vaccine uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca Covid-19 vaccine. The effort is funded by CEPI as part of an $8.6 million programme to advance Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines. Serum Institute of India has manufactured and stockpiled about 620,000 doses in two weeks and supplied 4,000 investigational doses for this trial. Preparations are underway for further studies with Ugandan partners pending regulatory approval. If Phase 1 succeeds, late-stage trials to support emergency use authorization or licensure are planned with CEPI collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォードで致死的アウトブレイクへの対応としてワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はCOVID-19ではなくDRC・ウガンダで発生しWHOがPHEICを宣言済みのBundibugyoエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクに関するワクチン治験の続報であり、既に国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威と認識されている事案のため。
triage.notes: 疾患タグは『COVID-19』となっているが、記事本文はBundibugyoエボラウイルス病(DRC・ウガンダで発生、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み)に対するワクチン治験に関する内容。Bluedotの疾患分類ミスの可能性が高い。ワクチン開発拠点である英国(Oxford/England)、及びワクチン製造元のインドは発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: บุรีรัมย์ฉีดวัคซีน-ทำหมันหมาแมวฟรี 500 ตัว เดินหน้าป้องกันโรคพิษสุนัขบ้า
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buriram offers free vaccination and spaying/neutering for 500 dogs and cats to prevent rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-control drive in Buriram Province, Thailand, on July 14, 2026, offered free spaying/neutering for 200 dogs and cats and free rabies vaccination for 300 dogs and cats (total 500 animals), with public education on rabies prevention as part of a royal-commemoration initiative. The event, led by the Buriram Provincial Livestock Office and Buriram City Municipality, aimed to reduce stray populations and raise owner awareness, targeting long-term rabies control. In 2026 Buriram reported 8 laboratory-confirmed rabies samples across five districts: Mueang Buriram, Prakhon Chai, Ban Kruat, Lahan Sai, and Chaloem Phra Kiat. The last human rabies death occurred in August 2024 in Ko Kwian subdistrict, Lahan Sai District, underscoring ongoing risk. Officials urge prompt post-exposure treatment and annual vaccination for dogs and cats to sustain a rabies-free environment.

triage.headline_ja: ブリラム県、狂犬病予防のため犬猫500匹に無料ワクチン接種・去勢手術を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的な公衆衛生活動の報道であり、異常な流行や新規の重大リスクは確認されず、社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はタイの地方部で地域流行(enzootic)状態にあり、本記事は通常の予防啓発・ワクチン接種キャンペーンの一環。2026年に確認された8件の検査陽性動物例は継続的なリスクを示すが、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikanen in Congo: geen vluchten naar VS wegens ebola

article.articleHeadline: Assam's 87.7% vaccination success faces test as measles resurges across globe
article.articleSummary: Guwahati, July 14, 2026: Assam reports an 87.7% vaccination success yet warns that some children are missing immunization, even as measles resurges globally. Internationally, measles has re-emerged after decades of success with widespread immunization. The United States, which eliminated measles in 2000, now records over 1,800 cases across 39 jurisdictions this year. In Europe, outbreaks are reported in Romania, Italy, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Spain, while the Pan American Health Organization warns of a resurgence across the Americas. The World Health Organization notes measles outbreaks in every world region, driven largely by gaps in routine immunization coverage. The report underscores the need to sustain high vaccination uptake to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州の予防接種達成率87.7%、世界的な麻疹再流行の中で試練に直面
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の世界的な再流行を背景にアッサム州でも接種漏れが指摘されているが、具体的な症例数や重症度データが不足しており、現時点では継続的な情報収集が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事はアッサム州（インド）の予防接種率と世界的な麻疹流行傾向を取り上げているが、地域固有の症例数や重症度の詳細は記載されていない。米国・欧州諸国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tendance à l'extension d'Ebola dans d'autres provinces : Félix
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trend of Ebola's spread to other provinces: Félix.
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi chaired the 4th meeting of the National Ebola Response Task Force at the African Union City, noting Ebola’s persistence in Ituri Province and its spread to other provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Dr Steve Ahuka was designated as field manager of the outbreak response. Latest figures report 1,900 Ebola virus disease cases and 700 deaths, with over 300 patients recovered in the eastern DRC. Health Minister Dr Roger Kamba highlighted ongoing government community-sensitisation efforts and urged people to seek care promptly at first symptoms rather than delaying to the diarrhoea/vomiting phase. U.S. Chargé d’Affaires Lan J. McCary reaffirmed Washington’s support, citing more than $600 million allocated to the response. Remarks from Kisangani in Tshopo Province corroborate the recovery count and underscore cross-provincial spread.

triage.headline_ja: 他州へのエボラ拡大傾向：フェリックス大統領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がイトゥリ州から他州へ拡大しており、症例1900件・死亡700件という大規模アウトブレイクで、国際支援も動員されているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: エチオピアは発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文では言及されておらず主題ではないため除外。米国からの600万ドル超の支援表明あり、国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: US-Mediziner im Kongo infiziert: Ebola-Patient in Frankfurt eingetroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. physician infected in the Congo: Ebola patient has arrived in Frankfurt.
article.articleSummary: US physician infected with Bundibugyo Ebola virus arrived at Frankfurt University Hospital's special isolation ward for high-pathogenic pathogens on Monday night; condition stable. Second Ebola patient treated in Germany; May: US physician treated at Charité in Berlin; another infected person treated in France, both survived. Bundibugyo, a particularly dangerous Ebola subspecies, has no vaccine or approved drug. Early symptoms include fever and muscle pains; later diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain; severe cases cause bleeding under the skin and mucous membranes, risking organ failure. Transmission via contact with body fluids. Isolation ward maintained under negative pressure; staff wear powered air-purifying respirator suits and undergo decontamination after work; waste is separately disposed. Patient reportedly worked for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Treatment is supportive (fluids, electrolytes, sugar) to stabilize circulation; mortality reduced below 20%. Frankfurt is one of seven centers; public risk deemed none.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで感染した米国人医師、フランクフルトに到着：エボラ患者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)由来のブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス感染例がドイツ・フランス等複数国で治療されており、DRCでの感染拡大・アウトブレイクの可能性を示唆するため、フルリスク評価への移行が必要。
triage.notes: 本症例はコンゴ民主共和国での感染後にドイツへ医療搬送された事例。過去にも同様にベルリン（5月）、フランスでの治療例があり、DRCにおけるブンディブギョ型エボラの発生状況について続報を要確認。ドイツ・フランス・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 scare in India after 2 deaths in Andhra Pradesh: Odisha on alert ahead of Rath Yatra, TN says no need to fear
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 scare in India after two deaths in Andhra Pradesh within 10 days prompts Odisha to heighten surveillance ahead of Rath Yatra in Puri. Odisha reports no active cases but steps up testing, monitoring and hospital preparedness as a precaution, with no immediate cause for concern per Public Health Director Rabindranath Mishra. Andhra Pradesh reported two deaths: the first on June 28 in Rajampeta (52-year-old with lung infection, bilateral kidney disease, diabetes and hypertension) who died after testing positive, and a second on July 7 in Kadapa district (46-year-old patient). 28 contacts were traced and eight tested positive; all are asymptomatic and under home isolation. Authorities formed a Rapid Response Team; 10-bed isolation wards were to be earmarked in government hospitals, and RT-PCR kits, Remdesivir, PPE and N95 masks kept ready. Tamil Nadu says there is no evidence of circulating COVID-19 and infections are lower than in previous years.

triage.headline_ja: インドでCOVID-19への懸念高まる：アンドラ・プラデーシュ州で2人死亡、オディシャ州はラート・ヤートラを前に警戒、タミル・ナードゥ州は懸念不要と発表
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19による散発的な死亡例（いずれも基礎疾患あり）が確認されたが、当局は活動的な感染拡大はないとし懸念不要としている。ただし大規模宗教行事（ラート・ヤートラ）を控え監視強化中のため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に風土病化しており、報告された死亡例は基礎疾患を有する高齢者。接触者8名は無症状で在宅隔離中。ラート・ヤートラという大規模集会前の予防的措置としての監視強化が主眼であり、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: USA wegen Ebola verhängen Einreisesperre für eigene Bürger aus DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA to impose entry ban on its own citizens from DR Congo over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak concerns prompt the United States to block direct entry of US citizens who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). A White House spokesperson said on Monday that US citizens who have stayed in the DRC or have recently left will be added to a flight ban list and may not enter the United States until they have spent 21 days in a third country. The report cites Washington, Kinshasa, and Bunia as locations involved. The policy is directed at travelers connected with the DRC and applies specifically to US citizens. The article does not provide case counts or transmission details.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にDRコンゴからの自国民入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: 米国がDRC滞在歴のある自国民に対して入国制限措置を導入しており、渡航制限が既に発生していることに加え、DRCでのエボラ流行という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が背景にある。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の入国制限措置に焦点を当てており、DRC国内のエボラ症例数や感染状況の詳細は記載されていない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フルリスク評価でDRCの流行状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: В мире начались первые испытания вакцины против нового штамма Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Around the world, the first trials of a vaccine against a new strain of Ebola have begun.
article.articleSummary: First-phase trials of a vaccine against the Ebola Bundibugyo strain began globally, enrolling 50 healthy adults to assess safety and immune response. About 4,000 doses were prepared for Phase 1. The Serum Institute of India has produced and stockpiled roughly 620,000 doses of the experimental vaccine for subsequent stages or potential emergency use. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform, similar to COVID-19 vaccines. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya notes that even if effective, it likely won't alter the current outbreak but will help prepare for future epidemics. The Bundibugyo outbreak spans several African countries with case fatality 50-70%. WHO data show cases rose in 2025; the strain was first detected in Uganda in 2007, with larger outbreaks since 2024. Ebola deaths in one African country reached 600.

triage.headline_ja: 世界で新型エボラ株に対するワクチンの初期治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイク自体はウガンダ含むアフリカ諸国で発生しており対象国リストに含まれず、インドはワクチン製造・備蓄の拠点として言及されているのみで疾病発生地ではないため、対象国に関するシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエボラ・ブンディブギョ株ワクチンの臨床試験開始であり、実際の流行地はウガンダを含むアフリカ諸国（対象国リスト外）。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチンを製造・備蓄しているという文脈でのみ登場し、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: US-Einreisesperre für eigene Bürger aus DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. entry ban for DR Congo's own citizens.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts a U.S. entry ban on direct travel for its citizens. U.S. citizens currently in Congo or who recently left are placed on a no-fly list and may enter the United States only after a 21-day waiting period in a third country. The measure affects about two dozen Americans planning to fly home. The decision was announced by a White House spokesperson; Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. cited the elevated Ebola risk, noting the disease is spreading in Congo and has reached within hours of Kinshasa. Official counts as of Sunday show 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide, with 702 deaths. The State Department said it would assist those affected during the wait.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国、コンゴ民主共和国からの自国民入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱がキンシャサ近郊まで拡大し、確認症例1,926件・死亡702件に達し、米国が自国民への入国制限措置を発動するなど国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。首都キンシャサ近郊への拡大と高い致死率（約36%）が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تمنع مواطنيها في الكونغو من العودة المباشرة إلى الوطن بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States bars its citizens in the Congo from returning directly home due to an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: The United States barred American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from returning home on commercial flights, requiring a 21-day stay in a third country before boarding. The move affects those currently in Congo or recent entrants, with about 24 Americans slated to fly home today (14 July 2026). The restriction coincides with an Ebola outbreak expanding across multiple provinces in the DRC, totaling 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths nationwide. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including high fever, vomiting, and both internal and external bleeding. The CDC reported a U.S. humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was evacuated to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany; a second American, doctor Peter Stafford, infected earlier in May, was also transported to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ、エボラ出血熱の流行を理由にコンゴにいる自国民の直接帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が拡大しており、米国による渡航制限措置や国際的な患者搬送（ドイツへの避難）も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ドイツ（フランクフルト）や米国は感染者の搬送・避難先であり、流行発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Yhdysvallat lykkää Kongossa olevien kansalaistensa kotiinpaluuta ebolan vuoksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States delays the repatriation of its citizens in the Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has infected nearly 2,000 people and caused about 700 deaths. The United States has delayed repatriation of its citizens in Congo, prohibiting travel home on commercial flights until individuals have spent at least 21 days in a third country. A White House official said the order applies to people currently in Congo or who have recently left. About 20 Americans who had traveled to Congo were slated to fly to the United States on Tuesday. The State Department will provide assistance to those affected during the three-week waiting period. Reuters reported that a United States citizen with Ebola is being treated in strict isolation in Frankfurt, Germany.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ合衆国、エボラ熱のためコンゴにいる自国民の帰国を延期
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約2000人感染・700人死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、フランクフルトでも米国人患者が隔離治療されるなど国際的拡大が確認されており、渡航制限措置も取られているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ドイツ（フランクフルト）や米国での症例言及があるが、これは輸入症例・治療事例であり、アウトブレイクの主発生地はコンゴ民主共和国であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。致死率が約35%と高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念事案。

article.articleHeadline: Prueban en humanos vacuna contra una nueva cepa del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine against a new strain of Ebola tested in humans.
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, the first human trial of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus began. The Phase I study will enroll 50 healthy adults to assess safety and immunogenicity of the experimental vaccine. The Serum Institute of India reported producing and storing about 620,000 doses for future trial stages and possible emergency use if efficacy is demonstrated, with 4,000 doses allocated to this initial phase. Even with favorable results, the vaccine is unlikely to alter the course of the current Ebola outbreak in the near term. Jean Kaseya, director-general of Africa CDC, noted that early-phase trials are not a quick solution for affected communities but are essential for developing better tools against future epidemics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の新株に対するワクチン、ヒト試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生ではなく、新規ワクチンの第I相臨床試験開始に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・臨床試験に関する内容であり、インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）としての言及のみで、感染症の発生国ではない。アフリカでの『現在進行中のアウトブレイク』への言及があるが具体的な国名は記載されておらず、対象国リストには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: สุรินทร์จัดโครงการปศุสัตว์ร่วมใจกำจัดภัยโรคพิษสุนัขบ้า เฉลิมพระเกียรติฯ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surin organizes a livestock project to unite in eradicating the rabies threat in honor of the King's birthday
article.articleSummary: Rabies elimination efforts were launched in Surin Province, Thailand, at Nong Muang Municipality, Nong Muang Subdistrict, Mueang Surin District, to honor the King’s birthday under the 'Dogs Free of Disease, People Safe from Rabies' program. Led by the Surin Department of Livestock, the initiative unites Public Health Office, Local Administrative Organization, Surin Public Relations Office, Surin Animal Quarantine Station, the Surin Hospital, and local communities to monitor, prevent and control the disease. Activities include spay/neuter surgeries for owned and underserved dogs and cats, vaccination of at-risk animals, and public education on prevention and responsible pet ownership to reduce outbreak risk. From July 4–10, 2026, Surin reported 18 animals with laboratory-confirmed rabies; residents are urged to vaccinate pets on schedule and report abnormal signs to livestock officials to strengthen control.

triage.headline_ja: スリン県、国王誕生日を記念し畜産関連機関が連携して狂犬病撲滅プロジェクトを実施
triage.triage_reason: タイ・スリン県における狂犬病予防・撲滅の定例啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、狂犬病はタイで風土病的に発生しているため異常性は低く、国際的拡大やヒトへの重大な影響も報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物（犬・猫）の狂犬病予防キャンペーンに関するもので、ヒトの感染例は報告されていない。7月4-10日に動物18頭で検査確定陽性とあるが、タイでは狂犬病が地域流行しているため異常事象とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا تمنع مواطنيها في الكونغو من "العودة المباشرة" بسبب تفشي "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States bars its citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from direct repatriation due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts the United States to bar direct repatriation of its citizens from DRC to the U.S. until they spend at least 21 days in a third country. As of late Sunday, Congo’s outbreak has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across multiple provinces. Ebola, a filovirus transmitted by direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or animal, causes high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. About 24 Americans who had traveled from DRC were scheduled to fly to the United States, with the State Department providing assistance during the waiting period. One American humanitarian worker in DRC has tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain and has been transported to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany for treatment. In May, another American, Dr. Peter Stafford, was reported infected with Ebola and moved to Germany for care.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行によりコンゴ民主共和国在住の自国民の「直接帰国」を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が1,926例・702人死亡に達し、渡航制限措置や国際的な感染拡大（ドイツへの患者搬送）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国およびドイツへの症例移送が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。発生地域リストにあるUganda、United States、Germanyは記事の主題（DRCでの流行）に基づき除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 英オックスフォード大、エボラ熱流行株ワクチンの治験開始
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: University of Oxford, UK begins clinical trials of the Ebola outbreak-strain vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University launched Phase I clinical trials of an Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, for outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The initial study enrolls 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Oxford to assess safety and immune response, with vaccination planned within weeks pending regulatory approval. The vaccine uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Serum Institute of India will manufacture about 620,000 doses within two weeks, providing 4,000 trial doses for the early research. If approvals are granted, preparations for additional Uganda trials proceed. Should Phase I prove safe and immunogenic, CEPI will support later-stage trials or emergency-use authorization with Oxford and SII.

triage.headline_ja: 英オックスフォード大、エボラ熱流行株ワクチンの治験開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラワクチンの第I相治験開始を報じる研究開発ニュースであり、新規の感染症発生や拡大を示すものではないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験（第I相、英オックスフォードで実施）に関する内容で、DRC・Ugandaは過去の流行株を対象とした将来的な治験地として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の感染拡大を報じるものではない。そのためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: यूपी से महाराष्ट्र तक सामने आए कोरोना के नए मामले, 2026 में फिर लौटेगा कोविड-19!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New cases of coronavirus emerge from Uttar Pradesh to Maharashtra; COVID-19 will return in 2026!
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, India records sparse new COVID-19 cases across Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Andhra Pradesh. In Varanasi, a 27-year-old man tests positive and is admitted to BHU’s Chest and TB department with breathing difficulties. Mumbai reports a new case, coinciding with John Kumar Sanu testing positive; his condition is stable. Andhra Pradesh has eight active cases and two recent deaths, with a 46-year-old Kadapa district resident dying and another case in Rajampeta, Annamayya district. Samples have been sent for genomic sequencing to determine possible new variants. Health authorities emphasize that this does not signal a renewed pandemic; COVID-19 is in an endemic phase, with immunity from vaccination or prior infection limiting severity. Preparedness includes rapid-response teams, control rooms, 10-bed isolation wards, and adequate stocks of tests, PPE, and masks. No lockdowns planned.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州からマハーラーシュトラ州まで新型コロナの新規感染確認、2026年に再流行か？
triage.triage_reason: インド複数州でCOVID-19散発例が報告されているが、当局はエンデミック期であり再流行ではないと強調しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに明確な該当はない。ただしゲノム解析中で新変異株の可能性を調査しているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知のCOVID-19エンデミックフェーズにおける散発的症例報告。当局は再流行を否定し、国内対応体制（隔離病床、検査・PPE備蓄等）で対応中。ゲノムシーケンシング結果が判明次第、新変異株の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 好市多冷凍蔬菜農藥殘留不合格、2批法國乾酪大腸桿菌數超標 邊境不准進口
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Costco frozen vegetables fail pesticide residue standards; two batches of French cheese exceed Escherichia coli limits; import prohibited at the border.
article.articleSummary: Costco's Kirkland Signature frozen mixed vegetables from the United States failed border pesticide residue tests: peas contained two banned pesticides and broccoli exceeded residue limits, totaling 17,756.8 kg. Taiwan's FDA will raise border sampling of US frozen vegetables to 20–50%. Two batches of French cheese also exceeded Escherichia coli limits. SCHERTENLEIB brand, imported by Dongyuan International, 10 pieces (1.8 kg); among five samples, 3 had E. coli counts of 10–100 per gram, exceeding the rule that at most two samples may be in that range. The second batch, FROMAGERIE PROVENCE by MOREL Co., 16 pieces (1.6 kg); five samples showed 460–1100 E. coli per gram. As a result, border checks for these importers are 100% and affected products must be returned or destroyed. Additional noncompliant items include Japanese cantaloupe, Vietnamese durian, Japanese mandarin, Malaysian peppercorns, Thai lettuce, and Chinese Echinacea extract with four unlisted preservatives; no substantiation provided.

triage.headline_ja: コストコの冷凍野菜が農薬残留基準不合格、フランス産チーズ2バッチが大腸菌基準超過、台湾国境で輸入禁止
triage.triage_reason: 国境検疫での食品規制違反（農薬残留・大腸菌基準超過）の事例であり、ヒトの感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。対象国での感染症発生とは無関係。
triage.notes: 本件は食品安全（農薬残留・大腸菌汚染）に関する国境検疫の是正措置報告であり、ヒトの感染症症例やアウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。対象国（ベトナム、中国、タイ等）はサプライヤー国として言及されているが、感染症発生地としての主題ではないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: 米、コンゴにいる自国民の即時帰国を禁止　エボラ出血熱流行理由
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. bans immediate repatriation of its nationals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak cited as the reason.
article.articleSummary: U.S. authorities barred immediate repatriation of Americans in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak. Under Title 49 transportation authorities, U.S. citizens who are currently in Congo or who recently left will be placed on a no-fly list and must spend at least 21 days in a third country before boarding a U.S.-bound flight. About 24 Americans who visited Congo were scheduled to fly to the United States on July 14; the State Department said it would assist those affected during the waiting period. The measure highlights public health precautions tied to Ebola outbreaks and travel, though no further outbreak details are provided in the summary.

triage.headline_ja: 米、コンゴにいる自国民の即時帰国を禁止　エボラ出血熱流行理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行を理由に米国が渡航制限措置を実施しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱流行によるコンゴからの米国人渡航制限措置について報じているが、流行の規模・症例数・地域拡大状況など詳細は記載されていない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。
