article.articleHeadline: 「夏季新冠」突襲中港台日四地！ 疾管署：本周全台恐進流行期 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer COVID-19 sweeps Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Japan; Taiwan CDC: This week, Taiwan as a whole could enter the epidemic phase.
article.articleSummary: Summer COVID-19 alert as of July 14, 2026: Taiwan CDC reports last week 2,811 outpatient/ER visits for COVID-19, up 34.4% from the prior week—the fifth straight weekly rise. Growth previously around 5% has surged to 30–40%, with officials forecasting a new wave potentially within days and a peak around mid-August. Nearby regions—Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Japan—have also seen 5–6 weeks of increases. Taiwan recorded 17 new local severe COVID-19 cases last week, with no new local deaths. If weekly visits exceed 5,000, a new epidemic period could begin, with the peak expected in about one to one-and-a-half months. This year’s peak is unlikely to exceed last year, estimated around 50,000 weekly visits at most. Public vaccination drive continues, extending free COVID-19 vaccines nationwide for residents 6 months and older through July 31, with about 456,000 doses in stock. High-risk groups (65+) and those with chronic diseases are prioritized, and many have not been vaccinated this season.

triage.headline_ja: 「夏の新型コロナ」が中国本土・香港・台湾・日本の4地域を襲う！台湾疾病管制署：今週中に全土が流行期に入る恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19流行拡大であり、台湾・中国・香港・日本で同時期の増加が見られるが、重症度や致死率の急増は確認されておらず、既知の病原体による通常の季節変動と評価されるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台湾・香港・日本は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには中国のみを記載。COVID-19は既知の病原体であり、記事内容も季節性流行の増加を報告する定期的な公衆衛生モニタリング情報である。重症者数（17件）・死亡者数（0件）は限定的で、昨年ピークを超えない見込みとされている。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄嚴防登革熱境外移入 東南亞返台快篩可獲500元禮券 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung tightens dengue prevention against overseas-imported cases; Southeast Asia returnees to Taiwan can receive a NT$500 gift voucher for rapid testing | PNN
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City launches a dengue prevention program targeting overseas-imported cases, offering a NT$500 (about US$) convenience-store voucher for rapid dengue testing to Southeast Asia returnees within 14 days of arrival, regardless of symptoms. The eligible Southeast Asian countries are Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, and Cambodia, with participants including locals, new residents, migrant workers, and school staff/students. The process requires a medical staff–conducted blood draw (about 5 mL) followed by a rapid test; all samples are sent to a laboratory for confirmation, with results in 1–2 days. The scheme aims to curb local dengue transmission by promoting early screening after travel. Kaohsiung’s CDC notes dengue infections are imported and that seven local cases have been cleared from alert, indicating the outbreak is stabilizing. Common symptoms include fever, headache, rash, diarrhea, and vomiting, though up to 70% may be asymptomatic but still contagious.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市がデング熱の海外流入を厳重警戒、東南アジアからの帰国者は迅速検査で500元の商品券を受け取れる｜公視新聞網 PNN
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における予防的スクリーニングプログラムの紹介記事であり、対象国（東南アジア諸国）はあくまで帰国者の渡航先として言及されているに過ぎず、これら諸国での発生を報じるものではない。台湾自体も対象国リストに含まれず、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾高雄市における輸入例対策の予防プログラムであり、ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン・タイ・シンガポール・カンボジアは帰国者の出発地として列挙されているのみで、これらの国での流行報告ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh Covid-19 Cases Reported In UP, Maharashtra And Andhra Pradesh; Will The Pandemic Return In 2026?
article.articleSummary: Fresh COVID-19 cases in Uttar Pradesh (Varanasi), Andhra Pradesh, and Maharashtra (Mumbai) signal ongoing, low-level circulation with no indication of a nationwide outbreak or lockdown as of 14 July 2026. In Varanasi, a 27-year-old Ashapuri resident tested positive after respiratory symptoms and is under treatment at Sir Sunderlal Hospital, BHU, illustrating continued presence but lower spread than previous waves. Andhra Pradesh reports eight active cases and two recent COVID-related deaths, including a 46-year-old man from Kadapa; samples are being genome-sequenced to monitor variants. In Mumbai, a new case involves singer Kumar Sanu’s son, Jaan Kumar Sanu, who is recovering under medical supervision. Officials describe the virus as endemic, with vaccination and prior infections reducing severe illness. Surveillance has strengthened; hospitals maintain isolation beds, testing kits, PPE, and N95 masks. No nationwide restrictions or mandatory masks, but at-risk individuals are advised caution.

triage.headline_ja: UP州、マハーラーシュトラ州、アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で新規COVID-19感染例が報告 ― 2026年にパンデミックは再来するか？
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既にエンデミック化しており、記事も低水準の散発的感染を報告しているのみで、全国的な流行拡大や規制強化の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 記事は著名人の感染例を含む散発的な国内報道であり、COVID-19はエンデミックとして扱われている。監視体制強化やゲノム解析の実施は通常のサーベイランス活動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Cases Rise in Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa; Two Patients Die, Health Alert Issued
article.articleSummary: Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, reports eight active COVID-19 cases and two deaths in YSR Kadapa district. A 52-year-old Rajampet man died at Christian Medical College, Vellore, after testing positive with fever and cough; another Kadapa patient, a 43-year-old man, died in Government General Hospital’s COVID-19 ICU. A 25-year-old Kadapa Medical College student has tested positive and is in home isolation. About 40 samples were collected; 18 tested negative, with others awaiting. Confirmed patients’ samples have been sent to a Pune laboratory for genome sequencing to identify the variant. Health officials deployed rapid response teams and intensified surveillance and sanitation. A statewide COVID-19 preparedness alert was issued; authorities will enforce protocols, mandate masks in crowded places including hospitals, test symptomatic individuals and contacts, and maintain isolation facilities.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパでCOVID-19症例が増加、2人死亡、健康警戒発令
triage.triage_reason: インド・アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州の一地区でCOVID-19症例増加と2人の死亡が報告され州レベルの警戒が発令されたが、症例数は少なく国際的な拡大やIHR基準への該当は現時点で確認できないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に地域流行している疾患であり、今回の報告は地方レベルの症例増加と州の健康警戒発令に留まる。ゲノム解析結果や変異株の有無など続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！國內出現境外移入茲卡病毒確定病例 男子泰國返台後發病-台視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case! Domestic confirmed Zika virus infection imported from abroad; a man fell ill after returning to Taiwan from Thailand - TTV News Network.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC confirms the year’s first domestically confirmed travel-associated Zika virus infection: a man in his 30s from the northern region who returned from Thailand in mid-June and fell ill with fever, dizziness, and headache; late June he developed a rash and sought medical care. Laboratory testing confirmed Zika virus infection. Contacts and cohabitants are asymptomatic. Public health authorities conducted environmental source cleanup at the patient’s activity areas, traced contacts, and provided education. As of July 13, Taiwan has 1 confirmed domestically imported Zika case this year. Since 2016, Taiwan has recorded 31 Zika virus infections, all imported, mainly from Southeast Asian countries. Zika transmits via Aedes mosquitoes or sexual contact, and can be passed from mother to fetus. Typical symptoms include fever, rash, and joint pain, usually milder than dengue; infection during pregnancy risks fetal microcephaly or fetal death.

article.articleHeadline: Американец позитивен на ебола, САД наредија карантин за сите патници од ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American tests positive for Ebola; the U.S. ordered quarantine for all passengers from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with over 1,700 infections noted as the virus spreads across multiple provinces due to population movement, per WHO. The United States imposes a travel ban under Title 49 on American citizens in Congo or who have recently left Congo from flying to the U.S. on commercial flights, requiring at least 21 days in a third country before boarding. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids. The CDC confirms a U.S. humanitarian worker tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. One infected American was admitted to a university hospital in Frankfurt, Germany, and another American, Dr. Peter Stafford (per NGO Serge Christian Mission), was infected and transported to Germany for treatment, per the CDC in May.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がエボラ陽性、米国がDRCからの全乗客に対し検疫措置を命令

article.articleHeadline: WHO says second US Ebola patient transferred to Germany, not Kenya
article.articleSummary: Second US humanitarian worker infected with Bundibugyo Ebola in Bunia, Ituri Province, DRC, has been transferred to Germany for continued care, WHO confirms, ending speculation that Kenya’s Nanyuki facility would receive patients. The patient, diagnosed with Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease, received WHO clinical care before evacuation to Germany. This identifies Germany, not Kenya, as the destination. The US CDC had confirmed infection but did not disclose transfer location. As of 14 July 2026, the eastern DRC outbreak has infected more than 1,947 people and caused over 700 deaths; the response is hampered by insecurity and misinformation. Four Red Cross volunteers were attacked amid rising false claims, and 12 community resistance incidents (seven verified on social media) have been reported. Germany has pledged €18 million to bolster surveillance, laboratory capacity, treatment, infection prevention, and emergency operations in DRC and neighboring countries to bring the outbreak under control.

article.articleHeadline: क्या कोरोना से भी खतरनाक है चांदीपुरा वायरस? गुजरात के साबरकांठा में जा रहीं लोगों की जानें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Chandipura virus more dangerous than the coronavirus? The lives of people traveling to Sabarkantha in Gujarat.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV) outbreaks in Sabarkantha district, Gujarat, prompt hospital admissions: at Himmatnagar Civil Hospital 9 pediatric patients admitted and 6 have died, with ongoing alerts from health authorities. Of 9 samples from children, 1 test is CHPV positive, 7 negative, and 1 pending; 2 patients are currently hospitalized. Nine pediatric samples have been sent to Gandhinagar laboratories (GDRC and Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre) for confirmation. CHPV is a rare, dangerous cause of acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) affecting under-15s; transmission occurs mainly via sandfly bites and is not known to spread between people. Symptoms resemble other febrile illnesses: sudden high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, severe headache, seizures, and potential rapid progression to coma. No specific antiviral or vaccine exists; protective measures include full-sleeve clothing to avoid bites. Malaria and dengue are also reported in the region, but CHPV confirmation remains uncertain; the situation raises concern for travelers to Sabarkantha.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスよりも危険なチャンディプラウイルス？グジャラート州サバルカンタで人命が失われている

triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介で人-人感染は知られていないが、致死率が高く小児に重篤な影響を及ぼすため注視が必要。確定診断は9検体中1件のみ陽性、7件陰性、1件保留と不確実性が残る。マラリア・デング熱も同地域で報告されているが本記事の主題はチャンディプラウイルス。

article.articleHeadline: Singapore contributes $2.5m to support Ebola outbreak response in Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Singapore will contribute US$2 million (S$2.5 million) to support the Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BVD) outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The funds, channeled through the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO), back the joint Continental Preparedness and Response Plan launched on June 5. The contribution will bolster on-the-ground efforts such as laboratory testing, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and case management. The announcement was made in a joint statement by Singapore's Ministry of Health and the Communicable Diseases Agency on July 14. This support aids regional readiness and response to the BVD outbreak in the DRC and Uganda as part of ongoing international coordinated efforts.

Health authorities have intensified surveillance and closely monitor the situation. Experts attribute endemicity to waning immunity and emergent variants, with periodic spikes possible. The article emphasizes awareness of new symptoms to watch for, though no specific laboratory confirmation or infection source details are provided. Public health measures focus on targeted surveillance and protecting high-risk groups while avoiding sensational escalation.

article.articleHeadline: 这种蚊媒传染病可致淋巴水肿，我国已消除，出国旅行仍需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lymphatic filariasis, a mosquito-borne disease that can cause lymphedema, has been eliminated in China; travelers abroad still need to be vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Lymphatic filariasis, a mosquito-borne parasitic disease caused by Wuchereria bancrofti, Brugia malayi and Brugia timori, can obstruct lymphatic vessels, leading to lymphedema and elephantiasis. After a mosquito bite, larvae mature in the lymphatics; long-standing infection may cause limb swelling and skin thickening, with possible fever, lymphadenitis, lymphangitis and eosinophilia. Diagnosis relies on clinical context plus tests such as nocturnal microfilariae detection, serology, molecular assays and imaging. China has eliminated lymphatic filariasis as a public health problem, achieving WHO elimination standards in 2007. Nevertheless, residual vectors exist in some areas, and international travel, labor, aid, and border exchanges keep imported cases possible. Globally, transmission persists in Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, Western Pacific islands, the Caribbean, and parts of South America, with ongoing preventive chemotherapy and surveillance. For travelers, risk is low for short stays but rises with prolonged exposure; use repellents, long sleeves/pants, and screened/bednet-protected accommodations, and seek care for persistent leg swelling with travel history; diagnostics include microfilariae detection, serology, molecular tests, and imaging.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介性のリンパ系フィラリア症、リンパ浮腫を引き起こす恐れ―中国は既に排除も海外渡航時は要注意
triage.triage_reason: 中国は既に排除済みで新規発生や異常事態の報告ではなく、一般啓発記事のため公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾患啓発・渡航者向け注意喚起の一般記事であり、中国国内での新規発生事例の報告ではない。発生地域として挙げられたUS(Missouri)やAfrica、Chinaは記事内で具体的な発生事例として言及されておらず、対象国リストとも一致しないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: U.S. bars citizens in DR Congo from commercial flights
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across multiple provinces since its May 15 declaration, with fears of regional spread. The United States imposes temporary travel restrictions on American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo (and those who recently departed), barring flights to the U.S. under Title 49 and placing about 24 travelers on a do-not-board list until they spend 21 days in a third country. Ebola transmits via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, causing high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and potential bleeding. Lab-confirmed Bundibugyo strain cases include an American humanitarian worker in the DRC; another patient evacuated to Frankfurt; a prior May case, Dr. Peter Stafford, transferred to Germany. WHO-backed clinical trials are pursuing Bundibugyo therapies; officials warn spillover toward Kinshasa is possible, and UNDP cautions significant regional economic impacts if the outbreak remains uncontrolled.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：米国がコンゴ民主共和国在住の自国民に商業便搭乗を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,926例・死亡702例に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、国際的な患者搬送や米国による渡航制限措置が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 患者のドイツ（フランクフルト）搬送や米国籍者への渡航制限は国際的拡大の兆候を示すが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: SUA blochează întoarcerea în țară a cetățenilor americani aflați în Congo, din cauza epidemiei de Ebola - HotNews.ro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States blocks American citizens in the Congo from returning home due to the Ebola outbreak - HotNews.ro
article.articleSummary: The United States barred American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from flying home on commercial flights, placing them on a 'do-not-board' list until they spend 21 days in a third country, under Title 49. The measure comes as Ebola outbreaks expand across multiple provinces in the DRC; confirmed cases reach 1,926 with 702 deaths. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. About 24 Americans who had traveled in Congo were due to board flights to the United States, with the State Department offering support during the waiting period. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. signed an order highlighting increased Ebola risks near Kinshasa. The CDC said an American humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Another infected American was hospitalized Monday in Frankfurt; previously, in May, Dr. Peter Stafford contracted Ebola and was transported to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行のためコンゴ滞在の米国民の帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ確定症例1926人・死亡702人と拡大が続いており、米国が渡航制限措置を講じ、感染者がドイツに搬送されるなど国際的拡大も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ドイツ（Hessen/Frankfurt）と米国は感染者の搬送先・帰国制限国であり、発生国はDRCのみ。対象国リストに独・米国は含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠疫情連5升「就診激增3成4」　疾管署：最快本周進入流行
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise for five straight weeks as clinic visits surge 34%, Taiwan CDC says it could enter an epidemic as early as this week.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan faces a summer resurgence of COVID-19 as the Taiwan CDC reports five consecutive weeks of rising outpatient/ER visits. In week 27 (Jul 5–11), 2,811 COVID-19 clinic/ED visits were recorded, up 34.4% from the prior week. Local severe cases rose by 17 last week; no new local deaths. The agency warns the epidemic threshold (emergency visits >0.3%) may be crossed this week or next, with a peak expected around August, potentially up to 50,000 weekly visits, lower than last year’s peaks of 70,000–120,000. Global positivity is rising; NB.1.8.1 is dominant, with increases in neighboring regions (China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Singapore). High-risk groups—65+ and those with chronic diseases—remain the focus, as most have not completed this season’s vaccination. Free public vaccination for those 6 months+ runs through 2026-07-31, with Moderna single-dose (450,000) and Novavax (600) doses. Antivirals remain stockpiled: Remdesivir 155,000 doses, Paxlovid (倍拉维) 113,000 courses, Xocova 18,000 courses; self-testing is encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ感染、5週連続増加「受診数34%急増」　台湾疾病管理署は今週にも流行入りの可能性と発表
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性COVID-19の通常の増加傾向であり、医療体制は逼迫しておらず、既存の対策（ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬備蓄）で対応可能なため、シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）における季節性COVID-19流行。近隣地域として中国・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールでの陽性率上昇にも言及されているが、これらは付随的情報であり主題ではない。対象国リストに含まれる中国のみverified_locationsに記載。台湾は既存の対策で管理可能であり、重症化率や死亡増加も見られないため、通常の季節性変動と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia-China Kembangkan Vaksin Demam Berdarah, Riset Dipimpin FKUI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia and China Develop Dengue Fever Vaccine, Research Led by the Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia and China are jointly developing a dengue fever vaccine using mRNA technology, leveraging genpreM-E material from a dengue strain native to Indonesia. The project involves Universitas Indonesia (UI), Tsinghua University (China), and PT Etana Biotechnologies Indonesia. Prototyping is led by the IDIRC, IMERI, FKUI under Prof. Dr. Beti Ernawati Dewi, PhD, since 2023. The multi-disciplinary effort combines virology, immunology, bioinformatics, and mRNA, with AI forecasting potential future mutations and a modified fusion loop to mitigate antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Indonesia’s Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin highlighted local production potential. Indonesia aims to locally produce 11 of 16 vaccine antigens for the national immunization program by 2030 (5 produced, 6 assembled or import-reliant). Dengue affects about 151,000 people and 650 deaths annually in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアと中国、デング熱ワクチンを共同開発 ― 研究はインドネシア大学医学部が主導
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱ワクチンの研究開発に関する内容であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱ワクチンの共同研究開発に関する報道であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。年間発生数（約15.1万人、死者650人）は既知の背景情報として言及されているのみ。中国は共同研究のパートナーとして言及されているが、疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Authorities Have Put Hyderabad On High Alert For Dengue, Here's What You Need to Know To Stay Safe
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad authorities have placed the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation on high alert for dengue as cases rise. The Health Department is boosting surveillance across government and private hospitals and field teams to rapidly verify patient details and track infections for early treatment. Mosquito control measures include fogging, inspecting breeding sites, and distributing larval control kits in affected areas, with weekly reviews to monitor the dengue situation. The article notes dengue risk spikes during the rainy season when rainwater collects in buckets, pots, tyres, coolers, and other containers, creating Aedes aegypti breeding grounds. Expert Dr. Dilip Gude attributes outbreaks to warm, unpredictable weather, poor waste disposal, unstable water supply prompting rainwater hoarding, unkempt open spaces, faulty drainage, and power outages that raise daytime mosquito bites.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード当局、デング熱に対し厳戒態勢を発令 ― 安全のために知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行で当局が監視体制を強化しているが、感染者数・重症度等の具体的データが不足しており、異常性も認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで雨季に毎年見られる季節性疾患であり、今回の記事も感染者数増加を受けた地方自治体レベルの通常の対策（防疫、幼虫駆除、監視強化）を報じるもの。具体的な症例数・死亡者数等の記載がなく、重症度や異常性の評価は困難。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha Govt Calls Urgent COVID Meeting Ahead Of Rath Yatra; 2 Dead In AP!
article.articleSummary: Published Date 2026-07-14: Odisha Health Minister urgently summoned a high-level review at Lok Seva Bhawan in Bhubaneswar to assess the state's COVID situation ahead of the upcoming Rath Yatra crowd, with the Health Secretary and Public Health Director among the participants evaluating advanced preventive measures. After two COVID-related fatalities were reported in Andhra Pradesh, severe panic has gripped South Odisha, prompting officials to tighten surveillance along the Odisha–Andhra border. The government issued a high alert across all border districts to monitor for any outbreak and to implement safety guidelines. The briefing signals intensified public health preparedness for mass gatherings, with Kanak News promising latest guidelines and safety updates. The article does not specify symptoms, vaccination status, laboratory confirmation, or infection source.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州政府、ラート・ヤトラを前に緊急COVID会議を招集；アンドラプラデシュ州で2名死亡
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患COVID-19による国内での限定的な死亡例と大規模集会前の予防的対応であり、IHR基準の複数該当は確認できないが、大規模集会（Rath Yatra）を控えた感染拡大の可能性から経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: o medo e a realidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The Fear and the Reality
article.articleSummary: Ebola, one of the most feared infectious diseases, was first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outbreaks: 2014–2016 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, with over 11,000 deaths. A Congo outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with related cases in Uganda, prompting reinforced surveillance. For Brazil, the risk remains low: no direct flights from affected areas and transmission requires close contact with infected bodily fluids, not airborne spread. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, secretions and other fluids of symptomatic individuals or contaminated objects. Common symptoms include sudden fever, severe headache, fatigue, muscle and abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea; hemorrhagic manifestations may occur in severe cases. Early diagnosis, hydration, metabolic correction, and intensive support improve survival; vaccines exist for some strains. Health workers should review travel history, isolate suspected cases, use PPE, and notify authorities. Brazil emphasizes reliable information and surveillance readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：恐怖と現実
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の発生があり、ウガンダへの関連症例拡大とサーベイランス強化が報じられており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル向けの一般啓発・解説記事であり、コンゴ民主共和国での現行アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）とウガンダへの関連症例拡大について言及しているが、具体的な症例数・日付等の詳細データは不足している。ブラジルへのリスクは低いと明記されており、ブラジル・ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは現行の発生国として確認されないため対象外とした。続報での具体的な症例数や公式発表の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Власти Конго два месяца не платили персоналу центра лечения Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese authorities have not paid the staff of the Ebola treatment center for two months.
article.articleSummary: Staff at an Ebola treatment center in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo have gone on strike after two months without pay, paralyzing operations at the Rwampara hospital in Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter. The protest involved epidemiologists, case investigators, drivers, and mortuary workers who blocked access and burned tires. Authorities said payroll lists were being verified after some names were added erroneously; Health Minister Roger Kamba cited payroll verification delays. Another center in Ituri remains active, while a combined antiviral therapy trial is underway there, though no vaccine or approved treatment exists. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, was officially declared on May 15; Congo reports 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths to date. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted a second U.S. humanitarian worker with fever evacuated to Germany; the first American patient was a physician who worked in the early weeks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ当局、エボラ治療センター職員に2ヶ月間給与未払い
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（確定1,926例、死亡702例）が継続中で、給与未払いによる医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を著しく損なっており、国際的な人的被害（米国人職員の発熱・国外搬送）も発生しているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda、United States、Germanyが含まれるが、記事内容はいずれもDRC（イトゥリ州）でのアウトブレイク対応に関する言及であり、感染発生国はDRCのみ。米国・ドイツは搬送先として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن تمنع مواطنيها العالقين في الكونغو من السفر جوا بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington bans its citizens stranded in Congo from air travel due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-14, the United States restricted air travel for American citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak. Under Title 49 transportation authority, Americans in Congo or who have recently left will be placed on a 'do not board' list until they spend at least 21 days in a third country, as a precaution. Ebola has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with transmission via body fluids and symptoms including fever and bleeding, as the outbreak expands toward Kinshasa, the capital. The CDC confirmed one American infected in Congo; another infected American was moved to Germany for treatment, and a doctor was evacuated in May. The White House said the State Department is assisting those awaiting departure, and Health Secretary Robert Kennedy Jr. cited spread near Kinshasa to justify the measure.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントン、エボラ出血熱の流行を受けコンゴに足止めされた自国民の航空機での渡航を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の首都キンシャサ方面へ拡大し、1,926人の確定例・702人の死亡が報告されている重大な公衆衛生事象であり、米国が渡航制限措置を取るなど国際的な対応が生じているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の渡航・治療対応国であり、発生国はDRCのみ。首都キンシャサへの拡大が懸念され、致死率も高い（702/1926）。

article.articleHeadline: Ръст на болестите на мръсните ръце -- OFFNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in diseases caused by dirty hands
article.articleSummary: Rising illnesses linked to dirty hands include summer spikes in gastroenteritis and enterocolitis. Some pathogens, notably noroviruses, spread via fecal contamination; strict hand hygiene is essential, especially for food workers in restaurants to prevent outbreaks. Transmission also occurs through animal-origin foods (meat, eggs, dairy), poorly washed leafy greens, and contaminated water. Thorough washing and prompt refrigeration of foods are advised; children are most vulnerable, so frequent handwashing is recommended. Lyme disease cases remain within last year’s totals; current conditions are not yet extreme, and ticks favor humidity. Look for a red, expanding rash 7–14 days post bite and seek antibiotics promptly. Marseille fever is less common, found in Black Sea countries, Southern France, Italy, Greece, and southern Bulgaria; incubation days with a dark eschar, high fever, and a fine rash, hospitalization. Globally, Ebola in Congo has 2,000 cases with >30% mortality and undiagnosed; monitor updates as of 14 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 汚い手による病気の増加
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はブルガリア国内の衛生啓発（胃腸炎、ライム病、マルセイユ熱）であり、対象国での重大な感染症流行を主題として扱っていないため。
triage.notes: 記事末尾に『世界的にはコンゴでエボラが2000例・致死率30%超で未診断』との簡潔な言及があるが、記事の主題はブルガリアの衛生啓発（手洗い、胃腸炎、ライム病、マルセイユ熱）であり、DRCのエボラ流行はこの記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ただし、DRCのエボラに関する情報は別途の一次情報源で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！男泰國返台染茲卡病毒　蚊子、性行為都會傳播│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year’s first case! A man who returned to Taiwan from Thailand contracted the Zika virus; transmission by mosquitoes and sexual activity.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus infection in 2026: a man in his 30s in northern Taiwan returned from Thailand in mid-June and developed fever, dizziness, and a rash before laboratory confirmation in late June. Contacts were asymptomatic; authorities proceeded with mosquito-source elimination and contact tracing. Since 2016, Taiwan has had 31 Zika cases, all imported, with Southeast Asia most affected (Thailand 8, Vietnam 6, Philippines 3, Myanmar 3, Malaysia 3; Maldives, Indonesia, Singapore, US Florida, Angola among others). Zika transmits via Aedes mosquitoes and sexual contact; pregnant women face the highest risk of fetal anomalies such as microcephaly. Preventive guidance includes wearing light clothing, using approved repellent, staying in screened or air-conditioned places, and maintaining mosquito precautions for at least 3 weeks after return. Men should use condoms for 3 months, women for 2 months, and blood donation should be deferred for 1 month.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初例！タイから帰国した男性がジカ熱に感染　蚊と性行為で媒介される可能性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入例1件で、渡航歴のある単発症例であり、接触者は無症状。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、過去にも継続的に報告されているパターンであるため異常性も低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾での輸入症例だが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染地とされるタイのみverified_locationsに含めた。ベトナム・フィリピン・ミャンマー・インドネシアは過去の輸入例集計の文脈で言及されているのみで、本件の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Trump Administration Restricts US Arrivals from Congo Over Ebola Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts U.S. travel restrictions. As of 2026-07-14, Congo reports 1,926 Ebola cases and 702 deaths. American citizens in DRC or with recent travel there are barred from boarding U.S.-bound civilian flights unless they have spent at least 21 days in another country, allowing the Ebola incubation period to pass. About 20 U.S. citizens were expected to depart DRC for the United States on Monday. The CDC confirmed one American working for an aid organization in DRC tested positive for Ebola—the first known U.S. national infection linked to the current outbreak. Another American infected in DRC was hospitalized at University Hospital in Frankfurt, Germany, with a third American previously treated there in May. The State Department will assist those affected as authorities monitor the outbreak and support aid operations.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権、エボラ懸念によりコンゴからの米国渡航を制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が拡大し1,926症例・702死亡に達し、米国人感染者も確認され、実際に米国が渡航制限措置を発動していることからIHR基準の複数該当が明らか。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツでの感染者確認は国際拡散の事例だが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。発生源であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak spreads to two more provinces
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to two additional northeastern provinces, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, bringing the national total to 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of Saturday. Four Tshopo cases (two deaths) and one Haut-Uele death were reported, with the outbreak—DRC’s 17th—initially declared on May 15 and largely centered in Ituri, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids from infected people or animals, causing high fever, vomiting, and bleeding. Investigations indicate most cases in the two new provinces are imported from Niania in Ituri, leading the National Institute of Public Health to designate Haut-Uele and Tshopo as epidemic zones. A World Health Organization official notes the true case count could be 2–4 times higher due to few cases with known links to others.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、さらに2州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で新たに2州へ拡大し、確定症例1,926件・死亡702件（致死率約36%）に達しており、WHOも真の症例数はさらに多い可能性を指摘。深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMali（Koulikoro Region等）が含まれているが、記事内容はDRCのエボラ流行拡大のみを扱っており、Maliは無関係とみられるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ cấm công dân bay thẳng từ Congo về nước vì dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States bans its citizens from flying directly from Congo to the United States due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the United States bans its citizens from flying directly from the Democratic Republic of Congo to the United States amid an Ebola outbreak with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, spreading toward Kinshasa. Americans in Congo or who recently travelled there are barred from US-bound flights and must complete a 21-day stay in a third country before returning. About 20 Americans who recently visited Congo were expected to fly home on Tuesday; the State Department will assist affected travelers. Ebola is a highly lethal virus transmitted through contact with bodily fluids, causing fever and bleeding. A Samaritan’s Purse staffer in Bunia tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was moved to University Hospital Frankfurt for treatment; he had not directly treated patients. This is the second U.S. citizen infected in this outbreak, after Dr. Peter Stafford treated patients in May in Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行によりコンゴからの自国民の直行便帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が首都キンシャサに拡大しつつあり、米国が渡航制限を発動し国際的な感染拡大（ドイツ・米国への感染者移送）も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 感染者はドイツ（フランクフルト、ベルリン）や米国にも波及しているが、対象国リストに独・米は含まれないためverified_locationsからは除外。DRCが流行の主体地域。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠疫情連5週升溫！最快本週進入流行期 8月中下旬恐迎高峰
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases have risen for five consecutive weeks; could enter the epidemic phase as early as this week, with a peak expected in mid-to-late August.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports COVID-19 cases rising for five weeks, with the epidemic phase possibly starting this week and a peak by mid-August. Last week outpatient visits reached 2,811 (up 34.4%), and weekly visits could exceed 5,000; with up to 20–30% gains, the peak may arrive in August. The rise links to waning immunity (4–6 months) and ongoing viral evolution, with summer travel and gatherings potentially accelerating spread and importations. Seventeen new local severe cases were reported last week; since October, 136 severe cases and 18 deaths, 94.9% unvaccinated, mainly elderly with chronic disease. Globally, increases in China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea and Singapore; dominant strains NB.1.8.1, JN.1, XFG. Vaccination: about 1.732 million doses; 65+ first-dose 21%, second-dose 0.5%. Public-funded vaccines for those 6 months+ available until July 31; stock ~455,000 doses. Masks advised in medical facilities and crowded and poorly ventilated spaces; fever or cough, stay home.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ感染症、5週連続で増加―今週にも流行期入りか、8月中旬から下旬にピークの恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でCOVID-19感染者数が5週連続で増加し、重症例・死亡例も報告されており、中国・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールなど周辺地域でも同時に増加が見られるため、WPRO基準（重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾のCOVID-19流行状況だが、中国（香港含む）など周辺国・地域でも同様の増加傾向が明記されているため、対象国リストにある中国のみをverified_locationsに含めた。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Singapore contributes $2.5m to support Ebola outbreak response in Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Singapore will contribute US$2 million (S$2.5 million) to support the ongoing Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BVD) outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The funds, disbursed through the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO), back the Continental Preparedness and Response Plan launched on June 5. The contribution will bolster laboratory testing capacity, contact tracing, infection prevention and control (IPC), and on-the-ground case management as part of regional containment efforts. The joint statement from Singapore's Ministry of Health and the Communicable Diseases Agency on July 14 underscores international partner coordination to curb transmission and safeguard neighboring populations.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールがコンゴとウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行対応に250万米ドルを支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のDRC・ウガンダにおける流行は国際的な支援対応（Africa CDC・WHOを通じた資金拠出）が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はシンガポールによる資金拠出のニュースであり、発生地域として挙げられたUgandaとSingaporeは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Начались первые в мире испытания вакцины против свирепствующего в Африке штамма Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world's first vaccine trials against the Ebola strain ravaging Africa have begun
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the world's first clinical trials of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain circulating in Africa have begun. In Phase I, 50 healthy adults will receive the vaccine to assess safety and immunogenicity. The Serum Institute of India has produced approximately 620,000 doses of the experimental vaccine in readiness for later stages and potential emergency use; 4,000 doses are allocated for the initial phase. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform, similar to some COVID-19 vaccines. Even if protective, experts say the vaccine is unlikely to alter the current outbreak trajectory but will help prepare more effective tools for future epidemics. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kasei emphasized the vaccine's role in preparedness rather than immediate outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで蔓延するエボラ株に対するワクチンの世界初臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョウ・エボラウイルス）の新規ワクチン試験開始という異常かつ注目すべきイベント。アフリカでの現在の流行、インドでの大規模製造能力（62万用量）、国際的な準備体制構築の動きが確認される。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的関心」に該当、WPROスクリーニングでは「異常性」「流行対策」「管理可能性」に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカでのエボラ流行と対するワクチン開発を報じており、インドのSerum Institute がワクチン製造を担当していることが明記されている。アフリカは対象国リストに該当する特定国がないため verified_locations には含めず、インドのみ列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は Zaire株とは異なる株であり、新規の脅威として認識される価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Начались первые испытания на людях вакцины против штамма Эболы Бундибугйо
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first human trials of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola have begun.
article.articleSummary: First-in-human trials of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola have begun. As of 14 July 2026, the study plans to enroll about 50 healthy adults in early-phase testing to evaluate safety and immune response. The Indian Institute of Serum reports stockpiling around 620,000 doses for subsequent phases and potential emergency use if efficacy is demonstrated, with 4,000 doses allocated for the initial phase. There are no approved vaccines or proven treatments specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola to date. The report notes an ongoing Central African outbreak linked to Ebola Bundibugyo, with more than 700 fatalities; earlier updates indicated Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceeded 500. The development underscores ongoing efforts to counter Ebola in Central Africa and the potential for emergency deployment if the candidate proves effective.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株ワクチンの初のヒト試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事は主にワクチン治験を報じているが、中央アフリカ（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株による進行中のアウトブレイクで700人超の死亡が言及されており、公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドで実施されているワクチン初回ヒト試験だが、実際の疾病発生（アウトブレイク）はコンゴ民主共和国（中央アフリカ）で継続中であり、致死者数700人超（DRC単独では500人超）という情報が含まれる。インドはワクチン製造・治験実施国であり、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。続報でDRCの詳細なアウトブレイク状況（感染拡大、渡航制限等）を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Tshisekedi confie la riposte de terrain au virologue Steve Ahuka, signe d'une épidémie qui déborde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Tshisekedi entrusts the field response to virologist Steve Ahuka, a sign of an outbreak that is spilling over.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, remains centered in Ituri with spillover into Tshopo and Haut-Uélé. As of July 11, 2026, the Public Health Emergency Operations Center reported 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths (case fatality ~36%), rising to about 1,900 cases and 700 deaths by July 13. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. President Félix Tshisekedi on July 13 appointed virologist Steve Ahuka-Mundeke as field operations manager; he heads the INRB virology department and has led the Ebola response (2018–2020) and coordinated COVID-19 efforts. The response contends with saturated treatment centers, UNICEF warnings of health-system collapse in Bunia, and staff strikes. Minister Roger Kamba notes community sensitization yielding positive signs, including over 300 recoveries. International support remains, with the United States pledging more than $600 million for response, preparation, and humanitarian aid.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：チセケディ大統領、現場対応をウイルス学者ステーヴ・アウカ氏に一任、拡大するアウトブレイクの兆候
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約36%、確認症例約1,900人・死亡700人に達するエボラ(ブンディブジョ株)大規模アウトブレイクで、医療システム崩壊懸念や国際支援(米国6億ドル超)が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は資金支援国であり発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ライセンスワクチンが存在しないブンディブジョ株での大規模流行であり、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 已有重症病例！成都疾控、成都气象联合发布提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There have already been severe cases! Chengdu CDC and Chengdu Meteorology jointly issue a warning.
article.articleSummary: Chengdu, Sichuan, China reports a severe heatstroke case amid an ongoing heatwave. A 58-year-old resident collapsed while cycling outdoors on July 9; body temperature reached 42°C and the patient remained in the Emergency Intensive Care Unit as of July 10. Heatstroke is the most severe heat-related illness with rapid progression and high fatality risk. Chengdu CDC and the Meteorological Service warn of prolonged heat. In Tianfu New District, authorities issued a high-risk alert; the next 10 days will stay hot: highs above 35°C (13–17 July) and above 37°C (18–22 July), with peak risk 12–18 hours daily. Five protective measures: limit outdoor exposure 10–16h, hydrate with electrolytes, eat light meals, rest, indoor cooling at 26–28°C, and monitor vulnerable groups. Dengue fever and chikungunya fever—transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes—are concerns; prevention focuses on eliminating standing water, reducing bites, and seeking prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: すでに重症例あり！成都疾病予防管理センターと成都気象局が共同で警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は熱波による熱中症警告であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱は蚊媒介感染症予防の一般的注意喚起として言及されているのみで、実際の症例報告や流行の異常性は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は熱中症・熱波に関する公衆衛生警告が中心であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱については蚊媒介感染症の一般的予防注意として触れられているのみで、具体的な感染症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠病例激增34.4% 連5周升溫 疾管署：最快本周進入流行期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases surge 34.4%, five straight weeks of increases; Taiwan CDC says the epidemic phase could begin as early as this week.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising COVID-19 activity: 2,811 COVID-related ED/outpatient visits in July 5–11, up 34.4% WoW; 17 new domestic severe cases July 7–13; no additional local deaths. After five weeks of increases, the epidemic phase could begin this week, with ED visits potentially reaching 5,000 and a peak expected mid-to-late August. Past summer peaks were ~200,000 (2023), ~120,000 (2024), and ~70,000 (2025); this season’s peak is projected around 50,000. Internationally, summer waves have occurred in China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, and Singapore. Global dominant variant NB.1.8.1, with JN.1 and XFG also reported. Cumulative seasonal vaccinations total ~1.732 million; 65+ first dose 20.97%, second dose 0.51%. High-risk individuals are advised to vaccinate, wear masks in medical/crowded poorly ventilated settings, and seek testing plus antiviral treatment if positive.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ感染症例が34.4%急増、5週連続上昇 台湾疾病管制署：早ければ今週にも流行期入り
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性のCOVID-19増加であり、重症・死亡の急増もなく既知のパターン内で推移している。また対象国リストに該当する国が主題となっていないため、監視対象としての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾におけるCOVID-19の季節性流行であり、中国・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールは比較対象として言及されているのみで、主題国ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Liên cầu lợn gây viêm màng não, bác sĩ cảnh báo biến chứng phù não đe dọa tính mạng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus suis meningitis: doctors warn that cerebral edema is a life-threatening complication.
article.articleSummary: Two days after eating raw pig blood dishes (tiết canh), a 45-year-old man from Bac Ninh developed high fever, headache, and nausea, rapidly progressing to coma. At Hanoi’s National Hospital for Tropical Diseases, he was diagnosed with acute meningitis likely due to Streptococcus suis. His Glasgow Coma Scale was 9, and cerebral edema loomed as a life-threatening complication. He was intubated, placed on mechanical ventilation, given potent antibiotics, and treated to control intracranial pressure. After four days of intensive care, he was extubated and moved for continued care. Streptococcus suis is the leading cause of meningitis in Vietnamese adults and can cause septicemia with hemorrhages, coagulopathy, septic shock, multi-organ failure, and death. Cases occur even without reported pork-blood consumption due to adulteration in commercial preparations. Public health advice: avoid all tiết canh and undercooked pork; seek urgent care for fever/headache after exposure to raw pork products or slaughter of sick/dead pigs.

triage.headline_ja: 豚レンサ球菌が髄膜炎を引き起こす、医師が生命を脅かす脳浮腫の合併症に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで散発的に発生する既知の人獣共通感染症（豚レンサ球菌症）の単発症例報告であり、生豚血（ティエットカン）喫食との関連も既知のリスク要因で、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単発症例に基づく公衆衛生啓発（生豚血・生豚肉の喫食回避の呼びかけ）が主目的であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。豚レンサ球菌症はベトナムの成人髄膜炎の主要原因として既に知られている。

article.articleHeadline: Empresa indiana acusada de vender testes falsos de malária, HIV e sífilis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indian company accused of selling fake malaria, HIV, and syphilis tests.
article.articleSummary: Mozambique’s medicines regulator ANARME, IP suspended nationwide sale of rapid diagnostic tests for malaria, HIV, and syphilis produced by Indian company Meryl Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd. The suspension follows non-conformities detected by the National Health Institute (INS) in malaria tests and critical deficiencies in the manufacturer’s Quality Management System identified during World Health Organization good practices inspections, which could jeopardize patient safety. The affected products include MERISCREEN Malaria Pf/Pv Ag, MERISCREEN Malaria Pf/Pan Ag, MERISCREEN HIV 1-2 WB, Meriscreen HIV+ Syphilis Antibody Test, HIVFIND Whole Blood HIV 1/2 Antibody Detection Self-Test, and Meriscreen Malaria Pf HRP-II/pLDH Ag. The measure applies across Mozambique; no case counts or health outcomes are reported. This action underscores regulatory vigilance over diagnostic accuracy and supplier quality controls pending further assessment.

triage.headline_ja: インド企業、マラリア・HIV・梅毒の偽検査キットを販売していたと非難される
triage.triage_reason: モザンビークにおける診断キットの品質問題による販売停止措置であり、対象国（インド）は製造元に過ぎず感染症の発生事例ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国での感染症流行事例に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件はモザンビークの規制当局による診断キットの品質問題に関する措置であり、感染症の発生・流行事例ではない。インドは製造企業の所在地として言及されているのみで、対象国リストにおける感染症発生国には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情蔓延，美国禁止在刚果（金）的美公民直接回国
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads; the United States bans American citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from returning home directly.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread across multiple provinces, with official data on July 12 reporting 1,926 cases and 702 deaths. On July 13, a White House official said the United States will prohibit American citizens in the DRC—or recently departed—from taking direct commercial flights back to the United States unless they stay in a third country for at least 21 days. The measure, under Title 49 of the U.S. Code (Transportation Management), affects about twenty Americans scheduled to fly home on July 14; the State Department will assist those affected during quarantine. The action aligns with rising Ebola risk, with the virus reaching areas within hours’ drive of Kinshasa. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and bleeding; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected persons or animals. The decision follows July 13 guidance from the HHS Secretary warning of escalating risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行拡大、米国がコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)在住米国人の直接帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が複数州に拡大し、致死率約36%（1,926症例・702死亡）に達し、首都キンシャサ近郊にも波及。米国が渡航制限措置を発動しており、国際的関心・対応も高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、渡航制限措置の主体として記事上重要な役割を果たしている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Reino Unido inicia testes em humanos de vacina contra ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Kingdom begins human trials of an Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: BD-Ebov, a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, begins first-in-human trials in Oxford, United Kingdom. This is the first of four Ebola vaccine candidates to reach clinical testing. The Phase 1 study will assess safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy volunteers aged 18–55, with doses to be given in the coming weeks and participants followed for one year. The current Ebola outbreak, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, has already caused hundreds of deaths and thousands of confirmed cases; region-wide displacement raises demand for a vaccine. BD-Ebov uses the same platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, employing a modified adenovirus vector to trigger immune responses against the ebolavirus. Developed about eight weeks after the WHO declared a public health emergency, the vaccine is produced by Serum Institute of India, which has prepared roughly 620,000 doses for later stages.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、エボラワクチンのヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼はワクチン治験だが、背景となるDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行はWHOが緊急事態を宣言済みで、既に数百人の死者・数千人の感染者を出しており、IHR基準複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事本体はオックスフォードでのBD-Ebovワクチン治験に関する報道だが、背景として言及されるDRC（およびウガンダ、対象国リスト外）での既存エボラ流行が本評価の主眼。インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）としての言及のみで疾病発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。英国も対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Singapore pledges US$2 million to support Ebola response in DR Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Singapore will contribute US$2 million to support the Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, channeled through Africa CDC and WHO under the Continental Preparedness and Response plan. Funds will bolster laboratory testing, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and on‑the‑ground case management, and procure diagnostics, laboratory equipment, PPE, essential medicines, fluids, blood products, oxygen and critical care equipment. The Bundibugyo outbreak was declared a WHO public health emergency of international concern on May 17 and an Africa CDC public health emergency of continental security the following day. WHO data show 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the DRC since mid‑May, with sustained, rapid transmission described as the fastest Ebola outbreak yet. Transmission occurs via contact with blood and bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; no approved therapeutics or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo. This funding supports Singapore’s broader global health commitments.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール、DRCとウガンダのエボラ対応支援に200万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEICおよびAfrica CDC大陸公衆衛生緊急事態に指定された大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行であり、致死率の高さと急速な伝播、国際支援・資金拠出が行われている点でIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの1,759症例・600死亡、致死率約34%と非常に高く、WHO PHEIC指定済みの重大イベント。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季新冠感染迎来小高峰，抗病毒药物需求升温
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer sees a small uptick in COVID-19 infections as demand for antiviral drugs rises.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity in China shows a small summer uptick. In June 2026, China CDC reports 79,000 newly confirmed cases nationwide, 130 severe cases, and 1 death (cardiovascular/other comorbidity-linked). Sentinel hospital data indicate COVID-19 positivity among influenza-like illness rising from 2.9% in early June to 6.4% by end of June; dominant Omicron NB.1.8.1 and sublineages. Historically, summers bring a modest peak (2023: June severe 1,968; July 455; 2024: June 112 severe, July 203; 2025: June 333,200 cases with 384 severe, 8 deaths; July 226,600 with 219 severe, 2 deaths). Expert Hu Yang notes June–August peaks are possible but controllable; July data will inform trajectory. High-risk groups remain: adults 65+, with cardiovascular, chronic lung, diabetes, liver/kidney disease, cancer, immune deficiency, obesity, late pregnancy. Public health measures urged. Antiviral demand rises: fever clinics up; online sales surge; Paxlovid imported; Molnupiravir approved. Six domestics, incl. Azvudine and others, are available; prices vary (Paxlovid 1,748 yuan per kit; Taizhongding 455 yuan; Mindev 474 yuan).

triage.headline_ja: 夏季新型コロナ感染が小さなピークを迎え、抗ウイルス薬の需要が高まる
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なCOVID-19の小規模な増加であり、過去の同時期の水準と同程度で管理可能とされているため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断。
triage.notes: 既知のCOVID-19変異株(Omicron NB.1.8.1)による季節性の小規模な増加であり、専門家も「制御可能」と評価。過去数年の同時期データと比較しても特段の異常は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: CLUSTER SANTE EBOLA- ANALYSE DES GAPS PAR PILIER DE REPONSE AU 11 JUILLET 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EBOLA HEALTH CLUSTER - ANALYSIS OF GAPS BY RESPONSE PILLAR AS OF JULY 11, 2026
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Ebola virus disease affects five provinces in the DRC—Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord Kivu, Sud Kivu, and Tshopo—across 42 health zones. Gaps analysis shows major operational challenges across response pillars in several zones. In Ituri (epicenter) with 26 zones: 10 zones are critical with gaps >86% (about 16 of 21 pillars uncovered), including Ariwara, Aungba, Damas, Gety, Kambala, Lolwa, Mandima, Mangala, Nia-Nia and Rimba; 12 zones with gaps >66% (≈14 pillars) such as Aru, Bambu, Drodro, Fataki, Kilo, Komanda, Lita, Logo, Mambasa, Nizi, Tchomia; 4 zones with 24% gaps (≈5 pillars): Bunia, Mongwalu, Nyankunde, Rwampara. In Nord Kivu (11 zones): 3 urgent with gaps >95% (≈20 pillars) Kyondo, Masereka, Vuhovi; 7 zones >62% (≈13 pillars): Beni, Butembo, Kalunguta, Katwa, Mabalako, Musienene, Oicha; Goma 28%. Sud-Kivu: Miti-Murhesa 57% (12/21). Haut-Uele: Wamba 100% (21/21). Tshopo: Lubunga, Makiso-Kisangani, Mangobo 100%. Gaps undermine early detection, isolation, care and prevention, increasing outbreak persistence and spread; partners are urged to report zone-level gaps.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ保健クラスター - 2026年7月11日時点の対応の柱ごとのギャップ分析
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で複数州・42保健地域にわたりエボラ出血熱が継続しており、対応体制の重大なギャップが指摘されている。重症度・拡大リスクともに高く、外部支援の必要性も明示されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはRwanda, Angola, Italy, Australia, Romania, Costa Ricaなどが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内5州（Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord Kivu, Sud Kivu, Tshopo）の状況のみを扱っており、他国は地名の同名による誤タグと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : six premiers patients guéris d'Ebola à Nizi - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the first six Ebola patients cured in Nizi - ACP
article.articleSummary: Six Ebola virus disease patients have been cured in the Nizi health zone, Djugu territory, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to a July 14, 2026 communiqué from the National Public Health Institute (INPS). The six survivors demonstrate that Ebola is not a fatal disease when care is rapid and appropriate. The message urges the population not to wait for deterioration or for deaths at home; at the first signs, individuals should seek care at a health facility or at an Ebola Treatment Center. Rapid management improves odds of survival, protects household contacts, and helps interrupt transmission within communities. The report notes that community deaths increase transmission risk and reduce survival chances. The announcement provides a hopeful sign and reinforces public health guidance for timely access to treatment upon symptom onset in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:ニジで最初のエボラ患者6名が治癒 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクが確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は治癒患者に関する前向きな内容だが、イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であることを示しており、感染拡大・重症度・地域社会への影響に関する既存の懸念を裏付ける。感染者数・死亡者数・アウトブレイク全体の規模など詳細情報は本記事からは不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UP COVID-19 Case: 27-Year-Old Admitted to BHU Hospital After Testing Positive in Varanasi
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurfaces in Uttar Pradesh: a 27-year-old Ashapur resident in Varanasi tested positive and is admitted to Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Hospital in the Chest and TB Department under medical supervision. He had several days of breathing difficulties; laboratory confirmation led to immediate admission, with no serious complications reported so far. BHU clinicians note one to two COVID-19 positive patients are seen each month, indicating the virus remains but is not causing a crisis. Public health guidance emphasizes early testing, basic hygiene, and vigilance, especially for seniors and those with weakened immunity or chronic illnesses. Symptoms to watch include fever, persistent cough, sore throat, shortness of breath, and unusual fatigue. Do not delay medical evaluation if unwell; testing is essential, signaling that the virus can reappear in Uttar Pradesh without widespread outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: UP COVID-19感染例：バラナシで陽性判定の27歳男性がBHU病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発の軽症COVID-19症例であり、医師も月1〜2例程度と述べており危機的状況ではない。異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の日常的な散発例であり、BHU医師も『危機ではない』と明言。フルRRA不要。

article.articleHeadline: 我国捐258万元 助刚果与乌干达应对伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China donates 2.58 million yuan to help the Congo and Uganda respond to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Singapore donates US$2.0 million (about S$2.58 million) to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to aid the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak response. The funds, delivered through the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention and the World Health Organization, support the joint Prevention and Response Plan launched on May 5, 2026. They will fund laboratory testing, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and case management. Health Minister Ong Ye Kung stated that global health security is a shared responsibility and emphasized Singapore’s role as a reliable partner during critical moments, noting that the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda remains variable and requires rapid, coordinated international action. The donation signals ongoing international support to contain the outbreak and bolster health-system response in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール、コンゴとウガンダのエボラ流行対応を支援するため258万シンガポールドル（約200万米ドル）を寄付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRC・ウガンダで継続的に発生し、国際機関を通じた緊急支援が実施されるなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているため、フルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびシンガポールも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスによるDRC・ウガンダでの共同対応計画（2026年5月5日開始）に対する国際支援の一環として報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford, Serum Institute Of India Launch Human Trials Of New Ebola Vaccine Against The Bundibugyo Strain
article.articleSummary: Oxford University and Serum Institute of India have launched the world’s first human trial of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola (ChAdOx1 BDBV). The Phase I study in Oxford will enroll 50 healthy volunteers aged 18–55 to assess safety and immune response, with follow-up visits to monitor outcomes. The Bundibugyo outbreak was declared about 57 days earlier, and there is no approved vaccine for this strain. The vaccine uses the same viral-vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. SII has supplied around 4,000 investigational doses for Phase I and is preparing for larger production, including more than 6.2 lakh doses for future studies or emergency use. If results are favorable, trials will expand to assess protection. CEPI, SII and Oxford emphasize rapid, affordable supply.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学とインド血清研究所、ブンディブギョ株に対する新型エボラワクチンのヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラワクチンの第I相臨床試験開始に関する報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ株エボラワクチン（ChAdOx1 BDBV）の臨床試験開始に関する内容で、オックスフォード（英国）で試験が実施され、インド血清研究所（SII）がワクチン供給を担当しているが、これは製薬・研究機関としての関与であり、インド国内で感染症が発生しているわけではない。言及されているブンディブギョ株のアウトブレイク発生国も記事中に明記されていないため、対象国リストに該当する実際の発生国はない。

article.articleHeadline: மீண்டும் தலைதூக்கும் கரோனா பாதிப்பு! இந்த அறிகுறிகள் இருந்தால் கவனம்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 infection once again causing headaches! If you have these symptoms, beware.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, COVID-19 infections are resurging in India, with two deaths reported in Andhra Pradesh. Authorities warn that SARS-CoV-2 remains capable of causing outbreaks even as severe mortality declines; variants continue to evolve, with mutations enabling easier spread. Vaccination remains protective but wanes over time, and vaccines do not fully prevent infection or transmission. Crowded indoor venues, poor ventilation, travel, and large gatherings amplify transmission risk. Common symptoms mirror earlier waves: ordinary cold-like signs such as nasal discharge and a sore throat in the morning, with fatigue; fever may be mild, and breathing difficulties require prompt attention. Most mild cases resolve in a few days, but worsening symptoms warrant testing and appropriate care to prevent deterioration. WHO reiterates global circulation and calls for continued surveillance, especially among individuals with comorbidities. Emphasize handwashing regularly.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ感染再び頭をもたげる！これらの症状があれば注意！
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知の流行パターン内での再流行であり、季節性の注意喚起記事に留まる。国際的拡大や渡航制限等の新規性は見られない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に地域流行状態にあり、本記事は健康啓発的な内容。アンドラプラデシュ州での死亡例2件は言及されているが、規模や異常性についての詳細情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Claims Fourth-Grade Student's Life in Rayagada Hostel
article.articleSummary: Malaria fatality in Rayagada district: Nine-year-old Joysen Kandagari, a fourth-grade student at Atada High School hostel, died while undergoing treatment at Berhampur Medical College. Joysen joined the hostel on June 29; on July 5 he fell severely ill and malaria was confirmed at Jemadeipentha Community Health Centre. He was admitted to Rayagada District Headquarters Hospital on July 7 and later referred to Berhampur due to critical complications. He died at 6 a.m. on July 14; his body is being brought to his village, Bada Kashapadu. The incident underscores perceived inadequacies in malaria preparedness in Rayagada, especially in residential schools. Monsoon-linked outbreaks recur, yet preventive measures remain reportedly inadequate and the district hospital lacks advanced facilities, forcing patients to rely on Berhampur. Locals call for health camps, hostel sanitisation, and stronger preventive actions to protect children.

triage.headline_ja: ラヤガダ郡の寄宿舎でマラリアにより4年生の児童が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例（児童1名の死亡）であり大規模な集団発生や国際的拡大の証拠はないが、モンスーン期に再発するマラリア対策の不備が指摘されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インド・オディシャ州ラヤガダ郡の寄宿舎で発生した単一のマラリア死亡例。モンスーン期の再発性アウトブレイクと予防対策の不備が住民から指摘されており、地域の公衆衛生対応能力に懸念があるため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Mombasa County, MSF strengthens Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: Mombasa County, Kenya’s main maritime gateway, in partnership with Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), has strengthened Ebola preparedness by opening an Ebola simulation and training centre in Changamwe to boost detection, prevention and response. The first cohort of 20 frontline workers received a two-day program mixing classroom instruction with realistic simulations on safe patient care and PPE use, with plans to train at least 60 health workers countywide. The facility will operate as a training hub and ongoing simulation centre, expanding in batches. Mombasa, among 25 counties deemed high risk due to the Port of Mombasa, Moi International Airport, and road corridors that bring cross-border truck drivers from Uganda and the DRC, where Ebola outbreaks have occurred. Kenya remains Ebola-free; public urged to seek care for symptoms: fever, body aches, vomiting, diarrhea, unexplained bleeding, and travel to affected countries or contact with infected persons. MSF resources including PPE are available.

triage.headline_ja: モンバサ県、国境なき医師団がエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ発生事例ではなく、ケニア・モンバサ県における予防的な訓練・準備体制強化に関する記事であり、ケニアはエボラフリーの状態が継続している。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・モンバサ県における越境トラック運転手等を通じたリスクに備えたMSFとの訓練センター開設に関する内容。DRCやウガンダは過去のアウトブレイク国として言及されているのみで、現時点での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情蔓延，美國禁止在剛果（金）的公民直接回國 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads; the United States bans its citizens in Congo (Kinshasa) from directly returning to the United States.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to spread, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported as of July 12, across multiple provinces and within a few hours’ drive of Kinshasa. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. The outbreak affects areas such as Ituri Province’s Bunia, highlighting expanding reach. On July 13, the U.S. government restricted American citizens in Congo or recently departed from boarding commercial flights directly back to the United States, requiring a stay in a third country for at least 21 days; about 20 Americans were slated to depart on July 14. The State Department will assist those affected. The restriction relies on U.S. Code authority under Title 49 (transportation management) due to heightened risk and geographic spread near Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行拡大、米国はコンゴ（キンシャサ）在住の自国民の直接帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が1,926症例・702死亡と拡大し、首都キンシャサ近郊にも波及。米国が渡航制限を実施するなど国際的な懸念が顕在化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC国内での感染拡大とキンシャサ近郊への波及が主題であるためDRCのみを計上。

article.articleHeadline: Suinicoltura: aziende colpite da effetti della Psa e aumento dei costi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pig farming: farms affected by the effects of African swine fever and rising costs.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) continues to weigh on Mantua's pig sector amid rising costs. In Mantua province, December 2025 data show 410 farms with 984,378 pigs, down from 424/992,817 last year, keeping counts below one million for the first time in nearly 30 years. Nationally, about 25,000 farms exist, a ~17% drop since 2021. Profitability is squeezed: finishing pigs (~170 kg) cost €1.70–€1.80/kg, while the Cun Suini price sits at €1.60/kg, indicating losses. ASF still undermines extra-EU exports to Japan, Thailand, and China, with Spain unable to push more to China and redirecting sales within Europe. Additional headwinds include costs from Middle East tensions around the Hormuz Strait affecting feed, energy, and fuels. Confagricoltura Mantua urged EU relief funds, while NAS and local Veterinary Services will intensify biosafety inspections and monitor wild boar populations.

triage.headline_ja: 養豚業：アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の影響とコスト増加に苦しむ農場
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はイタリア・マントヴァ地域における家畜疾病ASFの経済的影響（輸出減少、コスト増）に関する内容であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響はなく、発生国も対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリア（マントヴァ、ロンバルディア）における養豚業のASF被害と経済損失。日本・タイ・中国は輸出先として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため対象国リストには含めない。ASFは動物疾病でありヒトへの感染性はないため、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Two Covid deaths in Andhra, eight cases: Is this a cause for concern?
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths reported in Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa district, with eight additional positive cases, sparking surveillance but not a declared outbreak. The first victim, a 60-year-old man, was treated at Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences in Tirupati and later at Christian Medical College, Vellore; he died on June 28 after comorbidities including diabetes and kidney disease, with postmortem RT-PCR confirming Covid-19. The second death occurred July 7, a 46-year-old man admitted to Kadapa’s Government General Hospital; he developed acute breathlessness and died from severe bilateral lung damage, with chest CT showing Covid-19–related injury. Eight others tested positive and are monitored; five cases in Kadapa and three contacts. Health officials stress it's sporadic; a genome sequencing team at NIV Pune is analyzing samples, results due in days, with a committee ruling out a new subvariant. Tamil Nadu reports no evidence of high-severity strain; authorities advise ongoing precautions for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で新型コロナ死亡2例、感染8例確認――懸念すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 基礎疾患を有する高齢者の散発的なCOVID-19死亡例であり、新規変異株も否定されているため、通常の公衆衛生モニタリング事案と判断される。
triage.notes: 死亡2例はいずれも基礎疾患（糖尿病、腎疾患等）を有する患者であり、当局は散発事例と説明。NIV Puneでのゲノム解析で新規変異株は否定的、タミル・ナードゥ州でも高重症度株の証拠なし。

article.articleHeadline: Śmiertelny wirus atakuje tuż za granicą. Nie ma na niego szczepionki
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus strikes just across the border. There is no vaccine for it.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, Germany reports a second Ebola case, with two American nationals infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo and treated in Germany. The first case, diagnosed in Berlin in May, involved a Bundibugyo variant; the patient arrived at Charité hospital in Berlin after a critically ill transport from Africa. He recovered after two weeks of intensive care and experimental antiviral therapy; PCR tests remained negative from 30 May, and isolation was lifted after more than 72 hours of full asymptomatic status. The second patient was transported by special aircraft to Frankfurt am Main and admitted to an isolated unit; he remains stable with typical Ebola symptoms but no public risk is reported. The Bundibugyo variant—described in Uganda in 2007—has no vaccine or approved therapy; authorities emphasize high-containment isolation. Experts warn of global health security implications for neighboring countries, including Poland.

triage.headline_ja: 国境のすぐ向こうで致死性ウイルスが猛威を振るう。ワクチンはない。
triage.triage_reason: ドイツで2例目のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）確定例が報告され、感染源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、国境を越えた患者搬送や近隣国への健康安全保障上の懸念が専門家から指摘されており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 感染はDRCで発生し、患者はドイツ（ベルリン、フランクフルト）に搬送され治療を受けている。記事の主題は輸入症例だが、感染源国はDRCであるため対象国として計上。ドイツ・ポーランドは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: JAV bijo Ebolos: neleidžia iš Kongo grįžti savo piliečiams
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States fears Ebola: it won't let its citizens return from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported as of Sunday. The United States will not allow direct return of its citizens from Congo; those in Congo or recently departed are on a flight ban and may enter the US only after 21 days in a third country. About two dozen Americans scheduled to fly to the United States were affected, with the State Department pledging support during the waiting period. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. cites increased Ebola risk. The outbreak has reached areas within a few hours of Kinshasa, underscoring ongoing transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing high fever, nausea, and severe internal bleeding. An infected US citizen was transported to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany for treatment; another American doctor treated in Germany in May.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はエボラを恐れている：コンゴからの自国民帰国を許可せず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が拡大しキンシャサ近郊に達しており、死者702名・確定症例1926件と深刻。米国が渡航制限措置を講じるなど国際的な対応・懸念が顕在化しているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国は感染者の搬送・帰国制限に関する記述のみで発生地域ではないため除外。DRCが主題の発生国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: THL: Iduista lähtenyt salmonellaepidemia on ohi - vei 10 sairaalaan ja ainakin kaksi kuoli sairastumisen jälkeen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: THL: Salmonella outbreak originating from sprouts is over — it sent 10 to the hospital and at least two died after falling ill.
article.articleSummary: Finland's THL confirms the spring Salmonella outbreak linked to sprouts has ended. A cluster of 64 cases, with 37 confirmed as the same strain, occurred mainly March–May and one case in June. This year about 380 Salmonella cases have been reported in Finland, compared with over 700 last year. Affected individuals ranged 4–86 years; 41 were women. Ten people were hospitalized and at least two died within a month of diagnosis, though THL notes deaths may have been due to other illnesses. In April, the Finnish Food Authority reported about 30 nationwide cases of Salmonella Bovismorbificans. The likely source was undercooked sprouts, which are no longer sold. EU surveillance shows over 100 lab-confirmed cases in 10 EU/EEA countries from January–May linked to the same strain, with Italy identifying an India-based seed supplier, suggesting cross-border contamination. Symptoms typically include diarrhea and fever; severe cases can lead to bacteremia.

triage.headline_ja: THL：もやし由来のサルモネラ感染症の流行は終息 ― 10人が入院、少なくとも2人が発症後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: フィンランドで発生したサルモネラ集団感染はすでに終息が公式に確認されており、対象国（インド等）は種子供給元として言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではないため、対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフィンランドでのサルモネラ（Salmonella Bovismorbificans）集団感染で、既に終息済み。インドは種子供給元として汚染源調査で言及されているのみで、実際の発症・流行地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。疾患名フィールドのParatyphoid/Typhoidは誤分類の可能性が高い（実際はSalmonella非チフス性）。

article.articleHeadline: トランプ米政権、コンゴ滞在米国人の入国禁止措置　エボラ熱流入阻止狙いか
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump administration imposes entry ban on Americans in Congo, aimed at preventing Ebola from entering.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo leads the Trump administration to prohibit American citizens who are in Congo or who have recently left Congo from boarding flights to the United States until they spend at least 21 days in a third country. The policy, reported by Reuters on July 13, 2026, covers individuals with Congo travel history and extends to those currently in Congo. Approximately 20 Americans with Congo travel history were slated to board a U.S.-bound flight on July 14. The 21-day waiting period will be supported by the State Department. The move follows ongoing Ebola transmission in Congo and mirrors U.S. practice of restricting entry from outbreak areas; it aims to prevent importation of Ebola into the United States.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ米政権、コンゴ滞在米国人の入国禁止措置　エボラ熱流入阻止狙いか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な発生を受け米国が渡航制限措置を実施しており、IHR基準の複数項目（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴでのエボラ流行状況の詳細（症例数・死亡数等）は記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Fever during the rains? It could be more than just a viral infection
article.articleSummary: During the monsoon, fever cases surge as multiple infections circulate simultaneously, including influenza, dengue, malaria, leptospirosis, typhoid, and shigellosis. Early symptoms—high fever, headache, body pains, chills, fatigue, and loss of appetite—often resemble a viral illness, but the underlying cause varies and requires different treatments. Distinguishing signs appear later: dengue with rash and low platelets, leptospirosis with red eyes, calf pain, jaundice, or reduced urine; influenza with cough and breathing difficulty; shigellosis with diarrhoea and mucus or blood; typhoid with prolonged fever and abdominal symptoms. Early diagnosis relies on targeted testing: CBC can hint but not confirm; molecular tests for influenza; leptospirosis DNA early or antibodies later; stool tests for Shigella; blood cultures for typhoid. Exposure history—stagnant water, floodwater, mosquito bites, recent travel or contaminated food/water—guides clinicians. Delayed or wrong treatment can worsen disease; avoid treating fever as 'just viral'.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の発熱、それは単なるウイルス感染症以上のものかもしれない
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期における一般的な発熱疾患の鑑別診断に関する啓発記事であり、特定の異常なアウトブレイクや緊急性のある公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: この記事は特定のアウトブレイクイベントではなく、季節性の発熱性疾患の鑑別診断に関する一般的な医療情報記事である。具体的な症例数や発生地域の特定がなく、監視対象イベントとしての性質を持たない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid Returns Before Ratha Yatra; Border Districts Placed On High Alert! || Odisha News
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, Odisha faces a Covid-19 scare just 24 hours before the Puri Ratha Yatra. The Health Minister will chair an emergency high-level review at Loka Seva Bhavan, with the Health Secretary and senior health officials in attendance to plan preventive measures. Following the deaths of two individuals due to Coronavirus in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh, multiple border districts across South Odisha have been placed on high alert. Authorities are mobilizing surveillance and preparedness to manage potential transmission amid festival crowds, aiming to prevent further spread and ensure devotee safety. The report underscores intensified vigilance and rapid public health action in the border region as the Ratha Yatra approaches.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ再来、ラタ・ヤトラ祭直前で国境地区に厳戒態勢 || オリッサ州ニュース
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州での死亡例を受けオリッサ州が警戒態勢を敷いているが、感染規模や重症度に関する具体的情報が乏しく、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり大規模な公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められないが、大規模祭事（ラタ・ヤトラ）前の集団感染リスクへの行政対応として動向を注視する価値がある。
