article.articleHeadline: UK begins human trials of Ebola vaccine developed in eight weeks - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: UK begins phase I trials of an Ebola vaccine developed by University of Oxford after the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has 1,792 infections and at least 625 deaths. MHRA approved early human testing; first doses to healthy adults in the UK within weeks, with Uganda trials planned. The initial trial will enroll 50 volunteers aged 18–55 and monitor them for one year to assess safety and immune response. The Serum Institute of India has stockpiled about 620,000 doses for potential deployment if effective. The vaccine uses a viral-vector platform similar to Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19, delivering Ebola genetic material without the live virus. Four vaccine candidates are in development; this is the first to reach human testing. WHO warns the ongoing outbreak remains hard to contain due to insecurity and population movement.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、8週間で開発されたエボラワクチンのヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるBundibugyo株エボラの大規模アウトブレイク（感染1,792例、死亡625例）を背景に、WHOが治安悪化・人口移動により封じ込めが困難と警告しており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はUKでのワクチン臨床試験だが、背景となる感染症イベントはDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク。Uganda、UK、Indiaは対象国リスト外またはワクチン関連拠点（試験地・ストックパイル地）であり実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Liên cầu lợn gây viêm màng não, bác sĩ cảnh báo biến chứng phù não đe dọa tính mạng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus suis meningitis, doctors warn that cerebral edema complications can be life-threatening.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis meningitis in Bac Ninh, Vietnam, presents a severe, rapidly progressing case in a 45-year-old man (Đ.V.C.) who became acutely ill two days after consuming a raw pig blood dish (tiết canh) and subsequently undercooked pork. He developed high fever, headache, nausea, and quickly progressed to coma with altered consciousness. Doctors warn that cerebral edema is a potentially fatal complication of this infection. The report emphasizes the zoonotic risk associated with pigs and urges the public to avoid raw pig blood dishes and undercooked pork to prevent such meningitis cases. The case highlights the critical need for early recognition and rapid medical care for suspected Streptococcus suis meningitis, particularly after ingestion of undercooked pig products in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 豚レンサ球菌による髄膜炎、医師が生命を脅かす脳浮腫合併症を警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで散発的に発生する既知の人獣共通感染症（豚レンサ球菌症）の単発症例報告であり、生の豚血料理摂取という既知のリスク行動が原因。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ベトナムでは生豚血料理（tiết canh）の摂取に伴う豚レンサ球菌症が毎年報告される既知の風土病であり、本記事は個別症例に基づく注意喚起記事。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、アウトブレイクを示唆する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tribal Department School Hostel Gripped By Deadly Malaria In Rayagada!
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, Rayagada district, Odisha, reports a deadly malaria outbreak with a 9-year-old student, Jayasen Kondagari (Class IV), dying while under treatment at Krishna Chandra Medical College and Hospital. This marks the district’s second malaria-related fatality in seven days, highlighting sanitation and healthcare gaps inside state-run tribal school hostels. The incident underscores ongoing vector-borne disease risk within tribal education facilities and raises concerns about infection control, water and sanitation conditions, and timely access to diagnosis and care. No further case counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or imported/exported case information are provided. The report has spurred public health attention and calls for scrutiny of hostel conditions and strengthened malaria prevention and response in Rayagada.

triage.headline_ja: ラーヤガダの部族局立学校寄宿舎で致死的なマラリアが発生
triage.triage_reason: オディシャ州ラーヤガダの部族向け寄宿学校で7日間に2件のマラリア死亡が発生し、衛生・感染管理上の懸念から公衆衛生上の注目が高まっているため。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であり異常性は低いが、部族寄宿学校での連続死亡例は衛生・医療アクセスの構造的問題を示唆し、続報でのケース数・原因究明が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 首例境外茲卡病毒確診 出國防蚊別大意
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First imported Zika virus case confirmed; don't be lax about mosquito protection when traveling abroad.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan confirms its first imported Zika virus infection of the year, a man in Taiwan in his 30s who returned from Thailand mid-June. He developed fever, dizziness and headaches; a rash in late June led to hospital testing, with laboratory confirmation of Zika virus infection. Contacts and cohabitants are asymptomatic; health authorities conducted environmental vector control around exposure sites, pursued contact tracing, and provided education to the case and contacts. This is the year’s first confirmed imported Zika case and the first imported case in about two years, with no local transmission reported. Adult infections are usually mild, but maternal infection can transmit via the placenta and cause fetal microcephaly or fetal death. Travelers to Zika-affected areas should take mosquito precautions (light-colored long-sleeve clothing and pants, government-approved repellents, and housing with screens or air conditioning). Affected regions include Southeast Asia, Americas, Western Pacific, Europe; Africa has 18 countries including Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: 首例境外茲卡病毒確診 出國防蚊別大意
triage.triage_reason: 台湸における輸入例1件のみで局所感染は報告されておらず、症状も軽症。既存の対策（ベクター駆除・接触者追跡）で管理されており、社会的関心も限定的と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: ایبولا وائرس کا خوف امریکا نے کانگو میں موجود شہریوں کے سفر پر پابندی لگا دی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US bans travel by Congolese citizens amid fears of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the United States imposed a temporary ban on U.S.-bound commercial flights for Americans currently in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) or who recently left the country, under Title 49 regulations. Affected individuals must spend at least 21 days in a third country before attempting to return to the United States to minimize Ebola export risk. Congo has 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths. Ebola is a highly contagious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or animal; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal or external bleeding. The U.S. notes that one American in the DRC is infected, with some other infected Americans transported to Germany for treatment. The State Department will assist those affected, while health authorities continue monitoring the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルス感染への懸念からコンゴ国民の渡航を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,926症例・702死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、米国が渡航制限を課し、米国人感染者がドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的波及が既に発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の搬送先・対応国として言及されているが、発生地域としては対象国リストに含まれず、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Trung Quốc cảnh báo nguy cơ COVID-19 gia tăng trong mùa Hè
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China warns of increased risk of COVID-19 in the summer.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 risk rises in China this summer, driven by travel, social interaction, and indoor spaces. Chinese CDC reports about 79,000 cases in June, with 130 severe cases and 1 death in patients with underlying conditions. From late June through early July, SARS-CoV-2 positivity rose for six weeks; by the first week of July, COVID-19 was the second most common cause of influenza-like illness after seasonal influenza. All circulating strains are Omicron; no evidence of a new variant increasing risk. Experts say surges reflect recurring cycles rather than a strict seasonal pattern. While heat and UV may reduce environmental virus viability, crowds and indoor exposure remain risk factors. Precautions: elderly, chronically ill, and immunocompromised individuals should strengthen preventive measures and ventilate spaces, and seek care for fever, sore throat, or persistent cough. Testing kits and treatments are available with no shortages. OECD long COVID could cost up to $135 billion annually.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、夏季のCOVID-19リスク増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なCOVID-19症例増加についての通常のサーベイランス報告であり、既知のOmicron株のみで新規変異株の証拠はなく、重症度も低く医療資源も十分であるため、シグナルとしての対応は不要と判断。
triage.notes: 既存のOmicron株による季節的な感染再拡大であり、新規変異株や異常な重症化パターンの報告はない。検査・治療体制も十分とされ、通常の公衆衛生モニタリングの範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠連5週升溫 估8月中下旬達高峰 單週就診上看5萬人次
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 on a five-week rise, expected to peak in mid-to-late August, with weekly outpatient visits up to 50,000.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's COVID-19 activity is rising for the fifth straight week, with the health authority predicting a mid-to-late August peak and weekly outpatient visits possibly reaching 50,000. Last week, 2,811 COVID-19-related ED/clinic visits were recorded, up 34.4% from the week prior, with 17 new severe cases concentrated among those aged 65+ and with chronic conditions. Officials say the week may exceed 5,000 visits, crossing the 0.3% emergency-visit threshold to be considered an outbreak season. Summer waves attributed to waning antibodies, variants, and travel. Past summers peaked around May–June (about 70,000 weekly visits) and higher in 2023 (200,000) and 2024 (120,000); this year's peak is expected lower than last year, around 50,000 weekly visits. Internationally, China has risen for six weeks; Hong Kong and Japan also rising, with Japan's cases concentrated in Kagoshima Prefecture. Public health measures: vaccination, masking in crowded/poorly ventilated settings, stay-home if febrile or respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ、5週連続で増加傾向　8月中旬～下旬にピークとの予測、週間受診者数は5万人規模に達する見込み
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で例年通りの夏季COVID-19流行が5週連続で上昇しているが、重症化率は低く、既知の季節性パターンとして予測されており、IHR基準には該当しない。近隣地域（中国・香港・日本）でも同様の上昇が見られるため、動向を継続監視する。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kabupaten Tegal Kenalkan Program Mendengarkan Batuk: Strategi Eliminasi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tegal Regency Health Office Introduces Cough Listening Program: TB Elimination Strategy.
article.articleSummary: TB elimination drive in Tegal Regency, Indonesia: The Health Office, led by Acting Head Edy Sucipto, unveils Mendengarkan Batuk (Listening to Cough), a program developed with Pramuka (Scouts) to distinguish whether a cough stems from stress, flu, or tuberculosis. Presented during MPLS at SMA Negeri 1 Slawi, the initiative aims to curb TB transmission by screening as many people as possible, prioritizing close contacts of TB-positive patients. Trained staff will diagnose by listening to cough and will report suspected TB cases for follow-up. The effort is part of a broader campaign to eliminate TB by 2030 and mobilizes multiple actors—Polres Tegal police, Pramuka, PPTI, and other stakeholders—in an expanded screening campaign. The program underscores proactive community involvement to identify TB cases earlier and reduce spread.

triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常のTBスクリーニング施策の広報記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: हेंदलजूडी मे मलेरिया से छात्रा की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Hendaljudi, a female student dies of malaria.
article.articleSummary: A 14-year-old girl, Kiran Hansda, died of malaria in Kenddanga village, Hendaljudi Panchayat, Galudih, in the Ghatshila block of East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand. A seventh-grade student at Bankati High School, she had suffered headaches and fever for several days. She was first admitted to a private nursing home, and when her condition worsened, she was taken to a hospital in Jhargram, where treatment did not help. Her death has cast a pall over the village. Local leaders, including the village head Mirza Hansda and ward member Durabh Soren, visited the family to offer condolences. The report notes a fatal malaria case, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, the infection source, or any imported or exported cases. The incident occurred late Tuesday night, with the report published on 14 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ヘンダルジュディでマラリアにより女子生徒が死亡
triage.triage_reason: マラリア流行地域における単発の死亡例であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。

article.articleHeadline: What India and Africa can teach each other on animal health - A rare IMEA-wide view on disease surveillance, biosecurity and vaccine access across borders
article.articleSummary: IMEA view shows India and Africa sharing reliance on livestock, with infectious diseases crossing borders quickly through trade, climate shifts, and movement. They host large cattle, buffalo, sheep, goats and poultry populations underpinning milk, meat and eggs production and livelihoods. Front-line control targets transboundary diseases: Foot-and-Mouth Disease affects cattle/buffalo in Asia and parts of Africa; Lumpy Skin Disease; Peste des Petits Ruminants threaten small ruminants; African Swine Fever endangers pigs; Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza risks poultry. Early detection and targeted vaccination, plus movement controls, limit losses and trade disruption. India has strong veterinary surveillance, lab networks, digital reporting, molecular diagnostics and GIS; Africa relies on community health workers and improving cross-border networks with lab and digital investments. Vaccination drives resilience; India’s vaccine manufacturing ecosystem supports regional needs and shared disease intelligence through collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: インドとアフリカが動物衛生について互いに学べること - 国境を越えた疾病サーベイランス、バイオセキュリティ、ワクチンアクセスに関するIMEA全域の稀な視点
triage.triage_reason: 特定の急性発生事例ではなく、インドとアフリカの家畜疾病サーベイランス体制やワクチン協力に関する一般的・総説的な論説記事であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例を報じるものではなく、家畜疾病サーベイランス体制の比較・協力に関する解説記事のため、具体的な国での発生としてのverified_locationsは該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: 全球首创！中氪锌核抗菌皮革亮相海宁皮博会 五菌五病毒灭活率最高达99.99%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World's first! Zhongke Zinc-Core Antibacterial Leather debuts at Haining PIBO Leather Fair, with up to 99.99% inactivation against five bacteria and five viruses.
article.articleSummary: At the 33rd Haining China Leather Fair in Haining, Zhejiang, Snow Leopard, Lingjue Leather, and Zhongke Technology unveiled the '革·新' antibacterial leather series using the world’s first Zhongke Zinc Core technology. The inorganic semiconductor core-shell material physically inactivates bacteria and viruses by releasing reactive oxygen species via an internal multi-electron field, delivering durable antimicrobial action with no secondary pollution and no resistance. After its December 2025 Shanghai debut under the Tuweisun brand for architectural coatings, this is its first application to leather consumer goods. Lab tests show broad-spectrum inactivation of five bacteria and five viruses: bacteria including Candida albicans, Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Klebsiella pneumoniae (plus one unnamed bacterium); viruses including influenza A H3N2 (>99.99%), influenza A H1N1 (>99.97%), human coronavirus (>99.95%), herpes simplex virus 1 (>99.91%), and enterovirus 71 (99.13%). Experts say the technology could break foreign antimicrobial material monopolies and push China’s leather industry toward health-functional products.

article.articleHeadline: 台灣現今年首例境外茲卡病毒 北部男在泰國遭蚊蟲叮咬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus case of the year; a man in the north was bitten by mosquitoes in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, Taiwan’s CDC reported the year’s first imported Zika virus infection: a man in his 30s from the northern region who contracted a mosquito bite in Thailand. He returned in mid-June with fever, dizziness and headache; a late-June rash led to hospital treatment, and laboratory testing confirmed Zika. Contacts are asymptomatic; authorities conducted environmental vector control and contact tracing with patient education. Since 2016 Taiwan has recorded 31 imported Zika cases, with no locally acquired infections. Infections mainly come from Southeast Asia (Thailand 8, Vietnam 6; Philippines, Myanmar, Malaysia 3 each; Maldives 2; also Indonesia, Singapore, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saint Lucia, the U.S. Florida, and Angola 1 each). Globally, Zika has affected 97 countries since 2016; the Americas report over 11,000 cases by late June, while Thailand reports 76 cases this year. Prevention: bite avoidance; condom use for 3 months (men) and 2 months (women) after travel; defer blood donation for 1 month.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾、今年初の輸入性ジカウイルス感染例を確認 北部の男性がタイで蚊に刺される
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入例で、2016年以降31例目、地域内感染はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾での輸入性ジカ症例だが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるタイのみ対象国として記載。地域内感染や重症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les États-Unis bloquent le retour direct de leurs citoyens présents en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The United States Blocks the Direct Repatriation of Its Citizens Currently in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: On July 13, 2026, the United States announced it would block direct repatriation of U.S. citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to Ebola, placing about 24 Americans on a do-not-board list until they spend 21 days in a third country under Title 49. The policy cites rising risk from Bundibugyo-strain Ebola; no vaccine or approved treatment exists. As of July 14, 2026, the outbreak totals 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths, with Ituri Province as the epicenter (1,745 cases, 601 deaths) and recent spread to Tshopo and Haut-Uélé; Kinshasa and western provinces report no cases. The United States has seen infected nationals, including a July 10 case in a humanitarian worker and a second patient treated in Frankfurt; a May evacuation of Dr. Peter Stafford occurred. WHO discourages travel restrictions, while the Congolese government has not publicly responded.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:米国がコンゴ民主共和国に滞在する自国民の直接帰国を阻止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702死亡の大規模エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療薬なし）が継続し、米国が自国民の帰国制限措置を発表するなど国際的波及と渡航制限が現実化しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国およびドイツ（フランクフルト）での症例は輸入例であり、感染の主発生国はDRCのため対象国としてはDRCのみを列挙。CFRは約36%と高く、致死率・地理的拡大（Ituri中心からTshopo、Haut-Uéléへ拡大）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Así evoluciona el brote de ébola en la RDC: más de 1.960 casos y una letalidad del 36,6%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is evolving: more than 1,960 cases and a 36.6% fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of 12 July, 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. In the last 24 hours, 31 new cases and 10 deaths, with transmission persistently high, especially in Ituri, which accounts for over 90% of cases and about 85% of deaths. In Ituri, most new cases and seven community deaths occurred in Bunia, Lita, and Fataki, amid ongoing Djugu–Irumu corridor spread and several cases with no known links, signaling strong community transmission. The outbreak affects 42 of 140 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. In South Kivu, 47 days without new cases suggest a possible end, though vigilance remains. 736 people are in isolation (246 confirmed, 490 suspected); North Kivu occupancy at 117%. Contact tracing shows 82% monitored (target 95%). Challenges: safe burials, sampling acceptance, treatment capacity, mobility, and security.

article.articleHeadline: Ensitrelvir Reduces COVID Risk Among Household Contacts Post-Exposure
article.articleSummary: Ensitrelvir post-exposure prophylaxis reduced risk among 2041 household contacts aged ≥12 across the US, Argentina, Japan, South Africa, and Vietnam. Participants started ensitrelvir (375 mg day 1, 125 mg days 2–5) or placebo within 72 hours of index-patient symptom onset. Nasopharyngeal swabs for RT-PCR on days 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28. Primary endpoint: laboratory-confirmed COVID with ≥1 prespecified symptom within 10 days. By day 10, 2.9% vs 9.0% developed laboratory-confirmed infection (risk ratio 0.33, P<0.001), a 67% relative reduction. Adverse events were similar (15.1% vs 15.5%); serious adverse events 0.2% in each group; no COVID-related hospitalizations or deaths. Limitations include unmeasured transmission factors and lack of follow-up genome sequencing. Study led by Frederick G. Hayden; published in The New England Journal of Medicine online May 13, 2026; funded by Shionogi.

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Heranças culturais da Gripe Espanhola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: The Cultural Legacies of the Spanish Flu
article.articleSummary: The Spanish Flu infected about one-third of the world’s population and caused millions of deaths between 1918 and 1920, as the world struggled to recover from World War I. First documented in the United States, it quickly reached Brazil. With no vaccines or antivirals, doctors prescribed rest, light meals, teas, and chicken broth; home remedies evolved from lemon–garlic–honey–water to lemon–sugar–cachaça, giving rise to caipirinha. Religiosity also played a role, with prayers to Saint Sebastian as a protector against plagues. Quinine was widely prescribed, aiding the popularization of tonic water. The piece draws a parallel with COVID-19, noting vaccines and modern resources exist, yet fear, misinformation, pursuit of miracle cures, resistance to public health measures, and the tension between individual freedom and collective responsibility persist. The enduring lesson: science evolves and technologies advance, but understanding history can foster more prudent, perhaps even chicken-soup, responses to future pandemics.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 300 rescapés, et l'épreuve de l'après
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: More than 300 survivors, and the ordeal of the post-Ebola era.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri with Bunia as a focal point, marks the 17th epidemic, recording more than 300 survivors and 702 deaths in the latest consolidated tally. Survived patients are released from treatment centers and deemed non-contagious, yet reintegration is hindered by stigma, fear, and rejection within communities. To ease social and professional return, authorities issue certificates of recovery. Post-Ebola syndrome affects many survivors, including chronic joint pain, headaches, vision and hearing problems, fatigue, and neurological sequelae, requiring prolonged medical follow-up in a fragile healthcare setting. Médecins Sans Frontières highlights mental health needs—grief, isolation, and economic hardship—amid ongoing hostility toward survivors, though some community members are beginning voluntary testing. The article recalls the 2018–2020 outbreak (2,287 deaths, 1,170 recoveries) and emphasizes that defeating Ebola includes integrating survivors back into society, not just reducing deaths.

article.articleHeadline: 大人像感冒、胎兒恐死亡！被蚊子咬要「停機三個月」？首例茲卡現蹤，去泰國返台必看- 今周刊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adults with flu-like symptoms, fetal death feared! A mosquito bite could require a 'three-month pause'? The first Zika case detected; a must-read for anyone traveling to Thailand and returning to Taiwan - Now Weekly.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports the year’s first imported Zika virus case: a man in his 30s from northern Taiwan, who returned from Thailand in mid-June, developed fever, dizziness, and rash, with infection confirmed in late June. Contacts are asymptomatic; health authorities cleared the source and conducted contact tracing and education. By July 13, Taiwan has 1 confirmed imported case this year, all linked to Thailand. Since 2016, Taiwan has 31 imported Zika cases, 81% from Southeast Asia, including Thailand (8), Vietnam (6), Philippines (3), Myanmar (3), Malaysia (3), Maldives (2), and 1 each from Indonesia, Singapore, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saint Lucia, the United States (Florida), and Angola. Globally, Zika has affected at least 97 countries; about 80% of infections are asymptomatic. Transmission occurs via Aedes mosquitoes, sexual contact, vertical transmission, and blood transfusion. Pregnant women face risks of fetal microcephaly or death. Recommendations: safe sex for 3 months (men) or 2 months (women) after travel, postpone pregnancy, use mosquito protection for 3 weeks after return, and defer blood donation for 1 month; report travel history on arrival and seek care if symptomatic.

Jakarta-based Prudential official Yosie William Iroth notes ongoing risk during the pancaroba (monsoon-transition) season, despite lower volumes. Since 2024, Prudential has rolled out prevention-focused programs: PRUActive (encouraging physical activity and health education) and PRUPriority Hospitals (free medical check-ups and screenings); PRUWell Medical offers fair pricing with next-year premium discounts for customers maintaining good health; PRUSehat provides more affordable coverage aimed at lower- and middle-income groups. article.articleHeadline: Проф. Кантарджиев: Само един от 200 ухапани от заразен комар може да направи усложнение
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prof. Kantardzhiev: Only one in 200 people bitten by an infected mosquito may develop a complication.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever case in Greece prompts warning; Bulgarian epidemiologist Prof. Todor Kantardzhiev says only about 1 in 200 bites from an infected mosquito may cause a complication. Approximately 80% of those bitten are asymptomatic; 20% develop mild illness within 1–2 weeks with muscle and joint pain and fever. Only about 1 in 200 bitten may progress to encephalitis, a potentially life-threatening brain inflammation. West Nile virus is transmitted by common mosquitoes, not just exotic species, and originated in Africa but is now widespread. Greece reported this year’s first confirmed case. Travelers returning from Greece should inform physicians of travel and use repellents to limit bites. Separately, a American patient diagnosed with Ebola highlights risk for healthcare workers and funeral handlers; Congo and Uganda are hotspots. Summer see rises in enteroviruses.

article.articleHeadline: US FDA urges infant formula industry to strengthen supplier safety after outbreaks
article.articleSummary: FDA urges stronger supplier safety in infant formula after two infant botulism outbreaks potentially linked to a shared dairy ingredient supplier (Organic West Milk) supplying ByHeart and Nara Organics formulas, with FDA samples matching a clinical and formula sample. In late 2025–early 2026, nearly 150 confirmed or suspected cases of cereulide intoxication across 10 countries were traced to impure arachidonic acid (ARA) oil used in formula, leading to global recalls and an FDA Import Alert 99-51 on May 12, 2026 for ARA oil products from Cabio Biotech (Wuhan, China). The agency emphasizes risk within the supply chain and calls on manufacturers to rapidly assess supplier risks, monitor recalls/outbreak investigations, and maintain stringent controls for every ingredient. The cited Nestlé/Danone recall delays illustrate consequences; infants remain a highly vulnerable population requiring vigilant safety across all production stages.

article.articleSummary: Bengkayang Regency, Indonesia, launched the Desa Siaga TB program to strengthen early TB detection and management through community engagement. Desa Siaga TB aims to expand local involvement in prevention and control, turning TB care into a community-wide effort to identify cases faster, treat them appropriately, and interrupt transmission. Deputy Regent Syamsul Rizal says the initiative reinforces health services at the village level and requires broad participation to promote healthy living, environmental hygiene, immunization, and active program participation. The district will enhance service quality, train health cadres, and improve human resource capacity while fostering cross-sector collaboration for more effective case finding and patient support. article.articleHeadline: Dấu hiệu nhận biết sớm 5 bệnh truyền nhiễm thường gặp trong mùa mưa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early signs of five infectious diseases commonly seen in the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Five infectious diseases commonly seen in Vietnam’s rainy season: dengue fever, hand-foot-and-mouth disease, measles, chickenpox, and seasonal influenza. Dengue outbreaks often follow heavy rains, with abrupt fever 39–40°C, severe headache behind the eyes, muscle and joint pains, and facial flushing; by day 3–4, skin petechiae or nosebleeds may appear. Hand-foot-and-mouth disease in children features fever and oral ulcers, followed by vesicular rashes on palms, soles, knees and buttocks. Measles presents with high fever 38.5–40°C, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, Koplik spots, and a rash starting behind the ears and spreading. Chickenpox begins with mild fever and itching, then scattered vesicles that crust; complications can include pneumonia, vomiting, seizures or coma. Seasonal influenza causes abrupt fever, severe myalgia, headache, cough, sore throat, and nasal symptoms; young children may have nausea or diarrhea. Most cases are manageable at home; seek urgent care for red-flag signs such as hemorrhagic manifestations, respiratory distress, altered consciousness, or shock.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another person tests positive! Answers to these COVID-19 questions are here!
article.articleSummary: China’s national COVID-19 surveillance shows a June 2026 rebound. From June 1–30, 2026, 79,000 new cases were reported across 31 provinces and Xinjiang, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (with underlying disease). In sentinel acute-respiratory illness data, SARS-CoV-2 positivity was 9.6% among influenza-like illness patients, second to influenza (11.6%). Genomic surveillance of 3,741 locally sourced SARS-CoV-2 genomes found all Omicron lineages, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and sublineages (weeks 23–26: about 95–99%). No evidence of a novel high-risk variant. Experts attribute the surge to waning population immunity; summer indoor cooling with reduced ventilation may boost spread. Most infections are mild—fever, sore throat, cough, runny nose—with some diarrhea; pneumonia and severe illness remain rare. High-risk groups (elderly, chronic disease, immune compromise) should seek prompt care and vaccination, and continue measures like masks, ventilation, hygiene, and antiviral treatment if infected.

article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts the United States to tighten border controls as of 14 July 2026. The CDC reports ongoing transmission with 1,926 cases and 702 deaths in the DRC, across multiple provinces, and continued activity in Uganda. A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC has tested positive; two more Americans infected have been transported to Germany for treatment. In response, the U.S. temporarily restricts entry for travelers who recently visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. Returning U.S. citizens will undergo enhanced health screening, and those who visited affected areas should monitor health for 21 days and avoid travel if Ebola-like symptoms appear. For Americans in or leaving the DRC, no commercial flights back until a 21-day stay in a third country. The State Department is assisting; the CDC has raised the response level to the highest.

article.articleHeadline: Travellers reminded to take precautions to avoid infections abroad this summer
article.articleSummary: Provisional data for England, Wales and Northern Ireland show ongoing imported infections during Jan–Jun 2026: dengue 137 cases with South-East Asia and South Asia as main exposure regions (Thailand 27; Maldives 19); Zika 8 cases, Indonesia exposure 4, with pregnancy risk noted and no vaccine; chikungunya 59 cases, Sri Lanka the most common exposure (18); malaria 557 cases (Jan–May 2026), preventable with correct antimalarial prophylaxis. Enteric fever (typhoid and paratyphoid) totals 287 (Jan–Jun 2026), with peak activity May–October and 118 cases in September 2025 cited as context. Measles outbreaks persist worldwide; two-dose MMR/MMRV vaccination is advised for travelers and routine immunizations should be up to date, especially for children. Public health guidance emphasizes mosquito-bite prevention (repellent, covered skin, bed nets), food/water hygiene, vaccinations, and consulting TravelHealthPro for destination-specific advice, including pregnancy precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季の海外渡航者に対し、感染症予防の注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 英国における輸入感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア、腸チフス等）の定例サーベイランスデータに基づく渡航者向け注意喚起であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は英国（イングランド・ウェールズ・北アイルランド）における輸入感染症の統計データ発表であり、タイ、モルディブ、インドネシア、スリランカ等は英国渡航者の感染曝露地域として言及されているに過ぎず、これらの国自体でのアウトブレイク発生を報じるものではないため、対象国での実発生とは判断せずverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 新／今年首例！境外移入茲卡病例 3旬男赴泰後感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New: This year's first imported Zika case — a man in his 30s infected after traveling to Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC confirms 2026’s first imported Zika case: a man in his 30s from the northern region who returned from Thailand in mid-June. He developed fever, dizziness, and head fullness, with a rash in late June; lab testing confirmed Zika. Contacts and cohabitants are asymptomatic; exposure sites were cleaned and traced. Year-to-date, Taiwan has 1 imported Zika case in 2026. Since 2016, 31 Zika infections have been diagnosed, all imported, from Southeast Asia: Thailand 8, Vietnam 6, Philippines 3, Myanmar 3, Malaysia 3. Globally, Americas account for most cases (>11,000 by late June 2026). Transmission occurs mainly via Aedes mosquitoes, with sexual and vertical routes. Symptoms are mild: fever, rash, arthralgia. Pregnancy risks include fetal microcephaly or death. Pregnant or planning pregnancies should avoid Zika areas; if traveling, use preventive measures and seek care if symptomatic after return. Post-travel: men 3 months, women 2 months; blood donation delayed 1 month.

triage.headline_ja: 新／今年初の輸入性ジカ熱症例、タイ渡航後に感染した30代男性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における2026年初の輸入例（タイ渡航後感染）で、症状は軽度、接触者は無症状、局所感染の兆候もなく、例年通りの散発的な輸入症例報告にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本症例は台湾での輸入例であり、感染地とされるタイでの流行拡大や異常事象を示す情報はない。過去10年間の輸入例統計として東南アジア各国（タイ・ベトナム・フィリピン・ミャンマー・マレーシア）が挙げられているが、いずれも travel history の言及であり、現地でのアウトブレイクを示すものではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc viêm não Nhật Bản gia tăng, nhiều ca nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Japanese encephalitis cases among children, many in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis cases among children are rising in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. From the start of 2026, two hospitals report cases: Children’s Hospital 2 (Nhi Dong 2) has admitted 6 JE cases; 2 have brain sequelae requiring tracheostomy and prolonged ventilation. The Infectious Diseases department at Nhi Dong 2 records 3 encephalitis cases, of which 1 is JE and 2 from other causes. A 12-year-old, T.M.K., from Lam Dong province, arrived with seizures and reduced consciousness, but after 8 days of treatment regained alertness and could eat independently. At Children’s Hospital City, 7 JE cases have been seen this year, with most progressing to intubation and ventilation. Dr. Kiều Quốc Thanh warns that JE is dangerous to the CNS, with about 30% mortality and around 60% developing sequelae. JE virus is transmitted by Culex mosquitoes, peaking May–September; vaccination and boosters, plus mosquito control, are essential.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で日本脳炎患者が急増、重症例多数
triage.triage_reason: 日本脳炎による重症・後遺症例が複数報告され、地域メディアで注目されているため、WPRO基準（重症度・流行性）を満たし社会的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はベトナムで季節性に発生する既知の疾患だが、今回は重症例（気管挿管・後遺症）が複数報告されており、ワクチン接種率や蚊媒介対策の状況について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội: Ăn tiết canh, bệnh nhân bị viêm màng não nghi do nhiễm liên cầu lợn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi: Eating raw blood soup, patient has meningitis suspected to be caused by Streptococcus suis infection
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, Hanoi’s National Hospital for Tropical Diseases treated a 45-year-old man from Bac Ninh for meningitis suspected to be Streptococcus suis infection after consuming raw pig blood dishes (tiết canh). On admission he had reduced consciousness (Glasgow Coma Scale 9) with meningitis signs and rapid brain edema risk, requiring endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, antibiotics, and intensive care. After four days of treatment, his condition improved and he was extubated and moved to the Infectious Diseases Department. Streptococcus suis is a leading cause of meningitis in Vietnamese adults and can cause sepsis, rash, coagulopathy, shock, multi-organ failure, and death if not treated promptly. Authorities warn against eating tiết canh or undercooked pork due to contamination risks. The report also notes two deaths and three hospitalizations in Hung Yen linked to eating pig entrails and tiết canh.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ:豚の生き血スープ(tiết canh)を食べた患者が連鎖球菌感染疑いの髄膜炎を発症
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで既知の風土病であるStreptococcus suis感染の散発事例であり、人-人感染の可能性はないが、他地域での死亡例も報告されており継続的な食習慣リスクとして経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suisはベトナムで豚の生き血や未加熱豚肉摂取に関連して毎年報告される既知の疾患。今回はハノイの個別症例だが、フンイエン省でも同様の食習慣による死亡2例・入院3例が報告されており、継続的な食品衛生リスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: EUA Suspendem Regresso Imediato de Cidadãos Vindos da RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The U.S. Suspends Immediate Return of Citizens From the DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers U.S. travel restrictions under Title 49, suspending immediate return of American citizens in or recently departed from the DRC until they spend 21 days in a third country before boarding to the United States. The outbreak has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across multiple provinces near Kinshasa. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic illness, spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes high fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. About two dozen Americans scheduled to fly home on Tuesday after staying in the DRC are affected. CDC reports a U.S. humanitarian worker tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain; another infected American was hospitalized in Frankfurt, Germany, and a third, physician Peter Stafford, was transferred to Germany for treatment in May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者の即時帰還を停止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,926症例・702死亡の大規模エボラ流行が発生し、国際的な人的拡大（ドイツ・米国での感染例）と渡航制限措置が生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ドイツ（フランクフルト）や米国での感染者搬送・帰国制限は国際拡大の証左だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには計上せず。主たる発生地であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: இபோலா பாதிப்பைச் சமாளிக்க $2 மில்லியன் நிதி வழங்கும் சிங்கப்பூர்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singapore to provide $2 million in funding to tackle the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: 2 million dollars in funding from Singapore will support the Ebola outbreak response in the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The funds, about 2.5 million in local currency, will back research, vaccination campaigns, and patient care, and finance procurement of protective gear, medicines, oxygen, and emergency equipment. The support will be delivered through Africa CDC and the World Health Organization. WHO declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, highlighting its international risk. The funding underscores collaborative international assistance to strengthen outbreak response, surveillance, and health system readiness in affected areas. This ongoing Ebola outbreak was designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール、エボラ対応のためコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダに200万ドルの支援を表明
triage.triage_reason: WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したエボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ対応へのシンガポールからの資金支援について述べている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。シンガポールは資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）が明記されており、国際的リスクの高さを示す重要な事案。

article.articleHeadline: After two COVID deaths in Andhra Pradesh, Odisha steps up vigilance ahead of Jagannath Rath Yatra; what travellers should know
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-related deaths have been reported in Andhra Pradesh, as Odisha heightens vigilance ahead of the Jagannath Rath Yatra on July 16. Odisha’s border districts are increasing surveillance and testing suspected cases at district hospitals as lakhs of devotees and tourists are expected to visit. Despite a decline in cases, Odisha maintains COVID-19 surveillance and emphasizes no need for panic. The Rath Yatra is a large outdoor, crowded event, raising risks of respiratory illness spread. No travel restrictions or mandatory COVID protocols have been introduced for visitors. Travellers should avoid travel if symptomatic (fever, cough, sore throat), wear masks, sanitize hands, stay hydrated, and seek medical care if symptoms appear; elderly and those with comorbidities should be extra cautious. Tamil Nadu also urged vigilance with no new restrictions; the overall message is to stay informed, not alarmed.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID関連の死亡2例、ジャガンナート・ラート・ヤートラを前にオリッサ州が警戒を強化、旅行者への注意点
triage.triage_reason: COVID関連死亡2例と大規模宗教行事前の警戒強化が報じられているが、症例数の急増や異常な変異株等の情報はなく、既存の季節的変動の範囲内とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 大規模宗教行事(Rath Yatra)による人流増加でCOVID拡大リスクが懸念されているが、渡航制限やマスク着用義務化等の措置はなく、パニックの必要はないとの当局見解。続報で死亡者数や感染者数の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 1963 حالة بينها 719 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 1,963, with 719 deaths.
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 1,963 confirmed Ebola cases and 719 deaths, according to a latest official tally cited by Cairo News Channel. The figures indicate a continued deterioration of the outbreak, despite ongoing international and local efforts to contain transmission. Ebola remains among the deadliest viruses, requiring strict infection-control measures and robust health systems, particularly in regions with weak infrastructure. The update underscores the severity of the crisis and the need for sustained containment and support to bolster outbreak response and healthcare capacity across affected areas. No regional breakdown is provided in this briefing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が1,963例に上昇、死者719人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（症例1,963例、死亡719例、致死率約37%）が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 地域別内訳は本ブリーフィングでは示されていない。致死率約36.6%と高く、継続的な感染拡大が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые приступили к тестированию вакцины против штамма Бундибугио
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have begun testing a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: First-in-the-world clinical trials have begun for a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. In Phase I, the vaccine will be tested on 50 healthy adults to assess safety and initial immune responses. The effort comes amid an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa that has claimed more than 700 lives. For Phase I, 4,000 doses were produced; the Serum Institute of India has produced approximately 620,000 doses for later trial phases. The article dated July 14, 2026 notes that this marks a significant step in expanding protective tools against Bundibugyo Ebola and improving response capacity in the region. Details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases are not provided.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちがブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカで700人以上の死者を出しているエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行を背景に、新規ワクチンの第1相臨床試験開始が報じられており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカでのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）とワクチン開発に関するもので、具体的な発生国名（DRC等）は明示されていない。インドはワクチン製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）としての言及であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 广西受灾区域各类重点传染病监测指标平稳
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monitoring indicators for various key infectious diseases in Guangxi's disaster-affected areas are stable.
article.articleSummary: On July 13, Guangxi Health Commission briefed that post-flood areas are entering a high-risk window for infectious diseases, but surveillance signals remain normal and overall risk is stable. Five disease groups—enteric/infectious diarrheas, foodborne, vector-borne, zoonotic, and respiratory—are being closely watched. Flooding raises risks of bacterial dysentery, typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A, and other diarrheas; vector-borne risks include dengue, chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis due to stagnant water and heat; zoonoses such as leptospirosis, cutaneous anthrax, brucellosis, Streptococcus suis infection, and epidemic hemorrhagic fever may emerge, with severe cases presenting fever, jaundice, and kidney injury. Guangxi implements a monitoring and early warning plus environmental remediation strategy: daily case evaluation, symptom sentinel points at temporary clinics and resettlement sites, and strict daily/zero reporting for diarrhea, fever, and rash; rapid epidemiological tracing and source control. Environment: rapid cleanup, carcass disposal, water drainage, vector control, and food safety at markets, schools, and shelters.

triage.headline_ja: 広西被災地域における各種重点感染症の監視指標は安定
triage.triage_reason: 記事は洪水後の感染症サーベイランス体制の説明であり、監視指標は正常・リスクは安定していると報告されている。実際の集団発生や異常な感染症事例は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水後の公衆衛生当局によるルーティン監視報告であり、具体的な疾病発生や異常事例の報告はない。中国広西の地方行政区域(ADM1)は対象国リストに国レベルの発生地域としては該当するが、内容が予防的モニタリング報告に過ぎずシグナルとしての重大性は低いため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 北部30多歲男赴泰返台染茲卡病毒！ 疾管署籲孕婦當心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man in his 30s from northern Taiwan contracted Zika virus after returning from Thailand; CDC urges pregnant women to be cautious.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's first imported Zika case of the year involves a man in his 30s from northern Taiwan who returned from Thailand in mid‑June; he developed fever, dizziness and headache, and was confirmed positive in late June; contacts are asymptomatic. Zika spreads via mosquitoes, sexual contact, and mother‑to‑child transmission; pregnant women should avoid travel to Zika areas and use precautions if travel is necessary. Since 2016, Taiwan has recorded 31 Zika cases, all imported, mainly from Southeast Asia: Thailand (8), Vietnam (6), with the Philippines, Myanmar, and Malaysia (3 each), Maldives (2), and single cases from Indonesia, Singapore, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saint Lucia, the United States (Florida), and Angola. Three new domestic Japanese encephalitis cases involve individuals in their 70s in Taoyuan Guanyin District, Taoyuan City, and Huatan Township, Changhua County; onset June 13–18; symptoms include dizziness, headache, diarrhea, fever, weakness, and altered consciousness; all hospitalized. Exposures nearby rice paddies, dove houses, or pig barns; vector control measures and vaccination emphasized. This year JE totals 5 cases; peak season is June–July; vectors include three‑spotted, ringed, and white‑headed mosquitoes.

triage.headline_ja: 北部の30代男性がタイ渡航後にジカウイルスに感染、疾病管理署が妊婦に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内の輸入ジカ症例1例および季節性の日本脳炎国内発生報告であり、対象国（タイ等）は渡航歴としての言及に留まり実際の発生地ではないため、対象国に関するシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国外）における輸入ジカ症例と季節性日本脳炎の国内発生。タイ・ベトナム等は過去の輸入症例の渡航先国として列挙されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن تشدد قيود السفر إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية بسبب توسع تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington tightens travel restrictions to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to expansion of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) expands, prompting tightened U.S. travel restrictions. Americans currently in or recently departing the DRC face a no-boarding ban unless they spend 21 days in a third country. Congolese health authorities reported 1,926 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths as the outbreak extends to additional provinces. About 24 Americans were slated to travel to the United States; the State Department will assist those affected. The CDC confirmed an American working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC infected with the Bundibugyo (BDBV) strain; another American patient was evacuated to Frankfurt, Germany for treatment. Since the outbreak began, 112 health workers have been infected, 35 of whom have died. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; field challenges include weak health infrastructure and a strike at an Ituri treatment center. Oxford researchers began a first human trial of a Bundibugyo-focused vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントン、エボラ流行拡大を受けコンゴ民主共和国への渡航制限を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が拡大し1,926症例・702死亡、医療従事者112名感染・35名死亡、米国が渡航制限強化・自国民避難を実施しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは患者の渡航・搬送先として言及されているが、発生国はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株での感染拡大、医療従事者感染多数、ワクチン治験開始など重大な公衆衛生事象。

article.articleHeadline: सोनीपत: डीसी नेहा सिंह की अपील, हर रविवार मनाएं सूखा दिवस, मलेरिया-डेंगू से बचाव के लिए घर में पानी न होने दें जमा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sonipat: DC Neha Singh's appeal, observe a Dry Day every Sunday; to prevent malaria and dengue, do not let water accumulate inside the house.
article.articleSummary: Sonipat District Collector Neha Singh urged residents to curb mosquito-borne diseases—Malaria, Dengue, and Chikungunya—by eliminating standing water and observing a Dry Day each Sunday. To prevent breeding, empty and clean water containers such as coolers, water tanks, pots, fridge trays, buckets, old tires, and other receptacles. Ensure no water collects for more than seven days anywhere; remove rooftop debris and unused items. Wear full-sleeve clothing, use mosquito nets at night, and apply mosquito repellents as needed. If symptoms such as high fever, chills, headache, vomiting, or body or joint pain appear, seek immediate testing at the nearest government health center rather than self-medicating. The health department is running a district-wide awareness campaign; citizens are urged to participate to make Sonipat malaria-, dengue-, chikungunya-free. Eradication requires collective effort.

triage.headline_ja: ソニパット:DCネハ・シン氏の呼びかけ、毎週日曜日をドライデーに-マラリア・デング熱予防のため家庭内に水を溜めないように
triage.triage_reason: 行政による通常の予防啓発キャンペーンであり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行を示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染者数や流行状況を報告しておらず、季節性の蚊媒介感染症予防に関する行政キャンペーンの紹介記事である。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Warning over uptick in terrifying Zika virus that causes brain damage
article.articleSummary: Eight Zika virus cases have been reported in the UK in 2026, according to the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), surpassing seven recorded in 2025. The UK is warning Britons travelling to holiday hotspots to take precautions as cases rise rapidly. Zika, primarily spread by mosquitoes, can also be sexually transmitted in rare cases. Symptoms resemble fever and include high temperature, headache, sore eyes, swollen joints, and a rash; infection during pregnancy can trigger severe brain damage in developing fetuses. The most frequently linked travel location is Indonesia (four UK cases), followed by Thailand (two), with one case each from Malaysia, Maldives, and Singapore. The advisory urges travel planning via TravelHealthPro, and mosquito-borne protection (repellent, covered skin, bed nets) plus hygiene precautions. Pregnant or conceiving individuals should consult healthcare providers before travel. This is breaking news; updates to follow.

triage.headline_ja: 脳障害を引き起こす恐ろしいジカウイルスの増加に対する警告
triage.triage_reason: UKにおける輸入ジカウイルス症例のわずかな増加（2025年7例→2026年8例）を報告する記事であり、対象国での新規アウトブレイクや異常な流行拡大を示す情報はないが、渡航関連感染症として東南アジア地域における継続的なリスクを示唆するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: UKHSAによる渡航者向け注意喚起であり、UK国内での症例増加が主題。渡航先としてインドネシア（4例）、タイ（2例）が最多で、マレーシア・モルディブ・シンガポールは対象国リスト外のため除外。妊娠中の感染による胎児への影響は既知のリスクであり新規性はない。

article.articleHeadline: KAEF Siapkan Ekosistem Terintegrasi, Perkuat Misi Indonesia Bebas TB pada 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KAEF Prepares an Integrated Ecosystem, Strengthens Indonesia's TB-Free Mission by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's TB fight hinges on an integrated health ecosystem, as PT Kimia Farma (KAEF) pledges to support elimination by 2030 and a TB-free Indonesia by 2050. Despite medicines, Indonesia remains the second-largest TB burden after India, with an estimated 1,090,000 cases and about 125,000 deaths annually; Kemenkes 2024 data show roughly 885,000 cases detected and reported. KAEF offers end-to-end capabilities—from production of raw materials and finished TB drugs to nationwide distribution and health services—to bolster national TB control. Its portfolio covers drug-sensitive TB (DS-TB) and drug-resistant TB (DR-TB), including Fixed Dose Combination (FDC) products for adults and children. The statements came at the National TB Forum 2026 in Jakarta, underscoring policy implementation aligned with elimination targets.

triage.headline_ja: KAEF、統合エコシステムを準備し2030年インドネシアTBフリー達成を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核流行に対する製薬企業の取り組みに関する政策・事業紹介記事であり、新規異常事態や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: インドの記載はインドネシアの結核負担比較のための言及であり、インドで発生しているイベントではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 又一波新冠来了！医生提醒：不用恐慌，但也别硬扛
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another wave of COVID-19 has arrived. Doctors remind: there's no need to panic, but don't try to tough it out.
article.articleSummary: Another wave of COVID-19 has arrived in China as infections rise and fever clinics report higher visits. The piece warns that COVID-19 is not inherently self-limiting; while many recover with rest and hydration, fever, headache, throat pain and muscle aches reflect ongoing viral battle and can impair recovery. Symptomatic treatment with guidance from a physician or pharmacist is reasonable for fever and pain. It also urges keeping a well-stocked home medicine cabinet of common antipyretic-analgesics. In Guangdong, the well-known He Ji Gong brand offers 阿咖酚散 (Akofen San) powder and capsules—an antipyretic/analgesic combination of aspirin, acetaminophen and caffeine—used for fever and mild-to-moderate pain from colds or flu. Part of Guangzhou Baiyunshan, the brand is a Chinese time-honored trademark with domestic market share over 70%. Practical advice: rest, fluids, balanced diet, and prudent use under guidance.

triage.headline_ja: また新型コロナの波が来た！医師が注意喚起：パニックにならなくていいが、無理をしないように
triage.triage_reason: 中国広東省における季節性COVID-19感染増加を伝える一般的な健康啓発・市販薬紹介記事であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクの記載はない。
triage.notes: 記事は市販の解熱鎮痛薬（阿咖酚散）の紹介を含む健康啓発・宣伝的内容が中心であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Covid cases in AP reignite calls for heightened surveillance and caution
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths and new cases in Andhra Pradesh trigger cross-border alerts as Odisha tightens border surveillance and Telangana refrains from a formal advisory. In AP, active cases were detected after the fatalities in Hyderabad, prompting immediate surveillance alerts and caution about possible localized uptick amid rising upper respiratory infections. Odisha directs districts to heighten border vigilance and test anyone with respiratory symptoms, though no positives confirmed yet. Telangana has not issued a formal advisory; Basthi Dawakhanas in Hyderabad and Warangal continue treating viral infections, with no concerted SARI/ILI surveillance reported. Union Health Ministry has not issued an advisory. Public health officials warn that COVID-19 remains endemic and seasonal surges may recur during monsoons and winter.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でのCOVID症例増加、監視強化を求める声再燃
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既にエンデミック化しており、季節性の局地的増加として報告されている。中央政府も正式な勧告を出しておらず、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 地方紙による地域限定の季節性COVID報道。死亡例2件は言及されているが規模・重症度の詳細不明。中央保健省は勧告を出しておらず、州レベルでも対応にばらつきがある通常の監視強化報道と判断。

article.articleHeadline: இபோலா தொற்று: காங்கோவுக்கும் உகாண்டாவுக்கும் $2.5மி. சிங்கப்பூர் உதவி, சிங்க‌ப்பூர் செய்திகள் - தமிழ் முரசு Singapore News in Tamil, Tamil Murasu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: $2.5 million Singapore aid to Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Singapore pledges S$2.5 million to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda to combat the ongoing Ebola outbreak, channeled through the WHO and Africa CDC. The funds will bolster laboratory testing, contact tracing, infection control, and patient management. The WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths have been reported as of July 12. The outbreak is caused by the Ebola Bundibugyo (BVD) strain, with Uganda also affected. Singapore Health Minister Ong Ye Kung called for immediate coordinated international action. The assistance aims to strengthen testing capacity, surveillance, and response measures in both countries, with coordination between WHO and Africa CDC since June 5.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行:シンガポールがコンゴとウガンダに250万シンガポールドルの支援
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で、確定症例1,926人・死亡702人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な支援・拡大リスクも認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行に対するシンガポールの資金援助を報じているが、対象国リストにウガンダとシンガポールは含まれないためDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで、ブンディブギョ株（BVD）による流行。

article.articleHeadline: Taiwan COVID cases rise for 5th week | Taiwan News | Jul. 14, 2026 17:57
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a fifth straight week of rising COVID-19 cases, with the Centers for Disease Control recording 2,811 outpatient and emergency visits last week, up 34.4% from the prior week; officials warn weekly visits could exceed 5,000. Projections suggest peak infections in mid- to late August, potentially reaching about 50,000 weekly visits, below last year's 70,000, a figure possibly revised downward due to summer vacation and school closures. Since October 2025, Taiwan has tallied 136 domestic severe COVID-19 cases and 18 deaths; older adults accounted for 72.1% of severe cases, people with underlying conditions 83.8%, and 94.9% of severe patients had not received the season's vaccine. The CDC notes rising COVID activity in China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore, and urges eligible residents to get the latest vaccine; government-funded vaccinations are available through July 31 for everyone aged 6 months and older.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾、COVID-19感染者数が5週連続で増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性COVID-19の通常範囲内の増加であり、IHR基準は満たさないが、重症例・死亡の発生や近隣国での感染拡大が見られるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事では中国・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールでも感染増加が報告されているが、対象国リストに該当するのは中国（香港含む）のみ。季節性の流行パターンであり、CDCも既存の対策（ワクチン接種呼びかけ）で対応している。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford begins first human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine BD-Ebov enters first human trial as of 14 July 2026. Oxford University's ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine will be evaluated for safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Oxford, with recruitment underway and vaccinations expected in coming weeks pending regulatory approval. The platform mirrors the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Serum Institute of India has manufactured about 620,000 doses and supplied 4,000 investigational doses for the phase I study. The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompted WHO to prioritise ChAdOx1 BDBV alongside a single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo for clinical evaluation. CEPI has pledged up to $8.6 million to support development, and further Uganda studies are planned in collaboration with MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit, contingent on approvals. If successful, late-stage trials would pursue emergency-use or full approval and ensure rapid, affordable supply.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、ブンディブジョ・エボラウイルスワクチンの初のヒト治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はオックスフォード大学でのエボラ（ブンディブジョ型）ワクチン第I相治験開始に関する研究開発ニュースであり、新規の感染症発生シグナルではない。DRC/ウガンダでの既存アウトブレイクは背景情報として言及されているのみ。
triage.notes: 疾患名がCOVID-19と誤分類されているが、実際はエボラ（Bundibugyo種）ワクチン治験に関する記事。インドはワクチン製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak is at Least Double the Formal Tally, WHO Says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is likely far larger than the official case tally. WHO emergencies chief Dr Chikwe Ihekweazu said, based on modelling and support from partners, that the true number of Ebola cases is at least 2–4 times higher than what is being counted. He made the remark after visiting eastern DRC and speaking to reporters in Geneva, with Reuters noting the source. The statement highlights substantial undercounting in the ongoing outbreak, complicating response efforts. The article does not provide precise counts or death figures; it emphasizes the challenge of measuring outbreaks in the field. No details on infection source, lab confirmation, or imported/exported cases are given in the piece.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、WHOによれば公式集計の少なくとも2倍規模
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生事象であり、DRCでの流行が公式統計より大幅に過小評価されている可能性が指摘されており、国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO幹部の発言に基づくもので、具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記載されていない。スイス（ジュネーブ）は発表場所であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is at least double the formal tally, WHO says
article.articleSummary: True number of Ebola cases in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is at least 2-4 times higher than the official tally, according to the World Health Organization. On July 14, 2026, WHO emergencies chief Dr Chikwe Ihekweazu told reporters in Geneva after a visit to eastern DRC that modelling and support suggest the outbreak's scale is significantly undercounted. The article does not provide precise case or death counts. It notes ongoing Ebola transmission in Congo but offers no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The statement highlights substantial under-detection of the outbreak and the need for continued surveillance and response, with the location specified as eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and the date tied to the WHO briefing in Geneva.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、WHOは公式集計の少なくとも2倍と発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRC東部のエボラ症例数が公式集計の2〜4倍に上ると発表しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と過小評価という異常事態が確認されるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: スイス・ジュネーブはWHO記者会見の開催地であり、実際の発生地はDRC東部のみ。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 1708 إصابات و580 وفاة.. أزمة رواتب تشلّ جهود مكافحة إيبولا في إيتوري
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,708 cases and 580 deaths... Payroll crisis paralyzes Ebola response in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province is hampered by an open-ended strike by dozens of staff at the Roambara Ebola Treatment Center, over unpaid salaries and allowances since May. The walkout involves epidemiologists, case investigators, drivers, and grave diggers, who shut the hospital and blocked access, citing PPE shortages and perceived unfair treatment. The action unfolds as early clinical trials target the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola; WHO warns of ongoing transmission driven by population movement and security challenges, noting several treatment centers at capacity. Officially, the outbreak has reported 1,708 infections and 580 deaths, with later counts of 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths in 2026, marking one of the most complex Ebola waves in the country’s history. Health workers warned they would strike within 24 hours if dues remained unpaid, potentially hindering containment in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 1,708人感染、580人死亡…給与未払い危機がイトゥリ州のエボラ対応を麻痺させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で大規模なエボラ流行（1,708〜1,873症例、580〜672死亡）が継続しており、医療スタッフのストライキや治安・人口移動によりWHOが感染拡大継続を警告している深刻な事案。
triage.notes: 給与未払いによる医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を著しく低下させており、WHOも人口移動・治安悪化による感染継続を警告。ブンディブギョ株の臨床試験も進行中で、複雑な流行として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Taiwan may enter new COVID-19 epidemic phase this week: CDC
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC warned of a possible new COVID-19 epidemic phase as early as this week after 2,811 people sought care last week, up 34.4% from the prior week. Five consecutive weeks of rising activity have Taiwan on alert; neighboring regions including China, Hong Kong, South Korea and Singapore report similar trends. The agency said weekly COVID-19 medical visits could keep rising; exceeding 5,000 visits per week would trigger a formal new epidemic phase, with infections peaking one month to 45 days after the threshold. The peak is not expected to surpass last year’s, potentially reaching around 50,000 weekly visits, aided by summer vacations reducing transmission. Since Oct 2025, Taiwan has recorded 136 domestic severe COVID-19 cases, including 18 deaths; 72.1% of severe cases were 65+, 83.8% had chronic illnesses, and 94.9% had not received this season’s vaccine. High-risk individuals are urged to vaccinate or get a second dose if ≥6 months since the last shot. About 456,000 doses remain; publicly funded vaccination is open to everyone 6 months and older through July 31.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾、今週にも新たなCOVID-19流行期に入る可能性:CDC
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で季節性COVID-19患者数が5週連続増加し新流行期入りの可能性があるが、重症・死亡は主に高齢・基礎疾患・未接種者に偏り、CDCも既存対応(ワクチン供給)で管理可能としており、対象国での主要な発生も確認されないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾のCOVID-19季節性流行であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。中国・香港・韓国・シンガポールは『類似傾向』として言及されるのみで主題ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。台湾CDCは自国内で対応可能としており、ワクチン在庫(約45.6万回分)も確保済み。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: حجم تفشي فيروس إيبولا أربعة أضعاف عدد الحالات المبلغ عنها - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak is four times the number of reported cases — This Week
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the true scale of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times higher than officially reported cases. Cairo News Network cited the warning in a breaking news bulletin. Meanwhile, the administration of President Donald Trump has imposed new travel restrictions on Americans arriving from the DRC to reduce the risk of Ebola importation as the outbreak expands across several provinces. Official data released on Sunday place the outbreak at 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals, with common symptoms including high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱の流行規模は報告された症例数の4倍か—今週
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認済み1,926例・死亡702例のエボラ出血熱が複数州に拡大し、WHOは実際の規模が報告の2〜4倍と警告。米国も渡航制限を課しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Cairo（エジプト）はニュース配信元であり発生地域ではない。米国は渡航制限措置を取った国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: des médecins à l'épicentre de l'épidémie menacent de faire grève
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Doctors at the Epicenter of the Outbreak Threaten to Go on Strike.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists after being declared on May 15 as the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak. As of July 12, 1,963 cases and 719 deaths have been reported, with healthcare workers accounting for 112 infections and 35 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri Province, where the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center has treated 384 cases and 89 deaths. Frontline staff protested by burning tires and temporarily blocking access, saying they have not been paid since the crisis began. After a 48-hour ultimatum demanding salaries and allowances, a dry strike could be launched. Five eastern provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths at the border. The virus, Bundibugyo, has no vaccine or approved treatment, though a two-treatment clinical trial is ongoing. About $1.5 billion has been mobilized to support the response; officials acknowledge payment delays and aim to resolve organizational issues.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:流行の震源地の医師たちがストライキを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目(深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク)に該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当する重大なエボラ流行であり、医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を脅かしている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも国境付近で20例・2死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの第17次エボラ流行(Bundibugyo株)は5月15日に宣言され、1,963症例・719死亡、医療従事者112名感染・35名死亡。ワクチン・承認済み治療法がなく、医療従事者の未払い賃金によるストライキ脅威が対応の重大なリスクとなっている。

article.articleHeadline: AS Larang Warganya Pulang dari Kongo di Tengah Meluasnya Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Bans Its Citizens From Returning From Congo Amid the Spreading Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United States bans U.S. citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from returning to the United States on flights, placing them on a do-not-board list under Title 49 with a required 21-day quarantine in a third country before returning. As of 12 July 2026, Ebola has 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across several DRC provinces, including near Kinshasa. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever spread by direct contact with infected bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and bleeding. About two dozen Americans traveling from the DRC were slated to fly home on 14 July 2026, with the State Department assisting during the waiting period. The CDC confirmed a U.S. humanitarian worker infected with Bundibugyo Ebola in the DRC, treated in Frankfurt, Germany, and another American, Dr. Peter Stafford, moved to Germany. RFK Jr. cited rising risk near Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行拡大の中コンゴからの自国民帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが1,926症例・702死亡と大規模拡大しキンシャサ近郊にも波及、米国が渡航制限措置（帰国禁止・検疫）を取るなど国際的対応が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは対応国であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。DRCでの大規模エボラ流行が主題であり、Kinshasa近郊への拡大や国際渡航制限措置が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sivasagar reports no AES, JE deaths amid Assam's encephalitis surge
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, Sivasagar district, Assam reported no AES or JE deaths this year despite a statewide encephalitis surge. The District Health Department records 33 AES cases and 6 confirmed JE cases in Sivasagar, with all JE patients recovered after treatment. The majority of AES cases originated in the Kheluwa Development Block; blockwise AES: Geleki 5, Kheluwa 11, Dimou 6, Gaurisagar 5, Moranbazar 1. Preventive measures launched in February, including intensified vector surveillance, mosquito-net use, waste management, and public awareness, along with rapid surveillance, fogging, fever-testing drives, and frontline worker involvement, are cited for the decline. Context: Assam reports 147 JE cases and 10 deaths statewide so far this year, with JE deaths in Baksa, Cachar, Chirang, Kamrup (Metro), Tamulpur, Barpeta, Jorhat, Lakhimpur and Kamrup districts.

triage.headline_ja: シブサガールでAES・JEによる死亡なし、アッサム州の脳炎流行の中で
triage.triage_reason: アッサム州で日本脳炎（JE）・急性脳炎症候群（AES）の季節性流行が継続中で死亡例（州全体で10名）も出ているが、例年発生する既知の風土病であり、既に地域で対策（サーベイランス強化、防蚊対策等）が奏功しつつあるため、直ちにフルRRAには進まず継続監視が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はアッサム州シブサガール県における日本脳炎（JE）およびAES（急性脳炎症候群）の状況報告で、地域の対策（媒介動物サーベイランス強化、防蚊ネット、フォギング、発熱検査など）により死亡例がゼロとなったことを述べている。州全体では147件のJE症例と10件の死亡が報告されているが、これはアッサム州で毎年見られる季節性流行であり、突発的・異常な事象ではない。発生地域リストにシリア、ギリシャ等が含まれるが、記事本文はインド・アッサム州のみに関するものであり、他国は対象外。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में पेट दर्द, उल्टी और ऐंठन को न लें हल्के में, हो सकता है 'Stomach Flu', पढ़ें बचाव का सही तरीका - do not take stomach pain and vomiting lightly during the monsoon it could be stomach flu read ways to prevent it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Do not take stomach pain, vomiting, and cramps lightly during the monsoon; it could be gastroenteritis. Read the correct way to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: Gastroenteritis (stomach flu) during India’s monsoon poses dehydration risks, with abdominal cramps, continuous or intermittent vomiting, headache, mild fever, and weakness. Norovirus is cited as a common cause, though severe cases can affect other organs. The article highlights higher risk in humid, rainy seasons that foster bacteria, viruses, and fungi. Transmission is water- and foodborne: rainwater collection and washing produce outdoors, street foods, and lapses in kitchen hygiene can propagate infection. Eat fresh, home-cooked meals; avoid open-air foods. Sprouted grains should be cooked rather than eaten raw; avoid prolonged exposure of cooked foods at room temperature; refrigerate leftovers and reheat thoroughly. Emphasis on handwashing before meals and after using the toilet, handling pets, or gardening; avoid drinking suspect water and contaminated water sources. No outbreak counts are provided. Guidance from Dr. Anil Arora, Senior Gastroenterologist, Sir Ganga Ram Hospital, New Delhi, is cited.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期の腹痛・嘔吐・けいれんを軽視しないで、それは『ストマックフル(胃腸炎)』かもしれない――正しい予防法を読む
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、モンスーン季節の一般的な胃腸炎予防に関する健康啓発記事であり、症例数や異常な流行の報告はない。
