article.articleHeadline: Jaan Kumar Sanu on his sudden battle with Covid-19: It was very shocking
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, singer Jaan Kumar Sanu revealed he tested positive for Covid-19, marking a revival of the virus after avoiding infection throughout the pandemic. The Mumbai-based artist was hospitalised with fever 102–103 F, chills, shivering, and a fainting episode after gym and concert-prep. Doctors confirmed Covid-19 infection. He underwent two days of intensive treatment and injections, then was discharged Sunday evening, though recovery continues. He says immunity is low and lungs are stressed; he must stay indoors, take heavy medication, and drink fluids for at least a month, with strict mask use. The illness has paused his upcoming Mumbai concert, 'Dil Diaries,' with plans to reschedule by the end of the month. He remains hopeful about returning to the stage once recovered.

triage.headline_ja: ジャーン・クマール・サヌー、突然のコロナ闘病を語る「非常にショックだった」
triage.triage_reason: 個人の芸能人1名の罹患・入院に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 個人の著名人に関する健康情報であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての集団発生・アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: إعلان صادم من "الصحة العالمية" بشأن معدلات الإصابة بفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A shocking announcement from the World Health Organization regarding Ebola virus infection rates.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization states that the true scale of Ebola virus infection is between two and four times the officially reported cases, indicating underreporting. The agency cites weak health infrastructure, difficulty accessing certain areas, and social stigma as key factors driving undercounting, which heightens the risk of unchecked transmission and complicates containment efforts. The report underscores the need for strengthened surveillance, outreach, and public health response in affected regions. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, confirmed Ebola cases have risen to 1,963, with 719 deaths. The data imply gaps in reporting that may mask the outbreak’s true burden and suggest that current figures underestimate ongoing transmission and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)によるエボラウイルス感染率に関する衝撃的な発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ感染の過小報告（実数は公式の2〜4倍）を公表しており、死者719人・確定症例1963例という重大な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国での過小報告を指摘しており、実際の感染規模は公式統計より大きい可能性が高い。監視体制の強化と国際的な支援の必要性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Új, invazív kullancsfaj terjed: súlyos, akár szervkárosodást okozó fertőzést is átadhat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New, invasive tick species spreading: could transmit severe infections that may cause organ damage.
article.articleSummary: Longhorned tick Haemaphysalis longicornis, an invasive species from East Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, is spreading. In the United States it has established in more than twenty states and reached Turkey in 2025; Poland has limited presence; Europe is monitoring. Researchers warn this tick can carry Ehrlichia chaffeensis, the agent of ehrlichiosis. Climate warming extends tick activity year-round, with milder winters shortening dormancy and causing early spring activity and late fall persistence. Ehrlichiosis begins with fever, chills, severe headache, myalgia/arthralgia, and fatigue; some patients have nausea or diarrhea. Incubation is typically 5-14 days after a tick bite; early doxycycline treatment improves outcomes; untreated infection can affect liver, kidneys, lungs, and nervous system, with possible hospitalization and death. The tick can reproduce parthenogenetically, enabling rapid population growth. In Hungary ehrlichiosis remains rare.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな侵入性マダニ種が拡大：重篤な臓器障害を引き起こす感染症を媒介する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ等）における発生事例ではなく、米国・トルコ・ポーランド・ハンガリーでのマダニ種拡大に関する一般的な科学記事であるため、監視対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は東アジア原産のマダニ（Haemaphysalis longicornis）の米国・トルコ・ポーランドでの拡大とエールリキア症リスクを扱う内容で、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）のいずれにおいても具体的な発生事例は報告されていない。中国は『発生地域』に含まれるが、記事内では起源地としての言及のみで発生の主体ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ministry of Health Convenes Ebola Accountability Forum, Commends Response Partners
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports 20 confirmed Ebola cases in the current outbreak, with 2 deaths, 17 recoveries, and 1 active admission; most cases were imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a smaller share from local transmission. The Ministry of Health, with support from WHO Uganda, convened an Ebola Accountability Forum to provide financial and accountability updates, promote transparency, and strengthen trust among government and development partners. The forum reviewed resource use, aligned partner support with response priorities, and updated stakeholders on the Ebola situation. Key officials—Director General Health Services Prof. Charles Olaro; Health Minister Dr. Chris Baryomunsi; and Permanent Secretary Dr. Diana Atwine—emphasized cross-border cooperation with DRC and ongoing efforts to end the outbreak. The gathering reinforces transparent resource management, preparedness for future emergencies, and lessons learned for regional Ebola control, with Uganda continuing support to regional efforts and noting partners that did not restrict travel.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、エボラ出血熱に関する説明責任フォーラムを開催し、対応パートナーを称賛
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定20例（死亡2例含む）が報告され、DRCからの越境輸入例と地域内伝播が確認されているため、国際的拡大リスクのあるシグナルとして評価する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの対応会議だが、症例の大部分はDRCからの輸入例であり、DRCが感染源として記事の中心的関心事となっているため、DRCを検証済み地域として記載した。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tren HIV di Riau Meningkat, 4.524 Kasus Capai Stadium AIDS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV Trend in Riau Increases, 4,524 Cases Reach AIDS Stage.
article.articleSummary: Riau Province, Indonesia reports an increasing HIV burden, with 11,523 people living with HIV (HIV) from 1997 through Q1 2026, of whom 4,524 have progressed to AIDS. Among these, 7,137 are alive; 4,524 have advanced to AIDS. In Q1 2026 alone, 187 new HIV infections were identified. Transmission occurs mainly via infected blood, mother-to-child during pregnancy or delivery, and unprotected sexual contact. The Dinas Kesehatan (Health Office) continues the STOP strategy: Suluh (awareness), Temukan (case finding), Obati (treatment), and Pertahankan viral suppression. Screening yielded 195,298 HIV tests in 2025. Currently, 4,222 people living with HIV in Riau receive antiretroviral therapy (ART); ART stock from the Ministry of Health is secure and sufficient to meet needs. Emphasis is on early detection and sustained ART to prevent progression to AIDS.

triage.headline_ja: リアウ州のHIV傾向が増加、4,524件がAIDS段階に到達
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるHIV/AIDSの継続的な報告であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、地域保健当局がSTOP戦略とART供給体制で管理中。新規かつ急性の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": عدد المصابين بفيروس إيبولا ضعف الحصيلة الرسمية على الأقل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus is at least twice the official tally.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization states that the true number of Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo, particularly its eastern regions, is at least twice the official tally and may be four times higher. WHO Emergency Programme Executive Director Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu told reporters in Geneva after a visit to eastern DRC that, based on supporting data and modeling, the outbreak size is not fully captured by detected cases. The comments underscore potential under-detection and the need for intensified surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and response efforts to curb transmission in the DRC. The report highlights uncertainties in reported counts and the implications for public health planning and resource allocation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラウイルス感染者数、少なくとも公式集計の2倍か
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がWHOにより公式報告の2〜4倍過小評価されている可能性が指摘されており、重症度・国際的拡大リスク・対応能力の観点から複数基準に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: スイス(ジュネーブ)はWHO記者会見の開催地であり、発生地域としては該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد الإصابات المؤكدة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 1963 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 1,963.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-14, the Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,963 confirmed cases, with 719 deaths, according to authorities in a Reuters-cited update. The outbreak continues within the country. Ebola is transmitted by direct contact with the body fluids of an infected person or animal. Reported symptoms include very high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. The update underscores the ongoing severity and the need for continued public-health measures to curb transmission and protect healthcare workers and communities. The figures reflect the latest official tally reported to Reuters and indicate sustained transmission risk across affected regions.

article.articleHeadline: Erste Bundibugyo-Ebola-Impfung startet klinische Tests in UK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine begins clinical trials in the UK.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of July 11, 2026, the DRC reported 1,926 cases and 702 deaths across five provinces, with Kinshasa among high-risk areas; Uganda reported 20 cases with 2 deaths as of July 12. Oxford University’s Vaccine Group launched the first human trial of a Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine in Oxford, a Phase I study assessing safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. Uganda-led trials are planned after approvals from the Medical Research Council/Uganda Virus Research Institute and the Uganda Research Station of the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine. Africa CDC supports the rapid, high-standard studies. These early trials are not an immediate solution but a crucial step for future outbreak response and tool development.

article.articleSummary: First Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine begins human trials in the United Kingdom. Oxford University’s vaccine group launched the world’s first Phase I trial for a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, enrolling 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Oxford to assess safety and immune response. Pending regulatory approval, participants will be vaccinated and undergo follow-up visits over the coming weeks. Additional Phase I studies are being prepared in Uganda at the Medical Research Council/Uganda Virus Research Institute and the Uganda Research Unit of the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine. The trial coincides with an ongoing Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; by July 11, the DRC health ministry reported 1,926 cases and 702 deaths across five provinces, while Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths on July 12, with ten provinces including Kinshasa deemed high risk.

Africa CDC welcomes rapid progress amid high-risk areas, including Kinshasa.

article.articleHeadline: Saat Gaji Tak Kunjung Datang, Garda Terdepan Ebola di Kongo Memilih Mogok Kerja |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Salaries Fail to Arrive, Congo's Frontline Ebola Guards Go on Strike | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is grappling with the largest Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Africa, centered in Ituri Province with the Rwampara General Hospital under strain. By mid-July, over 1,900 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and hundreds of deaths have been reported. Frontline staff—including epidemiologists, case investigators, ambulance drivers, and mortuary workers—went on strike on July 13, blocking roads and shutting the Rwampara facility to protest months of unpaid salaries and delayed bonuses since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. Protests raise fears of slowed patient care, contact tracing, and safe burials. The government cites payroll verification glitches to ensure correct payouts, acknowledging delays. PPE shortages and intense risk add to frontline burdens as families depend on earnings not yet received.

triage.headline_ja: 給与未払いが続く中、コンゴのエボラ対応最前線スタッフがストライキを選択

triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州における大規模エボラ流行と、給与未払いによる最前線対応スタッフのストライキが対応能力に与える影響を報じている。発生地域に含まれる'Africa'は大陸レベルの分類のため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 新加坡拨200万美元 援手非洲抗击伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singapore allocates US$2 million to aid Africa in the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Singapore allocates US$2 million to assist Congo (Kinshasa) and Uganda in the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The aid, channeled through Africa CDC and the World Health Organization under the Africa Continental Joint Preparedness and Response Plan launched on June 5, will fund laboratory surveillance, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and on-ground case management. Funds will buy equipment for expanded testing, diagnostic devices, frontline PPE, and essential medicines, IV fluids, blood products, oxygen, and critical care supplies for treatment centers. The move follows WHO and Africa CDC declaring Bundibugyo Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with rapid case evolution in the region. Health Minister Ong Ye Kung says global health security is a collective responsibility and pledged rapid, well-coordinated support. Singapore has previously supported Africa CDC and WHO, including a US$12 million pledge to CEPI and 24 million yuan to WHO's first investment round.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールがアフリカのエボラ流行対策支援に200万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: WHO・アフリカCDCがブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の発生をPHEICと宣言し、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで急速な症例増加が報告されており、国際的関心・支援対応が活発化している。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はシンガポールによる資金拠出だが、実際のエボラ発生国はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO・アフリカCDCによりPHEICが宣言されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として重大視されている。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon brings increased risk of dengue and malaria; district hospital has set up eight special wards, health department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon raises dengue and malaria risk in Noida district as waterlogging and sanitation gaps boost mosquito breeding. Noida district hospital has created eight special wards for dengue treatment, with essential medical facilities, trained staff, ample medicines, and patient monitoring. If cases rise, admissions will be initiated promptly; currently no dengue patients are admitted in any government hospital. Health officials warn the monsoon season may further elevate transmission, and the health department will deploy additional resources if needed. Preventive guidance includes eliminating standing water around homes, regular cleaning of coolers, flower pots, tanks and old tires, wearing long sleeves, using mosquito nets, and applying repellents. Symptoms warranting immediate medical testing include high fever, headache, body pains, retro-orbital pain, vomiting, and red rash. Public urged to seek care promptly at government facilities.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンでデング熱・マラリアのリスク増大;県立病院が8つの特別病棟を設置、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の予防的注意喚起であり、現時点で患者発生の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアはインド（ウッタル・プラデーシュ州ノイダ）における例年のモンスーン季節性リスクに関する予防的報道。現時点で症例数の急増や異常事態の記載はなく、県病院は準備態勢を整えている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Maine ICE protests, Hormuz, Congo Ebola politics and Paramount lawsuit
article.articleSummary: Trump threatens a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and demands a 20% toll on cargo. In Maine, protesters fill streets after the second deadly ICE shooting in the United States within a week. Bangkok weighs surprise night-time safety checks on venues after a deadly pub fire. In Congo, M23 rebels leverage an Ebola outbreak in their territory to showcase leadership. Meanwhile, twelve states sue to block Paramount's Warner Bros deal, which would be the biggest merger in Hollywood history. The items illustrate a cross-issue snapshot—from U.S. foreign leverage via Hormuz to domestic gun violence, urban safety governance after a fatal incident, and health-security dynamics in Central Africa, alongside a major media consolidation dispute. Published 2026-07-14.

triage.headline_ja: メイン州のICE抗議、ホルムズ海峡問題、コンゴのエボラ政治利用、パラマウント訴訟
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ（DRC）でのエボラ流行がM23反政府勢力によって政治利用されているとの言及があるが、症例数・死亡者数・具体的な発生地域など疫学的詳細が一切なく、既存流行に関する政治的文脈の報道に留まるため。
triage.notes: 記事はポッドキャストの複数トピック概要であり、エボラに関する疫学的詳細（症例数、地域、死亡者数等）は本文に含まれていない。M23支配地域での発生という点で対応困難性（manageability）が示唆されるが、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून के साथ बढ़ा डेंगू-मलेरिया का खतरा; जिला अस्पताल ने बनाए 8 विशेष वार्ड, स्वास्थ्य विभाग सतर्क
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon brings increased dengue and malaria risk; the district hospital has established 8 dedicated wards, and the health department remains on alert.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season raises the risk of dengue and malaria in Noida, prompting preemptive health-system readiness. Noida District Hospital has established eight dedicated wards for dengue treatment, with trained staff, adequate medicines, and patient-monitoring provisions. At present, no dengue patients have been admitted in any government hospital. Officials warn that ongoing rains and water-logging could boost mosquito breeding in the coming weeks, sustaining the outbreak risk. Residents are urged to eliminate standing water around homes — coolers, pots, tanks, old tires, and similar sites — and to wear full-sleeve clothing, use mosquito nets, and apply repellents. Clinicians say anyone with high fever, headache, body aches, retro-orbital pain, vomiting, or rashes should promptly seek testing at a government facility to prevent complications. The district hospital and health department remain vigilant and ready to mobilize additional resources if cases rise.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンとともにデング熱・マラリアのリスク増大;地区病院が8つの専用病棟を設置、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で実際の患者発生は報告されておらず、モンスーン季節における例年通りの予防的対応を伝える記事であるため、フルRRAに進むほどのシグナルではないが、今後の患者発生動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン季節性のデング熱・マラリア警戒に関する予防的な報道であり、現時点で確定患者は報告されていない。今後の降雨状況・患者数推移を継続的にモニタリングする必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's response to this Ebola outbreak shows how to shape global health
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, has more than 1,700 cases confirmed since April and remains ongoing as of July 14, 2026. Dozens of governments and health organizations support the response, with Africa CDC and WHO promoting evidence-based measures—community reporting, case isolation, infection-control in health facilities, and strong community engagement. Africa CDC declared a public health emergency of continental security within days of confirming human transmission to mobilize resources under a single plan, budget, and team. The DRC has expanded bed capacity, decentralized testing, and screening/referral units to triage cases, prioritizing local needs. A field hospital in Kenya was funded to hold exposed and infected Americans locally rather than repatriating them. Ministers pledged cash or in-kind support for the DRC, contrasting with US travel bans (also imposed by Canada and the Bahamas) deemed scientifically unfounded.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのこのエボラ流行への対応は、世界保健のあり方を示している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる流行は1700例超に達し、複数国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的な影響が大きく、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での流行を中心に記述。ウガンダ・ケニア・米国等は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。米国・カナダ・バハマの渡航制限は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Covid Alert in Andhra Pradesh: 2 Deaths, 8 Positive Cases in Recent Weeks
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 alert in Andhra Pradesh, India: as of 14 July 2026, two deaths and eight confirmed cases have occurred in recent weeks. The deceased include a 52-year-old man who developed typical symptoms and a 43-year-old man from YSR Kadapa district who arrived with severe breathing difficulties; both died after hospital treatment. Eight other positive cases are recovering at home. Health authorities have deployed medical teams to trace and test close contacts, and state hospitals have been instructed to create isolation beds and stock medicines and test kits. Laboratories are testing samples to identify the circulating variant. Officials emphasize no panic but urge mask use in crowded places and diligent hand hygiene. The situation reflects a monitored, localized uptick with contact tracing and containment measures in Andhra Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州でコロナ警報：ここ数週間で死亡2名、陽性8名
triage.triage_reason: インドのアンドラプラデシュ州で小規模なCOVID-19の増加（死亡2名、陽性8名）が報告されているが、規模は限定的で地域当局が接触者追跡と隔離対応を行っており、現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ただし変異株の特定が進行中であり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 州保健当局が接触者追跡・隔離病床の確保・検体検査（変異株特定）を実施中。感染規模は小さく、パニックを避けるよう当局が呼びかけている。続報（変異株特定結果や感染拡大の有無）に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Οι ΗΠΑ απαγόρευσαν την επιστροφή Αμερικανών από τον Κονγκό - Στέλνουν πολίτες με Έμπολα σε τρίτες χώρες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States barred the return of Americans from Congo — They are sending Ebola-infected citizens to third countries.
article.articleSummary: Under Title 49, the United States bars the return of Americans who travelled to the Democratic Republic of Congo amid the Ebola outbreak, placing them on a non-boarding list until they complete 21 days in a third country. The order, signed Monday by Health and Human Services Secretary John Kennedy Jr., leaves more than 20 Americans awaiting evacuation from Congo in limbo, with the State Department to assist during the three‑week observation. The move follows earlier suspensions of Ebola-related repatriations and has drawn criticism from US health officials in letters to Congress who warned it breaches repatriation policies and raises clinical risk, potentially deterring volunteers and NGOs. Two Americans in Congo have tested positive for Ebola and were transferred to Germany for care. The Congo outbreak totals 1,929 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, initially centered in Ituri but now also in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, with models suggesting true cases may be 2–4 times higher, and Kinshasa is near the spillover.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴからの帰国米国人の入国を禁止 ― エボラ感染者を第三国へ移送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,929例・702人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、首都キンシャサ近郊にも波及。米国が自国民の帰国を制限するなど渡航制限措置が発動されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 米国とドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国内でのエボラ渡航制限措置や患者移送は国際的拡大・対応の文脈情報として記録。真の症例数はモデル推計で公表値の2〜4倍の可能性があり、状況は悪化傾向。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Shock rise in imported diseases as British tourists warned over mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: Eight Zika virus cases were recorded in England from January to June 2026, already surpassing the seven cases in all of 2025, with four linked to Indonesia. The UK Health Security Agency reports 137 imported dengue cases Jan–Jun 2026, mostly from South-East Asia and South Asia; 27 tied to Thailand and 19 to the Maldives. Fifty-nine chikungunya cases were reported Jan–Jun, Sri Lanka accounting for 18; 73 chikungunya cases were recorded in the same period last year. Malaria reached 557 cases in England, Wales and Northern Ireland from January–May, up from 548 at the same point last year. Typhoid and paratyphoid fever totalled 287 Jan–Jun. Disease prevention advice includes insect repellent, long sleeves, treated bed nets, vaccines, and check TravelHealthPro for destination-specific guidance including anti-malarial tablets; maintain food/water hygiene; travellers, especially pregnant, should consult healthcare providers before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介感染症の輸入例が急増、英国人旅行者に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 英国内における渡航関連の輸入感染症統計・注意喚起記事であり、対象国での新規アウトブレイクや異常事象を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は英国健康安全保障庁（UKHSA）が公表した2026年上半期の輸入感染症（ジカ熱、デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア、腸チフス等）の症例数統計に基づく旅行者向け注意喚起であり、渡航先（インドネシア、タイ、モルディブ、スリランカ等）での現地アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。モルディブ・スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Ebola en RDC: des médecins à l'épicentre de l'épidémie menacent de faire grève
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Ebola in the DRC: doctors at the epicenter of the outbreak threaten to go on strike.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains active as the country’s 17th outbreak, declared on May 15, continues to challenge the response. Nearly two months into the effort, health facilities—among the world’s poorest—face chronic resource gaps that hamper containment. Frontline doctors and care workers, who say they have not been paid by the state since the crisis began, threaten to strike. Official counts from the INSP show 1,963 infections and 719 deaths. Among healthcare workers, 112 infections have occurred, with 35 deaths. The article highlights the strain on the health system and ongoing transmission, emphasizing the need for sustained funding and support to protect workers and curb spread as the outbreak persists in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - コンゴ民主共和国:流行の震源地の医師たちがストライキを警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ第17次アウトブレイク（感染1,963例、死亡719例、致死率約37%）が継続し、医療従事者への未払いによるストライキの脅威も加わり公衆衛生対応に深刻な支障が出ている。
triage.notes: エボラは既知の疾患であり感染症自体は「異常」ではないが、致死率の高さと医療体制崩壊リスク（ストライキ）により深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際拡大リスクが認められる。第17次アウトブレイクとして継続中であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 國內今年首例茲卡境外移入　30多歲男泰國返台後確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first domestically imported Zika virus infection: a man in his 30s who returned to Taiwan from Thailand was diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first domestically imported Zika virus infection this year: a man in his 30s from the northern region who returned from Thailand in mid-June, developed fever, dizziness, headache and a rash, and tested positive. Household members and contacts are asymptomatic; authorities completed vector control and contact tracing. Deputy Director-General Zeng Shu-Hui urged travelers to Southeast Asia to use mosquito protection and practice safe sex; pregnant women should avoid travel to Zika-affected areas. As of July 13, Taiwan has 1 imported Zika case this year; since 2016, 31 cases, all imported, mainly from Southeast Asia. Globally, the Americas dominate outbreaks with over 11,000 cases by late June; Southeast Asia reports sporadic activity. Post-return, three weeks of mosquito precautions and one month before donating blood are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 国内今年初のジカ熱、海外由来症例:30代男性がタイから帰国後に確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入例で、既に接触者調査・防蚊対策が完了しており、二次感染の兆候もないため、国際的拡大や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 感染はタイでの滞在中に起きたと考えられ、台湾側は輸入症例として報告・対応済み。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはThailandのみ記載。既に接触者調査・防蚊対策完了で二次感染なし。

article.articleHeadline: 315 chèvres mortes en cinq jours : le Grand Kasaï frappé par une peste animale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 315 goats dead in five days: Grand Kasai struck by an animal plague
article.articleSummary: 315 goats dead in five days in Lusambo, capital of Sankuru, amid a peste des petits ruminants (PPR) outbreak in Grand Kasaï. On July 10, the Minister of Fisheries and Livestock briefed the government on a worrying zoo-sanitary situation as PPR—viral and highly contagious— strikes goats and sheep and spreads rapidly. The crisis is not confined to Lusambo; neighboring provinces—Kasaï, Kasaï-Central, Kasaï-Oriental, and Lomami—are affected, with losses jeopardizing households where a goat finances schooling or healthcare. Human risk is underscored by canine rabies in the region, causing more than 30 deaths despite an available vaccine and limited access to care. In Nord-Kivu (Beni, Lubero, Butembo) and Ituri, PPR outbreaks have triggered vaccination campaigns; authorities are launching a second vaccination phase and continuing nationwide operations to curb transmission amid seasonal herd movements.

triage.headline_ja: 5日間でヤギ315頭が死亡：大カサイ地方を襲う家畜疫病
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は家畜のペスト・デ・プティ・ルミナン（PPR）流行による経済的被害であり、人獣共通感染症としての狂犬病による30人以上の死亡は背景情報として言及されているが詳細（発生時期・地域範囲）が不明であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はPPR（家畜疫病）による経済的損失であり、人への直接的な感染症アウトブレイクではない。ただし狂犬病による30人以上の死者数への言及があり、ワクチンがあるにも関わらず医療アクセスが限られている点は公衆衛生上の懸念材料。狂犬病の発生時期・地域詳細が不明なため、追加情報を待ってフルRRAの必要性を再評価すべき。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford begins first human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine BD-Ebov advances to first-in-human Phase I trial at Oxford, testing safety and immunogenicity in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 using the ChAdOx1 BDBV vector (same platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine). Serum Institute of India stockpiled about 620,000 doses and provided 4,000 investigational doses for the study. CEPI funds of $8.6 million support Oxford and SII, with additional Uganda-based trials planned subject to regulatory approval. The trial follows the World Health Organization declaring the Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by 57 days prior. If safe and immunogenic, CEPI plans larger late-stage trials to support emergency use authorization or full licensure. Africa CDC welcomed the milestone, noting early trials build vaccine readiness for the current epidemic and future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、ブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがブンディブギョ型エボラ流行をPHEICと宣言してからワクチン開発が進んでいる状況であり、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はオックスフォードでのワクチン臨床試験に関する報道であり、実際の流行地はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）。インドはワクチン製造・供給元（Serum Institute of India）としてのみ登場し、疾患発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Реальное число заболевших Эболой в ДРК может вчетверо превышать официальные данные - ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Real number of Ebola cases in the DRC could be four times higher than official data - WHO
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the total number of Ebola cases may be four times higher than official counts. The current tally stands around 2,000 infections with more than 700 deaths. WHO emergency program director for health emergencies, Chikwe Ihekweazu, said at a Geneva briefing that using mathematical models, the outbreak's true scale is at least 2–4 times the identified cases, though detection is improving and figures are becoming more reliable over time. About 80% of new cases involve individuals not listed as contacts, indicating hidden transmission chains, while many patients die at home before receiving care. The report highlights ongoing challenges in containment and the need for broader contact tracing and community engagement in the DRC. As of 2026-07-14."}{

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ患者の実数は公式データの4倍に上る可能性 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: エボラという致死性の高い疾患で、公式数値の2-4倍の過小報告、隠れた感染連鎖(接触者未登録80%)が示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHOの記者会見開催地であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana's HIV Case Surge: 1,145 New Infections Reported in First Half of 2026 - A Closer Look at the Rising Trend
article.articleSummary: HIV in Ghana surged with 1,145 new infections reported January–May 2026 by the Ghana AIDS-Committee (GAC), signaling a rising epidemic. Ghana Health Service (GHS) and GAC respond with expanded HIV testing sites, mobile and community testing in rural and informal settlements, and the removal of user fees for testing, treatment, and care. Public awareness campaigns across radio, TV, and digital platforms, plus school-based programs, aim to reduce risk among young adults, sex workers, and networks with high transmission. Partners including UNAIDS, PEPFAR, and local NGOs support intensified testing and prevention. Community groups stress education, peer support, stigma reduction, and policy advocacy. The 90-90-90 targets remain a benchmark; authorities call for more funding, anti-stigma enforcement, and improved healthcare infrastructure to reach universal access and curb new infections.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのHIV感染急増：2026年上半期に新規感染1,145件、増加傾向を詳しく見る
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり急性の国際公衆衛生上の脅威ではないが、国内での新規感染増加と対策強化の動きがあり、動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の性感染症・血液媒介感染症であり、IHR Annex2の急性公衆衛生事象基準には該当しにくい。国内の感染拡大トレンドとして継続的なモニタリングが適切。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Says It Has Less Than Half Funding Needed To Fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains underfunded, with WHO reporting only about 40% of its $115 million appeal has been secured to tackle the Bundibugyo outbreak. As of July 14, 2026, government data show at least 1,926 people infected and 702 deaths. The outbreak has no proven treatment or vaccine. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO's Health Emergencies Programme, urged continued donor support, noting the response has reached a critical point as cases spread to two new provinces and intensified efforts to detect and isolate patients. Ituri remains the worst-hit province, highlighting ongoing transmission challenges. Ihekweazu also estimated that the true number of Ebola cases could be at least double, possibly more than four times the official tally. The article emphasizes the need for resources at a scale matching the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ対策に必要な資金の半分未満しか確保できていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクが拡大し、感染者1,926人・死者702人に達し、新たな州にも拡大、資金不足が深刻化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、資金不足による対応能力の低下が懸念される。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Even Hospitals launches ₹299 fever and dengue screening package in Bengaluru
article.articleSummary: Even Hospitals in Bengaluru launched a ₹299 Fever & Dengue Screening Package to mark its first anniversary, available from 13 July 2026. The package includes a consultation with an internal medicine specialist, CBC, Dengue Panel (NS1 antigen, IgG, IgM), Malaria Parasite Test (MPQB), LFT, and Urine Routine Examination. It targets adults with fever for 1–5 days and symptoms such as body ache, headache, weakness, chills, or fatigue, and those suspecting dengue, malaria, or viral fever. A 24/7 Dengue Hotline (9187213889) connects callers to doctors for symptom guidance, testing recommendations, and need for urgent care. Even Hospitals notes rising dengue and monsoon-related fever cases in Bengaluru and emphasizes early diagnosis to reduce complications. In its first year, the network served over 40,000 members and delivered more than 1.37 lakh specialist consultations; teleconsultations are available across India.

triage.headline_ja: Even Hospitals、ベンガルールで299ルピーの発熱・デング熱検査パッケージを開始
triage.triage_reason: これは病院の商業的なプロモーション記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は民間病院による検査パッケージのマーケティング記事であり、ベンガルールでのモンスーン期の発熱・デング熱増加に軽く言及しているのみで、具体的な症例数や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すデータはない。

article.articleHeadline: Singapura ikrar AS$2 juta bantu tangani wabak Ebola di DR Congo dan Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singapore pledges US$2 million to help tackle the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Singapore pledges US$2 million (about S$2.6 million) to help tackle the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The donation funds laboratory testing and contact tracing, prevention and infection control, and field case management, and will procure essential supplies including diagnostic equipment, PPE, infection-control materials, medicines, oxygen, and critical-care equipment. Funds will be channeled through Africa CDC and the World Health Organization to back Africa’s Continental Preparedness and Response Plan launched on June 5. The WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, followed by Africa CDC’s emergency designation. Africa CDC official Wessam Mankoula called it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded, involving Bundibugyo and other Ebola viruses. As of mid-May, 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or body fluids; there is currently no approved virus-specific treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行対策支援に200万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行（1,759症例、600死亡）であり、複数国に拡大し国際的支援が動員されている重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行に対するシンガポールの資金拠出を報じているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。シンガポールは資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みで、史上最速拡大とされる重大な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Presidente de RDC nombra responsable de campo para respuesta a ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC President Appoints Field Lead for Ebola Response.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 14 July 2026 — Democratic Republic of the Congo President Félix Tshisekedi named Dr. Steve Ahuka as field lead for the Ebola response, citing the outbreak centered in Ituri Province and its spread to other regions. Ahuka will coordinate actions to halt the current outbreak, which has caused 700 deaths and about 1,900 confirmed infections. Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba highlighted government efforts in community sensitization and noted more than 300 recoveries. U.S. Chargé d’Affaires Lan J. McCary attended the national working group meeting and reaffirmed American support, announcing more than $600 million in funding for the response. Officials urged people to seek medical care at the first signs of illness rather than delaying to the diarrheal and vomiting phase, which is harder to control.

triage.headline_ja: DRC大統領、エボラ対応の現地責任者を任命
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（死者700人、感染確定約1900人）が複数地域に拡大しており、国際的な資金援助（米国6億ドル以上）も動いていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国は資金支援国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 cases in India: Doctors say no need to panic, but don't ignore symptoms like fever, cough and body ache
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 cases in Andhra Pradesh total eight, with two related deaths (a 60-year-old man and a 46-year-old man). The first death, on June 28 at Christian Medical College, Vellore, involved severe lung infection with preexisting kidney disease, diabetes, and hypertension; RT‑PCR posthumously confirmed Covid-19. The second death occurred in Kadapa at Government General Hospital‑RIMS due to severe lung infection and related complications. Odisha has stepped up monitoring along districts bordering Andhra Pradesh, and surveillance with isolation wards has been strengthened. Forty contacts were traced, with eight testing positive. In Mumbai, Jaan Kumar Sanu, son of singer Kumar Sanu, was diagnosed and hospitalised until July 12, now recovering. Early symptoms include fever, cough, cold, diarrhea, headache, body/ muscle pains, and sore throat; not every symptom signals Covid-19. Most infections are mild for those with prior immunity, but high‑risk individuals should stay vigilant and remain up to date with vaccinations; preventive measures include good ventilation, hand hygiene, staying home when unwell, and masking in crowded indoor settings.

triage.headline_ja: インドの新型コロナウイルス感染症例：医師は「パニックになる必要はないが、発熱・咳・体の痛みなどの症状を無視しないように」と発言
triage.triage_reason: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州で少数の症例・死亡が報告されているが、いずれも基礎疾患を有する患者であり、医師も「パニックの必要はない」としている。COVID-19自体は既知の疾患であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 有名人（歌手クマール・サヌの息子）の感染が話題になっているが、これは社会的関心というより人間味のある報道要素であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。地域監視体制の強化は継続的措置として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: عدد المصابين بفيروس إيبولا ضعف الحصيلة الرسمية على الأقل - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus is at least twice the official tally - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: As of July 12, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 1,963 confirmed Ebola cases and 719 deaths. WHO emergencies head Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu cautioned that the true outbreak size could be two to four times higher than the official tally. The United States announced a travel ban on American citizens in the DRC traveling on commercial flights, requiring those who have recently left or remain in the country to spend at least 21 days in a third country before boarding to the United States. Ebola is transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, with symptoms including very high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. Separately, a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization infected with the Bundibugyo strain has been treated in Frankfurt, Germany; another American, Dr. Peter Stafford, had been identified as infected and transported to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラウイルス感染者数は公式集計の少なくとも2倍 - シュルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確認症例1,963例、死亡719例）に加え、実際の感染者数が公式発表の2〜4倍との指摘、米国による渡航制限措置、国際的な患者搬送(ドイツ)が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国での症例は治療目的の国際搬送であり、当該国での感染発生ではないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主要な発生地域であり対象国リストに含まれる唯一の国。WHOが過小報告の可能性を指摘しており、実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！30多歲男確診「茲卡病毒」　遊泰返台發燒起紅疹
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of the year! A man in his thirties diagnosed with Zika virus after returning to Taiwan from Thailand, developed fever and rash.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus case of the year: a man in his thirties from the northern region returned from Thailand in mid-June and developed fever, dizziness, and a rash about a week later; laboratory-confirmed infection followed medical consultation. Since 2016, Taiwan has 31 Zika cases, all imported, with about 81% concentrated in Southeast Asia—Thailand (8), Vietnam (6), and the Philippines, Myanmar, and Malaysia (3 each). Globally, Zika has declined from the 2016 peak, affecting at least 97 countries, with roughly 80% asymptomatic. In the Americas, by late June over 11,000 cases were reported, led by Brazil, Argentina, and Bolivia; Southeast Asia shows sporadic, declining activity, with Thailand reporting 76 cases through week 28 this year. Transmission is via Aedes mosquitoes, sexual and vertical routes. Pregnant women or those planning pregnancy should defer travel to Zika regions; use protective measures during travel. Post-return, men should use condoms for 3 months and women for 2 months; pregnant partners require continued protection throughout pregnancy.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初のジカ熱症例！30代男性がタイ旅行後に発熱・発疹で確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入症例1件の報告であり、既知の流行パターン（東南アジアでの散発的発生）の範囲内で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国外）での輸入症例が主題だが、タイ国内での本年の症例数（第28週までに76例、減少傾向）が言及されているためタイのみ検証対象国として記載。他の言及国（ベトナム・フィリピン・ミャンマー・マレーシア等）は2016年以降の累積輸入元データであり、現行の発生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: क्या वापस लौट रहा कोविड? 2022 के बाद पहली बार दो लोगों की मौत, आंध्र प्रदेश में मिले 8 नए केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is COVID-19 returning? For the first time since 2022, two people have died; eight new cases were detected in Andhra Pradesh.
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths were reported in Andhra Pradesh for the first time since 2022, alongside eight newly detected cases. In Kadapa district, five infections were identified, with the remaining three among their contacts. All patients are under home isolation or in a dedicated COVID ward and are being monitored. Post-mortem RT-PCR confirmed the fatalities were due to SARS-CoV-2; both patients had underlying conditions—uncontrolled diabetes and kidney disease—and died on June 28 and July 7, respectively; CT scans showed extensive bilateral pneumonia. To determine if a new Omicron sub-variant is involved, throat and nasal swabs from the deceased and other patients were sent to NIV Pune; results awaited. A five-expert committee ruled out a new deadly sub-variant. Tamil Nadu reports no evidence of a rising variant; NIV notes the current virus causes only mild illness. Six days with no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: コロナは再来しているのか？2022年以来初の死亡2例、アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で新たに8例確認
triage.triage_reason: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で2022年以来初のCOVID-19死亡例と少数の新規感染が報告されたが、専門家委員会は新たな重篤変異株を否定し、直近6日間新規感染なし。新変異株判定のための検体解析結果待ちのため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡した2例はいずれも基礎疾患（未管理糖尿病・腎疾患）を有しており、CTで両側性肺炎が確認された。NIVプネーへ検体送付済みで新変異株の有無を調査中だが、専門家委員会は既に新たな重篤変異株の可能性を否定。タミル・ナードゥ州では変異株増加の兆候なしと報告。全体として現状は軽症例が主体であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は限定的とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi Kongom: Više od 670 mrtvih, SZO upozorava na mnogo veći broj slučajeva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo: More than 670 deaths, WHO warns of a much larger number of cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths reported to date. WHO's Chikwe Ihekweazu, Executive Director of the Health Emergencies Programme, said the true scale is likely two to four times higher than officially confirmed, based on analyses and mathematical models. He spoke at a Geneva press conference, with Reuters reporting his remarks. The assessment signals substantial under-detection amid ongoing transmission and underscores the need for intensified surveillance, case finding, and public health response across affected regions. The report does not detail infection sources, laboratory confirmation specifics beyond the case counts, or information on exported/imported cases. Published 2026-07-14.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大：死者670人以上、WHOはさらに多くの症例数を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が大規模に拡大し、WHOが公式報告数の2〜4倍の実際の症例数を警告しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHOのジュネーブでの会見内容であり、発生地域としてGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。感染源や実験室確認情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: число заболевших Эболой может быть больше официальных данных
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: the number of Ebola cases may be higher than official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, detected in May 2026, continues with likely undercounting. The World Health Organization cautions the true case load may be 2–4 times higher than official figures, citing about 2,000 cases and more than 700 deaths in the DRC. As of early July, ACP reported 1,561 confirmed cases and 506 deaths, with 253 recoveries, for a case fatality of about 32.4% and a contact-tracing rate of 81.6%. Roughly 80% of new infections occur among people not listed in known contact lists, indicating surveillance gaps. By early July, official tallies included 1,502 confirmed cases and 473 deaths. The outbreak began in May in DR Congo and Uganda; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 15 June. Ongoing transmission means possible imported/exported cases and underscores the need for intensified tracing and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ感染者数は公式統計より多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ流行であり、致死率約32%・過小報告の懸念・接触追跡外での感染多発など公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEICを6月15日に宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例茲卡病毒境外移入！北部30多歲男泰國返台後確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first imported Zika virus case! A man in his 30s in northern Taiwan was diagnosed after returning to Taiwan from Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus infection this year: a man in his 30s from northern Taiwan who returned from Thailand in June and developed fever, dizziness, headache, and a rash. He was lab-confirmed; his condition is stable, and contacts remain asymptomatic. Health authorities have conducted vector-control at locations visited by the case and are monitoring exposed individuals. As of July 13, 2026, Taiwan has 1 domestically confirmed Zika case, with 31 total cases since 2016, all imported. Most infections originate from Southeast Asia—Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Myanmar and Malaysia—plus others in Indonesia and Singapore. Globally, the Americas have over 11,000 cases through June 2026; in Southeast Asia, Thailand has 76 and Singapore 7. About 80% of Zika infections are asymptomatic; transmission is via Aedes mosquitoes, sexual and vertical routes. Pregnant women should avoid endemic areas; travelers should practice protection and monitor for 3 weeks after travel.

triage.headline_ja: 今年首例ジカウイルス境外移入例！台湾北部の30代男性がタイから帰国後に確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾からの輸入例1件で、症状は安定し接触者は無症状、ベクター対策も実施済みの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本症例はタイ渡航中に感染し帰国後確診した輸入例。台湾は2016年以降31例（すべて輸入例）を報告しており、今回も既存のサーベイランス体制内で管理されている。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン・ミャンマー等は過去の輸入例の出身国として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題イベントの発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 2年來首例！茲卡病毒境外移入感染 疫情中心：孕婦恐傳染胎兒導致小腦症
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case in two years! Overseas-imported Zika virus infection; Epidemic Center: Pregnant women could transmit the virus to the fetus, causing microcephaly.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first overseas-imported Zika virus infection in two years: a northern man in his 30s who returned from Thailand in mid-June, developed fever, dizziness, headache, and later a rash; laboratory confirmation followed hospital testing. Zika resembles dengue but is usually milder; however, infection during pregnancy can vertically transmit to the fetus, risking microcephaly. The virus spreads mainly via Aedes mosquitoes (Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus) and can also transmit through bodily fluids and blood. After returning from outbreak areas, men should practice safe sex for 3 months and women for 2 months; blood donation should pause for 1 month. Zika is a second-class notifiable disease in Taiwan; since 2016 there have been 31 imported cases, mostly from Southeast Asia. Internationally, since 2016 Zika affected at least 97 countries, with outbreaks mainly in the Americas. In the Americas, 52 countries have reported cases; as of June 27 this year, 11,421 suspected and 448 confirmed, with no deaths. Brazil leads with 8,202; Argentina 1,654; Bolivia 1,445; peak in 2016 with 56,904 suspected.

triage.headline_ja: 2年ぶりの症例！ジカウイルスの海外感染例、疫病対策センター：妊婦が胎児に感染させ小頭症を引き起こす恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の海外感染（タイ渡航歴あり）による輸入症例であり、現地伝播や重症例・死亡の報告はない。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低い。
triage.notes: 台湾での2年ぶりの輸入例。タイへの渡航歴があるが、タイ国内での新規流行や現地伝播の記述はなく、ブラジル・アルゼンチン・ボリビアの症例数は米州における過去の背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 1926'ya yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola outbreak cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,926.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,926 cases with 702 deaths (case fatality rate 36.4%), as of July 14, 2026. The outbreak, first declared May 15 in Ituri after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, has spread to five provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Of the total cases, 753 are in isolation or receiving hospital care, and 318 have recovered. Active surveillance and early case detection continue, with strengthened national and provincial coordination. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. The outbreak is attributed to a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Ebola emerged in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, and the name derives from the Ebola River near Yambuku. The 2013-2017 West Africa outbreak caused about 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、症例数が1,926人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で、5州に拡大し致死率36.4%と深刻。IHR基準を複数満たし、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。承認された治療法・ワクチンなしで、まれなブンディブギョ株による流行。既にフルRRA対象と考えられる継続案件。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford, Serum Institute Launch First Human Trial for New Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, the University of Oxford and the Serum Institute of India launched the world's first human clinical trial for a vaccine designed to protect against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The experimental vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, is the first candidate developed specifically for this strain, for which no approved vaccine exists. The announcement describes the effort as a breakthrough for global public health and represents the first step in testing a strain-focused Ebola vaccine in humans. The article does not provide details on trial sites, participant numbers, or results, but confirms that there is no existing licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学とセラム・インスティテュート、新型エボラワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチンの臨床試験開始に関する研究開発ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・臨床試験のニュースであり、インドやイギリスで実際にエボラの症例が発生しているわけではない。Serum Institute of India はワクチン製造元として言及されているのみで、疾病発生地域ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'ampleur de l'épidémie pourrait représenter " de deux à quatre fois " les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the scale of the outbreak could be "two to four times" the official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times larger than official estimates, according to the World Health Organization on July 14, 2026. While case detection capacity for Ebola is increasing, WHO projections indicate the outbreak's true scale is at least two to four times the number of reported cases. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO's Health Emergencies Programme, told reporters that the estimates reflect improved detection and current epidemiological modeling. The remarks emphasize the potential undercounting and the need for strengthened surveillance and response in the DRC. No exact case or death figures are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：流行の規模は公式推定値の「2倍から4倍」に上る可能性、WHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がWHOにより公式推定の2〜4倍の規模である可能性が指摘されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とサーベイランス強化・国際支援の必要性が示唆される。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載されておらず、WHOによる過小評価の可能性の指摘が中心。続報でのRRA実施が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Resplice Foundation to hold free medical camp for Measles, SSPE-affected children on Aug 9
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad-based Resplice Autism Research Foundation will hold a free medical and research camp for measles and SSPE-affected children on August 9 at Shivapuri Colony, Muppas Panchavati Colony, Manikonda. The camp aims to identify early-stage SSPE and study factors—clinical characteristics, immune responses, genetic and environmental influences, and other biomarkers—to flag at-risk children. About 0.16% of measles cases may later develop SSPE, a progressive neurological disease typically appearing seven to ten years after infection with no proven cure. The event offers clinical evaluation for suspected/early SSPE, history of measles infection, post-vaccination reactions with no symptoms, and developmental or neurological regression after measles or MMR vaccination. Researchers are exploring Faecal Microbiota Transplantation as a potential, experimental therapy, with encouraging but preliminary results in a small cohort. Emphasis remains on measles vaccination to prevent SSPE, especially infection before age one; referrals encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: レスプライス財団、麻疹・SSPE影響児童のための無料医療キャンプを8月9日に開催
triage.triage_reason: 疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、医療啓発・研究キャンプの告知であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はSSPE（亜急性硬化性全脳炎）に関する医療キャンプの告知であり、麻疹の新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Troligen dubbelt så många ebolafall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Likely twice as many Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused 719 deaths and nearly 2,000 confirmed infections. WHO crisis-management chief Chikwe Ihekweazu said analyses indicate the outbreak’s true scale is at least two to four times higher than the identified cases. The outbreak in Congo-Kinshasa began in May and has affected four provinces, with Ituri Province in the northeast the hardest hit. The ongoing outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ感染者数は実際には報告の2倍に上る可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・特異的治療法なし）の流行が続き、死者719人・確認感染者約2000人に達し、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きいと分析。IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、WHOは実際の感染規模が公式報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘。イトゥリ州を中心に4州に拡大しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo er reelt dobbelt så stort
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is actually twice as large.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 1,963 confirmed cases, with WHO and Africa CDC cautioning the true scale is at least two to four times higher. About 719 deaths have occurred among more than 1,900 confirmed cases. Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant; there is no approved treatment or vaccine. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976, believed to originate from fruit bats. The most severe past outbreak occurred Aug 2018–Jun 2020, with 3,470 infections and 2,287 deaths. Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, and initial symptoms include severe fever that can progress to bleeding. The WHO briefing followed visits to eastern DRC as the virus spread in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は実際には2倍規模
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例数が実際は過小報告とされ、致死率が高く、承認された治療薬・ワクチンもないBundibugyo株による過去最速拡大の流行であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOとAfrica CDCは実際の症例数が報告の2〜4倍に及ぶ可能性を指摘しており、過小報告リスクが高い。承認された治療法・ワクチンがない稀なBundibugyo株による流行で、過去最大規模を超える可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Стварни број оболелих од еболе у Конгу и до четири пута већи од званичног
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The actual number of Ebola cases in Congo is up to four times higher than the official figure.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: The World Health Organization's Emergency Programme Director Chikwe Ihekwazu said at a Geneva briefing that the actual number of Ebola cases is at least two, and possibly four, times higher than the officially confirmed count, based on analysis and modeling. Confirmed cases rise to 1,873 with 672 deaths. The statement underscores a substantial gap between laboratory-confirmed figures and the real burden of the outbreak in the DRC. The article relies on Reuters reporting of the Geneva briefing and does not provide details on infection sources or imported/exported cases. Transmission continues amid ongoing containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数は公式発表の最大4倍に上る可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が拡大しており、WHOが公式報告数より実際の感染者数が2〜4倍多い可能性を指摘。死亡者672人と重篤な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ヒト-ヒト感染が継続している。
triage.notes: ジュネーブはWHOの記者会見開催地であり、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。記事は感染源や輸出入例についての詳細を提供していない。

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: WHO warnt: Viele Ebola-Todesfälle bleiben noch unentdeckt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: WHO warns: Many Ebola deaths remain undetected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a grave concern as the WHO warns many deaths go undetected. Lab-confirmed cases exceed 1,900 with over 700 deaths. Most fatalities occur within families rather than in treatment centers, increasing caregiver infection risk; about four-fifths of new infections are not on the contact lists of known cases, signaling numerous untracked transmission chains. Authorities and the WHO are intensifying outreach to reassure the public about treatment efficacy, noting survival is higher in dedicated treatment centers, which can help interrupt transmission. Capacity is being expanded, with nearly 800 beds in specialized centers and 14 laboratories available for rapid diagnostics. However, only 40% of the 115 million USD budget for the first six months has been funded, underscoring an urgent need for additional international support to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症:WHOが警告 多くのエボラ出血熱の死亡例が未だ発見されていない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大しており、確認症例1900人超・死亡700人超、追跡不能な感染連鎖が多数存在し、資金不足で国際支援が急務であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 接触者リストにない新規感染が約8割を占め、監視・追跡体制の限界が示唆される。資金は必要額の40%しか確保されておらず、国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS estime que l'épidémie est largement sous estimée en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO estimates that the outbreak is largely underestimated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is likely two to four times larger than official tallies, the World Health Organization said on July 14, 2026, with case detection improving daily. WHO official Chikwe Ihekweazu cited projections indicating the outbreak’s true scale is much higher than recorded figures. According to the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died. The statement highlights ongoing transmission and the challenge of under-detection, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and response measures. The article provides no information on laboratory confirmation or specific transmission chains, focusing instead on the discrepancy between reported cases and the estimated true burden, and on improving detection capacity in the affected country.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:WHOはコンゴ民主共和国での流行が大幅に過小評価されていると推定
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行規模が公式統計の2〜4倍に達すると推定しており、死亡者数も多く(702人)、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念とサーベイランス強化の必要性が明確に示されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO高官の発言に基づき、症例の過小報告と検出能力向上の必要性を強調している。実験室確認や具体的な感染経路の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak's true scale could be four times higher than official toll, WHO says
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be four times larger than official tolls, according to the World Health Organization. DR Congo’s latest figures show more than 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths since the outbreak was detected in mid-May. WHO modelling, described by Emergencies Director Chikwe Ihekweazu, suggests the true scale is at least two to four times the number of confirmed cases. The report does not provide further details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases. The information highlights a substantial potential undercount in reported figures and underscores the ongoing haemorrhagic fever outbreak in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、実際の規模は公式発表の4倍に達する可能性とWHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであり、WHOが公式統計の過小評価を指摘するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が認められるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: WHOによるモデリングで感染者数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性が指摘されており、実際の感染規模・死亡率の過小評価が懸念される。続報でラボ確認状況や感染源、国境を越えた伝播の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Broj obolelih četiri puta veći od zvaničnog broja: Objavljeni novi podaci o eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of cases is four times higher than the official figure: New data on Ebola have been published.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, data indicate the true Ebola burden in the Democratic Republic of Congo is at least two, and possibly four times higher than the official count. WHO's Ebola Emergency Programme Director Chikwe Ihekweazu said the estimate, based on analysis and modelling, suggests the real extent of the outbreak is 2–4× the officially confirmed cases. The confirmed case tally in the DRC has risen to 1,873, with 672 deaths. In northeastern DRC, a clinical trial is testing two experimental therapies against the Bundibugyo strain as part of an international project led by universities, pharmaceutical companies, and the WHO. The trial uses the antiviral remdesivir (already in use) and MBP134, an experimental agent containing proteins designed to recognize and neutralize the virus, with hopes of reducing mortality after promising animal data.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者数は公式発表の4倍に上る可能性:エボラに関する新データが公表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は確定症例1,873人・死亡672人に達し、実際の規模は公式発表の2〜4倍と推定されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: WHOによる過小報告の指摘、国際共同臨床試験(remdesivir, MBP134)の実施など、国際的関与が高いイベント。国境を越えた拡大の直接的言及はないが、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: यूपी में कोरोना की वापसी.... सांस लेने की दिक्कत के बाद BHU अस्पताल में युवक की COVID-19 रिपोर्ट आई पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The return of COVID-19 in Uttar Pradesh... After breathing difficulties, a young man at Banaras Hindu University Hospital tested positive for COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 case in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh: a 27-year-old Ashapur resident tested positive and was admitted to Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Hospital after experiencing breathing difficulties. BHU clinicians, in the Chest and TB Department, confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and initiated treatment. The patient’s condition is currently stable under medical supervision. Health authorities said the spread of COVID-19 is slower than in previous waves but the virus remains in circulation. They urged vigilance and to seek medical care promptly for symptoms such as cold, cough, fever, or shortness of breath. The report indicates ongoing community presence of SARS-CoV-2 with no details on other cases or transmission sources.

triage.headline_ja: UPでコロナが復活…呼吸困難後、BHU病院で若者のCOVID-19検査が陽性に
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発的なCOVID-19症例報告であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大等のいずれの基準も満たさない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の流行病であり、単一症例の報告で公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。当局も拡大は緩やかとしている。

article.articleHeadline: 建设性意见｜无人注意的角落里，新冠确诊数量拉升到了7.9万例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Constructive Commentary | In an overlooked corner, the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases has surged to 79,000.
article.articleSummary: China faces a seasonal peak in COVID-19 in June 2026, with 79,000 laboratory-confirmed cases reported nationwide in the past month, including 130 severe cases and 1 death (with underlying conditions). Data from the China CDC indicate the 79,000 refers to patients who sought hospital care, were tested, and reported; actual infections likely exceed 300,000. Omicron NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages dominate (>95%), with no new variant emergent. Preventive guidance remains standard, emphasizing ventilation and hand hygiene; there is no current nationwide annual COVID vaccination program in China. In the latest week, influenza accounted for 11.6% and COVID-19 for 9.6% of flu-like illnesses; symptom onset should prompt testing for both pathogens. Antiviral therapies exist for influenza (oseltamivir) and COVID-19; for COVID-19, antivirals can reduce symptoms and severe risk but are not readily available offline in pharmacies and require prescription. The commonly used COVID antiviral, Xianoxin, costs about 100+ yuan post-insurance. High-risk individuals (elderly, hypertension/diabetes) should seek early diagnosis and antiviral treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 建設的意見｜見過ごされがちな角で、新型コロナウイルスの確定症例数が7.9万例に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19流行であり、既知の変異株（Omicron NB.1.8.1）が優勢で新規変異株の出現もなく、重症例・死亡例も少数にとどまるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 季節性のCOVID-19流行に関する国内論評記事。新規変異株の出現はなく、重症化率・致死率も低い。中国CDCのデータに基づく通常の季節性報告であり、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Броят на заразените с ебола в ДР Конго е двойно по-голям, отколкото сочат официалните съобщения, каза СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the DRC is twice as high as official reports indicate, said the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: The World Health Organization says actual infections are at least two times, possibly four times higher than official reports. Government figures list 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. WHO remarks to reporters in Geneva, cited by Reuters. WHO urged donors not to abandon the country in this critical phase of the outbreak. The article notes no laboratory confirmation details. The report emphasizes a disparity between reported data and reality and underscores the need for intensified surveillance, testing, and international support to curb transmission in the DRC. Published 2026-07-14.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ感染者数、公式発表の2倍に上るとWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が疑われ、公式報告数の過小評価がWHOにより指摘されており、国際的拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: スイス・ジュネーブはWHOの会見場所であり発生地ではないため除外。DRCの死亡率（702/1926、約36%）は非常に高く、実際の感染者数はさらに多い可能性がある点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak's true scale could be four times bigger than official toll, WHO says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak could be four times larger than the official toll. Official figures list more than 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths since mid-May. WHO modelling suggests the true scale is at least two to four times the reported cases. The haemorrhagic-fever outbreak was detected in mid-May in the Democratic Republic of Congo. WHO emergencies director Chikwe Ihekweazu stressed that the apparent undercounting means the situation may be more severe than official tallies indicate. The article does not detail laboratory confirmation or specific infection sources, but underscores that the outbreak’s true extent could be substantially underestimated, with implications for surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、実際の規模は公式発表の4倍に達する可能性とWHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであり、WHOが公式統計の過小評価を指摘するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOによる過小評価の指摘があり、実際の感染規模・死亡者数は公式発表を大幅に上回る可能性がある。続報でのケース確定状況・国際的対応の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！30多歲男確診「茲卡病毒」　遊泰返台發燒起紅疹 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case! A man in his 30s diagnosed with Zika virus; fever and rash after returning to Taiwan from Thailand | LIFE Life Network.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports this year’s first imported Zika case: a man in his 30s from northern Taiwan returned from Thailand in mid-June, developed fever and dizziness about a week later, and was diagnosed after a rash. Since 2016 Taiwan has 31 confirmed Zika cases, all imported, with 81% in Southeast Asia; Thailand leads with 8 cases, followed by Vietnam (6), and the Philippines, Myanmar, and Malaysia (3 each). Globally, Zika activity has cooled since the 2016 peak, affecting at least 97 countries, with ~80% of infections asymptomatic. In the Americas, by late June there were over 11,000 cases, Brazil, Argentina, and Bolivia most affected; Southeast Asia shows low-level transmission, Thailand reporting 76 cases through week 28 this year. Transmission is via Aedes mosquitoes and also sexual or mother-to-child routes. Symptoms include fever, rash, joint pain, conjunctivitis; pregnancy risk includes fetal microcephaly or death. Public guidance: mosquito precautions and safe-sex measures—condoms or abstinence for 3 months (men) or 2 months (women) after return, and protection if partner is pregnant.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の症例！30代男性がジカ熱と確診、タイ旅行から台湾帰国後に発熱・発疹
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における1例の輸入ジカ熱症例であり、既知の疾患パターン（毎年散発的な輸入例）で重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾在住者の輸入ジカ熱症例。タイについては今年28週までに76例の発生が具体的に言及されているため含めたが、ベトナム・フィリピン・ミャンマー・マレーシア・ブラジル・アルゼンチン・ボリビアは2016年以降の累計統計として言及されているのみで、現在の主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: El brote del ébola avanza, cruza nuevas fronteras y ya son 700 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak advances, crosses new borders, and the death toll reaches 700.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared in May 2026, has reached 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths, per the Congolese Public Health Institute. New confirmations appear in Haut-Uele and Tshopo; Uganda reports several dozen cases near the border, with WHO models suggesting spread could cross into additional borders with South Sudan. This is the seventeenth official Ebola outbreak in Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is currently no vaccine. The epidemic remains concentrated in Ituri, with cases in Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. Investigations indicate Haut-Uele and Tshopo cases are largely imported from Niania in Ituri, prompting designation of these provinces as an epidemic zone. UNICEF warns nearly 3 million children in eastern DRC are at risk, with about 15% of confirmed cases in minors and over 25% of deaths among children, who face higher mortality than adults.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大、新たな国境を越え、死者数は700人に達した
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で17回目のエボラ流行（ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境・南スーダンへの拡大予測もあり、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、マリ、スーダンも発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株であることと、小児の死亡率が高い点は特に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Западная страна ввела жесткий карантин для своих граждан из-за смертоносной Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Western country has imposed a strict quarantine on its citizens due to the deadly Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 — The White House imposes a quarantine on U.S. citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) or those recently departed, barring boarding homebound flights until they spend at least 21 days in a third country, amid a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak. The CDC confirms Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, with cases across Africa reaching 1,926 and 702 deaths. The epidemic is reported to be advancing within hours of Kinshasa, the Congolese capital. A U.S. humanitarian worker in Congo tested positive, and another infected American is hospitalized at Universitätsklinikum Frankfurt. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. About two dozen Americans planned to depart Congo; the State Department will assist those affected during the wait."}

triage.headline_ja: 西側諸国、致死的なエボラ出血熱のため自国民に厳格な検疫措置を導入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で拡大するエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がキンシャサ首都圏まで到達し、感染者数1,926人・死者702人に達している。国際的な感染拡大（ドイツ・フランクフルトでの入院例、米国人感染者）と米国政府による検疫・渡航制限措置が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生中のエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大について報じており、米国およびドイツへの二次感染例も確認されている。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, primo test sull'uomo del vaccino Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, first human trial of the Bundibugyo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University launches a Phase 1 trial of the ChAdOx1 BDBV Ebola vaccine candidate (BD-Ebov), enrolling 50 volunteers to assess safety and immunogenicity. The study targets Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is supported by Cepi and Serum Institute of India (SII). The trial runs as the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda widens—the third-largest— with more than 1,900 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths as of July 12, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu. A second U.S. humanitarian worker infected with Bundibugyo Ebola was transferred to Germany for care. Bundibugyo is an Ebola virus species with no approved vaccine or therapy; unlike Zaire ebolavirus, for which vaccines exist. A therapeutic trial using monoclonal antibodies and remdesivir began July 2 in DRC. Transmission is by contact with blood or fluids; case finding, isolation, and contact tracing are essential. The partners aim to expedite access and data for regulatory authorization.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、ブンディブギョ株ワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで拡大中のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行（史上3番目の規模、1900例超・死亡700例超）であり、国際的な人的移動（米国人医療従事者のドイツへの搬送）も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。英国（オックスフォード）・ドイツ・米国・インドはワクチン開発・治療にかかわる関係国であり、発生地域ではないため除外。ブンディブギョ株はザイール株と異なり承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Says It Has Less Than Half Funding Needed to Fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo outbreak), with spread into two additional provinces (Ituri is the worst-hit). As of government data: about 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. WHO has received about 40% of its $115 million appeal to counter the outbreak, for which there is no proven treatment or vaccine. Donors are urged not to abandon the DRC at a critical stage of the epidemic. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO's Health Emergencies Programme, said the response has reached a critical point, requiring intensified efforts to detect and isolate patients. He warned the true number of Ebola cases is likely at least double, potentially more than four times the official tally. The article underscores the ongoing, escalating outbreak and the funding gap undermining containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ対策に必要な資金の半分以下しか確保できていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で拡大中のエボラ流行（感染1,926例、死亡702例、複数州に拡大）であり、資金不足が対応を妨げているとWHOが警告しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaやBundibugyo（ウガンダの地名）が含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ州含む）でのアウトブレイクのみを主題としており、ウガンダでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。WHO幹部は実際の感染者数が公式報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、過小報告の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS redoute une épidémie jusqu'à quatre fois plus étendue que le bilan officiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WHO fears an outbreak up to four times as widespread as the official tally.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-14, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is highlighted with a World Health Organization warning that the outbreak’s true scale could be up to four times larger than the official tally. The article does not report specific case or death counts, clinical details, laboratory confirmation, or confirmed transmission chains. It underscores concerns about undercounting and uncertainty surrounding the outbreak’s full extent. No dates of onset, symptom descriptions, or infection source are provided in the text. The report signals potential broader regional public health implications by suggesting substantial underestimation of cases, though it stops short of detailing confirmed cases, timeline, or exported/imported case information.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOは公式集計の最大4倍の規模の流行を懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当しやすい重篤な疾患であり、WHOが公式集計を大幅に上回る規模を懸念していることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と過小評価の可能性が示唆されている。
triage.notes: 記事には具体的な症例数、死亡数、感染経路等の詳細情報がなく、WHOの懸念表明のみに基づく報道。続報でのRRA実施が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolautbrottet växer - vaccin saknas mot varianten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is growing – there is no vaccine for the variant.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo variant) expanding across four provinces, with Ituri province in the northeast hardest hit. Since May 2026, authorities report 719 deaths and nearly 2,000 confirmed infections, though WHO crisis-management chief Chikwe Ihekweazu warns the true scale may be two to four times higher. The Bundibugyo variant drives this outbreak, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this form of Ebola. The situation underscores underreporting concerns and ongoing spread across multiple provinces, emphasizing the need for enhanced surveillance and response, as no vaccine or targeted antiviral is available for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が拡大 - この変異株にはワクチンがない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ変異株）がコンゴ民主共和国の4州に拡大し、719人死亡・約2000人感染確認、ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないため国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOはpublicには報告数の2〜4倍の過小報告の可能性を指摘しており、実態把握のため続報の注視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebolaudbruddet i DR Congo er langt større end rapporter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is far larger than reports indicate
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-14, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 1,963 confirmed cases, but the true total is at least twice that, according to the World Health Organization in a Geneva briefing. The WHO assessment indicates the outbreak's scale is larger than official reports suggest, based on modeling and surveillance support. The article highlights under-detection and the risk that the outbreak burden is underestimated, with implications for ongoing response and public health measures.
