No death count or explicit transmission sources are provided in the excerpt. The focus remains on the markedly underestimated scope of Ebola in the DRC, underscoring the need for sustained international attention and intervention.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: DRコンゴのエボラ流行は報告よりはるかに大規模
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式にエボラ症例数が報告の少なくとも2倍に上ると評価しており、重大な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenèveやSwitzerlandが含まれているが、これはWHO本部所在地であり、実際の発生国はDRコンゴのみ。死亡者数や感染経路は本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Броят на заразените в Конго може да е четири пъти по-голям от официалните данни, съобщи СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected in Congo could be four times higher than official data, WHO said.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times higher than official data, the World Health Organization said, cited by Reuters. Government figures list 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. The WHO statement, delivered to reporters in Geneva, stresses a potential undercount amid an ongoing outbreak in a critical phase and urges donors not to abandon Congo. Separately, the United States has banned travel by Americans from Congo. The report underscores data gaps and calls for continued international support and vigilant surveillance to control the epidemic as of July 14, 2026. The update highlights ongoing concerns about transparency and outbreak dynamics in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの感染者数は公式データの4倍に上る可能性、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で公式統計の過小評価が疑われ、米国が渡航禁止措置を取るなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ジュネーブ・米国・スイスは発生地域ではなく、WHO声明発表地・渡航禁止措置実施国として記載されているため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi Kongom, više od 670 mrtvih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading through Congo, more than 670 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 1,873 confirmed cases and 672 deaths reported to date. WHO Emergencies Programme Director Chikwe Ihekweazu said the true scale of the epidemic is likely at least two to four times higher than officially confirmed, based on analysis and modeling. He spoke at a Geneva press briefing, with Reuters reporting. The remarks underscore potential underreporting amid ongoing transmission in the DRC. The article does not specify additional laboratory confirmation details or sources of infection. These developments emphasize the scale of the challenge facing surveillance and response teams in the region. Published July 14, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで拡大、死者670人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行(症例1873件、死者672人)であり、WHOも実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性を指摘しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ジュネーブはWHO記者会見の開催地であり、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。WHO幹部は実際の症例・死者数はさらに多い可能性を指摘しており、過小報告が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: реальное число заражённых Эболой в ДРК может больше в четыре раза
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: the real number of people infected with Ebola in the DRC may be four times higher.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization cautions that the true number of Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times higher than official counts. WHO Emergency Programme Director Chikwe Ihekweazu cited mathematical models, with official totals near 2,000 cases and over 700 deaths. The outbreak is characterized by transmission largely outside known contact lists, about 80% of new cases lacking identifiable chains, and many patients dying at home without hospital care. Earlier reports put Ebola deaths in the DRC at about 625. France reported its first imported Ebola case on June 24. Russian infectious-disease specialist Daria Namazova says the risk of spread to Russia and other developed countries remains low.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数、実際は公表数の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は致死率が高く、感染経路不明の症例が約80%を占めるなど拡大リスクが高い。フランスへの輸入例も確認されており、国際的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: フランスとロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。公式集計約2000例・死者700人超だが、実際の感染者数はその2〜4倍と推定されている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'ampleur de l'épidémie pourrait dépasser " de deux à quatre fois " les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the scale of the outbreak could exceed 'two to four times' the official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could exceed official estimates by a factor of two to four, according to their projections. The article states that the outbreak's magnitude is at least two to four times higher than reported figures, per WHO modeling. No case counts, death tolls, dates, or provincial details are provided in the excerpt. It emphasizes a discrepancy between observed data and the true scale as estimated by projections. As the piece is brief, it centers on projection-based differences between observed counts and the outbreak's estimated true scale, without providing detailed epidemiological data.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOによると、流行の規模は公式推計の2~4倍に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行規模が公式推計の2〜4倍に達する可能性を警告しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と過小報告という異常事態が確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は簡潔で、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・州名などの疫学データが含まれていないため、詳細情報は続報を待つ必要がある。WHOによる過小報告の指摘は流行制御の失敗を示唆し得るため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: First Human Testing Begins for Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the first human clinical trial of a Bundibugyo strain Ebola vaccine has begun. The phase 1 study enrolls 50 healthy adults to assess safety and immunogenicity. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in central Africa has claimed more than 700 lives. Serum Institute of India has manufactured and stockpiled about 620,000 doses of the experimental vaccine and has allocated 4,000 doses for the trial. The article notes that ring vaccination—rapid case identification and contact tracing—could reduce deaths more than vaccinating only patients' contacts if existing vaccines offer limited Bundibugyo protection, according to a modeling study released ahead of peer review. Broad community vaccination could yield the greatest impact if rollout is rapid and scalable.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: 既知のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（中央アフリカで700人超死亡）に関するワクチン臨床試験開始の続報だが、発生国が具体的に特定されておらず対象国リストとの照合ができないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行を背景としたワクチン臨床試験（インドのSerum Institute製造）に関する報道。発生国名は明記されておらず、インドはワクチン製造・備蓄拠点であり発生国ではないため対象国から除外した。具体的な発生国（例：DRC等）が判明次第、再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS diz que dispõe de menos da metade dos recursos necessários para combater Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says it has less than half of the resources needed to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a major Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths, government data show. The World Health Organization reports funding shortfalls, having received about 40% of the US$115 million requested to combat the outbreak, and warns that resources are well below what is required. There is no proven treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. The most affected area is Ituri Province, and the response has reached a critical point as cases have spread this week to two additional provinces. WHO Emergency Programme head Chikwe Ihekweazu stressed that the true number of cases is likely at least double, potentially more than four times the official tally. Donors are urged not to abandon the country during this critical phase.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ対策に必要な資源の半分未満しか確保できていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのブンディブギョ株エボラの大規模流行（感染1,926人、死亡702人）が複数州に拡大しており、治療薬・ワクチンが未確立で資金不足も深刻なため、IHR・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性があるとWHOが指摘。資金不足（必要額の40%のみ確保）により対応能力が著しく制限されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الإصابات الفعلية بإيبولا في الكونغو قد تصل إلى أربعة أضعاف المعلن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The actual Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be up to four times higher than reported.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the true number of Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times higher than officially reported, based on epidemiological models. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO’s Health Emergency Programme, stated this at a Geneva press conference after visiting eastern Congo. The estimates indicate the outbreak’s size far exceeds detected and reported cases, with actual infections at least double the discovered cases and potentially up to quadruple them, reflecting substantial challenges in case finding and field surveillance. The message underscores ongoing Ebola transmission in eastern DRC and the need for intensified surveillance and reporting to better characterize the outbreak as of July 14, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国における実際のエボラ感染者数は公式発表の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の即時通報対象疾患であり、WHOが実際の感染規模が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を警告していることから、サーベイランス不足と流行拡大リスクが示唆されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO本部所在地でありイベントの主題地域はコンゴ民主共和国東部のため除外。実際の感染規模や死亡者数など詳細データは記事内に不明な点が多く、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hàng ngàn người vùng biên Quảng Trị được tầm soát bệnh lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of people in the Quảng Trị border region are screened for tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis screening and pulmonary assessments were conducted in Quảng Trị Province's border region from June 15 to July 13, screening over 3,800 residents across six border communes: Lìa, A Dơi, Lao Bảo, Khe Sanh, Tân Lập, and Hướng Phùng. The effort identified nearly 400 individuals with lung lesions or suspected TB, who were directed to local health facilities for further examination and treatment following established protocols. The program, led by the Quảng Trị Provincial Lung Hospital in collaboration with local authorities and community health stations, aims to improve access to high-quality care at the village level, curb transmission, and heighten disease awareness. Officials underscore that early detection and decentralized services are key steps toward the province’s goal of eliminating TB in Quảng Trị.

triage.headline_ja: クアンチ省国境地域で数千人が結核検診を受診
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの一環としての通常のスクリーニング活動であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は地域保健当局による定期的な検診・早期発見プログラムを報じたものでシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : un nouveau centre de traitement d'Ebola construit à Nizi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: a new Ebola treatment center built in Nizi.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola treatment center under construction in Nizi, Djugu territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as part of outbreak response. The facility, built by the Congolese government with partners led by ALIMA, will have 32 beds. Construction aims to address the lack of a dedicated treatment center in the area, reducing patient transfers to overloaded facilities and improving the speed and quality of care. The statement was given July 13, 2026. To date, the outbreak has recorded over 1,000 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 600 deaths since its start. Ituri is the epicenter, with Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele provinces also affected. Health authorities, via Minister of Public Health Roger Kamba, emphasize that the new center will bolster response capacity and accessibility for local populations.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ:ニジに新たなエボラ治療センターが建設される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は確定症例1,000例超、死者600人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数州に拡大していることからIHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 既存のDRCエボラ流行に関する続報。新治療センター建設は対応能力強化の一環だが、流行自体は依然拡大中で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus: A United States citizen working for Samaritan's Purse in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, has tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus—the current outbreak’s strain—and is the second American infected. The CDC confirmed the case; the patient has been in isolation since Monday and is receiving care at a Samaritan’s Purse Ebola treatment centre, with reports of a possible transfer to Frankfurt, Germany. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or treatment. In the DRC, 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths were recorded as of early July; the virus has also reached Uganda. The outbreak is believed to have circulated for up to five months before detection, compounding containment amid ongoing conflict and fragile health systems. Domestic risk remains very low; no U.S. cases. Lessons include Dr. Peter Stafford’s recovery after evacuation to Berlin and the impact on families.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（確定1,792例、死亡625例）が既にウガンダへ拡大し、米国人感染者もドイツへの搬送が検討されるなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療法が存在しないため深刻度も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にドイツ・米国・ウガンダが含まれるが、これらは感染者の搬送先・国籍・二次拡大先であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダへの拡大は重要な国際拡大シグナルだが対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in Democratic Republic of Congo rise to 1,963
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo rise to 1,963, with 719 deaths, authorities said on July 14, as Kinshasa reports updates amid one of the country’s worst outbreaks. The figures, cited by Reuters, indicate ongoing transmission across affected areas, with health authorities continuing to monitor and implement response measures to contain spread. Ebola is a highly infectious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals and is characterized by severe symptoms, including high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. The report underscores the continuing burden of the outbreak in the DRC, where case counts and fatalities remain high, and emphasizes the need for sustained public health interventions to curtail further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数、1,963人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例1,963人・死者719人に達する同国最悪級のエボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきである。
triage.notes: Reuters報道に基づく更新情報。死亡率は約36.6%と高く、感染拡大の継続が懸念される。渡航・貿易制限の有無については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: реальный масштаб вспышки Эболы может вчетверо превышать официальную статистику
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Real Scale of the Ebola Outbreak May Be Four Times Higher Than Official Statistics
article.articleSummary: Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO Emergency Programme Director, warned that the true scale of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times higher than lab-confirmed cases. WHO estimates about 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths, with roughly 80% of new cases emerging outside known contact chains. Earlier Congolese reports cited 1,561 confirmed cases and 506 deaths (253 recoveries; CFR ~32.4%). On July 4, authorities reported 1,502 confirmed infections and 473 deaths. The outbreak began in May, and WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on June 15. The DRC and neighboring Uganda situation is the largest in the country by laboratory-confirmed cases in the first month, and experts warn its spread may be a 'global rehearsal' for the next pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ出血熱の実際の流行規模は公式統計の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ出血熱の大規模流行であり、公式統計を大幅に上回る可能性が指摘されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際的拡大リスクともに極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダにも言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。CFRは約32.4%と高く、既にWHOによりPHEICが宣言済みの重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza con rapidez en el Congo: ¿hay advertencias en Argentina?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Congo: Are there warnings in Argentina?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province in the northeast. Since late April 2026, the outbreak has grown to nearly 2,000 cases with over 700 deaths reported as of July 13, 2026. The World Health Organization and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention warn that the outbreak remains active and global concern has risen. The United States has issued a maximum-level travel alert, advising avoidance of the affected region. The article also references questions about warnings in Argentina. The report frames Ebola as a highly contagious and dangerous virus and underscores ongoing surveillance and international response, but provides no details on exact infection sources, laboratory confirmation, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急速に拡大：アルゼンチンにも警告はあるか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で約2000症例・700人超の死者を出すエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、WHO・アフリカCDCが警戒を発し、米国が最高レベルの渡航警告を発出しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチンや米国での渡航警告に言及しているが、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）のみであり、米国・アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число жертв вспышки лихорадки Эбола достигло 719
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the death toll from the Ebola outbreak reached 719.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak has killed at least 719 people and confirmed 1,963 cases as of July 12. The outbreak began in May, the latest flare-up in the country. The World Health Organization cautions the true toll is likely 2–4 times higher than official figures, said by Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO emergencies program director. Funding remains a major challenge, with only about 40% of the required resources currently available; earlier reports estimated a need of $115 million for an effective response. The figures underscore ongoing containment difficulties and the need for sustained international support for surveillance, treatment, vaccination, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数が719人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者719人、症例1,963人と大規模な流行が継続しており、資金不足による対応困難も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の被害規模が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘。対応に必要な1億1500万ドルのうち約40%しか確保できておらず、国際支援の継続が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola à Kisangani - Samuel Roger Kamba lance la riposte et appelle la population à une vigilance extrême
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola in Kisangani - Samuel Roger Kamba launches the response and calls on the population to exercise extreme vigilance
article.articleSummary: Four imported Ebola virus disease cases confirmed in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with all cases traced to Ituri. On July 11, 2026, Health Minister Dr. Samuel Roger Kamba, alongside the Secretary General of Health, the Inspector General, and the provincial governor, launched a crisis response to contain the threat and reassess surveillance. Authorities state Kisangani is affected, and surveillance of contacts is underway; the population is urged to report fever and symptoms to health centers. Suspected cases, presenting fever, diarrhea, vomiting, or similar Ebola symptoms, must be immediately referred for clinical management and urgent laboratory investigations and confirmation. Health facilities have been instructed to direct any suspected case to the nearest center for care and rapid testing. Emphasis on transparency, community involvement, and strict epidemiological surveillance to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：キサンガニでエボラ出血熱—サミュエル・ロジェ・カンバ氏が対応を開始し、住民に極度の警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の輸入症例がキサンガニで4例確認され、保健大臣主導の危機対応が開始されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 症例はイトゥリ州から輸入されキサンガニ（チョポ州）で確認。エボラは致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高いため厳重な監視が必要。続報でクレード・感染源・接触者追跡状況の確認が望まれる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo health workers on Ebola front line threaten strike
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in DR Congo, as of July 12, 2026, has killed more than 700 people among nearly 2,000 confirmed infections, with the WHO warning the true scale may be two to four times the official tally. The Bundibugyo strain causing the current outbreak has no vaccine or specific treatment. The epicentre is Ituri, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele; Ituri borders South Sudan and Uganda, which has reported 20 cases and 2 deaths. Health workers at the Ebola treatment centre in Rwampara protest unpaid wages since May 15, threatening a full-scale strike after a 48-hour ultimatum. As of July 12, 727 patients are being treated in treatment centres. A clinical trial of two treatments is underway, supported by a $1.5 billion international response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ対応の最前線にいる医療従事者がストライキを警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で死者700人超・感染者約2000人規模のエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの越境拡大やワクチン未整備、医療従事者のストライキ懸念など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・特効薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、国際的な資金支援（15億ドル）も投入されている。

article.articleHeadline: Santé. " De deux à quatre fois " les estimations officielles : l'épidémie d'Ebola fait rage en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health. "Two to four times" the official estimates: the Ebola outbreak is raging in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times larger than official figures, according to the World Health Organization, as detection improves. Official counts exceed 700 deaths and about 2,000 cases, declared two months ago in Ituri (northeast), near Sudan/South Sudan and Uganda borders, and now spreading to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, with around 20 cases reported in Uganda. The most alarming finding is many new infections involve individuals who die in their communities without accessing health facilities. Emphasis is needed on earlier detection, intensified contact tracing, and ensuring health facilities are accessible, safe, and trusted. Over 90% of cases are detected in Ituri; contact tracing ~80%; 700 beds available; 14 laboratories operational. Two treatments are being tested locally, and a forthcoming post-exposure prophylaxis trial using obeldesivir will focus on contacts of confirmed cases, via INRB Kinshasa, ANRS MIE, and Alima.

triage.headline_ja: 健康。「公式推定の2倍から4倍」：エボラ流行がコンゴ民主共和国で猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大し、死者700人・症例2000人超（実際は2〜4倍の可能性）、複数州へ拡大しウガンダにも波及しており、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも約20例報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。国際的拡大の実態としては特筆すべき点。

article.articleHeadline: Post-Monsoon Health Alert: Mumbaikars Urged to Stay Vigilant Against Dengue, Malaria, and Water-Borne Diseases
article.articleSummary: Post-monsoon Mumbai faces rising risk of dengue, malaria, chikungunya, typhoid, hepatitis A, and other infections as stagnant water after heavy rains creates mosquito breeding sites and contaminated food/water propagates illnesses. Health experts at Apex Group of Hospitals warn the post-monsoon period typically shows higher infectious disease activity. Warning signs include high fever, severe headache, body aches, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, rashes, and extreme weakness. Early diagnosis through investigations, adequate hydration, and timely treatment is crucial to prevent complications. Preventive measures: eliminate stagnant water, maintain hygiene, drink boiled or purified water, avoid street food, wash hands, keep water storage covered, wear full-sleeved clothing, and use mosquito repellents, especially at dawn and dusk. Weekly inspections to remove standing water are recommended. Apex Group operates hospitals in Mumbai (Borivali, Kandivali, Mulund) with 350 beds.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン明けの健康警報:ムンバイ市民にデング熱・マラリア・水系感染症への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行拡大の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は病院による予防啓発の一般的注意喚起であり、具体的な感染者数や集団発生の報告はない。毎年恒例のモンスーン後の季節性リスクに関する内容。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UK begins human trials of new Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Oxford University has begun human trials of its Ebola vaccine designed to target the Bundibugyo strain, in a bid to curb the outbreak. The outbreak has spread widely in the Democratic Republic of Congo, reaching two new provinces, with more than 700 deaths reported in the DRC and parts of Uganda. The United States will block American citizens in the DRC from returning home until they have spent 21 days in a third country, leaving dozens stranded. The spread has been exacerbated by misinformation and a major deficit in health supplies. The vaccine trial represents a potential step toward ending transmission amid the ongoing DRC–Uganda Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、新エボラワクチンのヒト試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにまたがるエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大し、死者700人超・渡航制限措置も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダも流行地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。英国・米国は診断・政策対応の文脈で言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Kendari siapkan kelurahan siaga untuk deteksi penyebaran penyakit TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kendari City Government prepares alert urban villages to detect the spread of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: TB Alert urban villages program launched in Kendari, Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia, with 62 loci identified to detect local transmission. As of June 2026, Kendari reports 923 TB cases, with 896 (97.1%) on treatment; 451 contact investigations conducted and 75 people on TB preventive therapy. In 2025, Kendari’s TB cases totaled 2,126, reflecting a negative trend in detection. Mayor Siska Karina Imran announced integration with the Special Healthy Package program to improve health services and address malnutrition/stunting. Under the TB Alert urban villages framework, health workers and village officials will screen residents for TB symptoms; positives receive immediate treatment, while negatives are educated on preventive therapy. If any urban village has residents not yet examined, teams will conduct outreach weekly, linking TB response with broader public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ケンダリ市政府、結核の感染拡大検知のため警戒地区（クルラハン・シアガ）を準備
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの地域における既知の風土病であり、本記事は通常の公衆衛生対策（検診・治療プログラムの強化）を報じるもので、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり通常の対策強化の記事。件数は多いが継続的な地域プログラムであり突発的なシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Coronavirus New Variant | ফের উদ্বেগ বাড়াচ্ছে করোনা, অন্ধ্রপ্রদেশ ও মুম্বইয়ে নয়া সংক্রমণের হদিস! মৃত ২, কী বলছেন বিশেষজ্ঞরা?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus New Variant | The coronavirus is raising concerns again; signs of new infections in Andhra Pradesh and Mumbai! Two dead, what do experts say?
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, Andhra Pradesh and Mumbai report renewed COVID-19 activity linked to the Cicada BA.3.2 sub-variant of Omicron, with two deaths attributed to infections. The Cicada BA.3.2 lineage was first identified in November 2024 in parts of South Africa and is under genetic review by the health ministry amid signals of spread in Asia and Europe. Experts say COVID-19 is unlikely to be eradicated and will persist with fluctuating waves, similar to influenza. West Bengal authorities have not issued a specific alert yet, but surveillance continues. Public health guidance emphasizes continued masking in crowded places, regular hand hygiene, and vigilance to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルス新変異株｜再び懸念高まる新型コロナ、アンドラプラデシュ州とムンバイで新規感染確認！死者2人、専門家の見解は？
triage.triage_reason: 新たなオミクロン系統Cicada BA.3.2による感染再拡大がインド複数州で報告され、アジア・欧州への拡散兆候もあり、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に2つ該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 南アフリカで最初に確認された変異株（2024年11月）だが、記事の主題はインド（アンドラプラデシュ州・ムンバイ）での感染再拡大であり、南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。西ベンガル州は当局からの正式な警戒発令なしと記載。

article.articleHeadline: Résistance face à Ebola : le travail des relais communautaires salué à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting Ebola: the work of community health workers hailed in Beni
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo: community health workers and local youth leaders were praised for overcoming resistance to the response in Kanzuli-Nzuli, Bungulu. A suspect Ebola case, Sakada Mumbere Kombamoya (president of Mabakou youths), underwent five days of isolation; his test was negative and he was discharged. The recovered individual announced a public meeting to explain to residents why early isolation and treatment matter. Jérémie Malingumu, the lead nurse at Kanzuli-Nzuli health center, credited community figures with reducing resistance and encouraging timely care. The report notes a June 21 assault on two health workers in Mambango, Bungulu, which authorities and civil-society groups condemned. As of 14 July 2026, the ongoing outreach aims to maintain trust and prompt care in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの闘い：ベニで称賛されるコミュニティヘルスワーカーの活動
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニでの既存エボラ対応に関する記事で、疑い例は検査陰性で退院済み。新規の感染拡大や重症例の明確な兆候はないが、エボラ流行地域での継続的な疑い例発生とヘルスワーカーへの襲撃事案があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応活動（コミュニティエンゲージメント）に関する内容で、疑い例(Sakada Mumbere Kombamoya)は検査陰性・回復済み。6月21日にはマンバンゴでヘルスワーカーへの襲撃事件も報告されており、対応への抵抗が依然存在することを示唆。新規感染拡大の兆候は記事からは確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Number of Ebola cases could be four times higher than official figures: New data released
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has 1,873 confirmed Ebola cases and 672 deaths, according to the latest data. WHO's Chikwe Ihekweazu, executive director of the WHO Health Emergencies Programme, said the outbreak's actual scale is at least two to four times larger than the number of officially confirmed cases, a conclusion drawn from their analysis and mathematical models. He made the comments during a Geneva press conference, with Reuters reporting the remarks. The statement draws attention to a large discrepancy between the official case count and the modeled estimates used to characterize the outbreak's scope.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例数は公式統計の4倍に達する可能性:新データが公表
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行で死者672名、確認症例1873例、WHOが実際の規模は公式数値の2〜4倍と指摘しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ジュネーブはWHO記者会見の開催地であり、発生地域ではないため除外。スイスも同様に除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число скончавшихся от Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 700
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in the DR Congo has surpassed 700.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 719 people since it began in May. European media, via Interfax, report ongoing mortality from Ebola virus disease in the DRC. The brief provides no data on total confirmed cases, clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or infection sources, and does not mention imported or exported cases. The information highlights a protracted, deadly outbreak in the DRC with fatalities surpassing seven hundred, but lacks additional epidemiological or public health details.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が700人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者数が700人を超え、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 死者数のみで感染者総数や臨床情報、感染経路等の詳細は不明。継続的なアウトブレイクであり、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا إلى 1963 ووفيات الفيروس تبلغ 719
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola cases rise to 1,963 and virus fatalities reach 719.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 1,963, with 719 deaths, according to the latest update from the country. The figures cover data up to Sunday, July 12, and indicate ongoing transmission of Ebola within the DRC as of mid-July. The report provides no details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation methods, or on any imported or exported cases. These updated counts are reported ahead of the published date, July 14, 2026, highlighting a persistent and accumulating toll from the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ感染者が1,963人に増加、死者719人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで感染者1,963人・死者719人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、致死率も高くヒト-ヒト感染継続が示唆されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 感染源、検査方法、輸入/輸出症例の詳細は記事に記載なし。累積症例数の継続的増加が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak two to four times bigger than official scale -- WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, detected May 15 in Ituri province, is potentially 2-4 times larger than official counts, according to WHO modelling. Official figures exceed 1,960 infections and 700+ deaths across five DR Congo provinces, with Uganda reporting cross-border cases. Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment, is driving transmission via close contact and infected fluids. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri, and many fatalities occur in patients who die in their communities before reaching care. The outbreak is the third-largest and showing fastest month-to-month growth yet. Response capacity has expanded to over 700 treatment beds; laboratories have scaled up; contact tracing approaches 80% but still challenges remain. Recent days recorded over 80 new confirmed cases in a single day, signaling improved detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、公式統計の2〜4倍の規模か——WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中の第17次エボラアウトブレイクは公式集計を大幅に上回る規模と推定され、稀な株（ブンディブギョ株）でワクチン未承認、ウガンダへの越境例も報告されておりIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境症例が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。記事の主題であるアウトブレイク発生国はDRC（イトゥリ州中心）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'ampleur de l'épidémie pourrait dépasser "de deux à quatre fois" les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the scale of the outbreak could exceed two to four times the official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: WHO projects the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times the official counts, with over 700 deaths and about 2,000 cases since it was declared in Ituri two months ago. The northeast Ituri frontier region borders South Sudan and Uganda, with spread now to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé; Uganda reports 20 cases. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-growing in a month. Many new infections involve people dying in the community before seeking care, underscoring detection and contact-tracing gaps. WHO notes progress: contact tracing near 80%, about 700 beds for treatment, and labs rising from 1 to 14. Two treatments are tested on site; a post-exposure prophylaxis using obeldesivir for exposed contacts is to be announced by INRB Kinshasa, ANRS MIE, and Alima.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:流行の規模は公式推計の2倍から4倍に達する可能性、WHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が進行中で、WHOが公式統計の2〜4倍の規模と推計。ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。国境を越えた拡大リスクとしてihr_criteriaのinternational_spreadに反映した。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | L'AFD réaffirme son soutien à la lutte contre Ebola et renforce son partenariat avec l'INRB | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | AFD reaffirms its support for the fight against Ebola and strengthens its partnership with INRB | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, France’s Agence Française de Développement (AFD) reaffirmed its commitment to assist the Democratic Republic of Congo in the fight against Ebola and to strengthen its health system, during a visit to Kinshasa’s Institute National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB). AFD Director-General Christophe Lecourtier praised INRB researchers for work in genomic sequencing, prevention, and outbreak response. He stated that French cooperation will remain durable, beyond bilateral ties, serving global health protection and humanity. He noted health as a pillar of Franco-Congolese cooperation, citing major funded projects totaling around 80 million euros in recent years. Lecourtier emphasized the need for increased international solidarity to address health and climate risks. The visit occurs as the DRC continues fortifying epidemiological surveillance, scientific research, and disease response capacities with support from multiple partners.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | AFD、エボラ対策への支援を再確認しINRBとのパートナーシップを強化 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はフランスAFDによるコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策・保健システム強化への支援継続を表明する外交的・資金協力に関する報道であり、新規の感染拡大や異常事態の発生を示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応支援・研究協力に関する外交的発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増等の情報は含まれていない。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Gaji Tak Dibayar 2 Bulan, Nakes Penanganan Ebola di Kongo Mogok Kerja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Months of Unpaid Salaries, Ebola Response Healthcare Workers in Kongo Go on Strike
article.articleSummary: Two months of unpaid salaries triggered a strike by dozens of Ebola response workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo. In Ituri Province, at Rwampara General Hospital, epidemiologists, case trackers, ambulance drivers, and funeral workers refused to work on July 13, 2026, blocking hospital access and lighting tires on fire. The protest compounds challenges in the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, which began in May 2026 and has since spread to two additional provinces; no approved treatments or vaccines exist. As of July 14, 2026, the outbreak has 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Health Minister Roger Kamba said payroll lists are being verified to ensure payments reach the workers involved in outbreak response, amid concerns of misallocated salaries. Two candidate Ebola therapies were entering clinical trials earlier this month.

triage.headline_ja: 給与不払い2カ月、コンゴのエボラ対応医療従事者がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1,926症例、702死亡）が対応職員のストライキにより悪化しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国（イツリ州、ブンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイク）に限定されており、Ugandaは主題として言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'ampleur de l'épidémie pourrait être "de deux à quatre fois" plus importante que les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the scale of the epidemic could be "two to four times" greater than official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed 700 people and infected over 2,000 confirmed cases within two months, with activity notably centered in the DRC. The World Health Organization warned that the true scale could be two to four times higher than official estimates, indicating substantial undercounting in reported tallies. The report emphasizes the gap between official figures and the epidemic’s real burden, underscoring the ongoing transmission within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:WHOによると流行の規模は公式推定の「2〜4倍」大きい可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が2か月で死者700人、感染者2000人超に達し、WHOが公式統計の過小評価を警告するなど、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが公式統計の過小評価（実際は2〜4倍）を指摘しており、流行の実態把握が困難な状況。フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak May Be Four Times Worse Than Officially Reported
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo species, represents the third-largest crisis on record. The virus has infected more than 1,960 people and killed over 700 in two months, with transmission accelerating across five DRC provinces and crossing into neighboring Uganda. WHO warns the outbreak could be two to four times larger than official figures, underscoring gaps in detection and reporting. The outbreak currently has no approved vaccine or treatment, and many recent deaths occurred at home without access to medical facilities, despite increasing testing and treatment capacity. No specific infection source or laboratory confirmation details are provided in the article. The situation highlights rapid cross-border spread and the need for strengthened public health response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行、公式報告の4倍規模の可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で急速に拡大しウガンダへ越境、致死率も高く未承認ワクチン・治療のみでIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。感染者数・致死率ともに深刻で、WHOも過小報告の可能性を指摘しており、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Many Ebola infections and fatalities in Congo go undetected
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the true infection toll may be 2–4 times higher than official counts. To date, laboratory tests have confirmed more than 1,900 cases and over 700 deaths. Most deaths occur at home rather than in medical facilities, complicating containment; four out of five new infections are not on patients' contact lists, signaling unrecorded transmission chains. WHO and the Congo government are expanding capacity, with nearly 800 beds in specialist centres and 14 laboratories for rapid testing. Funding remains insufficient—only 40% of the $115 million requested for the first six months has been received—necessitating additional support to disrupt transmission and improve survival through hospital care.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴにおける多数のエボラ感染・死亡例が未検出のまま
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、実際の感染規模が公式数値の2〜4倍と推定される点、資金不足や国際支援の必要性が明示されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 感染者の多くが家庭内で死亡し接触者リストに含まれない伝播が多発しており、封じ込めが困難な状況。資金不足（要請額の40%のみ確保）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Kongon demokraattisen tasavallan ebolaepidemia ainakin kaksinkertainen virallisiin lukuihin verrattuna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is at least twice as large as official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is currently at least twice as large as official figures, per the World Health Organization, with the possibility of being up to four times higher than reported. To date, the disease has been confirmed in just under 2,000 people, with about 700 deaths. The outbreak is already among the largest Ebola epidemics on record even by official counts. The first Ebola case was detected roughly two months ago, and the substantial uncertainty about the true scale highlights ongoing transmission within the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は公式数値の少なくとも2倍規模
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行がDRCで発生しており、公式統計を大幅に上回る可能性が指摘され、死亡者数も多く公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: WHOが公式報告数の過小評価を指摘しており、実際の感染規模・死亡者数がさらに大きい可能性がある。既に史上最大級のエボラ流行の一つとされ、継続的な監視が必要。
