article.articleHeadline: Travellers warned of fatal mosquito-borne illness after rise in UK cases
article.articleSummary: England reported 137 dengue fever cases January–June 2026, all travel-associated. UKHSA urges travellers to use insect repellent, wear long sleeves, and sleep under treated nets; check TravelHealthPro for vaccines and anti-malarial guidance. Dengue is not present in the UK and not transmitted person-to-person. The highest dengue-linked travel occurred from Thailand (27 cases) and the Maldives (19); broader risk spans South-East Asia and South Asia, with additional risk in parts of southern Europe such as Croatia, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, and Madeira. In H1 2026, eight Zika cases (four linked to Indonesia) and 59 chikungunya cases (18 from Sri Lanka) were recorded in the UK. Malaria remained a concern with 557 cases reported Jan–May across England, Wales and Northern Ireland, while 287 typhoid/paratyphoid cases were also recorded. Pregnant travellers are advised to seek medical counsel before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 英国での症例増加を受け、渡航者に致死的な蚊媒介感染症について注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は英国内における渡航関連感染症（デング熱・マラリア・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱等）のサーベイランスデータであり、対象国（タイ・インドネシア等）は感染源として言及されているに過ぎず、記事の主題はUKHSAによる渡航者向け注意喚起である。対象国での実際のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は英国内の渡航関連感染症サーベイランスデータ（2026年1-6月）についての報告であり、感染は英国内で人-人感染しない旨明記されている。タイ・インドネシア・スリランカ等は感染曝露国として言及されているが、これらの国自体でのアウトブレイク発生を報じる記事ではないため、対象国リストにおける「実際に発生している国」には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛：伊波拉防疫經費不到所需一半 籲國際勿棄民主剛果
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola prevention funding is less than half of what is needed; urges the international community not to abandon the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo-type Ebola, continues with 1,926 infections and 702 deaths reported. WHO reports only about 40% of the 115 million USD funding appeal has been raised; no proven effective treatment or vaccine exists for this strain. The outbreak centers on Ituri Province, the hardest hit, but has spread to two additional provinces this week. WHO’s Health Emergencies Programme director Chikwe Ihekweazu emphasized a critical response phase, calling for intensified case finding and patient isolation. He warned that true infection numbers are at least double, potentially more than four times the official tally. He urged international donors not to abandon the Democratic Republic of the Congo during this key stage of the response. As of 14 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ対策資金は必要額の半分未満、国際社会にコンゴ民主共和国支援継続を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(Bundibugyo型)による死亡702人・感染1926人の大規模アウトブレイクが複数州に拡大しており、有効な治療薬・ワクチンもなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 有効な治療法・ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo型エボラであり、実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。資金不足も深刻でフルRRAによる継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Troligen dubbelt så många ebolafall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Probably twice as many Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization reports that the Ebola outbreak centered in Kongo-Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is probably two to four times larger than the number of cases currently identified by national authorities. Official figures cited by the DRC health authorities show 719 deaths and nearly 2,000 confirmed infections to date. On Monday, WHO's crisis-management chief Chikwe Ihekweazu indicated that independent analyses suggest the outbreak’s true scale is at least two to four times greater than what has been detected through routine surveillance. The outbreak, which began in May, has spread across four provinces, with Ituri Province in the northeastern region identified as the hardest hit.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ感染者数は実際には報告の2倍以上の可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中の大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、WHOが実際の感染規模は公式発表の2〜4倍と指摘、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威で国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: WHO危機管理責任者Chikwe Ihekweazu氏が独自分析に基づき、実際の感染規模が国家当局の報告の2〜4倍に及ぶ可能性を指摘。5月発生以来4州に拡大し、イツリ州が最も深刻な被害を受けている。

article.articleHeadline: El número de casos de ébola podría ser "de dos a cuatro" veces superior, según OMS Ensegundos República Dominicana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases could be "two to four" times higher, according to WHO Ensegundos Dominican Republic.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, WHO projects that the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak may be two to four times the officially reported infections. Official tallies exceed 1,960 cases with over 700 deaths from a hemorrhagic fever first detected in Ituri and now spanning North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Alto Uele, with Uganda reporting 20 cases. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO Emergency Programme Director, called this the third largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest to grow in a single month among outbreaks managed by the WHO. The case-contact follow-up rate is about 80%, but response efforts lag behind transmission. Authorities urge earlier detection, intensified contact tracing, and ensuring health facilities are accessible, safe, and trusted by communities to improve outbreak control and curb cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例数はWHOによると実際は「2〜4倍」多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死亡者700人超、史上3番目の規模かつ最速の拡大速度とWHOが指摘、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは公式集計の2〜4倍の症例数がある可能性を示唆しており、過小報告が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Walczą z groźnym wirusem, nie otrzymują wynagrodzeń. Ebola w natarciu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They fight a dangerous virus, they are not getting paid. Ebola on the offensive.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths, per Reuters. WHO emergencies chief Chikwe Ihekweazu estimates true incidence may be 2–4 times higher due to diagnostic factors. Officially declared May 15, the outbreak strains an already under-resourced health system. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. Evidence suggests rising case counts partly reflect expanded testing, but response is hampered by attacks on health workers, armed groups, and public distrust. Health workers report 112 infections and 35 deaths among staff (INSP/AFP). Medically frontline staff have worked without pay since May 15 and threaten a strike after a 48-hour salary ultimatum; Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba acknowledged salary delays and pledged fixes.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルスと闘うが給与が支払われない――エボラ、猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の確認症例1,963件・死亡719人、承認ワクチン・治療薬なし、医療従事者への攻撃や給与未払いによるスト脅威などIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: WHOはブンディブギョ株の実際の感染規模が公式報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘。医療従事者112人感染・35人死亡、給与未払いによるストライキの脅威、武装勢力の妨害など、対応能力に深刻な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra en RDC : l'épidémie que l'eau sale entretient, de Shabunda au Tanganyika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in the DRC: the epidemic that dirty water fuels, from Shabunda to Tanganyika.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains endemic and increasingly detected across multiple provinces. In Shabunda, Sud-Kivu, 52 acute-diarrhea cases were reported between June 23 and July 7, with 11 deaths (21% case fatality rate), linked to untreated drinking water from the Lubila and Ulindi rivers during the dry season, with no external support yet. In 2025, the DRC reported more than 71,200 cholera cases and 2,070 deaths per WHO. By mid-April 2026, 915 suspected cases in one week yielded a national CFR of about 0.4%, though deadly pockets exist. Outbreaks span North Kivu, Kinshasa, Haut-Katanga, Tanganyika, and Haut-Lomami; 168 cases in Mbanza-Ngungu prison (Kongo-Central) and 136 cases with 10 deaths in Popokabaka (Kwango) since late May, confirmed by INRB. Mwenga recorded 28 cases and 5 deaths. Core barrier: lack of clean water, treatment centers, and logistics despite preventive knowledge and rehydration. The cholera map from Kwango to Tanganyika highlights water access as the key obstacle, even as Ebola and conflict divert resources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のコレラ:シャブンダからタンガニーカまで汚水が助長する流行
triage.triage_reason: DRC全土で持続的なコレラ流行が続き、シャブンダでは致死率21%と重篤、複数州で死者・感染拡大が確認され外部支援も不足しているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: コレラは同国で地方流行病として恒常的に発生しているが、複数州での同時多発・高致死率地域の存在・清潔な水へのアクセス不足が継続的な公衆衛生上の課題であり、外部支援の必要性が明記されている。エボラ流行との資源競合にも言及あり、複合的リスク要因として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gubernur YSK Dorong Ranperda KLB dan Wabah Penyakit Menular, Perkuat Perlindungan Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: YSK Governor Urges Draft Regional Regulation on Public Health Emergencies and Infectious Disease Outbreaks, to Strengthen Health Protection
article.articleSummary: North Sulawesi Governor Yulius Selvanus Komaling (YSK) urged passage of a regional regulation on Penanggulangan Kejadian Luar Biasa (KLB) and Wabah Penyakit Menular to strengthen public health protection. Speaking at the North Sulawesi DPRD plenary on July 14, 2026, during explanations of the draft Ranperda, he cited rising threats from extraordinary events and infectious disease outbreaks that affect health, society, economy, security, and public order. The proposed regulation would establish a clear local legal framework, delineate government responsibilities, citizens' rights and duties, and define criteria for declaring KLB and outbreaks, plus priority programs with targets for prevention, response, and recovery. It would cover preparedness, emergency response, and post-event recovery, including potential social restrictions if needed. YSK urged comprehensive, coordinated discussion to produce a robust, operational law and called for stronger intergovernmental synergy in North Sulawesi.

triage.headline_ja: YSK知事、公衆衛生非常事態および感染症流行に関する地方条例案の推進を促す、健康保護の強化へ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症事例の報告ではなく、行政による条例整備に関する政策的な記事であり、公衆衛生上の具体的リスクは記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの発生ではなく、北スラウェシ州における公衆衛生関連の条例制定に関する行政的な議論を報じたものであり、疾患名も'Unknown Illness'（不明疾患）とされ実体的な感染症情報がない。

article.articleHeadline: PHL lifts ban on Hungarian imports of animal products as FMD risk recedes
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Philippines' Department of Agriculture lifted the temporary ban on importing animals and animal products from Hungary after containment of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) there. The World Organisation for Animal Health's Scientific Commission for Animal Diseases reinstated Hungary's FMD-free status following a containment plan submitted by Hungary's Ministry of Agriculture. The Commission concluded the containment zone meets the Terrestrial Code requirements for reinstatement of FMD-free status where vaccination is not practiced, per Resolution No. 19 of the 2026 (93 General Session, May 2026). The DA had suspended imports from Hungary in March 2025 after FMD cases in the village of Kisbajcs, Győr District, involving domestic buffaloes. The move signals reduced FMD risk for imported animal products.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、FMDリスク低下によりハンガリーからの動物製品輸入禁止を解除
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリーでのFMDは封じ込め済みで清浄国ステータスが回復しており、フィリピンは輸入禁止を解除するという規制緩和の記事であるため、公衆衛生上の新規リスクはない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はハンガリーでのFMD封じ込め成功に伴う貿易規制解除であり、フィリピンやその他対象国での発生事例ではない。ハンガリーは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: O surto de Ebola no Congo é de duas a quatro vezes maior do que a escala oficial, segundo a OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo is two to four times larger than the official figures, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak—driven by the rare Bundibugyo variant—may be two to four times larger than official figures, according to the World Health Organization. More than 700 deaths have been recorded, making it the third-largest outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo strain is circulating in five Congolese provinces and in Uganda, with Ituri province identified as the hardest hit. Despite advances in response efforts, the situation remains highly concerning due to substantial underdetection, as many cases have not been identified or reported. The report highlights subnotification by authorities, indicating gaps in case ascertainment, and notes ongoing transmission across cross-border areas. No explicit infection source or details of imported/exported cases are provided beyond the regional spread as of 14 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、WHOによれば公式統計の2〜4倍の規模
triage.triage_reason: 700人以上の死者を出し史上3番目の規模とされるエボラ流行が、大幅な過小報告下でウガンダとの国境地帯にも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（特にイトゥリ州）における稀なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行を主題とし、ウガンダへの越境拡大にも言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。実際の症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍と推定され、過小報告が深刻な懸念材料となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de ebola pode ser de duas a quatro vezes maior, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of Ebola cases could be two to four times higher, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: WHO says Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times higher than official estimates. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO's executive director of the Health Emergencies Programme, told reporters that the outbreak's true magnitude is at least 2–4 times the number of registered cases. As of July 14, 2026, official data from the DRC show more than 1,960 people infected and over 700 deaths linked to the hemorrhagic fever outbreak declared in mid-May. The remarks underscore substantial uncertainty in reported counts and the possibility of under-detection as transmission continues, highlighting the need for strengthened surveillance and response in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性、WHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中で、WHOが公式数値の過小評価を指摘するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的懸念が認められるため。
triage.notes: WHOが症例数の過小評価を公式に言及していることから、実際の感染規模はさらに深刻な可能性がある。続報でのケース数・致死率・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: ارتفاع حصيلة إصابات فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Rise in Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization estimates indicate the true burden of Ebola virus disease may be 2 to 4 times higher than officially reported, implying undetected or unregistered infections, per Cairo TV reports. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, a clinical trial has begun comparing two candidate Ebola therapies. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced that the first participant has been enrolled in the adaptive platform randomized trial for new and repurposed filovirus therapies (the Partners Platform). The study will evaluate treatments targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in a platform design designed to test multiple therapies. The development marks an expansion of outbreak response and therapeutic evaluation in DRC, with ongoing efforts to improve detection and treatment options.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラウイルス感染者数の増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大疾患であり、WHOによる過小報告の指摘とDRCでの新規臨床試験開始という情報があり、公衆衛生上の懸念と国際支援体制の動きが確認できるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける既存のエボラアウトブレイクに関連する治療研究(Partners Platform)の開始とWHOによる過小報告推定についての続報。新規発生の詳細（感染者数、地域、致死率等）は記載がなく不明点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Many Ebola infections and fatalities in Congo go undetected
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 1,900 lab-confirmed cases and over 700 deaths; true infections likely 2–4 times higher than reported. Most deaths occur at home; four-fifths of new infections are not on case contact lists, signaling unrecorded transmission chains. WHO and DRC are expanding capacity with nearly 800 beds in specialist centers and 14 laboratories for rapid testing. Funding shortfall: only 40% of the $115 million sought by the WHO for the first six months received; urgent support needed. Emphasis on informing communities, dispelling doubts about hospital treatment, and disrupting infection chains; survival rates higher in medical centers. Outbreak remains ongoing in the Congo region as of 2026-07-14.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴでエボラ感染・死亡の多くが未検出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例1900例超、死亡700例超のエボラ流行が継続中であり、実際の感染者数は報告の2〜4倍と推定される。接触者リストに載っていない感染連鎖が多数あり、国際的拡大・資金不足による対応能力の限界が明確でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが資金不足（必要額の40%のみ受領）と未検出感染の多さを強調しており、国際支援の緊急性が高い。フルリスク評価に進むべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Заразените с ебола в Конго може да са до четири пъти повече от официално обявените
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola infections in Congo may be up to four times higher than officially reported.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the World Health Organization says Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times higher than officially reported. Government figures list 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. The WHO’s remarks were delivered to reporters in Geneva and cited by Reuters. The United States has banned travel from Congo. The WHO urged international donors not to abandon the country during this critical phase of the epidemic, stressing the importance of sustained support to control the outbreak. The report underscores a gap between official tallies and the outbreak’s true scale, highlighting the urgency of continued international cooperation as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ感染者数は公式発表の最大4倍に上る可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで公式集計の過小評価が指摘され、米国が渡航禁止を実施するなど国際的な影響が既に発生しており、IHR基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerland/United Statesが含まれるが、これらはWHO記者会見場所・渡航禁止措置の主体国であり、実際の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。公式死者702名、感染者1926名との報告あるも、WHOは実際の感染規模がより大きいと指摘しており、続報での規模拡大に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : 17 cas suspects d'Ebola libérés par un centre d'isolement en 18 jours - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: 17 suspected Ebola cases released by an isolation center in 18 days - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 17 people suspected of Ebola were released after 18 days of care at the Kanzulinzuli Health Center isolation unit. All 17—seven men and ten women—tested negative. Two more patients remain admitted and are expected to be discharged soon. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) supplied medications, and health staff are commended for their Ebola response. The health zone has not transferred any confirmed Ebola cases. Community relay teams and local leaders are actively educating residents on hygiene and barrier measures, with Kanzulinzuli deploying field sensitizers to reinforce prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：隔離センターで18日間管理されたエボラ疑い症例17人が退院 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例は全員陰性で確定例は報告されていないが、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でのエボラ疑い例発生・隔離活動自体は継続監視が必要なため。
triage.notes: 疑い症例17人は全員検査で陰性となり退院。確定症例の転送はなく、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は確認されていないが、地域コミュニティでの啓発活動が継続中であり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Το μέγεθος της Έμπολας ξεπερνά "κατά 2 με 4 φορές" τις εκτιμήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The size of the Ebola outbreak exceeds estimates by 2 to 4 times.
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times higher than officially reported, as case detection improves. As of 14 July 2026, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died, according to government data. The hardest-hit Ituri province remains the epicenter, with the epidemic spreading to two additional provinces this week. The organization has received about 40% of the $115 million appeal to counter the outbreak, and there is no proven treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO officials urged donors not to abandon the DRC at this critical stage, calling for intensified efforts to identify and isolate cases. The emergency response director stressed that controlling the outbreak is like a marathon, requiring persistent action.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ流行の規模は推定の2〜4倍に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が拡大し死者数も多く、WHOが公式報告の2〜4倍の規模と警告、複数州への拡大とワクチン不在という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスに有効なワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、拡大リスクが高い。資金不足（$115M appealの40%のみ確保）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Terjed az Ebola Kongóban, négyszer annyi beteg is lehet, mint a valós statisztika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading in Congo, there could be four times as many patients as the real statistics indicate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths, according to government data. The epicenter is eastern DRC’s Ituri Province, with the virus spreading to two additional provinces this week. WHO official Chikwe Ihekweazu, returning from Ituri to Geneva, urged donors to provide resources commensurate with the scale of the challenge and warned against letting the burden fall on the DRC alone. He stressed that intensified case finding and isolation are essential as the outbreak enters a critical phase. The response is described as a marathon requiring sustained effort despite fatigue, to curb transmission and protect affected communities and contacts as the outbreak evolves across provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大、実際の統計より4倍多い患者数の可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで1,926人感染・702人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、複数州へ拡大しWHOが国際支援を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるがこれはWHO本部の言及によるもので、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Doğrulanan Ebola Vaka Sayısı 1.963'e Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola case count in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 1,963.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths as of July 14, 2026. Kinshasa-based officials, cited by Reuters, reported these latest laboratory-confirmed figures for the ongoing outbreak. Ebola spreads primarily through direct contact with bodily fluids from an infected person or animal. Patients commonly exhibit high fever and vomiting, with progression to internal and external bleeding in severe cases. The update documents the current severity of the outbreak in the region, underscoring the persistent lethality of Ebola virus disease in the DRC. This highlights the ongoing, fatal public health challenge posed by Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例数が1,963人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで致死率が高く（719人死亡）、IHR基準の複数該当と国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクの続報であり、症例数・死亡者数の増加が確認されている。致死率は約36.6%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de ebola pode ser "de duas a quatro" vezes maior, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of Ebola cases could be two to four times higher, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 – The World Health Organization says Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times higher than official tallies. Official figures show more than 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths from the outbreak declared in mid-May. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, near borders with South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Alto Uele; Uganda has reported 20 cases. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-growing within a month among crises managed by the WHO. Contact tracing stands at roughly 80%, but the epidemic is advancing faster than response efforts. Ihekweazu urged earlier detection, accelerated contact tracing, and ensuring health facilities are accessible, safe, and trusted by communities to strengthen the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例数はWHOの発表より2〜4倍多い可能性、WHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで拡大中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが公式集計の2〜4倍の規模である可能性があり、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例（20例）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内（イツリ州が震源地、北キブ・南キブ・チョポ・アルト・ウエレへ拡大）が主たる発生地。

article.articleHeadline: Podľa WHO je počet prípadov eboly v Kongu najmenej dvakrát a možno až štyrikrát vyšší
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: According to the WHO, the number of Ebola cases in Congo is at least twice as many, and possibly up to four times as many.
article.articleSummary: WHO estimates Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are at least twice, and possibly up to four times, higher than official counts, with about 2,000 cases and 719 deaths reported. The WHO has mobilized roughly 40% of the $115 million needed to combat the outbreak. Among health workers, 112 infections have been recorded, including 35 deaths. At an Ebola treatment center in Rwampara, Ituri Province, staff are striking over unpaid salaries. Most cases and fatalities are in northeastern Ituri, where the outbreak was declared in mid-May, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. The current outbreak is the 17th in DRC and is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによると、コンゴのエボラ症例数は公式発表の少なくとも2倍、多くて4倍に上る可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行(約2000症例、719死亡)が継続し、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行であり、医療従事者感染・死亡や資金不足、ストライキなど対応能力への懸念も強い。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола излиза извън контрол в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is spiraling out of control in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) worsens with 1,926 infections and 702 deaths reported by the government; WHO suggests true cases may be 2–4 times higher. The outbreak began May 15, 2026 in Ituri province and was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. There is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; care remains supportive. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of an infected or deceased person. Cases have been detected across multiple provinces, with spillover into Uganda. The crisis is compounded by conflict, displacement, weak health infrastructure, attacks on facilities, and health worker strikes, hindering surveillance and treatment. European risk is very low due to non-airborne transmission. Donors are urged not to abandon the country in this critical phase.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が制御不能に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、死者700人超、複数州およびウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境（スピルオーバー）が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsからは除外。DRC国内の複数州（イトゥリ州含む）での感染拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS advirtió que los casos de ébola en Congo podrían cuadruplicar las cifras oficiales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warned that Ebola cases in Congo could quadruple the official figures.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could quadruple official figures, the WHO warns. Declared mid-May, the outbreak has infected more than 1,960 people and caused over 700 deaths, per DRC government data. The initial cluster in Ituri province has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Alto Uele, with cross-border transmission to Uganda, which reports 20 confirmed cases. The WHO notes that roughly 80% of cases' contacts are being monitored, yet the epidemic is advancing faster than the response. Authorities urge faster detection of new infections, stronger contact tracing, and improved access to health centers to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ症例が公式統計の4倍に上る可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で拡大しウガンダへ越境伝播しており、致死率も高く公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。WHOが症例数過小評価の可能性を警告しており、感染拡大が対応能力を上回っている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Turis China Digigit Anjing Diduga Rabies di Bangli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese tourist bitten by dog suspected of having rabies in Bangli
article.articleSummary: A Chinese tourist, Li Qiujin, 30, was bitten by a white dog on Jalan Brigjen Ngurah Rai No. 10, Kelurahan Kawan, Bangli District, Bali, around 16:00 WITA on 13 July 2026. The dog, later suspected of rabies, had previously attacked Ni Ketut Suciasih in nearby Kelurahan Kawan near Rutan Bangli. Li received initial wound care at RSUD Bangli; the rabies vaccine (VAR) is available only at clinics and puskesmas. She later received VAR at a clinic in Ubud and was admitted 19:07, discharged 19:30 WITA. Suciasih also received VAR at Puskesmas Susut 1. The dog has been eliminated by residents; brain samples were collected and sent to a laboratory for testing. Two victims are being monitored for about two weeks to determine if the dog was rabies-positive; the animal reportedly acted aggressively and bit two people the day before. The incident involves a foreign tourist and highlights ongoing rabies monitoring in Bangli, Bali.

triage.headline_ja: バンリで中国人観光客が犬に噛まれ狂犬病の疑い
triage.triage_reason: バリ島バンリにおける個別の犬咬傷事例であり、狂犬病はインドネシアで既知の風土病。ワクチン対応済みで公衆衛生上の異常な拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 外国人観光客が関与するローカルニュース記事。狂犬病はバリで既知の課題であり、被害者は暴露後予防接種（PEP）を受けている。犬の脳サンプルは検査中だが、個別事例としての報告であり、より広範な感染症シグナルとは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Returns To Andhra Pradesh? Genome Sequencing Ordered After 2 Deaths, 8 Active Cases
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Andhra Pradesh, India, has produced two deaths and eight active cases in YSR Kadapa district within weeks. A 52-year-old man from Rajampet died after testing positive and was treated at Christian Medical College, Vellore; a second Kadapa resident, 43, died in the Government General Hospital COVID-19 ICU. A 25-year-old Kadapa Medical College student also tested positive and is in home isolation. Health teams expanded testing, collecting about 40 samples (18 negative; results pending). Positive cases’ samples were sent to Pune for genome sequencing to identify the variant and transmission dynamics. Authorities activated emergency response, enhanced surveillance, and sanitation measures; masks are mandated in crowded places, and isolation facilities are being prepared. Officials urge precautions but aim to avoid panic while ensuring hospital beds and isolation wards for potential new cases across Andhra Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID-19が再燃？2人死亡、活動性症例8件でゲノム解析を指示
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の小規模クラスターで死亡例が出ているが、既知の病原体であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ゲノム解析中で変異株の性質が不明のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域限定の小規模クラスターで、当局が緊急対応・サーベイランス強化・ゲノムシーケンスを実施中。変異株の性質判明まで続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie pourrait être quatre fois plus grave que les chiffres officiels, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak could be four times as severe as the official figures, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has expanded from Ituri on the Uganda-South Sudan border to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, with 20 cases reported in Uganda. Official counts exceed 700 deaths and about 2,000 cases since it was declared two months ago. WHO emergency program head Chikwe Ihekweazu projected the outbreak’s true scale to be at least 2–4 times the recorded figure, as case detection improves daily. This is the third-largest, and fastest-growing, Ebola epidemic in a month among those WHO has managed. A key concern is many new infections dying in the community before reaching health facilities. He urged earlier case detection, intensified contact tracing, and trusted, accessible facilities, noting over 90% of cases are still detected in Ituri. Surveillance and clinical research measures are in place.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOによると、実際の流行規模は公式統計の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式統計の2〜4倍の規模と推定する急速拡大中のエボラ流行であり、複数州・国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダで20例）が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびスーダンへの拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。死者700人超、症例約2000件、発生2か月でWHOが管理する中で3番目に大きく最速で拡大しているエボラ流行と報告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - akár négyszeres is lehet a valós esetszám a hivatalos adatoknál
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - the real number of cases could be up to four times higher than the official data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), specifically Ituri Province, with official counts: at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths reported by the government. WHO's Chikwe Ihekweazu warned that actual case numbers could be two to four times higher than official tallies, citing under-detection and reporting gaps. The warning comes as the outbreak spreads to two additional provinces in eastern DRC this week. Funding shortfalls persist: WHO has received only about 40% of its share of a 115 million dollar donation for the Bundibugyo outbreak, and there is no proven treatment or vaccine for Ebola cited. The WHO official urged donors to sustain support during the critical phase of response, emphasizing the need for intensified case finding, isolation, and resources to combat the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - 実際の症例数は公式データの最大4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、公式報告(1,926症例/702死亡)を大きく上回る可能性がWHOにより指摘され、複数州への拡大と資金不足も報告されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は報告ベースで約36%と高く、ワクチン・治療薬未確立、資金不足(必要額の約40%のみ確保)により対応能力に懸念あり。感染拡大が2州追加と報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: New US Ebola patient arrives in Germany for treatment
article.articleSummary: US national infected with Ebola in the DRC arrived in Germany for treatment, landing in Frankfurt and transferred to a university hospital. The patient, a Samaritan’s Purse employee in Bunia, Ituri, is part of the DRC’s 17th outbreak declared in mid-May. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or cure. WHO provided care and monitoring; director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said he was moved to Germany for follow-up. The outbreak has over 1,900 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths. German authorities say the individual poses no danger and importation risk is very low; Germany’s treatment capacity aided the transfer. A US patient recovered after Berlin treatment. The Trump administration barred DR Congo travelers from returning to the US. About two dozen Americans were set to board home. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人エボラ患者、治療のためドイツに到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、1900例以上・死者700人超）に関連し、国際搬送や渡航制限などIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・Ituri州Buniaでの第17次エボラ流行であり、ドイツ・米国は患者搬送先・出身国として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 1926'ya yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of cases in the Ebola outbreak in Congo has risen to 1,926.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri continues to grow, with total probable and confirmed cases reaching 1,926 and deaths at 702 (case fatality rate 36.4%). The infection has spread to Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo provinces. Official data show 753 people are hospitalized or in isolation, while 318 have recovered. Authorities report ongoing active case finding, early diagnosis and patient management, with strengthened national- and provincial-level coordination. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved therapy or vaccine exists. The Ebola virus first emerged in 1976 near Nzara and Yambuku; the 2013-2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone infected about 30,000 people and killed over 11,000. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、症例数が1,926人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行が拡大継続中で、症例1,926例・死亡702例（CFR36.4%）、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事内で言及されるSudan、Sierra Leone、Liberia、Burundi、Guineaは1976年発生地や2013-2016年西アフリカ流行の歴史的言及であり、現在進行中のイベントの発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: 'This is a fire': DRC Ebola outbreak is fastest-growing ever, warns WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the fastest-growing and third-largest on record. As of 11 July, about 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths across five provinces; initial outbreak centered in Ituri Province (Bunia), with 95% of new cases in Ituri, now spreading to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. WHO warns that 80% of new infections are outside contact lists, arising from unknown transmission chains, with many deaths occurring in communities before reaching care. The outbreak was declared roughly two months ago. Daily counts have included over 80 cases in a 24-hour period. No approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; several therapeutics are in clinical trials. Early supportive care improves survival. Response prioritizes rapid case finding, tracing, community engagement to protect health workers, and mapping travel routes to anticipate new cases.

triage.headline_ja: 「これは火事だ」：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は史上最速の拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際拡大リスク）し、致死性の高いエボラ流行が急拡大しているため即座にフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 約2000症例・700人超の死亡、5州に拡大、80%が未知の感染経路という点で公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。承認された治療薬がなく、致死率および感染制御の困難さから国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Congo begins trial of Gilead's experimental antiviral for Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleSummary: Obeldesivir, Gilead's experimental antiviral, is being trialed as post-exposure treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda. On July 14, 2026, enrollment began in Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter, in a study led by the DRC's National Institute for Biomedical Research and France's ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases, with support from ALIMA and Médecins Sans Frontières. The trial aims to evaluate the antiviral's safety and efficacy in exposed individuals as part of the regional outbreak response. The Bundibugyo outbreak is ongoing in Congo and Uganda; no further laboratory-confirmed results or case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ギリアドの実験的抗ウイルス薬をエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）治験に導入
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダにまたがるブンディブギョ株エボラ流行への抗ウイルス薬治験開始に関する報道。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。具体的な症例数・致死率等の詳細は本記事には記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: First Human Testing Begins for Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine enters first-in-human testing with a phase-1 trial enrolling 50 healthy adults to assess safety and immune response. The outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in central Africa has killed more than 700 people, with cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda. Serum Institute of India has manufactured and stockpiled about 620,000 doses of the experimental shot, providing 4,000 doses for the phase-1 study. The vaccine uses a chimpanzee adenovirus platform, the same as the Oxford-AstraZeneca Covid-19 shot, and was developed with funding from the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations. Trials begin 57 days after the World Health Organization declared the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, underscoring accelerated vaccine development timelines.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの初のヒト試験開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行はWHOによりPHEIC宣言済みで、700人以上の死者が出ており、国際的関心・公衆衛生上の深刻性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン第1相試験開始に関する内容だが、背景にあるエボラ流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言した重大事例であり、フルリスク評価が必要。インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Obseg izbruha ebole v DR Kongu večji od uradnih podatkov
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The scope of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is larger than official data.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is two to four times larger than official data as of 14 July 2026. The Geneva- and Kinshasa-based assessment highlights a notable undercount in reported mortality within the ongoing outbreak, underscoring gaps in surveillance and data collection. The true burden appears underestimated by official figures; the excerpt does not provide specific case counts or death tallies.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの規模は公式データより大きい
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な疾患のアウトブレイクで、WHOが公式データより実際の規模が2〜4倍大きいと指摘しており、サーベイランスの重大な欠陥と過小報告が示唆されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOがジュネーブから発表した評価であり、発生地域自体はDRCのみ。スイス(ジュネーブ)はWHO本部の所在地であり発生国ではないため除外。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: tayyar.org - حصري-أمريكا تمنع مواطنيها في الكونجو من العودة المباشرة للوطن بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: tayyar.org - Exclusive: The United States bars its citizens in Congo from returning directly to their homeland due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the United States barred its citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from returning home on commercial flights, requiring a 21-day stay in a third country before boarding. The Ebola virus disease outbreak is expanding to multiple provinces in Congo, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported. Transmission remains via direct contact with bodily fluids, and patients may present with high fever, vomiting, and bleeding. About 24 Americans who traveled to Congo were slated to fly to the United States on Tuesday, with the State Department set to assist affected travelers. The CDC confirmed a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was hospitalized at University Hospital Frankfurt in Germany. In May, another American, Dr. Peter Stafford, was infected and treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: 独占:米国、エボラ流行を理由にコンゴにいる自国民の直接帰国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ流行が複数州に拡大し確定症例1,926例・死亡702例と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、米国人感染者のドイツ搬送や渡航制限措置など国際的拡大・渡航制限の基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツでの感染者搬送や渡航制限は対応措置であり、実際の流行発生地はコンゴのみ。ドイツ・米国は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak: Fastest Growing, Warns WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is at record levels, with close to 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths across five provinces as of 11 July, following field visits to Bunia in Ituri Province. The outbreak is the third-largest ever recorded and the fastest-growing in a month, with over 80 new infections confirmed in 24 hours. A key concern is that most new cases arise from unknown transmission chains and the virus has spread beyond the original outbreak area. Alarmingly, many deaths occurred in communities before patients could access health facilities, described by WHO as “the most alarming finding.” Early detection and sustained global support are deemed critical to control the outbreak. The report underscores the ongoing, multi-provincial spread and unknowns fueling transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRCエボラ流行:過去最速の拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州にまたがり約2000例・700人超の死亡と過去最大規模で拡大、不明な感染経路が多く国際的拡大リスクが高いためIHR・WPRO双方の基準に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大と警告。感染経路不明の症例が多く、地域拡大が続いている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Pimpri-Chinchwad: PCMC Launches Citywide Drive To Prevent Dengue & Malaria During Monsoon; Residents Urged To Stay Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria prevention drive rolled out in Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC) ahead of peak monsoon, featuring citywide cleanliness, mosquito control, and public awareness. Actions include larvicide spraying, smoke fogging, door-to-door surveys, and targeted preventive chemical spraying, with ongoing screening and treatment at municipal hospitals and health centres. PCMC notes monsoon-related risk elevation due to stagnant water, unhygienic surroundings, and contaminated food/water. Residents are urged to keep homes and neighborhoods clean, prevent water accumulation, boil or purify drinking water, and keep foods covered. Regularly clean water storage tanks, coolers, flower pots, tyres and other containers where water can collect, with weekly inspections to curb mosquito breeding. Mayor Ravi Landge and officials call for public cooperation and prompt medical care for fever, body ache, vomiting, or diarrhoea. Officials emphasize personal hygiene and eliminating breeding sites to curb dengue, malaria, and other monsoon-related diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ピンプリ・チンチワッド:PCMCがモンスーン期のデング熱・マラリア予防のため市内全域で対策キャンペーンを開始、住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の恒例的な予防啓発活動であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の報告がないため、通常の公衆衛生対策の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の予防キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、具体的な患者数や重症例の急増データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : la fermeture frontalière ougandaise asphyxie l'économie locale à Kasindi - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: the Ugandan border closure is choking the local economy in Kasindi - ACP
article.articleSummary: Border closure between Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo due to an Ebola outbreak disrupts Kasindi, Beni, North Kivu, as of 14 July 2026. The Kasindi-Lubirihya area, dependent on cross-border trade, sees Congolese exporters traveling to Uganda for palm oil, brooms, bananas, coffee and cacao, while Ugandan traders bring manufactured goods and other farm products to Kasindi. Staples have surged in price: tomatoes from about 100 FC to several times that; a 25 kg bag of maize flour now costs $14–$16, up from $10. Congolese residents in Uganda and students studying in Congo face difficulties; cross-border commerce operations are impeded. Compliance with health measures is uneven: Lubirihya market (4,000–6,000 people on market days) has handwashing devices lacking water, with similar shortages at banana centers, schools, churches, and unloading points. No suspected Ebola cases reported; strict adherence to measures is urged.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ:ウガンダ国境閉鎖がカシンディの地域経済を圧迫
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で継続中のエボラ流行に伴いウガンダとの国境が閉鎖され経済的・社会的影響が拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ既存の重大公衆衛生事象の継続的動向としてフルRRAでの状況確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は新規エボラ疑い症例の報告ではなく、既存流行に伴う国境閉鎖の経済影響に関する続報。手洗い設備の水不足など公衆衛生対策の不備も指摘されており、感染拡大リスクの観点から継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Perceptions croisées des enfants, des parents/tuteurs et des acteurs sur l'épidémie d'Ebola et ses effets sur la protection de l'enfant - Les interventions protection de l'enfant en Ituri sont soutenues par
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cross-perceptions of children, parents/guardians, and stakeholders on the Ebola outbreak and its effects on child protection - Child protection interventions in Ituri are supported by.
article.articleSummary: Three surveys in Ebola-affected Ituri reveal widespread psychosocial distress and escalating child-protection risks. In the Ituri region, 81.1% of children fear Ebola, 80.0% feel stressed or sad, and 86.8% of parents observe fear in their children, while 89.0% of respondents report their own stress. Protection risks rise: among children, violence at home (37.3%), family separation (28.1%), and child labor (25.4%); among parents, domestic violence (64.8%), separation (40.7%), and child labor (35.2%). Actors likewise note stress, stigma, school disruption, violence against children, and, in some areas, recruitment into armed groups or sexual violence. Child protection services have been sustained but under pressure: access is limited or less known; delays, staff redeployment, funding cuts, higher costs, and reduced community activity. Adaptations include community outreach, hygiene kits, home visits, and remote follow-up to mitigate impacts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に関する子ども・保護者/後見人・関係者の相互認識の調査 ― イトゥリ州における児童保護活動が支援されている
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ流行（DRC・イトゥリ州）に対する心理社会的・児童保護面の影響調査であり、新規発生や流行拡大を示す一次情報ではないが、既存アウトブレイクの継続・支援体制の逼迫を示すため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラ流行(DRCイトゥリ州)に伴う児童保護・心理社会的影響の調査報告であり、新規症例数や感染拡大の疫学的情報は含まれていない。既存流行の社会的側面のモニタリングとして扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织警告：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情形势严峻
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is dire.
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 — The World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is dire, with virus transmission accelerating to a record pace. WHO says most new cases in this surge come from unknown transmission chains, indicating sustained community transmission. Surveillance and contact tracing are facing severe challenges. The agency calls for intensified case detection, expanded contact tracing, strengthened infection prevention and control, and enhanced community interventions to interrupt transmission. It also appeals to the international community to step up support to prevent further spread. The report highlights ongoing outbreak dynamics in the DRC, though the article provides no specific case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は深刻な状況
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ流行の深刻化と持続的な地域内伝播を警告し、国際支援を要請しているため、公衆衛生上の影響・国際拡大リスクともに高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡数は記事に記載なし。感染経路不明な症例が多く、コミュニティ内伝播が継続している点が特に懸念される。
