article.articleHeadline: Urgent warning for UK holidaymakers as mosquito-borne disease risk grows
article.articleSummary: Eight Zika virus cases were reported in England, Wales and Northern Ireland between January and June 2026, exceeding the seven UK cases in all of 2025; four infections were linked to travel to Indonesia. The UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) reported 137 imported dengue fever cases in England during the first six months of 2026, with South-East Asia and South Asia as the main sources (Thailand 27; Maldives 19). Malaria totaled 557 cases across England, Wales and Northern Ireland from January to May 2026, up from 548 in the same period last year. Chikungunya symptoms include fever, joint pain, headaches, muscle aches, joint swelling and a rash. Zika poses danger in pregnancy (miscarriage, stillbirth, birth defects); malaria can be fatal if untreated (fever, vomiting, muscle aches). Prevention emphasizes vaccines where available, anti-malarials, insect repellent, covered skin, bed nets and food/water hygiene; consult TravelHealthPro for destination guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 英国からの旅行者に蚊媒介感染症リスク増加についての緊急警告
triage.triage_reason: 英国内での輸入症例（ジカ、デング、マラリア）の統計報告であり、前年比増加は緩やかで、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。感染発生国は英国（対象外）であり、既知の風土病の季節的な輸入例に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国（対象国リスト外）における輸入感染症症例数の統計報告。インドネシア・タイ・モルディブは感染源地域として言及されているのみで、これらの国での流行拡大を報じるものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η επιδημία στο Κονγκό ίσως ξεπερνά έως και 4 φορές τις επίσημες εκτιμήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may exceed official estimates by up to four times.
article.articleSummary: Over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo strain is ongoing in the eastern region, with case numbers possibly 2–4 times higher than officially reported as case detection improves daily, according to the WHO Emergency Programme director. Government data count at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri province, the hardest-hit area, where the outbreak has spread to two additional provinces this week. The WHO notes the outbreak lacks a proven treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola and warns that resources are insufficient; only about 40% of the $115 million appeal has been funded. Donors are urged to sustain support as the response enters a critical phase, emphasizing intensified efforts to identify and isolate patients in the face of continuing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国の流行は公式推定の最大4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)による大規模な死者・感染者数、複数州への拡大、資金不足という複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 有効な治療法・ワクチンが未確立のブンディブギョ株による流行であり、資金不足（40%のみ充足）が対応の障壁となっている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola /Amploarea epidemiei ar putea depăși ''de două până la patru ori'' estimările
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola / The scale of the epidemic could exceed the estimates by two to four times.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times larger than official counts, according to WHO as of 14 July 2026. The epidemic began in Ituri province on the northeast border with South Sudan and Uganda and has spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé, with Uganda reporting 20 related cases. The WHO notes this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-spreading within a month among managed outbreaks. A key concern is that many new cases involve deaths in the community before seeking care. About 90% of cases are detected in Ituri. Response progress includes nearly 80% contact tracing, 700 treatment beds, and a rise in laboratories from 1 to 14. Two treatments are being tested on-site; a PPE post-exposure prophylaxis study using Obeldesivir is planned by INRB Kinshasa, ANRS MIE, and Alima.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ / 流行の規模は推定値の2〜4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOによりコンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱が第3位規模かつ最速拡大の流行と評価されており、ウガンダへの国境を越えた感染拡大も報告されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダで関連症例20件が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。スーダンも同様に対象国リスト外。WHOは本流行を管理下にあるエボラ流行の中で第3位の規模、かつ1か月以内で最速の拡大速度と評価している。コミュニティ内での死亡が多い点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 case detected in Varanasi; patient admitted to BHU Hospital with breathing difficulties
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 case detected in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with a 27-year-old Ashapur resident admitted to BHU Hospital after testing positive. He presented with several days of breathing difficulties and was referred to the Chest and TB Department before a positive test confirmed infection; he is currently stable under medical supervision. The health department notes that while the spread of COVID-19 has slowed compared with earlier waves, the virus remains circulating. Public health officials urge vigilance and preventive measures, and advise seeking immediate medical care for symptoms such as cold, cough, fever, or breathing trouble. No mention of transmission source or imported/exported cases; the report emphasizes ongoing transmission potential as of 14 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: バラナシでCOVID-19感染確認、患者は呼吸困難でBHU病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発の散発症例報告であり、COVID-19は既知の流行病であるため異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知のCOVID-19流行下における単発症例報告であり、新規性・重大性ともに低い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: Число заболевших Эболой в ДРК может в 4 раза превышать официальные данные
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The number of Ebola cases in the DRC could be four times higher than official figures.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, about 2,000 Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with over 700 deaths. WHO spokesperson Chikwe Ihekweazu says the true outbreak scale may be 2–4 times higher than official figures, based on mathematical models. Diagnostics capacity is expanding, improving data on spread, but roughly 80% of newly identified patients were not previously listed as contacts of known cases, leaving many transmission chains unidentified. Some patients die at home before seeking care, likely not captured in official statistics. Ongoing efforts aim to broaden case finding and contact tracing to better characterize transmission and guide response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:DRCにおけるエボラ感染者数は公式データの4倍に上る可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱でDRCにおいて約2,000症例・700人超の死亡が確認され、公式統計の過小評価や未同定の感染連鎖が多数存在するなど、深刻さ・拡大リスクともに高い。
triage.notes: WHOによる数理モデルで実際の症例数が公式統計の2〜4倍に達する可能性が指摘されており、80%の新規患者が既知の接触者リストに含まれていないため感染連鎖の把握が不十分。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例境外移入茲卡病毒 30多歲男赴泰旅遊返台確診 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first imported Zika virus case: a man in his 30s who traveled to Thailand and returned to Taiwan has been diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus case in 2026: a man in his 30s from the northern region who visited Thailand in mid-June and returned with fever, dizziness, and later a rash; laboratory-confirmed infection. Symptoms were mild and resolved; contact tracing found an asymptomatic close contact. Since 2016 Taiwan has documented 31 Zika cases, all imported; 81% originated in Southeast Asia, notably Thailand (8), Vietnam (6), Philippines (3), Myanmar (3), Malaysia (3), Maldives (2), Indonesia (1), Singapore (1). Health authorities warn maternal Zika infection can cause fetal microcephaly or death; pregnant or planning-pregnancy women are advised to postpone travel to endemic areas. Post-travel, men should practice safe sex for 3 months and women for 2 months due to possible virus in semen and vaginal secretions. Preventive measures include protective clothing and repellents; border quarantine may be activated if fever appears on arrival.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の輸入性ジカウイルス感染例：タイ旅行後に台湾で30代男性が確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入例（軽症・治癒済み）であり、タイ国内での新たな流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源とされるタイのみを対象国として記載。過去にも複数の輸入例が報告されており、今回も単発の軽症例で特段の異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warnt: Viele Ebola-Todesfälle bleiben noch unentdeckt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Warns: Many Ebola Deaths Remain Undetected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with more than 1,900 laboratory-confirmed cases and around 700 deaths. The WHO warns the true number of infections is likely two- to four-fold higher, based on frontline assessments by Emergency Director Chikwe Ihekweazu. Most fatalities occur at home within families rather than in treatment centers, raising concern that many transmission chains remain untracked, with four out of five new patients not listed on existing contacts. Authorities and WHO are scaling risk communication and emphasizing that survival is higher in treatment facilities, which help interrupt transmission. Response capacity includes nearly 800 beds in dedicated centers and 14 laboratories for rapid testing; funding remains insufficient, with only about 40% of the $115 million six-month budget received. Full containment depends on increased support.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：多くのエボラ死亡例が未だ発見されていない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクがDRCで継続しており、致死数・症例数が多く、追跡不能な感染連鎖と資金不足が指摘されるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOによる公式警告と資金不足の指摘があり、国際的な支援強化が求められている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Congo begins trial of Gilead's experimental antiviral for Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo began enrolling participants in a trial of Gilead Sciences' experimental antiviral obeldesivir as post-exposure treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda. In Ituri province, the epicenter, the study led by DRC's National Institute for Biomedical Research and France's ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases seeks about 1,000 people aged 12+ with high-risk exposure to a confirmed Ebola case within the previous five days and who have not yet developed symptoms. Participants are monitored daily for 21 days, with a final 42-day follow-up. Obeldesivir has shown activity against filoviruses, including Bundibugyo, in preclinical work. Funding totals include €3.4 million from Global Health EDCTP3 (EC-supported) and $1 million from Africa CDC, plus $5 million commitments from South Africa and DRC. A separate compassionate-use protocol offers remdesivir for certain children and pregnant/breastfeeding women. Congo has 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがギリアド社のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）実験的抗ウイルス薬の治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダにまたがるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクで確定症例1,963例、死亡719例と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際機関・複数国が資金支援する治験が開始されるなど国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はGileadの実験的抗ウイルス薬（obeldesivir）の曝露後予防治験開始を主題としているが、背景にあるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは確定症例1,963例・死亡719例と重大。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無いため verified_locations には含めず。南アフリカ・フランスは資金提供国であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Epidemija ebole mogla bi biti dva do četiri puta veća od službenih procjena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic could be two to four times larger than official estimates.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times larger than official counts, though case detection is improving. Government data indicate at least 1,926 people infected and 702 deaths. About 40% of the USD 115 million requested to fight the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has been received; there is no proven treatment or vaccine. WHO called on donors not to abandon the country during this critical phase. The response has reached a tipping point, with intensified efforts needed to identify and isolate patients after cases this week spread to two new provinces. WHO emphasizes that detection capacity is increasing daily, but the epidemic requires resources commensurate with the scale of the problem, beyond what DR Congo can bear alone.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラ流行は公式推定の2倍から4倍の規模である可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで拡大し新たに2州へ広がっており、致死率の高さ・国際支援の必要性・WHOの警告からIHR基準複数該当と判断される。
triage.notes: WHOが資金不足と検知能力の限界を指摘し、感染が新たな2州に拡大したことが報告されている。ワクチン・治療法未確立で深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: "No Need To Panic": Health Minister Mahaling On Covid-19 Situation In Neighbouring States
article.articleSummary: Odisha is closely monitoring the Covid-19 situation amid rising cases in neighbouring Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh. Health Minister Mukesh Mahaling urged residents not to panic, saying the government is alert and maintaining special vigilance in bordering districts. The administration is prepared to act per Central SOPs as issued. Surveillance has been intensified at hospitals and along border areas, with all districts instructed to stay ready with testing, treatment, and isolation facilities. As of 14 July 2026, Andhra Pradesh reports eight active Covid-19 cases and one casualty; Odisha has stepped up measures in response to renewed transmission in the neighbouring state.

triage.headline_ja: 「パニックになる必要はない」:マハリン保健相、近隣州のCOVID-19状況について発言
triage.triage_reason: 近隣州での症例増加を受けオディシャ州が警戒を強化しているが、症例数は少なく重大な公衆衛生上の影響は現時点で確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: アンドラプラデシュ州で活動性症例8件・死亡1件と報告されているが、詳細な疫学情報は限定的。COVID-19の季節的な再流行の可能性があり続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Kongu si vyžiadala už 719 životov. WHO varuje, že nakazených môže byť až štvornásobne viac, peniaze však chýbajú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo has already claimed 719 lives. The WHO warns that the number of people infected could be up to four times higher, but funds are lacking.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths as of July 12, per Congolese authorities; WHO cautions actual numbers could be two to four times higher. Health workers accounted for 112 infections, including 35 deaths, per INSP. In Ituri's Rwampara, salary delays sparked strikes at one treatment center. The virus has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Upper Uele provinces; Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases with 2 deaths across the border. As of July 11, Reuters cited INSP figures of 1,926 cases and 702 deaths. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Donors have funded about 40% of the roughly $115 million needed. Transmission occurs via contact with infected individuals or contaminated materials; risk of wider spread remains low per ECDC/WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者719人に。WHOは感染者数が4倍に上る可能性を警告するも資金不足
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1,963症例、719死亡）が発生し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。医療従事者への感染（112人、35死亡）や資金不足（必要額の約40%のみ確保）はアウトブレイク対応の脆弱性を示す重要情報。ボツリンブジョ株はワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: L'ampleur de l'épidémie d'Ebola pourrait dépasser "de deux à quatre fois" les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The scale of the Ebola outbreak could be two to four times higher than the official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the World Health Organization says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times higher than official estimates, with detection capacity improving daily. Declared two months ago in Ituri, near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, the outbreak has caused over 700 deaths and nearly 2,000 cases. It has spread to four additional provinces—North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele—with Uganda recording 20 cases. WHO emergency program director Chikwe Ihekweazu warned this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest-growing in a single month among Ebola outbreaks managed by the agency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の規模は公式推計の「2〜4倍」に達する可能性、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ流行がWHO史上第3位の規模かつ最速拡大となっており、700人以上の死者と近2000症例、複数州・隣国ウガンダへの拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例確認も記事に含まれるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。スーダンは国境近接の言及のみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ameba 'comedora de cérebro' acende alerta mundial com avanço para novas regiões
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brain-eating amoeba triggers a global alert as it advances into new regions.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, has emerged as a concern as cases rise in regions. The organism thrives in warm freshwater—lakes, rivers, ponds, hot springs, and inadequately treated pools—and infection occurs when contaminated water enters the nose during swimming; ingestion does not trigger disease. Once it reaches the nervous system, it causes primary amebic meningoencephalitis, with symptoms including severe headache, fever, nausea, vomiting, followed by confusion, seizures, hallucinations, and coma. Although extremely rare, fewer than 500 confirmed cases have occurred since 1962–2023, with mortality around 97%. Recent years show cases in colder regions of Europe and the northern United States, likely linked to climate warming and better diagnostics. India reported over 200 infections—the largest outbreak in the country—where diagnosis and treatment improved survival. Brazil’s Rondônia state reported a case. Prevention: avoid hot freshwater, use nasal clips, and use sterile water for nasal irrigation; maintain treated pools and water safety.

triage.headline_ja: 「脳を食う」アメーバが新たな地域への拡大で世界的警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ネグレリア・フォーレリ感染症は致死率が極めて高く、従来と異なる寒冷地域やインド・ブラジルなど新地域への拡大が報告されており、世間の関心も高まっているためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 本疾患はヒト-ヒト感染しない水系感染症であり大規模流行の可能性は低いが、気候変動による生息域拡大と致死率の高さから継続的な監視が必要。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Real number of Ebola cases in Congo may be four times higher than official tally -- WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be 2–4 times higher than the official tally. The current figure is about 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths, but WHO modeling suggests the true scale could reach up to four times that, as surveillance improves. Chikwe Ihekweazu, Executive Director of the WHO Health Emergencies Programme, said at a Geneva briefing on 14 July 2026 that roughly 80% of new cases are detected outside the patient contact lists, indicating transmission through unknown chains. He noted many patients die at home without reaching medical facilities, complicating outbreak assessments, while ongoing efforts to identify cases are increasing and the confidence in reported numbers is rising over time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数、公式発表の4倍に達する可能性──WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が公式集計（感染約2000人、死亡700人超）の最大4倍に達する可能性があり、新規感染の8割が既知の接触者リスト外で発見されるなど未知の感染連鎖が疑われるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHOブリーフィング開催地であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。80%の新規症例が既知の接触者リスト外で検出されている点は未知の感染連鎖を示唆し、国際的拡大リスクを高める重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar IPB Tekankan Pentingnya Vaksinasi Rabies pada Anjing Pemburu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bogor Agricultural University expert emphasizes the importance of rabies vaccination in hunting dogs
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 — A tragic attack on a child by hunting dogs in Jasinga, Bogor Regency, has heightened concern about rabies prevention. Dr drh Agus Wijaya of IPB University’s School of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedicine says animal health must be prioritized, noting rabies vaccination among hunting dogs remains a major challenge. Vaccination is a basic safeguard for animal and public health, but coverage is not consistently implemented. Misconceptions among owners that vaccines reduce hunting performance, together with unmonitored animal health and risky human–dog interactions, are key risk factors. Preventive steps include responsible ownership, keeping dogs leashed or indoors, and secure housing. A coordinated program of regular vaccination and intensified rabies education, with cooperation among government, hunting communities, and the public, is proposed to prevent recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: IPB大学専門家、狩猟犬への狂犬病ワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ワクチン接種の啓発に関する専門家コメント記事であり、具体的な集団感染や急性の公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。
triage.notes: インドネシア・ボゴールでの狩猟犬による子供への攻撃事件を契機とした狂犬病予防啓発記事。対象国リストのIndonesiaは発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題は個別事故を受けた予防啓発であり、シグナルとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تدعو إلى دعم جهود مكافحة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization calls for support for Ebola control efforts.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreaks are active in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri with spread to two additional provinces this week. The World Health Organization reports 1,926 cases and 702 deaths overall. The agency has received about 40% of the $115 million it sought to fund the response, leaving a substantial funding gap. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO's emergencies program, warned that resources must match the scale of the challenge and that the DRC cannot bear the burden alone. With the response at a critical stage, authorities are accelerating patient case finding and isolation as transmission expands, underscoring the need for renewed donor support to sustain surveillance, treatment, and infection control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラ対策への支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が拡大しており(1,926症例、702死亡)、資金不足の中で国際的拡大リスクと対応能力の限界が指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOは資金の40%しか確保できておらず、感染は当初の中心地イトゥリ州から2州へ拡大中。致死率は約36%と高く、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Una huelga de trabajadores sanitarios en RD Congo complica la lucha contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A strike by healthcare workers in DR Congo complicates the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. The outbreak emerged in May and is caused by the Bundibugyo virus variant, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists; confirmation was delayed as tests targeted a more common strain. Authorities say the virus has spread to two additional provinces. At Rwampara General Hospital in Ituri, dozens of staff—including epidemiologists, case investigators, drivers, and mortuary workers—went on strike over two months of unpaid salaries and bonuses, prompting hospital closure, roadblocks, and arson at the site. The government is reconciling payroll lists to ensure payments reach the right personnel; a separate two-treatment clinical trial is underway at another Ituri hospital. The WHO notes a second American humanitarian worker with Ebola has been transferred to Germany; the first American patient was a Congo-based physician.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での医療従事者ストライキがエボラ対策を混乱させる
triage.triage_reason: 1,926症例・702死亡という大規模なエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、治療法・ワクチン未承認）が複数州に拡大しており、医療従事者ストライキが対応を阻害、国際的な患者搬送も発生しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国人人道支援者2名がエボラ感染によりドイツへ搬送されたと報告されているが、ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ株は稀少で治療・ワクチンが未承認である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola sprider sig med rekordfart - så bedöms risken för Sverige
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading at record speed - how the risk to Sweden is assessed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where nearly 900,000 people live in internally displaced camps and move between villages and informal gold mines, complicating case finding and contact tracing. The outbreak has strained health services: 25 healthcare workers have died and several clinics have closed after transmission; wage arrears have sparked strikes. Donors pledged over $1.2 billion, but only about $115 million has been disbursed. There is about a 70% probability the virus reaches South Sudan within three months; Rwanda and Burundi are expected to be less affected. About 200 Swedish citizens are in the outbreak area (DRC and Uganda); Sweden and EU authorities assess the risk to Sweden and EU as very low. France has reported its first EU case, while Sweden has not had a confirmed case; ECDC and the EU Commission urge vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が記録的速度で拡大 - スウェーデンへのリスク評価
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が記録的速度で拡大し、医療従事者の死亡や資金不足で対応が逼迫、南スーダンへの越境やEU域内(フランス)での症例確認など国際的拡大の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダ、フランス、スウェーデンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生地域として確認された。

article.articleHeadline: WHO vraagt meer geld voor ebola-aanpak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO calls for more funding for the Ebola response in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization says funds allocated for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo are far short of needs. A top WHO official, Chikwe Ihekweazu, urged international donors not to abandon Congo in a critical phase of the Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak. Official counts report over 700 deaths in the DRC from Bundibugyo-ebola virus, a form that can cause severe bleeding. The WHO had requested 115 million dollars (about 100 million euros) to fight the outbreak but has received only about 40 percent of that amount so far. The agency cautions the outbreak’s true scale may be two to four times larger than currently known, underscoring the urgency of funding to sustain control measures, surveillance, and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴでのエボラ対応のためにさらなる資金を求める
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し700人超の死亡が報告され、資金不足により対応能力が損なわれている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の流行規模が公表値の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、資金不足がサーベイランスと対応の持続性を脅かしている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS hace inquietante advertencia sobre la magnitud del brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues an alarming warning about the magnitude of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times larger than official counts. Reuters notes that Chikwe Ihekweazu said about 80% of new Bunia cases are not linked to known contact lists, hindering contact tracing. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak has infected 1,792 people and caused 625 deaths according to government data. Approximately 90% of cases are concentrated in Ituri Province, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and most recently Tshopo Province. The figures highlight transmission tracing challenges and the potential for wider spread beyond the most affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの規模について憂慮すべき警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式集計の2〜4倍規模の可能性を警告し、致死率の高いエボラが複数州に拡大、接触者追跡が困難であることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 80%の新規Bunia症例が既知の接触者リストと関連なしとされ、感染規模の過小評価と追跡困難が強く示唆される。北キブ・南キブ・ツショポ州への拡大も報告されており、国内複数州への拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الكثير من إصابات ووفيات إيبولا في الكونغو لا يتم رصدها - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Many Ebola infections and deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo go undetected.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization warns that Ebola infections and deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are significantly undercounted, potentially by 2 to 4 times. In the current outbreak, more than 1,900 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been reported. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO’s Health Emergencies Programme, notes most deaths occur at home rather than in clinics, with caregivers without protective equipment at high risk of transmission. About 80% of new infections are not on known contact lists, indicating unsampled transmission chains. Funding shortfalls compound the crisis, as only roughly 40% of the $115 million requested for the first six months has been received, underscoring an urgent need for additional international support to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラの感染・死亡の多くが検出されていない
triage.triage_reason: エボラの実際の感染・死亡数がWHO推計で大幅に過小報告されており、感染連鎖の把握不能（接触者リスト外80%）と資金不足が重なり、国際的拡大・対応能力のリスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に過小報告を警告しており、感染拡大の実態把握が困難な状況。資金不足も深刻でフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: L'ampleur de l'épidémie d'Ebola pourrait dépasser " de deux à quatre fois " les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The scale of the Ebola outbreak could be two to four times higher than official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Two months after the Ebola outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, official tallies show more than 700 deaths and around 2,000 cases. The World Health Organization warns that the true scale could be two to four times higher than official estimates, underscoring substantial uncertainty in the numbers during an ongoing outbreak. This outbreak has become the third-largest Ebola epidemic on record, highlighting its severity relative to prior outbreaks. The information is current as of 2026-07-14 and concerns the situation in the DRC. Reported by Le Nouvel Obs with AFP.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の規模はWHOによると公式推定の2~4倍に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: DRCで700人超の死亡、2000例規模の史上第3位のエボラ流行であり、WHOが過小評価の可能性を指摘するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念が高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: WHOが公式統計の過小評価の可能性を指摘しており、史上第3位規模の流行として国際的な注目度が高い。続報でのケース数・致死率・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Majority of new Ebola cases are 'from unknown chains of...
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Congo, notably Ituri province's Bunia, continues to outpace response. 1,926 infections and 702 deaths have been reported across three provinces, with cases also confirmed in neighboring Uganda. About 80% of new cases are outside contact lists, arising from unknown transmission chains; many deaths occur in communities without health facilities. The outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa, with no approved treatment or vaccine. Response improvements include Bunia treatment capacity near 800 beds and lab capacity rising from 1 to 14 laboratories. A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Ebola. Challenges include funding gaps, attacks on health centers, ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, and community mistrust; a strike at an Ebola treatment center over unpaid salaries was reported. Congo declared a fresh outbreak on May 15; clinical trials for treatments began last week.

triage.headline_ja: 新規エボラ症例の大半は「未知の感染経路」から発生とWHO当局者が発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でアフリカ最速拡大のエボラ流行が継続し、感染者1,926人・死者702人、隣国ウガンダへの拡大や米国人感染者も確認されており、承認された治療薬・ワクチンもないため深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染確認との記載があるが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。資金不足、医療施設への攻撃、コミュニティの不信感など対応上の課題が多数報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊7.9万例，广东疾控最新提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases; Guangdong CDC's latest advisory.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 nationwide COVID-19: 79,000 new confirmed cases (June 1–30); 130 severe; 1 death with underlying diseases. Genomic surveillance of 3,741 sequences found all Omicron variants, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and sublineages; weeks 23–26 shares: 98.5%, 98.1%, 98.8%, 95.9%. No evidence of a new high-risk variant. Beijing You An Hospital expert Li Tongzeng links the rise to waning immunity; no fixed season, and summer indoor cooling may raise transmission. Most infections are mild, with upper-respiratory symptoms (sore throat, cough, runny nose, low fever) and some diarrhea; pneumonia and severe illness are rare. Guangdong’s July 10 health tips prioritize dengue, chikungunya, influenza, COVID-19, HFMD/herpangina, malaria, monkeypox, and Ebola. Advise avoiding poisonous mushrooms and Datura, preventing contaminated food, maintaining ventilation and hygiene; high-risk individuals should seek early diagnosis and wear masks in healthcare settings.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ新規確定症例7.9万人、広東省疾病予防管理センターの最新注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 中国国内の定例COVID-19サーベイランス報告であり、新規変異株の証拠なし、重症・死亡例も少なく、既知の季節的変動として説明されているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 定例の月次COVID-19統計報告と広東省CDCによる季節性感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、インフルエンザ、手足口病、マラリア、Mpox、エボラ）への一般的な注意喚起であり、特定の異常なアウトブレイクを示すものではない。全てOmicron系統で新規高リスク変異株の証拠なし。

article.articleHeadline: Majority of new Ebola cases are 'from unknown chains of transmission,' WHO official says
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, with no approved treatment or vaccine, continues to outpace response. In Bunia, Ituri province, health workers report many deaths occurring in communities without contact with facilities; 80% of new cases are outside contact lists and come from unknown transmission chains. As of 2026-07-14, at least 1,926 people infected and 702 killed across three provinces in Congo; cases have also been confirmed in neighboring Uganda. A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive. Congo declared a fresh outbreak on May 15 after transmission began weeks earlier. Response capacity has improved: Bunia now has about 800 treatment beds and labs expanded from 1 to 14. Challenges persist due to funding gaps, assaults on health centers, ongoing eastern Congo conflict, and community mistrust. Clinical trials for treatments began last week.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ新規感染例の大半は「感染経路不明」とWHO当局者が発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ流行が拡大中で、感染者1,926人・死者702人、国境を越えてウガンダにも波及し、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがない深刻な事例であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染例が確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsからは除外。米国籍の人道支援関係者も感染しており国際的な波及リスクが高い。資金不足・治安悪化・住民の不信感などにより対応能力に課題が残る。

article.articleHeadline: OMS diz que recebeu menos da metade dos recursos necessários para combater surto de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says it has received less than half of the resources needed to combat the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain with no proven treatment or vaccine. As of 14 July 2026, the World Health Organization has received about 40% of the US$115 million requested to combat the outbreak. Official data report 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. The response has reached a critical phase as cases this week spread to two additional provinces, with Ituri still the most affected. WHO Emergencies Programme head Chikwe Ihekweazu said the true number of Ebola cases is at least double, potentially more than four times the official tally. Donors are urged not to abandon the country during this critical period.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ流行対策に必要な資金の半分未満しか受け取っていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の流行が拡大し、感染者1,926人・死者702人、追加の州にも拡大しており、資金不足も深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 実際の感染者数は公式報告の2倍から4倍以上に上る可能性があるとWHOが指摘しており、過小報告のリスクが高い。ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株であることも重症化・拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемијата на ебола може да биде два до четири пати поголема од официјалните проценки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic could be two to four times larger than official estimates.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times larger than official counts, with at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths reported by authorities. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO's Health Emergencies Programme, said projections estimate the outbreak's size is substantially higher and that case-finding is improving daily. Despite progress, WHO has secured only about 40% of the $115 million requested to eradicate the Bundibugyo strain, which has no proven treatment or vaccine; donors are urged not to abandon the country in this critical phase. The response has reached a critical point, with intensified efforts needed to detect and isolate patients after cases spread to two new provinces this week.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラの流行は公式推計の2~4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続し、WHOが公式統計の2~4倍の規模を警告、新たな2州への拡大や資金不足も報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には有効な治療薬・ワクチンがなく、資金不足（要請額の約40%のみ確保）が対応の障壁となっている。新たに2州へ拡大した点は要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolás beteget kezelnek egy európai városban, a hatóságok szerint nincs ok pánikra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola patient is being treated in a European city, authorities say there is no reason to panic.
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker infected in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo with the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus disease has been airlifted to Frankfurt, Germany, and is being treated in a high-security isolation ward at Frankfurt University Hospital. Authorities stress the public is not at risk and that the virus cannot spread into the environment; the patient's condition is stable. The transfer underscores Europe’s ongoing importation of Ebola cases from the current outbreak. Notably, May saw an American physician successfully treated in Berlin from the same outbreak, and in late June France identified the first European case of the current outbreak, with rapid isolation preventing secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州の都市でエボラ患者が治療中、当局はパニックの必要はないとしている
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が継続的に欧州へ輸入されており、国際的拡大が確認されているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のエボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）から欧州各国（独・仏）への輸入例の続報。ドイツ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、発生源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: SMS de Feira de Santana registra 1,3 mil notificações suspeitas de dengue e intensifica combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feira de Santana's Municipal Health Secretariat records 1,300 suspected dengue notifications and intensifies the fight against Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil, recorded 1,373 suspected dengue notifications from January to July 7, 2026, with 96 laboratory-confirmed cases, 107 inconclusive results, and remaining investigations by Lacen-BA. The city remains in an endemic dengue pattern with no epidemiological alert. Arbovirus surveillance shows persistent Aedes aegypti control efforts, including area monitoring, breeding-site elimination, home visits, transmission blocking, mutirões, and expanded field teams. Higher temperatures and rainfall are linked to increased arboviral activity, though indicators align with endemic behavior observed in prior years. In 2025, dengue totalled 2,398 notifications and 204 confirmations; in January–June 2025 there were 1,371 notifications and 143 confirmations. Chikungunya reports 313 suspected with 201 confirmed this year; 2025 had 24 suspected and 15 confirmed. Zika has 4 suspected and 1 confirmed this year; 2025 had 4 suspected and 2 confirmed. Tomba and Queimadinha districts concentrate most cases. 103 health units offer rapid dengue testing; dengue vaccination is available for 10–14-year-olds per Ministry of Health strategy.

triage.headline_ja: フェイラ・デ・サンタナ市保健局、デング熱疑い1,373件を記録、ネッタイシマカ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 地域は明確にエンデミックパターンであり、疫学的アラートも発令されていない通常の季節性デング活動であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は例年通りのエンデミックなデング熱・チクングニア・ジカの状況を報告しており、記事自身が『no epidemiological alert』と明記している。ブラジル国内の地域保健局の定期報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO zabrinut oko ebole: Razmjeri zaraze bi mogli biti veći
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO is concerned about Ebola: The extent of the outbreak could be greater.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, could be 2–4 times larger than officially reported. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO’s Health Emergencies Programme, said projections suggest the outbreak’s scale is at least twice to four times the identified cases, even as case detection improves daily. The agency has received less than half of the $115 million sought to combat the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with about 40% funded. Government data indicate at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died. There is no proven treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Ongoing response efforts are expanding case-finding, but funding gaps threaten containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の拡大を懸念：感染規模はさらに大きい可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のDRCでの大規模流行で、WHOが公式報告の2〜4倍の規模を懸念しており、資金不足と治療法・ワクチン未確立という深刻な公衆衛生上の課題があるため。
triage.notes: 致死率約36%（702/1926）と高く、治療法・ワクチンが未確立なブンディブギョ株のため深刻度が高い。資金不足（必要額の40%程度）が対応の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warnt: Viele Ebola-Todesfälle bleiben noch unentdeckt - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Many Ebola deaths remain undetected.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a major concern. As of 14 July 2026, the WHO estimates the true infection count may be 2–4 times higher than lab-confirmed cases. More than 1,900 cases have been laboratory-confirmed, with about 700 deaths. Most fatalities occur at home among family members rather than in treatment centers, increasing risk to caregivers; roughly 4 of 5 new infections are not on the contact lists of known cases, indicating widespread undetected transmission chains. Authorities and WHO are informing the public and reinforcing confidence in care in clinics, noting survival is higher in treatment centers and that transmission can be interrupted there. Capacity measures include nearly 800 beds in specialized treatment centers and 14 rapid-testing laboratories, but only 40% of the $115 million six-month WHO budget has been disbursed; more international support is urgently needed.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：多くのエボラ死亡例が未だ把握されていない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が大規模流行しており、1900例以上の確認症例、約700人の死亡、市中での未検知感染連鎖の拡大が報告されており、国際支援も急務とされているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: WHO予算の40%しか拠出されておらず、資金不足が対応能力に影響している点に留意。5分の4の新規感染が既知の接触者リストにないため、感染連鎖の追跡が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta que número de casos de ebola pode ser até quatro vezes maior | Mundo e Ciência | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the number of Ebola cases could be up to four times higher | World and Science | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists, spreading from Ituri province near the Sudan and Uganda border to Kivu North, Kivu South, Tshopo, and Alto Uele, with Uganda reporting 20 cases. Official counts surpass 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths. The World Health Organization cautions that true case numbers could be two to four times higher than reported. Declared in mid-May, this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest to progress within a month among all managed outbreaks. As of 14 July 2026, contact-tracing coverage is about 80%, but transmission outpaces response efforts. WHO urges earlier detection, accelerated contact tracing, and safer, accessible health centers that communities trust to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の感染者数は報告の4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、死者700人超・感染者2000人近くに達し、WHOが実際の感染者数はさらに多い可能性を警告している重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: ウガンダとスーダンも発生地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダでは20例確認との記述あり。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Kongu mogla bi biti drastično veća od zvaničnih podataka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo could be drastically larger than official data.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak could be two to four times larger than officially confirmed cases, according to the World Health Organization. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO's Health Emergencies Programme, said their estimates indicate substantial undercounting, though daily case detection is improving. The outbreak involves the Ebola Bundibugyo virus strain, for which there is currently no proven treatment or vaccine. WHO warns that international funding is insufficient—less than half of the US$115 million requested for outbreak response has been received—and calls for intensified assistance as the virus spreads to new provinces. As of directives from DRC authorities, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died. The response requires ongoing, intensified detection, isolation, and international support; the effort is likened to a marathon, with no room to stop.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、公式データより大幅に深刻な可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の流行で公式統計を大幅に上回る感染が疑われ、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ資金不足で新州へ拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 致死率約36%（702/1926）と高く、ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株であること、資金不足（要請額の半分未満）が国際支援の緊急性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola poderá ser "duas a quatro vezes" superior a estimativas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic could be two to four times higher than estimates.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, northeast near South Sudan and Uganda) has 702 deaths and 1,926 confirmed cases, with 20 cases in Uganda, per government data. Declared two months ago, the outbreak now extends to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. WHO projections suggest the epidemic could be two to four times the official counts, even as case detection improves. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest to progress in a month among Ebola epidemics handled by the agency. Many new cases involve deaths in the community without healthcare access; emphasis on earlier detection, intensified contact tracing, and making health facilities accessible, safe, and trusted. Ituri accounts for over 90% of detected cases. About 700 beds are available; laboratories rose from 1 to 14; around 80% of contacts are followed up. Two treatments are being tested locally; INRB Kinshasa, ANRS MIE, and Alima plan a post-exposure prophylaxis trial using obeldesivir for contacts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は推定値の2〜4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは、死者702名・確定症例1,926例に達し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されている。史上3番目の規模かつ最速の進行速度とされ、WHOが介入する重大な公衆衛生事案でありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOはコンゴ国内での実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、封じ込めの困難さと国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns DR Congo Ebola outbreak may be double the official tally
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to escalate, with no vaccine or treatment available. The World Health Organization confirms at least 1,963 cases and 719 deaths, as of July 12, with 727 patients being treated in Ebola treatment centres across five eastern provinces, including Ituri (epicentre) and neighboring areas such as Tshopo and Haut-Uele. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded on the continent. Ituri reports 384 confirmed cases and 89 deaths. Healthcare workers face salary delays and have threatened a total strike after a May 15 deadline, complicating containment. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola epidemic on May 15. International partners and African nations have mobilised about $1.5 billion to support the response. Uganda has reported 20 cases, including two deaths, near the border.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRCのエボラ流行は公式集計の2倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・治療法のないエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が急拡大しており、国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大も確認されているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。医療従事者の給与遅延によるストライキの脅威が対応能力を脅かしている点も重要な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Perceptions des acteurs sur l'épidémie d'Ebola et ses effets sur la protection de l'enfant - Résultats de l'enquête auprès des acteurs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Perceptions of stakeholders regarding the Ebola outbreak and its effects on child protection - Results of the survey among stakeholders
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak compounds child-protection fragility in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo. A May 28–29, 2026 online survey of 252 protection actors across Ituri territories Djugu (36.1%), Irumu (28.6%), Bunia Ville (18.3%), and Mambasa (17.1%) found widespread operational and community restrictions tied to Ebola: movement limited 67.9%, reduced community access 50.8%, meetings banned 26.6%, activities suspended 19.4%, and stigma 75.8%. Humanitarian access deemed limited or impossible by 46.4%. Protection risks rose, notably stress 87.7% and stigma 47.6%; other risks included family separation 14.7%, violence against children and sexual violence 12.3% each, school disengagement 10.7%, child labor 9.9%, and armed recruitment 7.5%. Over half (52.8%) reported at least two concurrent risks. Protection services remained functional for 58.7% but reduced or suspended for 41.3%, with psychosocial activities, home visits, case management and family reunification most affected. Adaptations include community sensitization 82.9%; hygiene-kit distribution 50%; radio 43.7%; remote follow-up 36.1%. Programmatic priorities: sustain services, psychosocial support, rapid response, and adaptation to security context.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に関する関係者の認識とその子供保護への影響 - 関係者調査結果
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ流行（DRC・イツリ州）に伴う社会的影響調査であり、新規の疫学的シグナルではないが、継続する流行の深刻さと人道的影響から経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCイツリ州における既存のエボラ流行の社会・子供保護への影響を調査したもので、新規発生や症例数の急増を報告するものではない。感染者数・死亡者数など疫学的詳細は記載なし。既にRRA対象として認識されている可能性が高いため、続報（症例数推移等）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'épidémie pourrait dépasser " de deux à quatre fois " les estimations selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak could exceed "two to four times" the estimates according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times larger than official estimates, the World Health Organization said on July 14, 2026. The statement highlights substantial undercounting and uncertainties in surveillance and reporting surrounding the ongoing epidemic. While the article does not provide current case or death totals, the admission by WHO indicates the true scale of transmission may be far higher than publicly reported figures. The report underscores the gravity of the situation in the DRC and the challenges involved in tracking cases in real time. It stresses the need for robust data collection and transparent reporting to inform the public health response, without specifying laboratory confirmations or infection sources in the provided excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOによると、流行はメディアの推計の「2〜4倍」に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行規模が公式推計の2〜4倍に達する可能性を認めており、サーベイランスの著しい過小評価と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が示唆されるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事には具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載がなく、サーベイランスの不確実性がWHOにより強調されている点が特徴的。続報での具体的データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Water-Borne Diseases Are Rising: The Tests That Could Save Your Life
article.articleSummary: India's monsoon season drives a rise in water-borne diseases as heavy rainfall, flooding, and stagnant water contaminate drinking water with bacteria, viruses, and parasites. The surge increases risks of typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A, hepatitis E, leptospirosis, and acute diarrhoeal diseases. The article links monsoon conditions to rising illness and underscores the public-health need for safe water, sanitation, and hygiene to prevent transmission. The text does not provide infection counts, specific outbreaks, or laboratory-confirmation details. Infection sources are identified as contaminated drinking water resulting from rainfall, floods, and stagnant water. The affected location is India, with implications for monsoon-related water safety across the country. No imported or exported-case details are mentioned, and the excerpt focuses on risk factors and preventive emphasis rather than clinical guidance.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : un élu provincial invite la population à la vigilance - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: a provincial elected official urges the public to remain vigilant - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo Province in North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompted a vigilance call from provincial deputy Bienvenu Bolonge on July 14, 2026. He urged calm and strict adherence to prevention to curb spread, including avoiding contact with dead animals—especially bats, a presumed natural reservoir—and abstaining from their consumption. He stressed systematic handwashing with water and soap or chlorinated solution, avoiding handshakes, and installing handwashing stations in churches, mosques, and public venues. Bolonge asked the provincial government to strengthen health-control at entry points and to fund the provincial outbreak response plan. Religious leaders, community actors, media, and social networks should amplify reliable information and encourage preventive behaviors. For deceased victims, he recommended avoiding contact with bodies and bodily fluids, with burials carried out by trained teams under sanitary protocols. The Assembly pledged continued support and awareness efforts.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでエボラ出血熱発生：州議会議員が住民に警戒を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国トショパ州キサンガニでエボラ出血熱の発生が確認され、州当局が警戒を呼びかけている。致死率の高い疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や動物由来感染のリスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 州議会議員が住民への警戒喚起、手洗い設備の設置、死亡者の埋葬時の衛生プロトコル遵守、国境での健康管理強化、及び州の対応計画への資金提供を要請しており、既に公的対応が動いていることが伺える。感染者数・死亡者数等の具体的な疫学データは記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Kimia Farma Siapkan Rantai Layanan Hulu-Hilir Percepat Penanggulangan TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kimia Farma Prepares an Upstream-Downstream Service Chain to Accelerate TB Control
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's PT Kimia Farma Tbk (KAEF) presents an integrated upstream-downstream health service chain to accelerate tuberculosis (TB) elimination by 2030, spanning drug production, distribution, diagnostics, and health services. Speaking at the National TB Forum 2026 on July 14, 2026, Commercial Director Hanadi Setiarto highlighted KAEF's end-to-end ecosystem to bolster national health resilience and TB program targets. Indonesia remains among the world's TB burdens, second to India, with an estimated 1.09 million TB cases and about 125,000 TB deaths annually, per Global TB Report 2024 and 2025 Kemenkes data; 2024 saw 885,000 TB cases detected/reported. KAEF's TB portfolio covers drug-susceptible and drug-resistant therapies, including Fixed Dose Combination products for adults and children, and the production of the antibiotic Moxifloxacin since 2025. Upstream capacity is anchored by modern plants in Jakarta and Banjaran, exceeding 500 million tablets per year, to secure supply and enable more effective regimens.

triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症である結核に対する企業の医薬品供給・サービス体制強化に関する通常業務の記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو الديمقراطية قد تفوق الأرقام الرسمية بأربعة أضعاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could exceed official figures by fourfold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is likely undercounted by a factor of two to four, per WHO Emergency Programme Director Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu. The outbreak’s true size is estimated to be at least double to quadruple the detected cases, based on modeling. Official counts: 1,963 confirmed Ebola cases and 719 deaths in the DRC as of July 12; nationwide figures later cited as 1,926 cases and 702 deaths by late Sunday. The virus spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or animal; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. The outbreak has expanded across several provinces. In response, the U.S. imposed travel restrictions: Americans in the DRC or who recently left may not board commercial flights to the United States and must spend at least 21 days in a third country, amid concerns about imported/exported cases; about 24 Americans were scheduled to depart.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数、公式発表の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州に拡大し、死亡者数も多く、米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的な対応が発生しているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域として記載されているが、記事は米国からの渡航制限措置について言及しているのみで、実際の感染発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Covid deaths put states on alert; experts say no need for panic
article.articleSummary: Two Covid-19 deaths and eight active cases reported in Andhra Pradesh, prompting high-alert surveillance in neighboring Odisha and Tamil Nadu ahead of Rath Yatra. The first case, a 52-year-old man from Tirupati, died June 28 after transfer between hospitals; post-mortem RT-PCR confirmed Covid-19 with Klebsiella pneumoniae co-infection and comorbid diabetes and chronic kidney disease. The second death, a 46-year-old Kadapa patient, occurred July 7 with bilateral lung damage and pneumonia. Authorities report 40 people tested recently, all negative; hospitals instructed to maintain isolation wards and ICUs. Variants under watch include XFG and BA.3.2; globally about 45,000 cases in the last three months with a 1.2% test positivity rate. Experts say immunity from vaccination and prior infections reduces risk; no aggressive variant identified in four years. Tamil Nadu and Odisha have stepped up SARI/ILI testing and pre-surgery Covid checks as precaution.”}{

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でのコロナ死亡例、周辺州を警戒態勢に―専門家はパニックの必要なしと指摘

article.articleHeadline: Majority of new Ebola cases are 'from unknown chains of transmission,' WHO official says
article.articleSummary: As of July 13, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo continues to outpace response. In Bunia, Ituri province, Bundibugyo Ebola has infected 1,926 and killed 702 across three Congolese provinces, with cases also confirmed in Uganda. WHO emergencies chief Chikwe Ihekweazu said many deaths occur at home before care, and 80% of new cases are outside contact lists from unknown transmission chains. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. Bunia’s capacity has risen to about 800 treatment beds and labs from 1 to 14, but progress is hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, ongoing conflict, and community mistrust. Dozens at a northeast Congo Ebola treatment center struck over salaries. May 15 authorities declared a fresh outbreak after weeks of undetected transmission. Clinical trials for treatments began last week; a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive per CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 新規エボラ症例の大半は「未知の感染経路」によるものとWHO当局者が発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大しており、感染経路不明の症例が80%を占め、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されている。承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として重大。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国人職員の感染確認や資金不足、医療施設への攻撃など、対応の困難さを示す情報も含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Americana tem 1a morte por febre maculosa no ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Americana records its first death from Rocky Mountain spotted fever this year.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) in Americana, São Paulo, Brazil, has caused the year’s first death. The Secretaria de Saúde de Americana, via Vigilância Epidemiológica, confirms a 37-year-old man who died on June 30 after hospitalization in a public hospital. Diagnosis was confirmed by the Instituto Adolfo Lutz. The probable infection site is under investigation by the Programa de Vigilância e Controle do Escorpião e Carrapato (PVCE). Up to the latest update, Americana reports 22 RMSF notifications: 16 ruled out, five awaiting results, and one death confirmed on July 14; no other suspected deaths. Health authorities advise avoiding risk areas near rivers, streams, lagoons, and the Salto Grande Reservoir. If entry is necessary, wear light clothing, tuck pant legs into socks, wear high boots, check the body every three hours, and monitor for symptoms. PVCE has monitored risk zones since 2006 with warnings about the star tick.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカーナ市で今年最初のロッキー山紅斑熱による死亡例
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州アメリカーナ市における紅斑熱（ダニ媒介性）は既知の風土病であり、2006年から監視プログラムが継続中。今年最初の死亡例1件のみで、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ダニ媒介性の紅斑熱（RMSF）はヒト-ヒト感染せず、地域の既存監視プログラム（PVCE）で対応中。22件の届出中1件死亡、16件除外、5件結果待ちという状況は局地的なサーベイランスの範囲内であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: El número de casos de ébola podría ser "de dos a cuatro" veces superior, según la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases could be two to four times higher, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times higher than official counts, WHO said on July 14, 2026. The outbreak has officially infected more than 1,960 people and caused over 700 deaths since it began in mid-May. Detected in Ituri province near borders with South Sudan and Uganda, the virus has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele, with Uganda reporting 20 cases. WHO notes this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest-growing in a single month among responses managed. About 80% of contacts are being traced. WHO and local partners stress earlier detection, intensified contact tracing, and ensuring health centers are accessible, safe, and trusted to reach affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数は「2~4倍」に上る可能性、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告があるが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。感染者数・死者数の実数把握が公式値の2~4倍とされており、過小報告の懸念が強い。

Health teams then organized fever camps at four sites—Nagla Bamma, Gotaiya, Dwarkapuri, and Nagla Machi—testing and treating patients. article.articleHeadline: Health experts downplay panic as AP tracks suspected Covid cases, states step up vigil
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains endemic in India, with suspected new cases under watch in Andhra Pradesh as of July 14, 2026, while Tamil Nadu and Odisha boost surveillance. Health experts urge the public not to panic, noting most infections remain mild. Monsoon season typically sees more viral illnesses, and occasional case upticks may occur due to viral changes, waning immunity, and increased social contact. The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare is closely monitoring the situation, emphasizing there is no need for alarm. Medical professionals advise standard precautions: hand hygiene, proper ventilation, avoiding close contact when unwell, and staying home with symptoms. High-risk groups, older adults, pregnant women, and those with chronic illnesses, should be especially cautious and adhere to Covid-appropriate behaviour at large gatherings. Learn to live with Covid, but protect vulnerable populations.

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: Anvisa determina atualização das vacinas para acompanhar variantes em circulação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Anvisa mandates updating vaccines to keep up with circulating variants.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa orders updating Brazil's COVID-19 vaccines to monovalent formulations containing the LP.8.1 strain as the preferred antigen, or JN.1-derived antigens such as XFG or NB.1.8.1, or other formulations with broad neutralizing antibody responses and efficacy against circulating SARS-CoV-2 variants. The Normative Instruction No. 454/2026, published in the Official Gazette after approval at the 12th Public Ordinary Board meeting, mandates vaccines used in Brazil to align with circulating strains. Dozens of flu-like illnesses attributed to COVID-19 have been reported, underscoring the need for updated vaccination strategies. Transition: previously manufactured and distributed vaccines may be used for up to nine months from approval date, unless the agency opposes. Manufacturers with non-conforming compositions must file an update protocol detailing quality, production, immunogenicity in animal models, and safety/efficacy per WHO criteria. IN 454/2026 repeals IN 429 and takes effect on publication date.

triage.triage_reason: 規制当局によるワクチン組成更新の行政措置であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や重大な影響を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: GHMC reports sharp decline in dengue cases in Hyderabad
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad’s Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) reported 266 dengue cases from January through July 13, 2026, with 127 laboratory-confirmed. This totals far below the same period in 2025 (570 cases) and 2024 (821). In full-year terms, 2025 recorded 1,983 dengue cases, while 2024 had 2,806. GHMC attributes the decline to strengthened surveillance, vector-control measures, and coordinated efforts with health agencies. The city is conducting ongoing dengue surveillance and collaborating with District Malaria Officers (DMOs) under District Medical and Health Officers (DMHOs), as well as National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) teams. As of July 13, 2026, the trend indicates effective monitoring and control of dengue transmission through multi-agency efforts. The report underscores improved public health measures rather than an isolated outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Covid tests must for SARI patients in Ganjam hospitals; 5% ILI samples to be screened | Bhubaneswar News
article.articleSummary: Ganjam district in Odisha directs mandatory Covid-19 testing for all patients presenting SARI in government hospitals and random 5% screening of ILI cases, following reports of two suspected Covid-19 deaths in Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa district last week. There is daily cross-border movement with AP; CDM&PHO Bhabani Shankar Mishra emphasizes high alert and daily monitoring, with hospitals to report SARI/ILI testing figures, infrastructure readiness, and logistics to the district public health unit. Assess isolation wards and oxygen-supplied beds; ensure medical supplies including ORS, paracetamol, zinc, and vitamins. Frontline workers (Asha and anganwadi) are to watch for fever or respiratory clusters and educate the public on hygiene and early care. No Covid-19 case has been reported in Ganjam at present, Mishra said, but lapses in surveillance or stock management will be treated seriously.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda calls for sustained international support in Ebola response
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-14, Uganda urged sustained international collaboration to support its neighbor, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), in an ongoing Ebola outbreak. At an Ebola Accountability Forum in Kampala co-hosted by the Ugandan government and the World Health Organization, Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi thanked partners for helping bring Uganda's Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, under control, while stressing the need for continued aid to prevent cross-border transmission. Uganda has deployed health personnel and equipment to eastern DRC to bolster its response. Permanent Secretary Diana Atwine commended countries that refrained from travel restrictions during the outbreak. Official data indicate Uganda has 20 confirmed Ebola cases in the current outbreak, of which 15 are imported from the DRC; 17 have recovered, 1 is hospitalized, and 2 have died.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対応における継続的な国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当し、コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ感染がウガンダへ越境した実例があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダとDRCの越境エボラ流行に関するもの。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源であり継続的な流行が発生しているDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダ国内の症例（20例、うち15例がDRCからの輸入例）は制御下にあるが、DRCでの流行継続によりリスクは残存。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU bloquea la vuelta de sus ciudadanos desde RDC por el ébola, a...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. blocks the return of its citizens from the DRC due to Ebola, to....
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded from the eastern to central areas near Kinshasa. The DRC's INSP reports 1,926 cases and 702 deaths. In response, the United States restricts travel for citizens who have recently been in the DRC, allowing return to the U.S. only after at least 21 days in a third country. The measure, an update signed by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, targets new risk patterns flagged by the outbreak. The State Department will assist affected Americans during the 21-day waiting period and provide consular support; the CDC will offer medical evaluations in RDC and elsewhere. Germany has evacuated a second Ebola-infected American to Frankfurt for treatment, following a prior evacuation two months earlier. Washington emphasizes coordination with humanitarian partners and ongoing travel warnings for the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱を理由にコンゴ民主共和国からの自国民帰国を制限、第三国で21日間経過後のみ許可
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が首都キンシャサ近郊まで拡大し（1,926症例、702死亡）、米国が渡航制限を課し独への患者搬送も発生するなど国際的な波及とIHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは対応国であり感染発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率約36%と高く、都市部（キンシャサ）への拡大は公衆衛生上重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠估最快本周進入流行期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is estimated to enter the epidemic phase as early as this week.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising domestic COVID-19 activity: last week 2,811 COVID-related ED/urgent-care visits, up 34.4% from the prior week, with five consecutive weeks of increase. Health officials warn the epidemic threshold could be crossed this week or next, and a peak may occur by mid-to-late August, based on typical lead times. Last week there were 17 new domestic severe cases and no local deaths; since October 2025, cumulative local severe cases total 136 with 18 deaths, mainly among those aged 65+ or with chronic conditions, of whom 94.9% were unvaccinated this season. Globally, positivity is rising; neighboring regions China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, and Singapore show increases, with NB.1.8.1 as the dominant variant, followed by JN.1 and XFG. As of July 12, Taiwan has administered about 1.732 million seasonal vaccine doses; first-dose rate for 65+ is 20.97%, second-dose 0.51%. Seasonal vaccination reduces emergency visits by ~48–50% and hospitalizations by ~53–55%. Public vaccination for ages 6 months+ runs through July 31; vaccine stock includes Moderna (450k) and Novavax (60k). Antivirals: Remdesivir (155k), BelaVi (113k), Xocova (180k); authorities will allocate as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ、今週にも流行期入りか
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性COVID-19の増加を報じる内容で、既知の変異株による典型的な季節的流行パターンであり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾におけるCOVID-19の季節的増加であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。中国・香港・日本・韓国・シンガポールは近隣地域の陽性率上昇として簡潔に言及されているのみで、記事の主たる対象ではないため verified_locations には含めない。変異株NB.1.8.1、JN.1、XFGは既知の株であり新規性はない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says DRC Ebola outbreak fastest-growing with most new cases from unknown transmission chains
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province is the fastest-growing on record; as of July 11, nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths across five provinces, making it the third-largest outbreak. The most alarming trend: single-day infections have hit record highs, with more than 80 cases in 24 hours. About 80% of new cases are outside contact lists, arising from unknown transmission chains; WHO modelling suggests true scale could be two to four times higher than reported. While up to 95% of new cases originate in Ituri, the virus has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. WHO outlines a dual strategy: intensify response in the epicenter and map travel routes to identify high-risk areas. There is no approved treatment yet for Bundibugyo species; early supportive care improves survival. The outbreak was declared two months ago.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は史上最速の拡大速度であり、新規感染の大半が未知の感染経路によるものと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが史上最速の拡大速度・大規模流行・未知の感染経路の多さを指摘しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOはイトゥリ州が震源地であり、ハウトウエレ州・ツォポ州にも拡大していると報告。約2000例・700人以上の死亡、単日80例超の新規感染を記録し、8割が接触者リスト外からの発生で感染経路不明。承認された治療法がなく、対応にはさらなる国際支援が必要とされる。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo supera los esfuerzos de respuesta de la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo outpaces the WHO's response efforts.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak continues to outpace response efforts. As of Monday, 1,926 infections and 702 deaths have been reported across three provinces, with cases also confirmed in Uganda. In Bunia, Ituri, WHO emergencies chief Chikwe Ihekweazu said many recent deaths occurred at home before care, and 80% of new cases are not in contact lists, indicating transmission from unknown chains. The outbreak involves a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus with no approved treatments or vaccines. Africa CDC says it is Africa's fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. Bunia's treatment capacity surged to about 800 beds and 14 laboratories. Challenges include funding gaps, attacks on health facilities, ongoing eastern Congo conflict, and community mistrust. A U.S. NGO worker tested positive; authorities declared a new outbreak on May 15, and trials for a treatment began last week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、WHOの対応能力を上回る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高いエボラ（Bundibugyoウイルス）が急拡大しウガンダにも越境、WHO・Africa CDCが史上最速の流行と認めており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染確認との報道だが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、資金不足・紛争・地域住民の不信感が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: GLP-1s and Blinding Condition; Cyclosporiasis Source Found? Tylenol-Autism Lawsuits
article.articleSummary: Michigan’s cyclosporiasis outbreak has surpassed 2,600 cases, with health officials identifying lettuce or salad greens as the likely source; Taco Bell is under investigation. The World Health Organization says Congo’s Ebola outbreak may exceed the officially reported tally, urging increased funding to curb spread; a second U.S. citizen with Ebola is hospitalized in Germany and in stable condition. The U.S. will bar Congo travelers from returning until they spend at least three weeks in a third country. In the U.S., 65 new measles cases were reported in the past week (locations not specified). A cohort study associates continuing GLP-1 receptor agonists for diabetes with a higher risk of anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, a potentially blinding condition. A federal appeals court revived hundreds of lawsuits claiming prenatal acetaminophen exposure (Tylenol) caused autism/ADHD in offspring.

triage.headline_ja: GLP-1薬と失明疾患；サイクロスポーラ症の感染源特定？；タイレノール-自閉症訴訟（コンゴのエボラ拡大、渡航制限も）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ出血熱の発生がWHO公式集計を上回る可能性があり、国際的な感染拡大（ドイツ・米国での症例）と渡航制限（米国によるコンゴ渡航者の入国制限）が確認されているため、IHR基準の複数該当がありフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は複数トピックの医療ニュースまとめであり、サイクロスポーラ症（ミシガン州）と麻疹（米国）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラに関するコンゴの動向がIHR/WPRO基準を満たすためPICKUP判定とした。ドイツ・米国の症例は輸入例であり発生国はDRCと判断。

article.articleHeadline: State reports 16,728 malaria cases in 6 months, June sees surge
article.articleSummary: Malaria registered 16,728 cases in the first six months of 2026, with June at 4,386. Jan–May accounted for 12,342 cases, and the June spike pushes the total beyond 16,000. West Singhbhum and East Singhbhum together accounted for about 12,744 cases (roughly 76%). Godda, Khunti and Seraikela-Kharsawan also contributed. Dengue remained comparatively low with 77 cases Jan–June, including 32 in June; Ranchi led with 27. Sporadic dengue appeared in Hazaribag (9), Sahibganj (6), Ramgarh and West Singhbhum (5 each), and others. In Ranchi, Sadar Hospital has no malaria admissions; Rims treats 15 malaria patients, with officials saying malaria is under control. Two dengue patients were detected at Rims’ medicine OPD; both asymptomatic with normal platelets; one dengue patient was discharged. Dengue hospitalization is rare unless platelets fall or severe symptoms occur.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州、過去6か月でマラリア1万6728件を報告、6月に急増
triage.triage_reason: ジャールカンド州における季節性のマラリア・デング流行の定例報告であり、当局は「制御下にある」としている。重症例や異常な拡大の兆候はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: マラリア・デングともに毎年季節的に報告される流行状況であり、当局が管理下にあると明言している。特段の異常性や重症化傾向は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Surto na RDC Alarga Área de Contágio e Soma Quase 2 Mil Casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Outbreak in the DRC Expands the Transmission Area and Brings the Total to Nearly 2,000 Cases
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces in the northeast, raising confirmed cases to 1,926 and deaths to 702. This is the 17th DRC outbreak, declared May 15, and while predominantly centered in Ituri, cases have been reported in North Kivu and South Kivu. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; common symptoms include high fever, vomiting and bleeding. Reuters reported late June that authorities began tracing potentially exposed people in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, though they were not yet in daily government reports. The National Institute of Public Health says all detected cases there have been imported from Niania in Ituri, but these provinces should be considered an epidemic zone. Kisangani is the Tshopo capital; Haut-Uele borders South Sudan and Central African Republic. WHO notes the true outbreak size may be 2-4 times official figures due to many unlinked cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国での流行が感染地域を拡大、症例数はほぼ2000人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが新たな州（Haut-Uele、Tshopo）に拡大し、死者700人超・症例約1900件に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 記事中のCentral African RepublicやSudanは国境接壌の言及のみで、実際の発生地域はDRC国内（Ituri、North/South Kivu、Haut-Uele、Tshopo各州）に限定される。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、越境拡大リスクにも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'épidémie sous-estimée de 2 à 4 fois, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak is underestimated by 2 to 4 times, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the third-largest and expanding rapidly. Declared in May in Ituri near the South Sudan and Uganda border, the epidemic has officially killed over 700 people and infected about 2,000. WHO estimates the true scale is two to four times the reported number as case detection improves. The outbreak has spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, with 20 cases reported in Uganda. More than 90% of cases remain in Ituri. Despite progress, transmission outpaces response, with many new infections among people who die at home before reaching care. Key measures: earlier case detection, intensified contact tracing, and making health facilities accessible, safe, and trusted. Laboratory capacity has grown from 1 to 14, and about 700 beds are available for treatment; contact tracing approaches 80% follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOによると流行は2〜4倍過小評価されている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ流行は死者700人超・感染者約2000人規模で、ウガンダにも拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダで20例確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。南スーダン国境付近との言及もあるが対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-RDC : L'épidémie serait 4 fois plus grave que les chiffres officiels, alerte l'OMS - Cameroun24.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-DRC: The outbreak would be four times more severe than the official figures, WHO warns - Cameroun24.net.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times larger than official tallies. As of now, the DRC reports 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths (case fatality rate 36.6%), but 80% of new infections occur outside known contact lists, indicating hidden transmission chains where patients often die at home without care. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo—and has crossed into Uganda. On July 2, Congolese authorities, with WHO support, launched clinical trials of the first etiotropic antivirals against the Bundibugyo strain; simultaneously, the University of Oxford began testing its ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine with 50 volunteers. International responses include evacuations of infected health workers to Germany and Berlin, and the African Union Health Service labeling the outbreak the fourth most severe since 1976. Containing the “invisible” cases is critical to preventing a catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・DRC：流行は公式統計の4倍深刻な可能性、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行が公式報告の2〜4倍規模である可能性をWHOが警告し、致死率36.6%、隠れた感染連鎖、ウガンダへの越境、国際的な医療従事者搬送など国際的拡大と深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認されるため。
