triage.notes: ウガンダやドイツへの拡大・搬送が報じられているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: "الأمر أشبه بحريق" - تفشي الإيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية هو الأسرع انتشارا على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "It's like a fire" - The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-spreading outbreak ever.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, and the third-largest in history. As of July 11, 2026, WHO reports about 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths across five provinces, with most new infections in Ituri, where Bunia is the epicenter. The virus has spread beyond the initial epicenter to Haut-Uélé and Chobo. About 80 new confirmed cases were recorded in 24 hours, and some 80% of new cases are not linked to known chains of transmission, indicating multiple undetected transmission pathways. Early detection and sustained international support are critical. There is no approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet; some therapies are in clinical trials, and survival rises with prompt supportive care. Response hinges on containment in Ituri while mapping movement and building community trust to protect health workers.

triage.headline_ja: 「まるで火事のようだ」―コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は史上最速の拡大速度
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速のペースで拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が8割に上るなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola（Cuanza Norte Province等）が含まれるが、記事本文はDRCのイトゥリ州を中心とした流行のみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生は確認されないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Afryka. Epidemia eboli w Kongu. Dyrektor z WHO: Co najmniej dwa razy więcej
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa. Ebola epidemic in Congo. WHO director: At least twice as many.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with an Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain. As of 14 July 2026, official data show nearly 2,000 cases and more than 700 deaths since the first case was detected two months earlier, though WHO emergency director Chikwe Ihekweazu says true numbers are 2–4 times higher. Bundibugyo has no patented effective vaccine. Officials describe it as the third-largest Ebola epidemic in history and note the fastest growth in cases observed in a single month among all waves. Cases have occurred in five Congo provinces and in neighboring Uganda. In the latest period, more than 80 laboratory-confirmed cases were reported in a single day. A troubling share involve people who died in their communities before reaching care. Despite the surge, treatment capacity exceeds 700 beds and is expanding weekly. Transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, or excreta; infectivity begins with symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ。コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行。WHO責任者:実際の感染者数は少なくとも2倍以上
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が発生し、死者700人超・史上第3位の規模、ウガンダへの越境も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。有効なワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョ株であること、致死率の高さ、コミュニティ内死亡の多さなど重症度・拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : les soignants du centre de traitement d'Ebola de Rwampara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the health workers at the Ebola treatment center in Rwampara.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Ituri is jeopardized as health workers at the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) at Bunia’s General Referral Hospital strike as of July 13, 2026, abandoning patients on beds. Frustrated over unpaid salaries and bonuses promised by the public health minister during a regional visit, workers set tires ablaze at the facility's main entrance after failed negotiations. Arrears have accumulated since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, 2026. In addition to salary delays, strikers allege dangerous working conditions and insufficient protective equipment, and demand full payment before resuming duties. The unrest is spreading to other Ebola treatment centers across Ituri, posing dual risks: cessation of care and surveillance for hospitalized patients, and higher chances of contact-case escapes and uncontrolled transmission of Ebola within communities. Coordinators did not respond to interview requests.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:ルワンパラのエボラ治療センターの医療従事者たち
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターの医療従事者によるストライキで患者管理・感染制御体制が崩壊しつつあり、感染拡大リスクが高まっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 医療従事者のストライキにより患者の放置、接触者の逃亡、コミュニティ内での制御不能な感染拡大のリスクが指摘されている。給与未払い問題が解決しない限り、エボラ対応体制の崩壊が続く恐れがあり、続報の確認と国際支援の必要性の評価が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Dubai sends more than 72 tonnes of aid to Uganda to help with Ebola response | The National
article.articleSummary: Dubai's emergency response centre dispatched 72.5 tonnes of relief to Uganda to support the Ebola response tied to the Bundibugyo strain, with aid destined for communities across the border in DR Congo affected by the outbreak. The shipment represents the fourth batch in this operation and follows four airlifts, aimed at sustaining the regional response. Provided supplies include water purification tablets, protective gear, mobile storage units, generators to power treatment sites, and tarpaulins for shelter for patients and medical teams. UAE authorities highlight steady leadership in delivering relief as outbreaks cross borders. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak was announced on May 15 and had allegedly gone undetected for weeks, complicating containment efforts across Uganda and DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ドバイ、ウガンダのエボラ対応支援のため72トン超の援助物資を輸送
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダからDRCへ越境拡大しており、国際的な援助が行われている継続中の重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 主な発生地であるウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事はDRCへの越境影響とUAEによる国際支援に言及しており、既に5月15日から続く既知のアウトブレイクである点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Innovation, technology drive UP's TB elimination journey: Health official
article.articleSummary: Technical Conclave on TB Elimination in Uttar Pradesh, at AIIMS Gorakhpur (July 14, 2026), reviewed progress and charted next steps for TB elimination. Over 60 participants including Padma Shri Dr. Rajendra Prasad and Dr. Surya Kant Tripathi attended; four breakouts covered diagnostics, treatment, private sector engagement and community mobilisation, with recommendations presented at closing. Leaders emphasized innovation, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and surveillance, aiming for population-level risk-based screening beyond symptoms. Under the 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, UP screened over 3.1 million people, detected 185,000 new TB cases and identified about 52,000 asymptomatic cases; high-risk village coverage reached 94% (25,073 of 26,722). 308 AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines conducted 3.04 million chest X-rays (111% of target). 1,414 NAAT sites tested 752,000 of 819,000 enrolled (92%). Jan–Jun 2026 TB notifications reached 337,000 of a 700,000 annual target (48% of yearly, 96% of pro-rata). UP leads national TB elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 革新と技術がウッタル・プラデーシュ州の結核撲滅の歩みを推進：保健当局者
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 国家的なTB撲滅キャンペーン（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan）の成果報告記事であり、既知の疾患に対する既存プログラムの進捗内容のためシグナルとして扱う必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Seeks More Funding As DRC Ebola Outbreak Worsens
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-14, the WHO reports funding for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is only about 40% of the $115 million appeal, with donors yet to provide the majority of required resources. The outbreak has caused 1,926 reported infections and 702 deaths since it began, and there is no proven treatment or vaccine. Ituri Province is the worst-affected area, and authorities say the virus has spread to two additional provinces, intensifying the response challenges. WHO's Health Emergencies Programme head Dr Chikwe Ihekweazu urged international donors not to abandon the country, stressing the need for intensified detection, isolation, and case management. He warned the official counts likely underestimate the true scale, possibly more than double to four times higher.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行悪化を受けさらなる資金拠出を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が拡大し死者702名・感染1926例に達し、追加2州への拡大と治療法・ワクチン不在という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Ituri州はDRC国内の地域であり、対象国リストの国レベルのIDはDRC(203312)のみ該当。WHOは実際の感染者数は報告数の2〜4倍に達する可能性があると警告しており、過小報告の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО предупреждава: Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго може да е четири пъти по-мащабна
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be four times larger.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be four times larger than official counts. Official data show more than 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths since the outbreak began about two months ago. WHO Emergencies Director Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu stated models indicate the outbreak’s scale is 2–4 times the detected cases. The incident is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history, with the fastest month‑over‑month growth observed to date. It is centered in Ituri Province in the northeast, where over 90% of cases are registered, with cases also reported in five provinces and in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Many new cases involve individuals who died in communities without seeking medical care. Response capacity is increasing: more than 700 treatment beds, expanded laboratory capacity, and near 80% contact-tracing effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は公式統計の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、史上3番目の規模、ウガンダにも波及、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyoウイルスによる流行であり、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Броят на заразените с ебола в ДР Конго е поне два пъти по-голям от официалния
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The number of people infected with Ebola in DR Congo is at least twice as high as the official figure.
article.articleSummary: WHO says Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo are at least 2-4 times higher than the official count of 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, executive director of WHO's Emergency Programme, told reporters in Geneva after a visit to eastern DRC that, based on WHO data and models, the outbreak’s scale could be 2-4 times higher than reported. The government figure stands at 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. WHO urged donors not to abandon the country during this critical phase, noting that funding received so far is less than half of what is needed to combat the Ebola outbreak in the eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数は公式発表の少なくとも2倍に上る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHOが公式統計（感染者1,926人、死者702人）の2〜4倍の実際の規模を示唆し、資金不足による対応の逼迫も指摘されている。
triage.notes: ジュネーブ・スイスはWHO本部所在地としての言及であり、発生地域には該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 北部30多歲男在泰染疫　台現今年首例境外移入茲卡病毒確診 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man in his 30s in northern Taiwan infected in Thailand; Taiwan confirms this year's first imported Zika virus case.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's CDC on July 14, 2026, reported the year's first imported Zika virus infection: a man in his 30s from northern Taiwan who returned from Thailand in mid-June, developed fever, dizziness and headache, then a rash; lab confirmation followed. Contacts and cohabitants are asymptomatic; authorities conducted environmental vector cleanup, contact tracing, and health education for the case and contacts. As of July 13, 2026, Taiwan has one imported Zika case this year. Since 2016, Taiwan has diagnosed 31 Zika infections, all imported, predominantly from Southeast Asia (Thailand 8, Vietnam 6, Philippines 3, Myanmar 3, Malaysia 3, Maldives 2; Indonesia, Singapore, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saint Lucia, the United States—Florida—and Angola each 1). Globally, Zika has affected at least 97 countries since 2016, with about 80% asymptomatic. Transmission occurs via mosquitoes, sex, and vertical routes; pregnancy risk includes fetal microcephaly. Public guidance emphasizes mosquito prevention, safe sex for 3 months after male exposure or 2 months after female exposure, blood donation deferral, and seeking care if symptoms occur after travel.

triage.headline_ja: 北部の30代男性がタイで感染、台湾で今年初の海外由来ジカウイルス感染症例確認
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入例（渡航後感染）であり、対象国内での発生ではなく、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾国内での輸入症例（タイ渡航歴あり）に関する定例報告であり、対象国（タイ等）における実際のアウトブレイク発生を示すものではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU bloquea la vuelta de sus ciudadanos desde RDC por el ébola, a menos que pasen 21 días en un tercer país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. blocks the return of its citizens from the DRC due to Ebola, unless they spend 21 days in a third country.
article.articleSummary: U.S. authorities will block the return of Americans from the Democratic Republic of Congo on commercial flights unless they have spent at least 21 days in a third country, in response to an Ebola outbreak that began in mid-May and has expanded from the eastern border into central areas within hours of Kinshasa. A White House spokesperson said Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy signed an update to an existing order reflecting new risk patterns; the rule targets anyone who has been in RDC. Roughly two dozen Americans planning to depart today would be affected. The State Department will assist travelers during the 21-day waiting period; consular help will support those isolating in a third country, and the CDC will provide medical evaluations in RDC and elsewhere. Germany has evacuated a second Ebola-infected American to Frankfurt; the RDC INSP reports 1,926 cases, 702 deaths, 318 recoveries, 753 hospitalizations, with 78.3% contact follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱によりコンゴ民主共和国からの自国民帰国を制限、第三国での21日間滞在を義務化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行がキンシャサ近郊まで拡大し、死亡者702名・症例1,926件に達している。米国が渡航制限を課し、ドイツへの感染者空輸事例も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な国際的シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での流行拡大と、それに伴う米国・ドイツの対応（渡航制限、感染者空輸）を報じている。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率が高く（702/1926）、首都近郊への拡大は極めて深刻な状況を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: 7月广东省健康风险提示：重点关注登革热、基孔肯雅热、流行性感冒、新型冠状病毒感染等传染性疾病__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: July Guangdong Province Health Risk Alert: Pay Particular Attention to Dengue Fever, Chikungunya Fever, Influenza, Novel Coronavirus Infections, and Other Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province, China, summarized June 2026 statutory infectious disease activity: total 429,628 cases with 129 deaths; Class A infections none. Class B accounted for 64,546 cases and 128 deaths, led by COVID-19, hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis and gonorrhea (94.66% of Class B). June saw 26,117 new COVID-19 cases, up from 2,979 in May. Class C reported 365,082 cases and 1 death, dominated by influenza (274,328 cases) and hand-foot-mouth disease; other infectious diarrheal diseases comprised the rest; black fever, hydatid disease, and filariasis reported no cases. For July, Guangdong CDC issued a health risk alert focusing on dengue, chikungunya, influenza, COVID-19, hand-foot-mouth disease and herpangina, malaria, monkeypox and Ebola virus disease. Recommendations emphasize indoor ventilation and disinfection in high-traffic settings, routine fever checks, early medical care for vulnerable groups, masking when symptomatic, and rapid reporting of influenza-like illness spikes.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年7月広東省健康リスク注意喚起：デング熱、チクングニア熱、インフルエンザ、新型コロナウイルス感染症等の感染症に注意
triage.triage_reason: 広東省CDCによる月次法定感染症統計と7月の定例健康注意喚起であり、COVID-19症例の増加はあるものの異常な流行や新規事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: COVID-19症例数が5月から6月にかけて増加（2,979件→26,117件）している点は今後の推移を注視する価値があるが、本記事自体は定例の月次サーベイランス報告と季節性注意喚起であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: شمار قربانیان ایبولا در کانگو به بیش از ۷۰۰ نفر رسید
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in Congo has risen to over 700.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 702, with 1,926 confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has now spread to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and newly affected Haut-Uele and Tshupo. The government notes hundreds of deaths in eastern Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The University of Oxford announced on July 13 the first human trial of a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, as efforts are accelerated to combat outbreaks in DRC and neighboring Uganda. The U.S. CDC said a case of Ebola was confirmed in a U.S. citizen who worked for a humanitarian organization in Congo on July 10. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus raised the internal risk level in DRC from high to higher. In the United States, entry restrictions target travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; flights from these countries must land only at Washington Dulles and Atlanta for 21 days post-exposure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が5州に拡大し死者700人超、米国への輸入症例も確認され渡航制限が発動されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国内での輸入症例確認、WHOによるリスクレベル引き上げ、ワクチン臨床試験開始など、事態は急速に進展しており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo health workers on Ebola front line threaten strike
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has killed more than 700 of nearly 2,000 confirmed infections. WHO cautions the true scale may be two to four times the official count. The epicentre is Ituri in the northeast, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele; Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths at the border. Some 112 health workers have been infected and 35 have died. Front-line staff have not been paid since detection, prompting a 48-hour ultimatum and a threat of a full-scale strike; at the Rwampara treatment centre, workers burned tyres and blocked access. The Bundibugyo strain spreads by direct contact with bodily fluids; there is no vaccine or specific treatment. As of July 12, 727 patients are being treated, with a two-treatment clinical trial underway. International donors have raised about $1.5 billion for the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ最前線の医療従事者がストライキを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たす大規模エボラ流行（死者700人超、感染者約2000人）であり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大や医療従事者のストライキによる対応能力低下という懸念が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきである。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの発症例（20例、死亡2例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。医療従事者への未払い賃金と待遇問題が対応の継続性を脅かしており、これが公衆衛生対応能力（manageability）へのリスクとなっている。

article.articleHeadline: 北部30多歲男在泰染疫　台現今年首例境外移入茲卡病毒確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man in his 30s from northern Taiwan infected in Thailand; Taiwan reports this year's first imported Zika virus case.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its imported Zika virus infection in 2026: a man in his 30s from northern Taiwan who returned from Thailand in June. He developed fever, dizziness and headache, and a rash by late June; laboratory testing confirmed Zika virus infection. Contacts are asymptomatic; authorities conducted vector control at the case’s locations and provided health education. Since 2016, Taiwan has diagnosed 31 Zika cases, all imported, mainly from Southeast Asia (Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Myanmar, Malaysia). Globally, Zika has affected at least 97 countries; about 80% of infections are asymptomatic. Pregnant women are at risk for fetal abnormalities. Prevention emphasizes mosquito protection and safe sex: men returning from affected areas should use condoms or abstain for 3 months; women for 2 months. Vector control for 3 weeks; defer blood donation for 1 month. Seek care within 2 weeks of return if unwell and report travel history. CDC Taiwan website or 1922/0800-001922.

triage.headline_ja: 北部30代男性がタイで感染、台湾で今年初の輸入性ジカウイルス感染確定例
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入例であり、症状は軽度、接触者も無症状で、過去10年間に31例の輸入例が継続的に報告されている定型的な事例であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 感染はタイでの滞在中に発生したとされるが、記事の主題は台湾における輸入症例の確定・対応報告であり、タイ国内でのアウトブレイクや異常事象を示す記述はないため、対象国リストには該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO varuje, že epidémia eboly v KDR môže byť až štyrikrát väčšia, než ukazujú údaje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola epidemic in the DRC could be up to four times larger than the data show.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times larger than official data. Since the outbreak began about two months ago, Congolese authorities report over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths, but WHO models suggest many cases remain undetected. It is the third-largest Ebola epidemic in history and the fastest-spreading since records began. More than 90% of cases are in the northeastern Ituri Province where armed groups operate; the outbreak has also appeared in four other provinces and in neighboring Uganda. A worrying trend is many patients dying at home without access to care. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO notes expanding treatment and testing capacity and improving contact tracing, but containment remains challenging.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が公式データの最大4倍の規模である可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大＝ウガンダへの波及）に加え、WPRO基準も全項目該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。武装勢力が活動するイトゥリ州が中心で、封じ込めが困難な状況。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も重大リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Les cas d'Ebola proviennent de "chaînes de transmission inconnues", dit l'OMS | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases come from "unknown transmission chains", says WHO | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces a persistent Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved treatment or vaccine. As of July 13, 2026, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died across three provinces. Alarmingly, 80% of new cases are not on contact lists, indicating transmission chains remain unknown and heavily centered in communities lacking access to care. Cases have been confirmed in neighboring Uganda, underscoring cross-border spread. Response efforts are hampered by funding shortfalls, attacks on health centers, ongoing eastern conflict, and community mistrust. Bunia’s treatment capacity nears 800 beds, and laboratories have expanded from one to fourteen. A new Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15, with clinical trials for a treatment starting the previous week. The CDC also reported a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in DRC tested positive.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例は「未知の感染連鎖」から発生している、とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が継続し、死者702人、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占め、ウガンダへの越境例や米国市民の感染も確認されるなど国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよび米国での症例確認は記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。資金不足・武力紛争・コミュニティの不信感が対応を困難にしている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 广东6月报告新冠感染超2.6万例、流感超27万例_南方网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong reports over 26,000 COVID-19 infections and over 270,000 influenza cases in June
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province reported June 2026 notifiable disease data: COVID-19 infections 26,117 with 0 deaths; influenza 274,328 cases with 1 death; and hand, foot and mouth disease 70,016 with no deaths. Total statutory infectious diseases reached 429,628 cases and 129 deaths. Category A diseases were zero. Category B recorded 64,546 cases and 128 deaths, led by COVID-19, hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis, and gonorrhea, which together accounted for 94.66% of B-type cases. Category C registered 365,082 cases and 1 death, led by influenza, HFMD, and other infectious diarrhea, making up 99.75% of C-type cases. Prevention notes emphasize protecting elderly and chronic patients, hygienic measures, and prompt reporting. Influenza activity is rising in Guangdong during the summer, with the B Victoria lineage noted; HFMD mainly affects children under 5, peaking May–July. EV71 vaccine for ages 6 months–5 years is recommended to reduce severe HFMD.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省が6月の新型コロナ感染2.6万例超、インフルエンザ27万例超を報告
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な法定感染症統計報告であり、既知の季節性疾患（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、手足口病等）の通常範囲内の推移を示すのみで、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 定例の月次法定感染症サーベイランスレポートであり、季節性インフルエンザとHFMDの通常の季節的増加を報告。死亡率も低く、公衆衛生上の緊急性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha Health Minister Urges Public to Stay Alert and Avoid Rumours on COVID-19
article.articleSummary: Odisha, India, on 2026-07-14, addresses rumors of a potential COVID-19 situation with a calm but vigilant stance. Health Minister Dr Mukesh Mahaling urged the public to stay alert without fear, stressing there is no current cause for worry. During a Lok Seva Bhawan high-level meeting, he said the state government is in continuous coordination with the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and is fully prepared to handle any scenario. Citizens were asked not to be disturbed by rumours, to follow essential health safety protocols, and to rely only on official sources for information. The meeting was attended by Health Secretary Ashwati S., National Health Mission Director Brinda D., and other senior Health Department officials, highlighting ongoing preparedness to safeguard health services and public confidence.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州保健相、COVID-19に関して住民に警戒と流言への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告がなく、噂への対応と平時の準備態勢を強調する内容であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染者数やアウトブレイクの詳細を含まず、噂の沈静化と平時の準備態勢に関する行政広報の色合いが強い。COVID-19自体は既知の疾患であり新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo có thể lớn gấp 4 lần số liệu ghi nhận
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be four times higher than recorded figures.
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 – WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be 2–4 times higher than officially reported. Emergency chief Chikwe Ihekweazu said modelling suggests actual infections are at least 2–4× the detected cases. The spread is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Since first detected about two months ago, official counts exceed 1,960 cases and 700+ deaths. Ituri province accounts for over 90% of cases; outbreaks have reached five provinces and neighboring Uganda. Health workers in Goma conduct temperature checks as part of control measures. Many new infections are identified only after patients die in the community without seeking care. Treatment beds exceed 700 and are expanding weekly; laboratory testing has improved, and contact tracing nears 80%. Daily confirmed cases recently rose to the highest levels since the outbreak began, at times above 80 per day.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、公式記録の4倍規模の可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCのエボラ流行が公式報告の2〜4倍規模である可能性を警告しており、稀少株（ワクチン・治療薬未承認）による多州・越境（ウガンダ）拡大、致死率の高さからIHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、致死率・拡大リスクが高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola sigue cfreciendo a un ritmo más rápido que la respuesta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to spread at a faster pace than the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the third-largest on record, expanding at the fastest monthly rate to date. As of July 11, 2026, the DRC reported 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths across five provinces. WHO emergency chief Chikwe Ihekweazu warned that transmission is outpacing response, with about 80% of new cases outside known contact lists, indicating unknown transmission chains. A substantial share of deaths occurred in communities without access to health facilities, complicating control efforts. The response has strengthened since a month earlier: more than 700 beds for Ebola patients, 14 diagnostic laboratories (up from 1), and training of over 21,000 community health workers. Safer and dignified burials have improved. However, funding remains insufficient, with only 40% of the $115 million requested received.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、対応より速いペースで拡大し続ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が過去最大級の規模で急速に拡大しており、感染経路不明の症例が8割に上るなどIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが資金不足と対応の遅れを警告しており、既知の接触者リスト外での感染が8割を占めるため感染連鎖の把握が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من تجاوز تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية قدرات الاستجابة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed its response capacities - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: On July 11, 2026, the World Health Organization warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is outpacing response capacities. Despite progress in treatment, diagnostics, and contact tracing, the outbreak has reached 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola epidemic globally. A major concern is deaths occurring inside communities before seeking healthcare. WHO urged early case detection, intensified contact tracing, and to close a funding gap estimated at 70 million USD to support the response. The warning underscores ongoing transmission risk and the need for sustained international support to contain the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が対応能力を超えていると警告
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例1,926例・死亡702例に達し世界третиで最大級のエボラ流行となっており、WHOが対応能力の限界と資金不足を警告していることから、深刻性・国際拡大リスク・対応可能性の観点で複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが資金ギャップ7000万USDを指摘し国際支援を要請しており、フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": مصابو "إيبولا" ضعف الرقم المعلن في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola-infected are twice the number announced in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains severe. As of July 12, the country reported 1,963 confirmed Ebola cases and 719 deaths. The World Health Organization’s emergency chief, Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, said the true number of infections is at least 2 to 4 times higher than official counts, based on models and field support during a visit to eastern DRC. The response is reaching a critical phase as cases have spread to two new provinces this week. Funding remains inadequate: the UN agency has received roughly 40% of the $115 million it requested to curb the outbreak in Bundibugyo. WHO urged donors not to withdraw support, stressing the need to scale up case finding, isolation, and other containment measures to match the outbreak’s scale.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：コンゴのエボラ感染者数は公表された数の2倍
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の死者数・感染者数が深刻であり、WHOが実際の感染者数は公表数の2〜4倍と指摘、新たな州への拡大も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中のBundibugyoはウガンダの地名としても知られるが、本記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での流行状況であり、ウガンダでの発生は明記されていないため除外した。資金不足（要請額の約40%のみ確保）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: " C'est un incendie " : l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC progresse plus vite que la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "It's a fire": the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is progressing faster than the response.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain reaches 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of July 11, marking the third-largest on record. Five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—across 42 health zones are affected, with Ituri as the epicenter (about 26 zones, roughly ten in critical condition). New cases have emerged in Haut-Uele and Tshopo (Kisangani). Daily counts exceed 80 confirmed cases, while many die at home and 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, signaling extensive undetected transmission chains. WHO notes progress: 700+ hospital beds, 14 laboratories (versus one), ~80% of contacts followed, and 21,000+ community health workers trained. Trials for Bundibugyo treatments are under way; the EBO-PEP trial will test obeldesivir post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts. Funding gaps remain: $115 million needed, only 39% funded, about $70 million short.

triage.headline_ja: 「これは火事だ」：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は対応より速いペースで進行している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準も全項目該当し、資金不足・対応遅延という社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 確定症例1,926例、死亡702例（第3位規模のエボラ流行）。5州42保健地区に拡大中、新規症例の80%が既知の接触者と無関係で潜在的な伝播が続いている。資金は必要額の39%のみ確保され約7,000万ドル不足。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Outbreak: Launch of the EBO-PEP Trial to Protect High-Risk Contacts
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda spurs the EBO-PEP trial to test post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir. As of 9 July 2026, 1,759 infections and 600 deaths are reported (WHO PHEIC declared 17 May 2026; INSP figures). No approved treatment or vaccine exists. The first sub-protocol begins 14 July 2026 in Ituri, with recruitment at PEP centers beside ALIMA Ebola treatment centers in Bunia and Rwampara, aiming for about 1,000 participants. Eligible are adults or children over 12 with direct contact to a confirmed case within five days who are asymptomatic; daily monitoring for 21 days, final visit at 42 days. A second sub-protocol offers compassionate use of remdesivir for children under 12 and pregnant/breastfeeding women. ALIMA coordinates with INRB and ANRS MIE; GH EDCTP3 provides EUR 3.4 million, Africa CDC USD 1 million plus additional pledges to support the trial.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行:高リスク接触者を保護するためのEBO-PEP試験の開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで感染者1,759人・死者600人という深刻な流行であり、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）と治療法未確立という特性からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEICが宣言済みの既知の大規模流行。ウガンダにも拡大しているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は記事サマリー中で流行地域として言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من تصاعد تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of an escalation of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating beyond current response capacity, despite progress in treatment, diagnostics, and contact tracing. Confirmed cases have reached 1,926 and deaths 702 as of July 11, 2026, making this the third-largest Ebola outbreak in the world. The warning signals sustained transmission and mounting pressure on health systems in the DRC. The agency notes advances in therapeutics and testing, yet stresses that containment remains elusive and calls for intensified international support, enhanced surveillance, and broader public health measures to curb spread and protect affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが世界第3位規模のエボラ流行と警告し、感染者1,926人・死者702人に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスクともに該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが国際支援強化とサーベイランス強化を呼びかけており、現行対応能力を超える規模との警告あり。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Majority of new Ebola cases are 'from unknown chains of transmission,' WHO official says
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) continues to outpace response. As of Monday, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 died across three provinces, with cases also confirmed in neighboring Uganda. WHO officials warn that many newly reported deaths occurred in communities without facility care, and about 80% of new cases are outside contact lists, indicating transmission through unknown chains. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for this rare Ebola strain. Despite progress—Bunia treatment capacity approaching 800 beds and lab capacity rising from 1 to 14 labs—the response has not caught up with the outbreak. A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo has tested positive. The outbreak is the fastest-growing in Africa, highlighting ongoing surveillance and containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 新規エボラ症例の大半は「不明な感染経路」によるものとWHO当局者が発言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダへ国際的拡大を示し、承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、感染連鎖の追跡が困難でヒト-ヒト感染が継続していることから、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。米国人感染者の報告もあり国際的注目度が高い。承認治療薬・ワクチンなしの希少エボラ株（ブンディブギョ型）であることが特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Sonbhadra Intensifies Communicable Disease Control Drive with Door-to-Door Dastak Campaign | Sonbhadra गांव-गांव दस्तक, घर-घर निगरानी... सोनभद्र में संचारी रोगों के खिलाफ छिड़ी निर्णायक जंग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sonbhadra Intensifies Communicable Disease Control Drive with Door-to-Door Dastak Campaign | Sonbhadra: Knocking at Every Village, House-to-House Surveillance... A Decisive Battle Against Communicable Diseases in Sonbhadra.
article.articleSummary: Sonbhadra district, Uttar Pradesh, intensifies communicable disease control with a door-to-door Dastak campaign from July 11 and a broader drive started July 1, under District Magistrate Charchit Gaud. High-risk villages get microplans to accelerate sanitation, shrub clearance, drain cleaning, handpump repairs (1,137) and platforms (468) and toilet construction (329), with emphasis on drinking clean water and eliminating standing water to curb mosquito-borne diseases. Urban fogging covers 60 wards; 640 rural and 676 urban drains are cleaned; 123 pig farmers sensitized; 264 vector-control meetings. In house-to-house screening, teams identify fever, malaria, diarrhea, leprosy, tuberculosis, kala-azar, and ILIs; fever suspects tested by RDTs; malaria-positive patients treated promptly. 137 cough/cold cases and 95 suspected TB cases identified for testing/treatment. Public participation is highlighted as key to effective control.

triage.headline_ja: ソンバドラ、戸別訪問「ダスタク・キャンペーン」で感染症対策を強化 | 村々への訪問、家々での監視活動…ソンバドラで感染症との決戦が展開中
triage.triage_reason: これはインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州における通常の季節性・予防的な感染症対策キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政による予防的・定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーン（Dastak campaign）の報道であり、特定の疾病の異常な流行やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。マラリア・結核・ハンセン病・カラアザールなどのスクリーニング活動が通常業務として実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": عدد المصابين بفيروس "إيبولا" ضِعف الحصيلة الرسمية على الأقل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus is at least twice the official tally.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the true Ebola outbreak size in the Democratic Republic of Congo is at least double—and possibly quadruple—the official tally. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO emergency program director, said after a visit to eastern DRC, notably Ituri Province, that models suggest the outbreak may be two to four times the detected cases. Government data show at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths from Ebola, for which there is no proven cure or vaccine. The agency has received about 40% of the $115 million it requested to fight the outbreak, equating to roughly $46 million, with donors urged not to withdraw. The response has reached a critical stage, requiring intensified detection and isolation after the virus spread to two new provinces this week. Congo cannot shoulder this burden alone.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラウイルス感染者数は公式集計の少なくとも2倍
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCのエボラ流行規模が公式発表の2〜4倍である可能性を指摘し、新たな2州への拡大と資金不足という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは公式集計（1,926感染、702死亡）の2〜4倍の実際の感染規模を推定。イトゥリ州を含む新規2州への拡大と、要請額1.15億ドルに対し約40%（4600万ドル）しか確保できていない資金不足が深刻な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Π.Ο.Υ.: Το μέγεθος της επιδημίας στο Κονγκό μπορεί να ξεπερνά "κατά δύο με τέσσερις φορές" τις επίσημες εκτιμήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The scale of the epidemic in Congo may exceed official estimates by two to four times.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times larger than official counts, even as case detection improves. Government data show at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths from the Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the eastern DRC. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province, with spread to two additional provinces this week, signaling a critical stage for control. There is no proven treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. The WHO has received about 40% of the $115 million appeal, with funding still below needs, and urges donors not to abandon Congo. Containment hinges on intensified case finding and isolation, alongside sustained resource mobilization to manage a protracted response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴの流行規模は公式推計の2~4倍に達している可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが拡大し、死亡者700人超・複数州への拡大が確認され、有効な治療薬・ワクチンがなく資金不足も深刻であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、資金調達も目標の40%に留まっている。感染規模が公式統計より過小評価されている可能性がWHOにより指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos suspeitos de chikungunya despencam após pico da epidemia em Dourados - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected chikungunya cases plummet after the epidemic peak in Dourados - O Progresso
article.articleSummary: Suspected chikungunya cases plummet in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil after the epidemic peak. In the 27th epidemiological week (5–11 July 2026), 86 suspected chikungunya notifications were recorded, with no confirmed cases that week; during the peak week 12 there were 1,209 notifications and 672 confirmed cases in Indigenous settlements and the urban perimeter. Since outbreak onset, Dourados has logged 10,101 chikungunya notifications (5,425 probable, 4,908 confirmed); 4,676 discarded and 517 under investigation. The positivity rate is 51.21% and the attack rate 2.05%. Seventeen deaths occurred from chikungunya complications, including 12 Indigenous residents of Bororó and Jaguapiru. The municipal health secretariat credits coordinated efforts with the Ministry of Health and Indigenous agencies; the CCZ mobilized hundreds of vector-control agents to inspect thousands of properties and apply chemical treatments. Dengue remains monitored, with 1,372 notifications since January, 132 confirmed, 909 discarded, no dengue deaths in the first half.

triage.headline_ja: ドウラードスでチクングニア熱の流行ピーク後、疑い症例が急減
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドウラードスでのチクングニア熱流行はピークを過ぎ症例数が急減しているが、17名の死亡例（うち12名は先住民）が発生しており、今後の推移や近隣地域への波及を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州ドウラードス市の地域的な流行の推移報告であり、地元保健当局と保健省・先住民保健機関の連携によりベクター対策が実施済み。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、先住民コミュニティでの死亡例が多い点は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: conheça os sintomas e o esquema de vacinação para adultos e crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Learn the symptoms and the vaccination schedule for adults and children.
article.articleSummary: Five measles cases were confirmed in the Municipality of São Paulo in June 2026 amid rising measles circulation across the Americas, with the 2026 World Cup host countries—United States, Mexico, and Canada—experiencing higher transmission and increased traveler exposure. Measles is airborne; the virus can linger up to two hours, with a single case potentially infecting 15–20 people in a shared space. Key symptoms include high fever, generalized maculopapular rash, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis; Koplik spots may precede the rash. High-risk groups are children under 5 (especially under 1 year), pregnant individuals, immunosuppressed, and unvaccinated adults; pneumonia and encephalitis are possible complications. Vaccination guidance: ages 20–29 should receive two doses of MMR; ages 30–59 usually one dose, healthcare workers two doses. For children, the routine schedule remains: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months (MMR or MMRV). Revaccination depends on records. Prevention centers on vaccination, isolation, ventilation, and respiratory hygiene; suspect measles with fever and rash plus cough/coryza/conjunctivitis, especially after recent travel or contact with travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：成人と子供のためのワクチン接種スケジュールと症状について
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ市で麻疹5例が確認されたが、記事は主に症状・ワクチン接種の啓発情報であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や社会的関心の高まりは明確でない。麻疹の感染力の強さから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にワクチン接種の啓発・教育目的であり、サンパウロでの5症例確認は具体的なアウトブレイク警報というより背景情報として言及されている。米国・カナダ・メキシコ等はワールドカップ関連の一般的な感染拡大リスクとして触れられているのみで、対象国リストには該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: Число заболевших Эболой в ДРК может превышать официальные данные
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The number of Ebola cases in the DRC may exceed official figures.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) may be up to four times higher than official counts, which report about 2,000 cases and more than 700 deaths. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO Emergency Programme Executive Director, said estimates are based on mathematical models showing the outbreak scale is at least two to four times the detected cases. As surveillance improves, confidence in these estimates increases. About 80% of new infections are identified outside the known contact lists, indicating transmission through unknown chains. Additionally, many patients die at home without ever reaching medical facilities, underscoring gaps in detection and care. The remarks came at a Geneva briefing and emphasize that the true burden of Ebola in the DRC may be substantially higher than currently reported.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:DRCにおけるエボラ感染者数は公式データを上回る可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで公式報告の2〜4倍規模である可能性がWHOにより示唆され、未知の感染連鎖や検知漏れが指摘されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴うためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ジュネーブはWHO本部所在地であり発生地域ではないため除外。スイスも同様に除外。

article.articleHeadline: Crescimento de casos de ebola na RD Congo é o mais alto já visto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Growth in Ebola cases in the DRC is the highest ever seen.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the third-largest on record, with about 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths across five provinces. The WHO reports over 80 cases confirmed in 24 hours, with roughly 80% of new infections arising from unknown transmission chains. The epicenter is Ituri province, especially Bunia, though the virus has recently spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. About 95% of new cases are in Ituri. The Bundibugyo variant is circulating; there is no approved treatment, though early supportive care improves survival, and several drugs are in trials. Many deaths occur in communities without access to health facilities. WHO highlights strengthened contact tracing, mapping of transmission routes, and community engagement before opening new treatment centers to address safety and trust.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数の増加、過去最高を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去3番目の規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、24時間で80例超の確認、感染経路不明が8割を占めるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いため、フルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 感染経路不明の症例が80%を占め、承認された治療法がないこと、複数州にまたがる拡大が確認されており、WHOが対応を強化中。続報でのケース数・致死率・封じ込め状況の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo dịch Ebola tại Congo nghiêm trọng hơn số liệu chính thức
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is more serious than official figures.
article.articleSummary: More than 1,960 Ebola cases and over 700 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 14, 2026, in the outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri—the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak. WHO warns the true number of infections may be 2–4 times higher than official tallies due to under-detection, with transmission accelerating. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. About 90% of cases are in Ituri, with spread to five provinces and neighboring Uganda; Haut-Uele province has recently identified suspected cases in Pawa, Boma Mangbetu, and Isiro (its capital). Daily confirmed cases recently surpassed 80 at times. Despite challenges, response capacity is improving: more than 700 treatment beds in use and expanding weekly, substantially enhanced testing capacity, and close-contact tracing approaching 80%.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が公式統計よりも深刻であると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1960例超・700人超の死亡が報告され、ウガンダへの越境拡大とワクチン未承認株（ブンディブギョ株）による深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは実際の感染者数が公式統計の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、過小把握と感染拡大の加速が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak intensifies as the risk of spread to South Sudan grows
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak worsens with 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths as of July 12, spanning five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé. Transmission is accelerating in existing hotspots while new cases emerge farther from Bunia; the spread to Kisangani in Tshopo, over 500 km west, raises concerns it could travel along the Congo River to Kinshasa. Two confirmed cases in Wamba, Haut-Uélé near the South Sudan border heighten cross-border transmission fears. The World Health Organization estimates a 70% likelihood the outbreak could spread into South Sudan. Contact tracing has improved to 78.3%, but remains below the 90–95% threshold recommended to contain spread. Operational challenges—insecurity, border and airport closures, limited access—complicate response; the IRC calls for strengthened surveillance, infection prevention, community engagement and frontline health services in high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ流行が深刻化、南スーダンへの拡大リスク増大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,963症例、719死亡）が5州に拡大し、国境を越えて南スーダンへの拡大リスクが70%と評価されるなど、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。WHOによる国境越え拡大予測（70%）や接触追跡率が国際基準未達（78.3%）である点も高リスク要因として特記。

article.articleHeadline: Алармантно упозорење СЗО: Број оболелих од еболе у ДР Конгу четвороструко већи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming warning from the WHO: The number of people ill with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is four times higher.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be four times higher than officially reported. Since mid-May, nearly 2,000 people have been infected and more than 700 have died. Officially, cases have been recorded across five provinces, with over 90% in Ituri province; cases have also been detected in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy. It is the third-largest Ebola epidemic in history, with the fastest growth in a month. The response has scaled up to over 700 hospital beds, expanded laboratory capacity, and roughly 80% contact tracing. Many new cases involve people who died at home before seeking care. The outbreak began about two months ago, with DR Congo declaring the seventeenth Ebola outbreak on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの警告:コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染者数は公式発表の4倍に上る可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行で死者700名超、複数州・近隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例確認とあるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による史上第3位規模の流行であり、致死率も高い(死亡700/感染2000)。WHOによる正式な警告発出済みでIHR通知相当の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: VS verbieden commerciële vluchten uit Congo door ebola-uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US bans commercial flights from Congo due to an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-14, the United States barred American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from returning home on commercial flights, requiring a 21-day quarantine in another country before departure. The ban, issued under Title 49 transportation authorities, follows a sharp rise in Ebola virus disease cases in multiple Congolese provinces near Kinshasa. Congo has 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Ebola is transmitted through contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals and typically causes severe fever, vomiting, and bleeding. The emergency decree was signed by Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Secretary of Health and Human Services, noting the disease has reached areas around Kinshasa. The U.S. State Department said it would assist roughly two dozen Americans booked on flights. CDC reports new infections among Americans: a humanitarian worker positive for Bundibugyo strain; another patient evacuated to Frankfurt; a May incident involved Dr. Peter Stafford evacuated to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ発生によりコンゴからの商業便を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病の症例が急増（1,926例確定、702例死亡）し、首都キンシャサ周辺に拡大、米国が渡航制限措置を発動するなど国際的関心・対応が既に生じているためIHR基準に複数該当。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツ（フランクフルト）への症例輸出が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。ヘッセン州（ドイツ）も同様の理由で除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ytterligare en amerikan vårdas för ebola i Tyskland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American is being treated for Ebola in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola virus disease in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has arrived at a hospital in Germany for treatment. The patient, in his 60s, is a humanitarian aid worker who had been in Bunia, northeastern DRC. This marks the second American treated in Germany for Ebola; a previous patient was treated in Berlin in May and recovered after about two weeks. The World Health Organization reports that the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC has caused over 700 deaths and roughly 1,900 infections. The transfer highlights international medical support for Ebola-affected regions, with Germany serving as a destination for imported cases. No further details on the treatment facility or exact arrival date are provided beyond Bloomberg's report.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツで別の米国人がエボラ出血熱の治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ流行（死者700人超、感染者約1900人）により、国際的な患者移送（ドイツへの搬送）が発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: ドイツ（ベルリン）は輸入症例の治療先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。DRC北キブ州・ブニアが実際の発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta em Rondônia: Três morcegos testam positivo para raiva e autoridades reforçam cuidados com a população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Rondônia: Three bats test positive for rabies, and authorities reinforce precautions for the public.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak alert in Rondônia, Brazil: Three bats tested positive for rabies in 2026 across the municipalities of Cacoal, Cacaulândia and Jaru, from 40 samples analyzed by the Laboratory Central of Public Health of Rondônia (LACEN-RO). The State Health Surveillance Agency (AGEVISA-RO) issued an epidemiological alert and ongoing monitoring and control measures aim to prevent transmission to people. Rabies is a viral infection of the central nervous system with high fatality once symptoms appear, making any contact with bats or other suspected animals a risk. Rondônia has had no human rabies case for more than two decades; the last was in 2004 in Pimenta Bueno. Authorities urge residents to avoid touching bats and, in bites or saliva exposure, to wash the area, seek healthcare, and follow post-exposure recommendations.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州で警戒:コウモリ3頭が狂犬病陽性、当局が住民への注意喚起を強化
triage.triage_reason: コウモリ3頭の狂犬病陽性が確認されたが人間への感染例はなく、州当局による通常のサーベイランス・注意喚起活動の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 動物(コウモリ)における狂犬病陽性確認であり、人間症例は20年以上発生していない。州保健当局(AGEVISA-RO)による通常の疫学警戒と予防措置の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Les États-Unis interdisent les vols commerciaux en provenance du Congo dans le contexte de la crise d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States bans commercial flights from Congo amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-14, the United States bans commercial flights for American citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from returning home, requiring a 21-day quarantine in a third country before boarding. The move follows a surge in Ebola infections, with the DRC reporting 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and hemorrhaging. An emergency decree was signed by Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., noting the outbreak near Kinshasa. The State Department will assist about twenty Americans affected by the restriction. CDC reports new infections among U.S. citizens: a humanitarian worker tested positive for Bundibugyo, and another patient was transferred to a Frankfurt hospital for treatment. Earlier in May, Dr. Peter Stafford of the Serge Christian mission was evacuated to Germany after contracting the virus.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ、エボラ危機を受けコンゴからの商業便を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ大規模流行（1,926症例・702死亡）に加え、米国が渡航制限措置を実施、キンシャサ近郊での発生と国際的な症例輸出（フランクフルト搬送等）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当及び社会的関心の高まりが認められる。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国は症例の域外搬送先であり、感染発生地はDRC（キンシャサ近郊）に限定される。Bundibugyo株の言及があり、通常のZaire株流行とは異なる可能性があるため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : " Aucun patient n'a jusqu'à présent contracté Ebola à l'hôpital du Cinquantenaire " (Médecin-directeur) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: "No patient has so far contracted Ebola at the Cinquantenaire Hospital" (Medical Director) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), July 14, 2026 — Ebola virus disease has not infected any patient at Kisangani's Cinquantenaire Hospital to date, per Medical Director Dr. Falay Sadiki. Despite public fear around the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE), the hospital reports decreased attendance while services continue. The CTE is fully separated from routine care with a physical barrier and staff dedicated to Ebola, reducing cross-contamination. Neonatology and maternity units remain regularly active; overall patient flow is down, though monthly stats are not yet consolidated. Dr. Sadiki cautioned that Ebola is not transmitted via air or a simple gaze, and that implemented precautions mitigate risk. Visit by the Health Minister and Secretary General reaffirmed governmental commitment, including new specialized Ebola centers in Kisangani and upgraded rapid-diagnostic capacity to shorten case-confirmation times; lab-result delays remain a challenge.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:「シンクアントネール病院ではこれまでエボラに感染した患者はいない」（医療部長）― ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の常時報告対象疾患であり、キサンガニにエボラ治療センター（CTE）が稼働中であることから、DRCで進行中のエボラ流行の一環として監視が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事自体はキサンガニのシンクアントネール病院で院内感染が発生していないことを伝える安心情報だが、エボラ治療センターの存在や保健大臣の視察、新規専門センター設置の動きから、DRCでエボラ流行対応が継続中であることが示唆される。基礎疾患の重大性からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'épidémie pourrait dépasser "de deux à quatre fois" les estimations officielles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak could exceed the official estimates by two to four times.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeast Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri), near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, with approximately 2,000 reported cases and around 700 deaths; official counts could be underestimates by 2–4×. The epidemic has spread to four additional provinces, and Uganda has reported 20 cases. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest-growing within a single month among outbreaks managed to date. Detection is improving: contact-case follow-up around 80%, about 700 treatment beds, and laboratory capacity rising from 1 to 14 sites. Two treatments are currently being tested on site; Kinshasa’s INRB, in collaboration with France’s ANRS MIE and NGO Alima, are expected to announce a clinical trial of a post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) shortly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:流行の規模は公式推定値の2〜4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で発生中のエボラ出血熱が既に近隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、公式推定を大幅に上回る規模の可能性があるため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの20症例も報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。フランスは臨床試験協力国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تفوق الحصيلة الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola infections in Congo exceed the official tally.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is highlighted by WHO findings: as of July 12, there are 1,963 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 719 deaths. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO's Health Emergencies Programme, warns the true toll may be two to four times higher. Most deaths occur at home rather than in medical facilities, and caregiving relatives often acquire infection without protective clothing. About 80% of new infections do not appear on case-contact lists, indicating untracked transmission chains. The outbreak has spread to two additional provinces, with Ituri the hardest hit. WHO notes only 40% of the $115-million six-month appeal has been funded, urging donors to sustain support and calling for intensified pursuit, isolation, and response to the escalating crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ感染者数は公式集計を上回る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで検査確定1,963例・死亡719例のエボラ流行が拡大し、WHOは実際の被害はさらに大きい可能性を指摘。追跡不能な感染連鎖や資金不足も深刻で、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOはこの流行に対する6ヶ月間の1億1500万ドル規模の資金要請のうち40%しか調達できていないと指摘しており、国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Το μέγεθος της επιδημίας Έμπολα ίσως είναι μεγαλύτερο από τα επίσημα στοιχεία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The magnitude of the Ebola outbreak may be larger than official figures.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times larger than official counts, according to a WHO emergency program director, who noted that case detection capacity is improving daily. The Bundibugyo lineage is involved, and there is currently no approved treatment or vaccine. Official figures report at least 1,926 sick people and 702 deaths. The Ituri province remains the hardest hit, with new cases detected in two additional provinces, signaling a broader and more difficult response. Financing is critically short, with only about 40% of the $115 million WHO requested for Bundibugyo control mobilized. The WHO appealed for international support, stressing that the outbreak requires resources commensurate with the scale of the challenge and cannot be shouldered by Congo alone, likening the effort to a marathon.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ出血熱の流行規模は公式統計より大きい可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が公式統計以上に拡大している可能性があり、複数州への拡大、致死率の高さ、承認された治療薬・ワクチンの不在、資金不足による国際支援要請があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 実際の症例数が公式報告(1,926人、702人死亡)の2〜4倍に上る可能性がWHOにより指摘されており、新たに2州で症例確認、資金は目標額の約40%のみ確保。ブンディブギョ株には承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、国際支援が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says DR Congo Ebola outbreak could be two to four times larger
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak in the east (Bundibugyo strain) has 1,963 cases and 719 deaths since it was declared on 15 May, according to the government. WHO cautions the true scale is at least 2–4 times higher, with many infections going undetected as patients die at home before seeking care. More than 90% of confirmed cases remain in Ituri province, though the outbreak has spread to five eastern provinces and crossed into Uganda, which has 20 infections and 2 deaths. Treatment capacity expanded to 700+ beds; laboratories have increased capacity; contact tracing improving toward ~80% follow-up. No approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; two experimental therapies are under trial. About $1.5 billion has been pledged by international partners and African governments. Frontline staff have not been paid for two months, prompting protests at Rwampara Ebola treatment center; 112 infections and 35 deaths among medical staff.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は実際には2~4倍の規模である可能性があると発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大〈ウガンダへの越境〉）し、WPRO基準も全5項目該当。国際的な資金拠出・WHO声明もあり社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。実際の感染者数はWHO推計でDRC政府発表の2~4倍とされ、過小報告が懸念される。医療従事者への感染・死亡（112例・35死亡）と未払い給与による抗議活動も、対応能力に関するリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تُحذّر من تصاعد تفشّي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the escalating Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization warns that the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating beyond response capacity. WHO reports 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of July 11, marking it the third-largest Ebola outbreak globally. A major concern is deaths occurring in communities before receiving medical care. The organization calls for stronger early detection, expanded contact tracing, and closing a funding gap of about $70 million to sustain control efforts. The update underscores ongoing transmission and the critical need for rapid case finding, patient isolation, and prompt funding to support surveillance, laboratory testing, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式に流行拡大を警告し、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱で1,926例・702死亡という大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: WHOが資金不足（約7000万ドル）を指摘し、対応能力を超えて拡大していると警告。世界第3位の規模のエボラ流行として国際的関心が高い案件。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak much larger than official figures, WHO says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda is far larger than official tallies, WHO says. Nearly 2,000 infections and over 700 deaths are reported; 20 confirmed cases in Uganda. The outbreak concentrates in Ituri Province (northeast DRC) and in North Kivu and South Kivu. The scale is at least two to four times the reported figure, with many cases unrecorded. Funding shortfall persists: less than half of the $115 million needed in the first six months. Hospital care with IV fluids and oxygen improves survival; many deaths occur in communities before seeking care. Bundibugyo strain first identified in Uganda. No cure or vaccine available. US travel rules tightened: DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan nationals face restrictions; 21 days in a third country for returning citizens; non-citizens who recently visited these countries cannot travel to the US.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、公式統計よりはるかに深刻とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、WHOが公式統計より大幅に感染規模が大きいと発表。国際的な渡航制限も既に実施されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、北・南キブ州）とウガンダでの流行拡大を主題としているが、ウガンダ・米国・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。資金不足（必要額の半分未満）が対応能力に深刻な影響を与えている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تحذّر: عجز 60% في تمويل مكافحة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns: 60% funding shortfall in the fight against Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warns that only about 40% of the $115 million requested to fight the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has been funded, leaving a 60% shortfall. The response is concentrated in Ituri, with the outbreak spreading to two new provinces. There have been 1,926 cases and at least 702 deaths. There is no proven treatment or vaccine for Ebola. WHO’s Emergency Programme Director urged donors not to abandon Congo in this critical phase, saying resources must match the scale of the challenge and that Congo cannot bear this burden alone. The response has reached a critical stage, requiring intensified case finding and patient isolation, as the true number of infections could be at least twice, and perhaps up to four times, the official count.

triage.headline_ja: 「世界保健機関」警告：エボラ対策の資金が60%不足
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が拡大し（1,926症例、702人死亡）、資金不足により対応が危機的段階にあるとWHOが警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはイトゥリ州を中心に新たに2州へ拡大しており、実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性があるとWHOが指摘。ワクチン・治療法が確立していない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 广东6月流感确诊27万例！广东疾控提醒：已进入夏季流行季，日常防护要注意→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong reports 270,000 confirmed influenza cases in June! Guangdong CDC reminds: We have entered the summer influenza season; daily protective measures should be observed.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province reported 429,628 legally notifiable infectious disease cases and 129 deaths in June 2026 (June 1–30). Class B diseases were led by COVID-19, hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis, and gonorrhea, making up 94.66% of B-class cases. Class C diseases totaled 365,082 with 1 death, dominated by influenza, hand, foot and mouth disease, and other infectious diarrheal diseases (99.75% of Class C). COVID-19: 26,117 June cases, up from 2,979 in May. Influenza: 274,328 cases with 1 death in June. April–June influenza trend: 71,477; 140,837; 274,328. Guangdong CDC notes rising influenza activity in the summer season, with influenza B (Victoria lineage) predominant. High-risk settings include elderly care facilities, maternity centers, and welfare institutions; emphasize hand hygiene, ventilation, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated places, and avoiding touching eyes, mouth, or nose. Seek care for fever or cough.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省で6月にインフルエンザ確診27万例！広東省疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起：夏季流行シーズンに入ったため、日常防護に注意を
triage.triage_reason: 広東省CDCによる月次法定伝染病サーベイランスの定期報告であり、季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19増加は例年見られるパターン内で、重大な異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 広東省疾病予防管理センターによる月次定例サーベイランス報告。季節性インフルエンザ（B型Victoria系統優勢）とCOVID-19の夏季増加は中国南部で通例のパターンであり、致死率も低く特段の異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: מגפת האבולה בקונגו מחריפה: בארגון הבריאות מזהירים מהיקף תחלואה גדול בהרבה - JDN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo worsens: WHO warns of a much larger number of cases - JDN
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens; WHO warns true infections may be 2–4 times the official counts. Since May 15, 2026, 1,926 cases and 702 deaths have been reported, but underreporting likely due to undetected transmission chains, with four in five new infections lacking links to known patients. Many die outside treatment centers. The outbreak began in Ituri Province and has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Chopo, and Out Ouala, near South Sudan and the Central African Republic. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or proven therapy. It can cause high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and multi-organ failure. Remdesivir and MBP134 are in trials; efficacy will require months and hundreds of participants. Resources are scarce: about 40% of a $115 million appeal. Healthcare workers in Ituri protested unpaid salaries amid conflict and infrastructural challenges. WHO calls for intensified international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が悪化：WHOが実際の感染規模ははるかに大きいと警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで急速に拡大し、致死率も高く、ワクチン未承認、国際支援要請もあることからIHR・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事では中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンへの近接に言及されているが、実際の感染事例は報告されていないためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya segue em desaceleração em Dourados e notificações despencam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya continues to slow in Dourados as case notifications plummet.
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Brazil, continues to slow a chikungunya epidemic while dengue case notifications drop, according to an epidemiological bulletin based on the Sistema de Informação de Agravos de Notificação. Since January, dengue has 1,372 notified cases, with 463 probable and 132 confirmed; 909 discarded and 331 under investigation. No dengue deaths occurred in the first half of the year, but dengue infection has been confirmed in four pregnant women. By age, the most affected group is 20–29 years (27 cases) and the least affected is 0–9 years (16 cases). The report notes that although the city is dealing with a chikungunya outbreak, also transmitted by Aedes aegypti, dengue cases remain under control in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: ドウラードス市でチクングニア熱の減速続く、届出数が急減
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジル国内で流行が沈静化・減速している旨を報告しており、死亡例もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知のAedes aegypti媒介感染症で、地域内での通常の疫学監視報告。流行は沈静化傾向にあり、死亡例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : L'OMS tire la sonnette d'alarme - " Le vrai bilan est deux à quatre fois plus élevé "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO sounds the alarm — "The real toll is two to four times higher."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) intensifies as of July 14, 2026, with 1,926 official infections and 702 deaths, while WHO estimates real cases are at least two to four times higher. Declared two months earlier in Ituri, the outbreak has spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, and Uganda reports 20 cross-border cases. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-growing in a month among WHO-managed events. Many new cases involve individuals dying in communities before reaching health facilities, signaling weak early detection. Progress includes nearly 80% contact tracing, 700 treatment beds, and 14 diagnostic laboratories (up from 1). Two therapeutics are being tested on the ground; INRB Kinshasa, with ANRS MIE and Alima, will soon launch a post-exposure prophylaxis trial using obeldesivir. Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases, with risk remaining high in remote villages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱DRC:WHOが警鐘 ― 「実際の被害は公式発表の2〜4倍」
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが急拡大し、ウガンダへの越境例も報告されており、WHOが警鐘を鳴らす深刻な国際的公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダで20例の越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはコミュニティ内死亡例の多さから実際の症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍と推定し、早期探知の弱さを指摘している。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'insécurité complique le suivi des contacts Ebola à Nizi (Ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Insecurity complicates Ebola contact tracing in Nizi (Health Minister) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, in Ituri's Nizi health zone, Djugu Territory, Democratic Republic of the Congo, ongoing insecurity hampers Ebola virus disease contact tracing. Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba cited armed groups blocking access to areas, with around 69 displacement camps housing over one million people, driving mobility and humanitarian needs. Surveillance and contact follow-up are compromised as response teams struggle to reach insecure sites and displaced populations reliant on water and aid. Officials are negotiating with the military governor to curb mobility and with local leaders to access the most volatile zones. Nizi has been an epicenter of militia activity, involving Codeco and Zaïre self-defense groups, recently allied with CRP, whose cycles of attacks and reprisals often target civilians and lead to looted or shuttered health facilities. No outbreak numbers are provided.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:治安不安がニジでのエボラ接触者追跡を困難に(保健大臣)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の接触者追跡が治安悪化により妨げられており、100万人以上の避難民を抱える地域での感染拡大リスクが高く、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が大きい。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載されておらず不明。治安悪化により接触者追跡と監視活動が著しく制限されている点が主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: بتوجيهات محمد بن راشد.. شحنة إغاثية جديدة إلى أوغندا لدعم مكافحة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Under the directives of Mohammed bin Rashid, a new relief shipment to Uganda to support the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Dubai Humanitarian, under Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid’s directives, dispatched the fourth relief shipment to Uganda to support the Ebola outbreak response in Entebbe. The 72.5-ton air cargo aboard a Dubai Royal Wing flight draws from UN World Food Programme and UNICEF prepositioned stocks in Dubai Humanitarian City. The consignment includes water purification systems, mobile storage units, generators for treatment centers, temporary shelter for patients and medical teams, data-recording devices for vaccine and cold-chain temperature monitoring, and sanitation supplies to curb transmission. Dubai Humanitarian’s executive director Giuseppe Saba emphasizes delivering aid to those in need and the shipment’s impact on affected communities. This adds to nine shipments totaling over 450 metric tons this year to Gaza, Lebanon, Mozambique and Afghanistan. A prior relief flight on June 21 reached Entebbe with 76.2 tons destined for Congo; total aid value exceeds $223,000, with estimated air transport costs around $270,000.

triage.headline_ja: ムハンマド・ビン・ラーシドの指示により、エボラ対策支援のための新たな救援物資がウガンダへ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はウガンダ（エンテベ）向けのエボラ対応支援物資輸送に関する内容であり、対象国リストに含まれる国が主題として扱われていないため見送りとする。DRCは前回便の目的地として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はUAEからウガンダへの人道支援物資輸送に焦点を当てた内容であり、DRCへの言及は6月21日の前回便の目的地としてのみで、本記事の主題国はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）。エボラ自体の重大性は高いが、対象国に該当する発生国情報がないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la Protection civile mise sur les enterrements sécurisés pour freiner Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Civil Protection relies on safe burials to curb Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, Ituri province in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo intensified its Ebola virus disease (EVD) response by expanding dignified and safe burials (EDS) teams to eight health zones: Bunia, Rwampara, Nizi, Bambu, Lita, Nyankunde, Komanda and Mongbwalu. Community-based teams, trained with support from WHO and FHI 360, assist communities in implementing burial and infection-control protocols for Ebola-related deaths and strengthen surveillance by channeling alerts—live cases, suspicious deaths, and other Ebola information—through the centralized hotline 0821419595. The Civil Protection also contributes to security for personnel and facilities and prioritizes fire prevention in Ebola response installations. Authorities urge residents to cooperate and report suspected cases promptly to enable early care and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：市民保護隊がエボラ抑制のため安全な埋葬を推進 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の対応が8保健地域に拡大しており、進行中のアウトブレイクとしてIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにルーマニア、イタリア、ルワンダ等が含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCイトゥリ州における進行中のエボラ対応であり、これらの国は関連性がないため除外した。WHOおよびFHI 360の支援を受けた既存の公衆衛生対応であることから、既に認知されているアウトブレイクの継続報道と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: East Singhbhum officials on alert after suspected dengue case
article.articleSummary: Suspected dengue detected in East Singhbhum, Jamshedpur: a nursing student at MGMMCH tested positive on a rapid antigen test and is under treatment; an ELISA confirmatory test is ordered with results expected within eight hours. East Singhbhum has not reported a confirmed dengue infection so far this year; over 3,000 dengue tests Jan–Jun were negative. Health teams will survey the GNM school campus in Sakchi (old MGM Hospital premises) where about 120 students reside, to identify mosquito-breeding sites amid waterlogging from ongoing construction. Civil surgeon Dr Sahir Pall has directed MGMMCH, Sadar Hospital, and PHCs to set up dedicated dengue wards; surveillance is intensified and residents urged to remove stagnant water. In Dhanbad, dengue cases are rising; larvae were found at 22 locations, and inspections are intensified. Infected include Dr Sanjeev Kumar Prasad, Dr Anita Chaudhary, and Santosh Kumar, all under treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 疑いのあるデング熱症例発生を受け東シングブーム当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域で疑い例および散発的な増加が報告されているが、確定例数や重症度など詳細情報が不足しており、地域的流行拡大の兆候は限定的。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド東部（ジャールカンド州）で例年発生する疾患であり、地方当局が対応・監視を強化している段階。国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の影響を示す情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: L'OMS a averti que la 17ᵉ épidémie d'Ebola connaît la progression la plus rapide jamais enregistrée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO has warned that the 17th Ebola outbreak is experiencing the fastest progression on record.
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the fastest-moving Ebola outbreak on record. By July 11, it logged nearly 2,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 700 deaths, ranking as the third-largest in history. Many recent deaths occurred at home before patients could reach care, and 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, indicating transmission chains that remain unknown. Attacks on health facilities have been sporadic, complicating response efforts. The outbreak centers in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo; WHO officials visited Bunia during assessments.
