No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; two treatments for this strain are under development. Transmission occurs from wildlife spillover and human-to-human spread via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces or objects.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:WHOは第17次エボラ流行が過去最速のペースで進行していると警告
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の進行速度、多数の死亡者、感染経路不明の症例が80%を占めるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、ワクチン未承認という管理困難な要素もあるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、承認ワクチンが存在しない点が管理上の大きな課題。感染経路不明の症例が多く、地域拡大リスクも継続的に評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cyclosporiasis cases in Michigan climb to over 3,000, state health officials say
article.articleSummary: Michigan reports 3,309 cyclosporiasis cases linked to an outbreak as of July 14, 2026, up 669 from the prior update on Monday. The Michigan Department of Health and Human Services says 44 hospitalizations are associated with the outbreak, with no deaths reported to date (through July 9). The update provides ongoing state totals but does not include details on the infection source or foods implicated, or laboratory confirmation in this summary. The information indicates sustained transmission within Michigan and underscores the need for continued public health surveillance and response. The Reuters report is dated July 14, 2026, with reporting by Siddhi Mahatole in Bengaluru and editing by Shailesh Kuber.

triage.headline_ja: ミシガン州、サイクロスポーラ症の感染者数が3,000人を超えたと州保健当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: 米国ミシガン州における食品由来のサイクロスポーラ症アウトブレイクであり、対象国（インド等）とは無関係。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事中のインド（Bengaluru）は執筆記者の所在地であり、実際の発生地はいずれも対象国リストに含まれない米国ミシガン州であるため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情感染激增，未知传播链占多数
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo sees infections surge, with unknown transmission chains accounting for the majority.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, with the virus spreading to Upper Uele and JoPo Provinces; Bunia is the outbreak hub. As of July 11, confirmed cases approach 2,000 and deaths exceed 700 across five provinces, marking the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Most new infections come from unknown transmission chains; 80% of new cases are not on the contact-tracing list, and many deaths occur in communities that never reached care. Models estimate the outbreak could be two to four times the reported numbers. While up to 95% of new cases remain in Ituri, spread beyond the initial zone is underway. Therapeutic trials are underway, but there is no approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; early supportive care improves survival. Enhanced community engagement, transparency, and global solidarity are urged, including sharing pathogen data.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で感染が急増、未知の感染経路が大半を占める
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例約2000人・死者700人超で史上第3位規模のエボラ流行が拡大中であり、未知の伝播経路が大半を占め封じ込めが困難な状況であるため、IHR・WPRO双方の基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州が震源、ブニアが拠点）のエボラ流行に関するもの。メキシコ・ソノラ州やEl Jopoは地名の誤認識または無関係な位置情報とみられ、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。承認された治療法がなく、80%の新規症例が接触者追跡リスト外という点で流行制御が極めて困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Τα νέα κρούσματα Έμπολα προέρχονται από άγνωστες αλυσίδες μετάδοσης
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola cases originate from unknown transmission chains.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain since May continues to outpace response efforts. Health officials report at least 1,926 cases and 702 deaths across three provinces as of Monday, with confirmed cases also in neighboring Uganda. WHO Africa Emergencies Director notes many recent deaths occurred in communities lacking access to health facilities, and about 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts, signaling transmission through unknown chains. Bunia, in Ituri Province, hosts nearly 800 treatment beds, and laboratory capacity has risen from 1 to 14 labs. There is no approved treatment or vaccine; last week clinical trials began for new therapeutic regimens. Challenges include funding gaps, attacks on health facilities, ongoing eastern Congo conflict, and community mistrust. A U.S. humanitarian worker tested positive; outbreak declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ症例は未知の感染連鎖に由来する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが1,926症例・702死亡に達し、国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大、症例の80%が未知の感染経路であるため公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例確認も報告されているが、GeoNames対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。米国人人道支援者の感染事例もあり、国際的な関与・関心が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Majority of new Ebola cases are 'from unknown chains of transmission,' WHO official says
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Congo continues to outpace response, with Bunia in Ituri province as the epicenter. As of Monday, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 have died across three Congo provinces, with confirmed cases also reported in neighbouring Uganda. A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo has tested positive for Ebola. WHO officials say 80% of new cases are outside contact lists, representing unknown chains of transmission, and many deaths occurred in communities that never reached care. Congo has no approved treatment or vaccine. Treatment capacity in Bunia is nearing 800 beds and lab capacity has expanded from one to 14 labs. The outbreak began in May, with authorities declaring a fresh outbreak on May 15. Funding gaps, attacks on health centers, ongoing conflict, and community mistrust hinder response; clinical trials for treatment began last week.

triage.headline_ja: 新規エボラ症例の大半は「未知の感染連鎖」によるもの、とWHO当局者が発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（1,926人感染、702人死亡）がウガンダや米国籍者にも拡大しており、感染連鎖の80%が追跡不能という異常事態であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよび米国での感染者確認は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の重要な兆候として本文には記載。承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない点、資金不足や紛争、地域住民の不信感が対応を阻害している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Americana confirma morte por febre maculosa e investiga origem da infecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Americana confirms death from Brazilian spotted fever and investigates the origin of the infection.
article.articleSummary: Americana, São Paulo, Brazil, confirmed the death of a 37-year-old man from Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa) after laboratory confirmation by Instituto Adolfo Lutz. The city has 22 notifications (16 ruled out; 5 awaiting results). The patient, hospitalized, died on June 30. The infection source has not yet been identified; PVCE leads the investigation. Health authorities urge avoiding risk areas such as riverbanks, streams, lagoons, and the Salto Grande Reservoir; if exposure is unavoidable, wear light clothing, tuck pant legs into socks, use tall boots, inspect the body every three hours, and monitor for symptoms. Febre maculosa is caused by Rickettsia and can be severe; early antibiotic treatment is provided by the SUS, typically seven days, extended three days after fever ends. Delays increase the risk of complications and death.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカーナ市、ブラジル紅斑熱による死亡を確認し感染源を調査
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で紅斑熱（リケッチア感染症）による死亡例が確認されたが、ダニ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、地域的な事案にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 紅斑熱（Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever/febre maculosa）はブラジルで既知の風土病であり、ダニ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はしない。地元保健当局（PVCE）が感染源を調査中で、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola en RD Congo podría ser hasta cuatro veces mayor que lo detectado, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be up to four times larger than detected, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, WHO warned the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times larger than detected. Official counts exceed 1,960 infections and 700 deaths since May 15, with Ituri province bearing most cases; the virus has spread to five provinces and into Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids and contaminated materials; traditional funeral rites have been restricted, fueling local discontent. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and potential hemorrhage. Two therapeutic investigations (remdesivir and MBP134 antibodies) are underway, but trials could take months and require up to 1,000 participants. Although capacity has expanded to over 700 beds, labs and contact tracing near 80%, funding remains only about 40% of the $115 million request, stressing responders and frontline workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、WHOが検出数の最大4倍規模の可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準のうち複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、ワクチン未承認変異株）し、社会的関心も高く、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。資金不足（要請額の約40%のみ）が対応能力に影響している点は要継続監視。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola sprids till två nya provinser i Kongo - men nu kommer första vaccinkandidaten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to two new provinces in the Congo - but now the first vaccine candidate is here.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces, extending from the Ituri epicenter. Kisangani, a major city on the Congo River in Tshopo, lies about 170 miles downstream from Kinshasa and raises concern for regional spread. The outbreak has caused at least 1,750 infections and 600 deaths, with transmission dating to months before mid-May. The virus is Bundibugyo Ebola, a variant first identified in Uganda about 20 years ago; existing vaccines do not cover this strain. Oxford researchers announce a first-in-human trial of a new vaccine candidate developed in eight weeks, using the same viral-vector platform as AstraZeneca’s COVID-19 vaccine; initial doses for 50 healthy volunteers in the United Kingdom are expected within weeks. Vaccination may start with ring vaccination for healthcare workers and contacts, possibly expanding to entire communities. Mistrust, violence against aid workers, and funding disputes hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴの新たな2州に拡大 ― しかし最初のワクチン候補が登場
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が既に1750人感染・600人死亡に達し、震源地イトゥリから新たに2州へ拡大、既存ワクチンが無効という異常事態でIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ、オー・ウエレ、ツォポ州）でのエボラ流行拡大が主題。ウガンダ・英国は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。既存ワクチンが効かない新規株であり、資金・信頼問題も響き対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية" تحذر من تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues at a pace outstripping response capacity. As of July 11, 1,926 confirmed Ebola cases and 702 deaths have been reported, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak globally. A key concern is fatalities occurring in communities before receiving healthcare. The WHO urges strengthened outbreak response, including early detection and rapid contact tracing, and notes a funding gap of $70 million to sustain efforts. Despite progress in treatment, diagnostics, and contact tracing, transmission persists within the DRC. The report underscores the need for additional resources and coordinated international support to contain the outbreak and prevent further deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（世界第3位の規模、1926症例・702死亡）が継続しており、WHOが資金・国際支援の必要性を訴えている重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: WHOが70百万ドルの資金ギャップと国際支援の必要性を明言しており、対応能力を上回る速度で流行が拡大している点が重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: US to Restrict Direct Return of US Citizens From Congo Over Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: US imposes restrictions on direct return of citizens who have been in Congo amid Ebola outbreak. As of July 14, 2026, Americans who have been in Congo must spend at least 21 days outside the country before boarding a U.S.-bound flight, with federal Title 49 authority placing such travelers on a do-not-board list. About 24 Americans were set to fly home before the rule began. The CDC previously indicated U.S. citizens could enter the United States after visiting Congo, while a May order already required non-citizens who have recently been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan to spend 21 days outside those countries. The new restrictions, based on an updated order from Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., will last 30 days. The State Department will assist during the waiting period. Two Americans have tested positive after working in Congo; one treated in Berlin, the other for Samaritan’s Purse, also flown to Germany. The CDC will provide medical assessments.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱流行を受けコンゴ民主共和国からの米国市民の直接帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行により米国が渡航制限を発動し、感染者がドイツへも搬送されるなど国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 感染者2名がコンゴでの活動後に陽性となりドイツ（ベルリン）で治療を受けている。米国は渡航制限（21日間の待機、do-not-boardリスト適用）を30日間実施。感染源国はDRCであり、他の言及国（米国・ドイツ・ウガンダ・南スーダン）は対象国リスト外または二次的言及にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : Isiro face au défi du manque de laboratoire et centre de traitement Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Uele: Isiro faces the challenge of the lack of a laboratory and an Ebola treatment center - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, lacks a laboratory and an Ebola Treatment Center, complicating the outbreak response. Only two Ebola treatment centers exist—Durba (Watsa Territory) and Wamba—with plans to establish facilities in Isiro and to expand in other zones where the disease is declared. For the period June 22 to July 13, 2026, INRB confirmed 14 Ebola cases in Haut-Uele, with 13 deaths and 1 survivor. Case distribution: Wamba 8, Pawa 3, Boma-Mangbetu 2, Isiro 1. The response lists 127 contacts, of which 83 are being followed; 2 suspected hospitalizations; 14 safe and dignified burials; 5 samples awaiting dispatch. Officials urge strict adherence to barrier measures to interrupt transmission while scaling up laboratories and treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州:イズィロがエボラ治療センターと検査室不足という課題に直面 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オートウエレ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、致死率が高く（14例中13死亡）、治療施設・検査体制が不十分であるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とされる疾患であり、治療センター・検査室不足により感染制御能力に懸念がある。フルリスク評価(RRA)への移行が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: বর্ষার জলে ডুবছে পা? শরীরে ঢুকতে পারে মারাত্মক জীবাণু, কী কী করণীয়!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are your feet soaking in monsoon water? Deadly pathogens can enter the body — what should you do?
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the article warns that puddled rainwater in monsoon areas can harbor Leptospira bacteria, causing leptospirosis. Transmission occurs when contaminated water or soil contacts broken skin or wounds and can enter through eyes, nose, or mouth; urine from rats and infected animals contaminate streets and mud. Myths are debunked: clean-looking water is not necessarily safe, and infection can arise from floodwater, mud, or animal urine, not only sewer water. Prevention: wear waterproof boots in flooded areas; cover cuts with waterproof dressings; avoid barefoot walking; wash exposed skin with soap after returning home; change wet clothes promptly. Symptoms appear 2–14 days after exposure and include fever, leg muscle pain, headache, chills, vomiting, and weakness; severe disease may include red eyes, jaundice, abdominal pain, or kidney and liver complications. Seek prompt medical care if symptoms develop after water exposure; early antibiotics are usually effective.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の水たまりに足を浸けていませんか？危険な病原体が体内に侵入する可能性—何をすべきか
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生報告ではなく、モンスーン季節におけるレプトスピラ症の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の情報がない。
triage.notes: この記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、レプトスピラ症の一般的な健康啓発・予防情報を提供する内容。具体的な患者数や地域の特定がなく、季節性の一般的な注意喚起記事。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le virus Ebola progresse encore plus vite malgré la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola virus is spreading even faster despite the response.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak in the eastern region, centered around Bunia, is the fastest-spreading in history, with nearly 2,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 700 deaths as of July 11. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine. WHO emergency response chief Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu described the situation as progress tempered by deep concern during a visit to Bunia. He noted 80% of new cases are not on contact lists, signaling widespread unseen transmission chains, and that many fatalities occurred at home without access to health facilities. Health facilities have faced sporadic attacks. The virus remains highly contagious, transmitted from wild animals to humans and between people through bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. Two treatments are under development for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:対応にもかかわらずエボラウイルスの拡大がさらに加速
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速のエボラ流行で約2000例・700人超死亡、ワクチン未承認、80%が接触者リスト外という制御不能な感染連鎖が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 承認ワクチンがないBundibugyo種による流行で、接触者追跡が機能しておらず、医療施設への攻撃も発生していることから制御困難な状況が続いている。WHO緊急対応責任者が現地訪問し深い懸念を表明。

article.articleHeadline: Erste Studie am Menschen: Impfstoff gegen Bundibugyo-Variante des Ebola-Virus wird getestet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First-in-human study: A vaccine against the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus is being tested.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant has persisted since May, with 1,963 laboratory-confirmed infections and at least 719 deaths; WHO cautions total cases and deaths could be two to four times higher. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu amid armed conflict, with transmission via close contact and bodily fluids. Containment hinges on identifying and monitoring about 90% of contacts, a goal hampered by fragile health systems and funding shortfalls; WHO says roughly $115 million is still needed. A first-in-human trial of a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo has begun in the DRC: developed by the Indian Serum Institute, it enrolls 50 healthy adults in Phase 1 to assess safety and immune response. The chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform mirrors that used in the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID vaccine. Existing Ebola vaccines target the Zaire variant and are not approved for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 初のヒト臨床試験:エボラウイルスのブンディブギョ変異株に対するワクチンが試験中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ変異株によるエボラ流行が継続し、確定症例1,963例・死亡719例、武力紛争下で接触者追跡が困難であり、WHOが多額の資金支援を必要としているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ワクチンはインドのSerum Instituteが開発したものだが、臨床試験および流行自体はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ州）で発生しているため、インドは発生地域として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго распространяется быстрее, чем когда-либо в современной истории
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than at any time in modern history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, centered in Ituri province in eastern DRC. As of July 11, nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been reported across five provinces, making it the third-largest modern outbreak. The spread is accelerating—the past 24 hours saw more than 80 new infections. About 80% of new cases are not linked to known transmission chains, arising from unknown sources. Modeling suggests the true scale could be 2–4 times higher than reported. A two-stage response is underway: maintain operations in Ituri while mapping movement routes to identify risk zones. No approved treatment exists for the Bundibugyo variant, though therapeutic trials are ongoing; early care improves survival. Attacks on health workers underscore the need for transparency and community engagement. Global discussions address pathogen access and vaccine distribution under a Pandemic Agreement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は、現代史上最速のペースで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（約2000症例、700人超死亡）が急速に拡大しており、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占めるなど制御困難な状況で、国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株による流行で承認された治療薬がなく、医療従事者への攻撃も報告されている。モデリングでは実際の規模が報告の2〜4倍の可能性が示唆されており、続報の監視とフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Estados Unidos bloquea la vuelta de sus ciudadanos desde el Congo por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States blocks the return of its citizens from the Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: United States imposes a 21-day pre-embarkation restriction on travelers who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to the ongoing Ebola outbreak. Americans departing RDC must spend at least 21 days outside the country in a third nation before flying to the United States; about two dozen affected citizens were set to depart. The CDC will provide medical evaluations, and the State Department will coordinate consular assistance during the waiting period. Germany evacuated a second U.S. citizen infected with Ebola in RDC for treatment in Frankfurt; the patient is a humanitarian worker. In the DRC, the National Institute for Public Health reports 1,926 confirmed cases, 702 deaths, 318 recoveries; 753 hospitalized, contact tracing 78.3%. The outbreak persists in Ituri and is spreading to other provinces. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Uganda reports two related deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱によりコンゴからの自国民帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、致死率が高く、国際的な渡航制限措置（米国の21日間出国前隔離）が既に実施されているため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連死亡例やドイツでの治療事例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国・ドイツは渡航制限・治療対応国であり発生国ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株は承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、既にWHOがPHEICを宣言している点も重大性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: WHO varuje, že epidémia eboly v KDR môže byť až štyrikrát väčšia, než ukazujú údaje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola epidemic in the DRC could be up to four times larger than the data show.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) concentrates in Ituri province, with more than 1,960 people infected and over 700 deaths reported by Congolese authorities since two months into the outbreak. The World Health Organization (WHO) estimates the true case count may be two to four times higher, based on their models. This is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history and the fastest-spreading WHO has recorded. Over 90% of cases are in Ituri, where fighting groups operate, with transmission also reported in four other provinces and in neighboring Uganda. Many patients die at home before reaching care, and the circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO notes expanding treatment and testing capacity and improving contact tracing, but emphasizes substantial under-detection and community deaths as ongoing concerns.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行がデータが示す数の最大4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: 史上3番目に大きく最速拡大とされるエボラ流行がDRCで進行中で、隣国ウガンダへの伝播も報告されており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認株による重症・死亡例多数のためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株であり、過小報告の可能性が高い点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: West and Central Africa: Latest Events at a glance (7 - 13 July 2026)
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola update: as of 11 July, 1,926 confirmed cases across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo; Ituri accounts for 90.9% of cases and 86.2% of deaths. South Kivu recorded 42 consecutive days without a new confirmed case on 7 July, suggesting the outbreak may be ending there; response remains challenged by mistrust, insecurity, funding gaps, limited treatment capacity and gaps in contact tracing. Central African Republic: Am-Dafock hosts about 11,000 displaced since 30 June; the town's health facility has been looted and water remains scarce. On 4 July, 425 tarpaulins were delivered; roughly 24 tons of relief are stranded; 12 additional helicopter rotations are needed. About 1,000 new displaced arrived in Birao, joining roughly 25,000 Sudanese refugees. Cameroon: Far North cholera outbreak reports 331 cases and 12 deaths as of 9 July; Mada and Makary confirmed; suspected transmission in Fotokol, Kolofata, Kousseri and Maroua 2; linked to a regional epidemic; response hampered by insecurity, logistics constraints and heavy rains; the region hosts nearly one million displaced. Chad: 9-10 July multisectoral assessment in Fouli and Kaya finds critical needs across seven displacement sites, with protection concerns from lack of identity documents and unaccompanied children; needs include protection, water, food and shelter, while partner coverage remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: 西・中央アフリカ：最新情勢概観（2026年7月7日～13日）
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,926例確定、複数州にまたがり死亡率も高い）が継続しており、治安・資金・接触者追跡の課題により対応が困難な状況であるため、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念としてフルRRAの検討が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Haut-Uele、Tshopoにまたがる）とカメルーンのコレラ流行、中央アフリカ共和国・チャドの避難民危機を含む地域概況報告。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみで、カメルーン・中央アフリカ共和国・チャドは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。South Kivuでは新規症例が42日間報告されておらず収束の兆候があるが、Ituriが依然として大部分を占め深刻な状況が継続。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية.. 1963 إصابة بإيبولا والصحة : العدد الحقيقي أضعاف - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo... 1963 Ebola infection and health: the real number is several times higher
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the true number of Ebola virus disease infections is at least two, potentially four times higher than official counts. WHO says estimates based on models suggest the outbreak size may be 2–4 times detected cases. The National Institute of Public Health says the outbreak has reached two additional northeastern regions, Ou Willy and Choobo. Official counts show 1,963 confirmed cases nationwide and 719 deaths. The latest outbreak, the 17th, was declared on May 15, centered largely in Ituri, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of the sick and infected animals. Investigations indicate all cases in Ou Willy and Choobo are largely imported from Nyania in Ituri; these areas are now considered part of the outbreak zone. The United States reaffirmed commitment to work with the DRC to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国…エボラ感染1963例、保健当局「実際の数はさらに数倍に上る」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク(第17次)が公式集計1963例・死亡719例に達し、WHOは実数がさらに多い可能性を指摘。複数地域への拡大と国際的関与(米国の支援表明)があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGhana、United States、Upper East Regionが含まれるが、記事本文はDRCのエボラ流行のみを主題としており、これらは米国の支援表明等の言及に過ぎないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: New US Ebola patient arrives in Germany for treatment
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, a U.S. national who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo arrived in Frankfurt, Germany, for treatment and was transferred to a university hospital. The patient, in his 60s, is described by Samaritan's Purse as a full-time warehouse manager who worked in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, where the current Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak began in mid-May—the 17th outbreak in the DRC. The World Health Organization reports that the patient received clinical care and close monitoring and was safely moved to Germany for continued follow-up. A previous Ebola patient, also American, had been treated in Berlin weeks earlier. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or cure. Separately, the Trump administration announced restrictions preventing U.S. citizens in the DRC from traveling to the United States on commercial flights.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな米国人エボラ患者が治療のためドイツに到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ株エボラ（第17次アウトブレイク、承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし）で、国際的な患者搬送や米国による渡航制限が発生しており、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはドイツ・米国が含まれるが、これらは患者搬送・治療先であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）のみ。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、既に2人の米国人患者がドイツへ搬送されている点は国際的拡大リスクを示す。米国政府によるDRC発の渡航制限も発表されている。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Ibu Hamil di Blitar Reaktif HIV, Dinkes Dampingi hingga Persalinan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 Pregnant Women in Blitar Are HIV-Reactive, Health Department Escorts Them Through Delivery
article.articleSummary: Five pregnant women in Blitar Regency, East Java, Indonesia, tested reactive for HIV during mandatory antenatal screening for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B (reported June 14, 2026). The Blitar Health Office has placed these cases under close supervision, with monthly prenatal checkups to monitor mother and fetus until delivery. While the exact route of infection is not disclosed, officials note HIV spreads through certain body fluids. Healthcare authorities have prepared first-level facilities, including puskesmas, with trained staff to assist deliveries for HIV-reactive mothers. The screening program aims to detect infections early and reduce mother-to-child transmission. Pregnant women are urged to undergo routine pregnancy testing and the HIV/syphilis/hepatitis B screenings to ensure safe outcomes for mother and baby.

triage.headline_ja: ブリタール県の妊婦5人がHIV反応陽性、保健局が出産まで付き添い支援
triage.triage_reason: 地域の定期妊婦健診で判明した既知のHIV陽性例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性・国際的拡大リスクはなく、通常の母子感染予防対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 妊婦健診における個別症例の報告であり、通常の公衆衛生プログラム運用の一環。アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Pedro Teixeira intensifica vacinação antirrábica após confirmação de morcego com raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pedro Teixeira steps up rabies vaccination after confirmation of a bat with rabies
article.articleSummary: Pedro Teixeira Municipal Health Department will conduct a home-to-home anti-rabies vaccination on July 15 from 8:00 to 16:00 after confirming a bat in the municipality tested positive for rabies. The campaign aims to reinforce protection for dogs, cats, and residents by expanding vaccination coverage among domestic animals. Rabies is a viral disease transmissible to humans through bites, scratches, or contact with saliva of infected animals; vaccination remains the primary prevention method and a key public health safeguard. Health authorities urge residents to welcome vaccination teams and keep their pets up to date on rabies vaccination to help control the disease and protect the community. The initiative underscores proactive measures following the bat-confirmed case, and local residents should ensure access to vaccination for eligible animals during the scheduled hours.

triage.headline_ja: ペドロ・テイシェイラ市、狂犬病感染コウモリ確認を受けワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: コウモリ1匹の狂犬病陽性確認を受けた通常の予防接種キャンペーンであり、人への感染事例はなく公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 動物(コウモリ)での狂犬病確認に伴う予防的なワクチン接種活動であり、地域の日常的な公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Προειδοποίηση για τον ιό Ζίκα: Ραγδαία αύξηση κρουσμάτων μετά από διακοπές σε δημοφιλείς προορισμούς
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about the Zika virus: Rapid increase in cases after holidays in popular destinations.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, UK health authorities warn of a rapid rise in Zika virus infections linked to popular holiday destinations, with nine UK cases this year—already higher than seven in all of 2025. Zika, transmitted mainly by Aedes mosquitoes and, rarely, via sexual contact, has no vaccine; prevention centers on avoiding mosquito bites. Symptoms resemble fever, headache, eye pain, joint swelling, and rash, though infections can be more severe, and pregnant women face risk of severe brain damage in developing fetuses. Most UK cases originate from travel to Indonesia (4) and Thailand (2), with individual exposures linked to Malaysia, the Maldives, and Singapore. Authorities fear imported cases as travelers return home. The alert also notes ongoing travel-associated cases of chikungunya, dengue fever, malaria, and enteric fever.

triage.headline_ja: ジカウイルスに関する警告：人気観光地への旅行後に感染例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 英国内での輸入症例（年間9例）に関する注意喚起であり、対象国（インドネシア・タイなど）における具体的な流行拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は英国での旅行関連輸入症例の増加を報告しているのみで、インドネシアやタイなど渡航先国での具体的な流行状況やアウトブレイクの記述はない。渡航先はあくまで感染源として言及されているに過ぎず、対象国での公衆衛生イベントとしては確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupació a Àfrica: La lluita contra l'ébola en l'aire per la vaga del personal sanitari al Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern in Africa: The fight against Ebola is up in the air due to the healthcare workers' strike in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) faces a new obstacle as epidemiologists, investigators, drivers and undertakers at Rwampara General Hospital go on strike over two months of unpaid salaries and bonuses. The protest, including hospital closure, roadblock and burning a tire, threatens surveillance, isolation, contact tracing and safe burials. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less common strain with no licensed vaccine or specifically approved treatment, and has spread beyond Ituri to two other provinces, with many new infections from unidentified transmission chains. Since May 15, there have been at least 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. An experimental-treatment trial continues at another Ituri hospital; a second U.S. aid worker infected in eastern Congo has been evacuated to Germany, joining a previously infected American doctor.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで懸念:コンゴの医療従事者ストライキでエボラとの闘いが宙に浮く
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行(1926症例・702死亡)が継続中で複数州に拡大、加えて医療従事者ストライキにより監視・隔離・埋葬対応が機能不全に陥っており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ドイツは感染した米国人援助者の後送先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認の稀少株(Bundibugyo)による大規模流行に加え、医療スト・不明感染経路の増加という複合的リスクがあり、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rapidez con que avanza brote de ébola alarma a la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The speed with which the Ebola outbreak is advancing alarms the WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the third-largest on record, with the fastest month-on-month growth, according to the WHO on July 14, 2026. As of July 11, the DRC had 1,926 laboratory-confirmed cases and 702 deaths across five provinces; most new infections originate from unknown transmission chains, with about 80% outside known contact lists. The outbreak is outpacing response capacity, prompting projections that total cases could be two to four times the confirmed figure. Positive measures include more than 700 Ebola beds, 14 diagnostic laboratories (up from one), and over 21,000 trained community workers; safer, dignified burials have improved. However, funding remains insufficient: only 40% of the $115 million requested has been received. Emphasis remains on earlier case detection, rapid contact tracing, and accessible healthcare facilities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の急速な拡大にWHOが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行が過去最速ペースで拡大しており、感染経路不明例が多数（約80%）で資金不足も深刻なため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 1,926例確認・702人死亡、5州に拡大。約80%が既知の接触者リスト外からの感染で、実際の感染者数は確認数の2〜4倍と推定。資金は要求額の40%のみ確保されている状況で、WHOが強い懸念を表明。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza y golpea a 6 provincias en El Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances and hits six provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo advances northeast, spreading to Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces, bringing affected regions to six since May 15, 2026 when the WHO declared the emergency. The outbreak began in Ituri and moved into North Kivu and South Kivu; Nya Nya, the main dispersion hub. Counts report 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, including fatalities in Tshopo and Haut-Uele. WHO warns true impact may be much higher, with about 80% of new infections lacking a clear epidemiological link, indicating substantial underreporting. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no licensed vaccine, and WHO advised against Ervebo due to low efficacy against this variant. Conflict in the region hampers containment, with the rebel alliance CRF autonomously controlling eastern areas and fighting between rival authorities complicating data sharing. Over 120 armed groups prolong the crisis; this outbreak may be the region's gravest since 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の6州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOが緊急事態を宣言した大規模エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、致死率・感染者数ともに高く、有効なワクチンがなく紛争により封じ込めが困難という深刻な国際的懸念事案であるため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には認可済みワクチンがなく、Ervebo投与も推奨されていない点、80%の症例で疫学的リンク不明という過小報告の可能性、120以上の武装勢力による紛争が対応を妨げている点が特に懸念される。2018-2020年以来最悪の流行との指摘あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO varuje, že epidémia eboly v KDR môže byť až štyrikrát väčšia, než ukazujú údaje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola epidemic in the DRC could be up to four times larger than the data indicate.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province in the northeast, may be 2–4 times larger than official counts. Congolese authorities report over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths since the outbreak began two months ago. WHO estimates the true caseload is significantly higher, describing the epidemic as the third-largest in history and the fastest-spreading Ebola hotspot recorded. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri, where armed groups operate; the outbreak has also appeared in four other provinces and in neighboring Uganda. Many deaths occur at home before patients reach healthcare facilities. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO notes expanding treatment/testing capacity and improving contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行はデータが示す規模の最大4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し(1960人以上感染、700人以上死亡)、隣国ウガンダにも越境、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる史上3番目に大きい流行とWHOが指摘しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス種であり、武装勢力の活動地域での対応困難さも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Ebola Menyebar Lagi ke Dua Provinsi di Republik Demokratik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spreading again to two provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces in the southwestern region. Total Ebola cases rise to 1,926, with 702 deaths reported to date. The latest update records four new cases in Tshopo, including two deaths, while one death was reported in Haut-Uele. The information indicates ongoing transmission within these two provinces as health authorities monitor the evolving outbreak. The report does not provide further details on infection sources or laboratory confirmation. The figures highlight the sustained severity of the outbreak across multiple provinces. Public health authorities continue surveillance and response efforts to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国の2つの州に再び拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの複数州に拡大し、累計1,926症例・702死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 致死率は約36%と高く、複数州への拡大が確認されている。感染源や検査確定に関する詳細情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: La peste sigue presente: ¿por qué aún se registran casos y cómo un diagnóstico tardío puede ser mortal?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague remains present: why cases are still being recorded and how a late diagnosis can be deadly.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains present worldwide, with up to about 3,000 cases reported annually. Current hotspots are the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and Madagascar, which continues to report 250–500 cases per year after a significant 2017 outbreak; isolated cases also occur in western United States. Caused by Yersinia pestis, plague manifests as bubonic plague (fleas feeding on infected rodents), septicemic plague (bacteria in the bloodstream), or pneumonic plague (lungs with human-to-human transmission via droplets). A notable U.S. case involved Paul Gaylord, who developed plague after a cat bite; initial treatment for cat-scratch disease failed, he deteriorated to ICU coma, and plague was laboratory-confirmed; he survived. Untreated plague mortality approaches 100%. Historical context includes medieval pandemics and Europe’s last cases in 1945 (Corsica). Public health efforts emphasize rapid diagnosis and international collaboration, including Robert Koch Institute work with Madagascar to strengthen diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは今も存在する：なぜ今も症例が報告され続けるのか、そして診断の遅れがいかに致命的になり得るか
triage.triage_reason: ペストに関する一般的・教育的な解説記事であり、新規の具体的アウトブレイク報告ではないが、コンゴ民主共和国が現在のホットスポットとして言及されており、地域流行の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はペストに関する世界的な背景解説であり、コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ・マダガスカルが現在のホットスポットとして挙げられているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。具体的な新規症例数や発生時期の詳細情報がなく、続報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊7.9万例 疾控提醒 夏季感染率上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, 79,000 newly confirmed COVID-19 cases; the CDC reminds that infection rates rise in summer.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 saw 79,000 newly confirmed COVID-19 cases in China, with 130 severe cases and 1 death among individuals with underlying diseases. Genomic surveillance from June 1–30 across 31 provinces plus Xinjiang reported 3,741 valid SARS-CoV-2 genomes, all Omicron variants, with no new high-risk mutation detected; the dominant circulating sublineage is Omicron NB.1.8.1. Most summer infections are mild; severe cases occur mainly in the elderly with multiple comorbidities. Contributing factors include waning vaccine-induced immunity, Omicron immune escape, and summer behaviors—indoor air-conditioned environments with limited ventilation and increased travel. Public guidance urges regular routines, balanced diet, exercise, and continued personal protection. JD Pharmacy data show doubled sales of COVID self-tests and rising influenza and COVID medication orders, with Paxlovid and other antivirals up 47–62% week-over-week in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Shanghai.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ新規確定患者7.9万例、疾病予防管理センターが夏季の感染率上昇を注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19感染者数増加であり、既知のOmicron系統で新規高リスク変異は検出されておらず、通常の季節性動向として管理可能なため。
triage.notes: 既知のOmicron変異株(NB.1.8.1)による季節性増加であり、新規変異なし。重症例は基礎疾患のある高齢者に限られる。中国CDCによる通常の公衆衛生広報の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: هشدار تازه درباره ایبولا؛ موارد واقعی در کانگو بیشتر از آمار اعلام‌شده است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fresh warning about Ebola; actual cases in the Congo are higher than the reported figures.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization officials warn that the true number of Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern provinces is at least two to four times higher than officially reported. Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO Assistant Director-General for Emergency Preparedness and Response, said after traveling to eastern DRC in Geneva on Tuesday that the outbreak’s scale is likely undercounted by a factor of two to four. Ebola is an often severe, hemorrhagic viral illness that can cause internal and external bleeding. The report underscores gaps in case detection and surveillance amid the ongoing outbreak in eastern Congo. No exact case or death tally is provided in the article. The information emphasizes the need for expanded surveillance and public health response to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに関する新たな警告；コンゴでの実際の症例数は公表されている統計よりも多い
triage.triage_reason: WHO幹部がエボラ出血熱の実際の症例数が公表値の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 正確な症例数・死亡者数は記事内で明示されていないが、WHO当局者が過小報告の可能性を指摘しており監視体制の強化が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: à l'INRB, l'AFD réaffirme l'engagement de la France et salue " un rôle de sentinelle pour le monde " face aux épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: At INRB, the AFD reaffirms France's commitment and welcomes "a sentinel role for the world" in the face of epidemics.
article.articleSummary: During July 13–15, 2026, in Kinshasa, France’s AFD director-general Christophe Lecourtier visited the Democratic Republic of Congo’s National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) amid the ongoing 17th Ebola virus outbreak in eastern DRC. INRB Director-General Jean-Jacques Muyembe Tamfum highlighted France’s long-standing support and the expansion of a national laboratory network, with facilities in Kinkole, Mbankana, Maluku, and other sites, to bolster identification, treatment and prevention of infectious diseases. Lecourtier praised Muyembe and reaffirmed France’s financial backing for Ebola response, notably in Ituri and other provinces, announcing new investments including a future administrative building. The visit underscored INRB’s sentinel role for public health—protecting Congo and serving as a reference for Europe and the world—through sequencing, prevention, and outbreak response. RDC remains a top AFD priority with over €731 million across 35 projects in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:INRBにてAFDがフランスの関与を再確認し、疫病対策における『世界の哨戒的役割』を称賛
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で継続中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する内容であり、エボラは重篤性・国際拡大リスクからIHR基準を複数満たすため、継続監視対象として取り上げる。
triage.notes: 記事自体はフランスAFDによる資金・技術支援に関する外交訪問報道であり、新規症例数や死亡者数などの疫学的更新情報は含まれていない。ただし『第17次エボラ流行』が継続中である事実が確認されるため、進行中のアウトブレイクとして継続監視が必要。フランスはIHR対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UP Screens 31 Lakh People, Detects 1.85 Lakh TB Patients During 100-Day Campaign
article.articleSummary: Uttar Pradesh led the 100-day TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan 2.0, screening more than 31 lakh people and detecting 1.85 lakh new TB patients, including about 52,000 asymptomatic cases. A Technical Conclave at AIIMS Gorakhpur highlighted tech- and surveillance-driven progress, emphasizing early detection, rapid diagnosis, prompt treatment and continuous surveillance. The state deployed 308 AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines, delivering 30.4 lakh chest X-rays (target 27.3 lakh). NAAT testing operated at 1,414 centers, with 7.52 lakh of 8.19 lakh enrolled undergoing confirmatory testing. January–June 2026 saw 3.37 lakh TB cases notified against an annual target of seven lakh (48% of yearly target; 96% of pro-rata). High-risk villages reached: 25,073 of 26,722 (94%). The March 24 launch prioritizes population-level, risk-based screening beyond symptoms, with multi-stakeholder support and next-phase planning led by UP and AIIMS Gorakhpur.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州、100日間キャンペーンで310万人をスクリーニングし18万5千人のTB患者を検出
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるTBに対する政府主導のスクリーニングキャンペーンの成果報告であり、異常な公衆衛生事象ではなく、通常の疾病対策プログラムの一環である。
triage.notes: 結核（TB）はインドで既知の風土病であり、本記事は政府の検診・治療キャンペーンの実績報告。新規異常事象ではないためシグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: A WHO figyelmeztet: nem sikerült megfékezni az Ebola-járványt Közép-Afrikában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns: the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa could not be contained.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could not be contained. The actual number of infected Ebola patients is at least twice, and possibly up to four times, the figures in official statistics, according to WHO’s head of crisis operations. This discrepancy underscores ongoing underreporting amid a protracted outbreak in Central Africa. The WHO official criticized the organization’s funding for outbreak response, noting it has received less than half of the resources required to sustain measures. The article highlights the gravity of the situation in the DRC and the urgent need for increased funding and robust public health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告:中央アフリカでエボラ流行を封じ込められず
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を封じ込められていないと警告し、実際の感染者数が公式統計の2〜4倍に上る可能性があるとしており、国際的拡大リスクと資金不足による対応能力の懸念が示されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOの危機対応責任者が過小報告を指摘し、資金不足が対応能力に影響していると警告している。続報でのRRAにて詳細な感染者数・地域拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola sigue creciendo a un ritmo más rápido que la respuesta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to grow at a faster pace than the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the third-largest in the country’s history, expanding faster than the response. As of July 11, authorities confirmed 1,926 cases and 702 deaths across five provinces. A major challenge is that 80% of new infections arise from transmission chains not captured in existing contact lists, indicating undetected spread. Many victims died in communities without access to health facilities, hampering containment and contact tracing. International response has improved since last month, with more than 700 beds for Ebola patients, the expansion from one to 14 diagnostic laboratories, and over 21,000 community health workers being trained. Safe and dignified burials are being implemented to reduce transmission at funerals. However, response capacity remains constrained by funding gaps: only 40% of the $115 million requested has been received.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は対応よりも速いペースで拡大し続けている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行が拡大しており、感染連鎖の80%が追跡不能で国際的拡大・資金不足による対応能力の限界が懸念される。
triage.notes: 資金は要請額1.15億ドルの40%のみ確保されており、対応能力の制約が継続的な感染拡大の主要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Duits: Erste Studie am Menschen: Impfstoff gegen Bundibugyo-Variante des Ebola-Virus wird getestet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RT Deutsch: First human study: Vaccine against Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus is being tested.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola vaccine begins first-in-human testing in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Indian Serum Institute (SII) Pune leads development targeting the Bundibugyo variant, which has spread since May across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, areas affected by ongoing conflict. The Phase 1 trial enrolls 50 healthy adults to assess safety and immune response. For this phase, SII provides 4,000 doses, while over 620,000 doses have already been produced and stored for later trial stages and potential emergency approval. The candidate uses a chimpanzee adenovirus platform, the same one used in the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Existing Ebola vaccines target the Zaire variant and are not approved for Bundibugyo. Experts doubt an immediate impact on the current outbreak, with the vaccine framed mainly for future outbreak prevention. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids; WHO notes that stopping spread is necessary.

triage.headline_ja: RTドイツ：初のヒト試験、エボラウイルスのブンディブギョ変異株に対するワクチンが試験開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ変異株エボラの流行が継続しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性（希少変異株、既存ワクチン非対応）が認められるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン開発・製造拠点（Serum Institute of India, Pune）としての登場であり、実際の感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。エボラのブンディブギョ変異株はイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ州で5月以降流行中で、紛争地域という管理困難な状況にある。

article.articleHeadline: Stung by dengue cases, GCC steps up vector control drive across Chennai
article.articleSummary: Chennai logged 65 dengue cases in July 2026 as Greater Chennai Corporation intensified vector control with door-to-door fogging and domestic breeding checks. The city has 2,073 DBCs, with one checker per 500 homes. A survey of 8,000 new construction sites aims to prevent water stagnation; builders face notices if activity is paused for 15 days. Inspections in Tamil Nadu Urban Habitat Development Board complexes target open water drums fed by 1hp motors, with residents advised to cover the drums. Hotspots near the Cooum, Adyar river, and Buckingham Canal will be targeted for Culex mosquitoes, which breed in sewage water and can transmit Japanese encephalitis and West Nile fever. GCC commissioner issued a circular for intensified fogging and larvicide spraying from vehicle-mounted sprayers and urged adequate insecticide stocks. Domestic breeding checkers refer fever cases to PHCs; action reports are required. Last July averaged 10 cases/day; this July has 4/day so far.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例の増加を受け、チェンナイ市当局(GCC)が市内全域でベクター対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイの季節性デング熱に対する通常の行政対応（防疫強化）であり、症例数も前年同期より少なく、異常性や重大性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政の定例的なベクター対策活動を報じたもので、症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向（10件/日→4件/日）。日本脳炎・西ナイル熱は媒介蚊(Culex)の言及のみで、実際の患者発生報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS advierte que los casos de ébola en República Democrática del Congo podrían cuadruplicar las cifras oficiales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could quadruple the official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe, with WHO estimating real cases could be two to four times the official count. Official figures exceed 1,960 infections and 700 deaths since mid-May, when the hemorrhagic fever outbreak was declared. Initial case detection occurred in Ituri province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele, and 20 cases reported in Uganda. Described by WHO’s Chikwe Ihekweazu as one of the largest and fastest-growing outbreaks within a month, the crisis underscores that transmission outpaces response, despite about 80% of contacts being traced. The WHO urges accelerated case detection, rapid contact tracing, and ensuring health facilities are accessible and trusted by communities, including cross-border risk mitigation, to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数は公式統計の4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行がDRCで進行中で、公式統計を大幅に上回る可能性がWHOから指摘されており、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。致死率が高く（700名死亡/1960名感染）、WHOが公式統計の過小評価を警告する深刻な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola en Ituri : renforcement des mesures d'assainissement du fichier des prestataires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Response in Ituri: Strengthening Sanitation Measures for the Providers' Registry
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centers on tightening control and sanitation of the providers registry involved in the outbreak response. Two months after the resurgence was officially declared, the Health Secretary General chaired a Bunia meeting to evaluate the response, focusing on human-resource management and payment of providers. He urged zone medical chiefs to submit reliable, up-to-date lists, enabling the National Institute of Public Health to pay only active providers, with ANICNS supporting digitalization to ensure transparency, traceability, and efficient fund use. Digitalization has begun in Bunia and Rwampara and will expand to other Ituri health zones via mobile units, enrolling about 400 providers daily. Notable progress includes diagnostic capacity expansion with new laboratories, construction of Ebola Treatment Centers, and more evacuation ambulances. Payments await validation by Medical Chiefs of Zone and provincial health inspectors; fictitious providers are under investigation, and all funds will be audited by the IGF. The aim remains to break the Ebola transmission chain in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ対応:提供者登録簿の衛生管理措置強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で再燃した流行が継続しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イツリ州における既存のエボラ流行対応（人材管理・資金透明性強化）に焦点を当てており、ルワンダへの拡大については言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : au camp de Kigonze, la peur d'Ebola s'ajoute à une précarité extrême
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: at the Kigonze camp, the fear of Ebola adds to extreme precarity.
article.articleSummary: At Kigonze camp in Ituri province, Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 20,000 internally displaced people live in dire sanitary conditions as the Ebola threat looms. Access to safe water and toilets is severely limited: the site relies on a single water point and about 300 toilets for over 5,000 households, most of which are unusable, aggravating pollution and disease risk. Malaria, typhoid and other water-and-sanitation–related infections are widespread. Since May, at least 50 residents have died in the camp; June tests confirmed that some deaths were Ebola-related, fueling fear. Camp leadership warns that prevention measures are inadequate, appealing for protective kits and additional resources to curb spread. A clinic and a treatment center are under construction, but conditions and supply gaps leave the situation vulnerable to a worsening Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:キゴンゼ避難民キャンプで、極度の困窮に加えエボラへの恐怖が広がる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州の避難民キャンプでエボラ感染による死亡が検査で確認されており、劣悪な衛生環境下でマラリア・腸チフスも蔓延、感染拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 20,000人以上が居住する避難民キャンプで水・トイレ設備が著しく不足し、5月以降50人以上が死亡、6月の検査で一部エボラ関連死が確認されている。キャンプ側は防護具・資源の不足を訴えており、外部支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例 男子遊泰確診茲卡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case: man who traveled to Thailand diagnosed with Zika.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, Taiwan's CDC confirms the year's first domestically imported Zika virus infection. A man in his 30s from northern Taiwan returned from Thailand in mid-June with fever, dizziness, and headache; a late-June rash prompted hospital care, and laboratory testing confirmed Zika virus infection. Contacts and cohabitants are asymptomatic; local authorities conducted environmental source cleanup and contact tracing at the patient’s activity area. Zika virus is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, sexual contact, and mother-to-child transmission. Symptoms commonly include fever, rash, and arthralgia; infection during pregnancy can cause fetal microcephaly or death. With up to 80% of infections asymptomatic, preventive measures are essential. Post-travel, men should practice safe sex for 3 months and women for 2 months. Pregnant women should defer travel to Zika-endemic regions such as Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初症例:タイ旅行後の男性がジカ熱と診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内で確認された単発の輸入例であり、接触者は無症状、環境対策も実施済みで、国際的拡大や重篤な公衆衛生上の影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 患者は台湾在住でタイ旅行後に発症・診断されたケース。実際の診断・対応は台湾内で行われており、対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。タイでの感染機会は言及されているが、事象の中心（診断・対応）は台湾であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Philippine student dies after school deworming activity
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 — A Grade 4 student in Cavite province, southwest of Manila, died after a routine school deworming activity. The deworming was conducted July 2 at a public elementary school in coordination with the local health office; the student died July 3 after hospitalization for vomiting. Initial medical findings link the death to septic shock caused by an infection. Several students reportedly fell ill following the event. The Department of Education says health authorities are reviewing the circumstances and investigating the incident. Deworming activities are held twice a year under the department’s program to rid students of intestinal parasites that cause nutritional deficiencies. No further details on the infection source or other cases are provided; authorities are investigating the incident.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンの学生、学校での駆虫活動後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡例で感染源や病原体が特定されておらず、他の患者との関連性も不明であるため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 感染性が疑われる敗血症性ショックによる死亡だが、感染源・病原体は未特定。他の発症者の詳細も不明で、教育省が調査中とのこと。続報での病原体特定・感染経路の情報を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من وباء إيبولا ووتيرته المتسارعة في الانتشار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of the Ebola outbreak and its accelerating spread.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is spreading at the fastest pace recorded, with around 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths across five provinces. Epicenter Bunia, Ituri, where a WHO mission led by Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu confirmed more than 80 new cases in 24 hours; roughly 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, complicating response. The true case load could be 2–4 times higher than official counts. The virus has moved toward Haut-Uele and Tshopo. WHO urges sustained interventions in the epicenter and stronger movement surveillance to prevent new foci. Community deaths before care are rising; early detection is essential to limit transmission. No approved treatment exists yet for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though several experimental therapies are under evaluation. International partners are urged to boost support for DRC, alongside Geneva negotiations on pathogen sharing and benefits.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラ出血熱の流行とその急速な拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約2000人の確定症例と700人超の死亡者を伴うエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）が記録的な速さで拡大しており、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占め、複数州に拡大していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: スイス（ジュネーブ）は病原体共有交渉の開催地として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。承認された治療法がなく、真の症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性があるとされ、国際的な支援強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Ocho de cada 10 nuevos casos de ébola en Congo provienen de "cadenas desconocidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight out of ten new Ebola cases in Congo originate from "unknown transmission chains."
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri province, with spread across three provinces and cases also in neighboring Uganda. As of Monday, at least 1,926 people infected and 702 deaths have been reported. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. About 80% of new infections are from unknown transmission chains not linked to declared contacts, and many deaths occurred in communities that did not seek care at health facilities. Response capacity in Bunia has expanded to roughly 800 treatment beds and laboratories increased from 1 to 14, but funding gaps, attacks on health centers, ongoing east Congo conflict, and community mistrust hinder containment. The outbreak was declared on May 15, with clinical trials of treatments starting recently. On July 11, a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive for Ebola, with few details disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ新規感染例の10件中8件は「不明な感染連鎖」に由来
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイク（感染1,926人・死亡702人）で、未承認治療・ワクチン、感染経路不明が8割、国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大、米国人感染者発生など、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。米国人感染者の発生は国際的な関心・渡航への影響につながる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 2 Covid deaths in Andhra, 8 cases reported: Could it lead to a fresh outbreak?
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, Andhra Pradesh reported two Covid-19 deaths and eight new positive cases, with the fatalities marking the first since 2002. The 60-year-old man died June 28 after care at Tirupati’s Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences and Christian Medical College, Vellore; postmortem RT-PCR confirmed Covid-19. The 46-year-old Kadapa patient, admitted with acute breathing problems, died from deteriorating lung damage and pneumonia, with chest CT showing extensive Covid-compatible injury. Some clinicians fear a more virulent Omicron subvariant driving a surge, but Health Secretary S. Suresh Kumar says the rise is sporadic and a five-member committee has ruled out a new subvariant; no new cases in six days. Health authorities have stepped up contact tracing and testing; five Kadapa cases and three related contacts identified. Odisha heightened surveillance; Tamil Nadu reports no evidence of a high-severity strain, with lower case numbers than in prior years.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で新型コロナ死者2人、感染8例報告――新たな流行の兆しか？
triage.triage_reason: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で2002年以来初のCOVID-19死亡例が報告されたが、当局は散発的事例と判断し新変異株の存在を否定しており、直近6日間新規感染なし。情報が限定的で継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 当局は5人からなる委員会により新変異株の可能性を否定し、散発事例と結論。オディシャ州は監視強化、タミルナドゥ州は高重症度株の証拠なしと報告。COVID-19自体は既知の疾患であり、現時点で国際的拡大やIHR通報相当の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Wie der Kongo-Konflikt dem Ebola-Virus in die Karten spielt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the Congo Conflict Is Playing into the Ebola Virus's Hands
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province near Bunia reports the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Kigonze refugee camp, home to about 20,000 internally displaced people. In June Ebola was detected in deceased individuals for the first time, with up to six deaths per day since then. Through mid-July there were 1,963 confirmed infections and 719 deaths in the DRC, with 20 infections and 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after the May outbreak. Ongoing conflict hampers response: overcrowded camps, displacement, and armed control of areas disrupt case finding, vaccination, and medical logistics. Historical patterns show violence raising transmission (R rising from about 0.8 during vaccination to 1.9 after attacks, then falling). In Ituri, the AFC/M23 coalition’s control complicates containment. Parallel cholera crises in Yemen and Sudan illustrate the broader risk landscape.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ紛争がエボラウイルスをいかに利しているか
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が拡大し、WHOがPHEICを宣言、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されており、紛争により対応が阻害されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・スーダン・イエメンも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアが主発生地。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: CEPI-backed Ebola vaccine set to enter phase 1 trials
article.articleSummary: ChAdOx1 BDBV, the first vaccine candidate targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is set to enter phase 1 trials in the United Kingdom, enrolling 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 to assess safety and immune response. Recruitment is underway; first vaccinations are expected in the coming weeks after regulatory review. Developed by the University of Oxford's Oxford Vaccine Group with the Serum Institute of India on the same platform as the AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, the candidate is backed by CEPI in an $8.6 million partnership to accelerate trials amid the outbreak declared May 15 in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. To date, Serum Institute has supplied 4,000 investigational doses, with 620,000 additional doses stored for future use. If phase 1 succeeds, CEPI intends to support late-stage trials to seek emergency approval and licensure.

triage.headline_ja: CEPI支援のエボラワクチン、第1相試験開始へ
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチンの第1相治験開始であり、新規の流行拡大や重症化に関する情報はないが、DRCでの既存アウトブレイクに関連するため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月15日にDRC・ウガンダで宣言されたブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行への対応としてのワクチン開発ニュースであり、流行そのものの新規情報（症例数・重症度等）は含まれていない。ウガンダ・インド・英国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : adhésion " progressive " des déplacés de Kigonze aux mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the Kigonze displaced gradually adhere to barrier measures - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo: at the Kigonze displacement site in Bunia, Ituri, as of July 14, 2026, a gradual behavioral change toward barrier measures is observed among displaced populations. Olive Kapara, CREC risk-communication and community engagement focal point at the site, reports increasing awareness of Ebola's severity and growing compliance with preventive measures, though further reinforcement is needed. Health responders continue localized sensitization to encourage protective behaviors and facilitate rapid identification of suspected cases. The improving cooperation between displaced residents and health teams is cited as a significant achievement in the Ebola response. However, disinformation persists and fuels some resistance, underscoring the need to sustain risk-communication efforts and to involve community leaders to build trust and limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ:キゴンゼ避難民、感染予防策の順守が徐々に進む - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、エボラは重篤性・国際的拡大リスクが高い疾患のためIHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 本記事は避難民キャンプでのリスクコミュニケーション進捗に関する内容であり、新規症例数や致死率などの具体的疫学データは含まれていないが、既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の一環として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: AIP-Côte d'Ivoire/Inter: L'OMS alerte sur une épidémie d'Ebola plus étendue que les chiffres officiels
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIP-Côte d'Ivoire/Inter: WHO warns of an Ebola outbreak more widespread than the official figures.
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 – The World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, may be undercounted by two to four times the official figures. While detection and surveillance have improved, the virus is spreading rapidly, with many cases identified only after death, hindering contact tracing. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the outbreak has extended to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele; cases have also emerged in Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission risk. The WHO calls it among the largest and fastest Ebola outbreaks in DRC since 1976. Response gains include more treatment centers, stronger laboratory capacity, and better contact follow-up; clinical trials of new therapies and a post-exposure prophylaxis plan are being developed. Health workers report salary and risk-pay delays; the government says payments will be regularized. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: AIP-コートジボワール/Inter: WHOがエボラ流行は公式統計より拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がWHOにより1976年以降最大級・最速級と警告され、複数州への拡大とウガンダへの越境感染も報告されているため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。公式統計は実際の2〜4倍過小評価の可能性がWHOにより指摘されており、監視・対応体制の強化が急務。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Pune's Serum Institute ships 4,000 Ebola vax doses to UK for phase I human trial | Pune News
article.articleSummary: 4,000 investigational Ebola vaccine doses targeting Bundibugyo strain were shipped from Pune's Serum Institute of India to the UK for a Phase I trial in London, involving 50 healthy volunteers aged 18-55 and monitored for 30 days. Cleared by the UK MHRA, the University of Oxford-led trial will seed Phase II/III studies in African countries. The vaccine uses the ChAdOx1 adenovirus platform—the same vector as Covishield—based on a master seed provided by Oxford on June 6, with readiness achieved in 14 days. SII reports 6.2 lakh doses in readiness, including 1.1 lakh finished products. The CEPI-funded US$8.6 million program supports Oxford and SII to advance Bundibugyo-vaccine development. Ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths, underscoring urgency to evaluate vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: プネーのセラム・インスティテュートがエボラワクチン4,000回分を英国に発送、第I相臨床試験へ
triage.triage_reason: 記事本体はワクチン輸送に関するものだが、DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が確認例1,792例・死亡625例と深刻であり、国際的なワクチン開発支援が進行中であることから公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はインド・セラム社製ワクチンの英国への出荷と第I相治験だが、背景としてDRCで進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（確認例1,792、死亡625）が言及されており、これが実際の疾病発生地。インドと英国はワクチン製造・治験実施地であり、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo cresce e já é o 3º maior, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo grows and is already the third largest, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the third largest in history and continues expanding faster than health authorities can respond. As of July 11, 2026, 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths have been reported across five provinces, with the epidemic showing the fastest month-on-month case growth among all outbreaks. About 80% of newly confirmed cases are not linked to monitored contacts, indicating transmission through unknown chains and hampering case tracing and interruption. Many victims died in their communities before receiving care, raising the risk of further transmission. Response capacity has increased but remains insufficient: hospital capacity exceeds 700 beds for Ebola patients, diagnostics are available in 14 laboratories (up from 1), and over 21,000 community workers have been trained. Safe burial protocols have been strengthened, but funding remains a constraint, with only 40% of the $115 million requested secured.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が拡大、WHOによると史上3番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上3番目の規模に拡大し、致死率も高く、感染経路不明な症例が8割を占めるなど国際的拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 致死率約36.5%（702/1926）と非常に高く、資金不足（要請額の40%のみ確保）が対応能力を制限している。5州にまたがる拡大が続いており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Much Larger Than Official Figures, WHO Says
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Africa is much larger than official counts. In the DRC, the outbreak centers on Ituri and North Kivu and South Kivu; 20 confirmed cases have been detected in Uganda. Official figures report nearly 2,000 infections and over 700 deaths, but WHO emergencies director Chikwe Ihekweazu says the real scale is at least two to four times higher, with many unrecorded. The WHO has received less than half of the $115 million needed for the first six months. Many new cases die in communities before care; hospital treatment with IV fluids and oxygen improves survival. The Bundibugyo strain originated in Uganda; there is no cure or vaccine. US travel rules tighten for DR Congo, barring some citizens from returning on commercial flights and demanding a 21-day stay in a third country; non-citizens from DRC/Uganda/South Sudan are blocked from entry.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、公式統計よりはるかに大規模とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心にエボラ出血熱が拡大し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されている。WHOは実際の感染規模が公式統計の2〜4倍に達すると警告し、米国は渡航制限を導入しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染確認や米国の渡航制限措置は言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta brote ébola podría ser de dos a cuatro veces superior
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns Ebola outbreak could be two to four times higher.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times higher than official counts, according to the WHO. As of mid-May, the country has reported over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths. The outbreak began in Ituri province near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda and has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Alto Uele, with Uganda reporting 20 cases. WHO’s Chikwe Ihekweazu said the true scale is at least two to four times the registered figures, noting this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest to progress within a single month among those managed. Contact tracing is about 80%. Authorities emphasize earlier detection, intensified contact tracing, and ensuring health facilities are accessible, safe, and trusted by communities to strengthen the response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上3番目の規模かつ最速進行のエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例の感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。実際の感染者数が公式統計の2〜4倍に達する可能性がある点、また史上3番目の規模・最速進行という点で重大なアウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الأسرع انتشاراً وثالث أكبر موجة تاريخياً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the fastest-spreading and the third-largest wave in history.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the fastest-spreading and third-largest in history; this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. As of July 11, about 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been reported across five provinces, centered in Ituri (Bunia). The virus has recently spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The outbreak shows the fastest month-on-month growth since its start, with more than 80 confirmed cases in 24 hours. A large share of recent deaths occurred in communities without access to health facilities. About 80% of new cases are not on contact lists, indicating unknown transmission chains; the true size could be 2–4 times higher. Response focuses on containment in Ituri while mapping movement to anticipate hotspots; no approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo EBOV, though early supportive care improves survival.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は史上最速の拡大かつ史上3番目の規模
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、約2000症例・700人超死亡、未知感染連鎖の存在も指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: WHOがBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるDRC第17次流行として警告。5州に拡大し、80%の新規症例が接触者リスト外であることから、実際の規模は報告の2-4倍の可能性。承認された治療法は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha ready to tackle any COVID resurgence, claims Minister
article.articleSummary: Odisha, 14 July 2026: Health and Family Welfare Minister Mukesh Mahaling stated the state is fully prepared to tackle any resurgence of COVID-19, with all necessary measures in place and no reason for public panic. In a high-level review at Lok Seva Bhawan, officials assessed readiness, surveillance, and response strategies, confirming close coordination with the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to respond effectively to any eventuality. Mahaling urged citizens not to be swayed by rumours and to maintain essential health and hygiene protocols. The meeting, attended by Health Secretary Aswathy S., National Health Mission Director Brunda D., and other Health and Family Welfare Department officials, evaluated the state’s preparedness, surveillance mechanisms, and contingency plans for COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、COVID再流行に対応準備万全と大臣主張
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染再流行や症例増加の報告はなく、行政の準備態勢確認に関する会議報告に過ぎないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の症例急増ではなく、行政による予防的な準備状況の発表であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: J&K government declares leprosy a notifiable disease with immediate effect
article.articleSummary: Leprosy has been declared a notifiable disease in Jammu and Kashmir with immediate effect, under orders from Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha. Effective from 14 July 2026, all government and private healthcare facilities must mandatorily report every diagnosed leprosy case to designated health authorities. The directive enhances disease surveillance, enabling early diagnosis and timely treatment and aiming to curb further transmission. By mandating reporting across public and private sectors, the measure seeks to improve data collection, epidemiological tracking, and rapid public health response. The move aligns with national objectives to achieve a Leprosy-Free India through better monitoring, coordinated case management, and targeted interventions. This development marks a significant step in strengthening leprosy control in the region and supports ongoing public health measures to reduce incidence.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンムー・カシミール州政府、ハンセン病を届出義務疾患に即時指定
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患であるハンセン病のサーベイランス強化を目的とした行政措置であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病を届出疾患化する行政的施策であり、アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大の報告はない。サーベイランス制度改善のニュースであり、リスク評価対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: 'അനിൽ മേനോൻ ഇന്ത്യയിൽ പോളിയോ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളിൽ പങ്കാളിയായ ആൾ'|Anil Menon |Soyuz MS 29
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'The person who participated in polio activities in India'|Anil Menon|Soyuz MS 29
article.articleSummary: Anil Menon recounts his participation in polio vaccination campaigns in Indian villages, detailing firsthand experiences from on-the-ground efforts in India. The account highlights frontline immunization activities, community engagement, and the logistical challenges of delivering oral polio vaccines in rural settings.
