While in India, Menon collaborated with local health workers to reach children and address vaccine hesitancy, sharing insights into cultural considerations, training, and supervision of outreach teams. The narrative underscores the ongoing importance of polio eradication efforts in the region, illustrating how international voices can contribute to public health campaigns through field experience. The article, alongside space news about Russia's Soyuz MS-29 mission, centers on human-centered vaccination work and the enduring global commitment to preventing poliomyelitis.

triage.headline_ja: アニル・メノン、インドでのポリオ活動に参加した人物|アニル・メノン|ソユーズMS-29
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではなく、宇宙飛行士アニル・メノン氏の過去のポリオワクチン活動に関する回顧的な人物紹介記事であり、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオ流行の報告ではなく、宇宙飛行士の過去の人道支援活動を紹介する人物記事。ロシアはSoyuz MS-29宇宙ミッションの文脈でのみ言及されており、感染症発生地域ではない。インドについても現在進行中の発生事例ではなく過去の活動の回想であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS estime que l'épidémie est largement sous-estimée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WHO estimates that the outbreak is widely underestimated.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is likely far undercounted. The World Health Organization estimates the true number of cases could be two to four times higher than official tallies, even as case detection capacity improves daily. WHO Emergency Programme Chief Chikwe Ihekweazu stated projections indicate the outbreak comprises at least two to four times the currently recorded cases, with detection capabilities advancing. Government figures cited report at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. The warning emphasizes that the epidemic’s actual scale may be larger than reported due to evolving surveillance, underscoring the need for intensified testing, surveillance, and case finding in the DRC. The report focuses on Ebola in the DRC and the public health implications of underestimation. Keywords: Ebola, DRC, outbreak, surveillance, WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱DRCで:WHOは流行が大幅に過小評価されていると推定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例1,926人、死亡702人）がWHOにより過小評価と指摘されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（702/1926≒36%）、WHOが症例数を公式発表の2〜4倍と推定しており、サーベイランス強化が急務とされている。既存の大規模流行の継続報道であり、続報でのRRA更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Oms, 'l'epidemia di Ebola da 2 a 4 volte superiore a quella ufficiale' - Sanità
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO, "The Ebola epidemic is two to four times higher than the official one" - Health
article.articleSummary: On 14 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has official figures of over 1,960 cases and more than 700 deaths since its detection two months earlier, according to the World Health Organization. WHO emergencies chief Chikwe Ihekweazu said models indicate the true scale is at least two to four times higher than reported, making it one of the largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreaks to date. Declared on 15 May, the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC began in Ituri, a northeast province rich in minerals and affected by armed-group violence. Cases have been recorded in five Congolese provinces and in neighboring Uganda, with more than 90% of cases concentrated in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、「エボラ流行は公式発表の2〜4倍規模」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し、隣国ウガンダにも波及しており、WHOが公式統計より実際の規模が2〜4倍大きいと指摘するなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダへの感染拡大にも言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCの第17次エボラ流行で、5州に拡大し、公式統計の2〜4倍の規模との推計あり、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola sigue creciendo a un ritmo más rápido que la respuesta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to grow at a faster rate than the response.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to outpace response, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across five provinces as of July 11. The WHO calls it the third-largest outbreak on record and the fastest-growing in a single month. A key challenge is that 80% of new infections occur outside established contact lists, signaling transmission from unknown chains. Many deaths happened in the community before patients reached health facilities, hindering containment. On the response side, efforts have intensified: more than 700 beds for Ebola patients, 14 diagnostic laboratories, and training for over 21,000 community workers. Safer, dignified burial practices have improved transmission control. Funding remains a concern, with only 40% of the $115 million requested for operations in the country received.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、対応より速いペースで拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上3番目の規模かつ単月最速拡大と評価しており、致死率も高く、資金不足で対応が追いついていないためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 確定症例1,926例、死亡702例、5州に拡大。新規感染の80%が既知の接触者リスト外であり、未知の感染経路が示唆される。資金は要請額の40%のみ確保。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن تشدد قيود السفر إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية بسبب توسع تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington tightens travel restrictions to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to the expansion of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a widening Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths, as infections spread to new provinces including an American national. U.S. travel restrictions tighten, prohibiting boarding to the United States for travelers from Congo until 21 days in a third country; about 24 Americans were slated to fly home. The CDC confirms an American humanitarian worker infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and another American is evacuated to University Hospital Frankfurt, Germany for treatment after exposure in Congo. Since the outbreak began, 112 health workers have been infected, 35 of whom have died. Challenges include weak health infrastructure, limited access to affected areas, and a strike at an Ebola treatment center in Ituri. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and bleeding. Oxford University has begun a human trial of a Bundibugyo vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントン、エボラ流行拡大を受けコンゴ民主共和国への渡航制限を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が拡大し1,926症例・702死亡、米独への感染者搬送・渡航制限措置が発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 米国およびドイツへの感染者移送・渡航制限は国際的波及を示すが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。医療従事者112名感染・35名死亡、ワクチン臨床試験開始など事態は深刻かつ流動的であり、続報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Stakingen doen ebolarespons in Congo wankelen, terwijl het virus zich in recordtempo verspreidt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strikes cause Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to falter as the virus spreads at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Strikes by health workers in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, cripple Ebola response as the Bundibugyo variant spreads rapidly. At Rwampara Hospital's Ebola treatment center, the entrance was blocked by dozens of angry staff demanding 45 days of unpaid salaries, undermining care continuity. Ituri accounts for about 95% of infections; two additional provinces reported cases last week. Latest totals: nearly 2,000 confirmed infections and more than 700 deaths. WHO notes most new deaths occur among people without access to healthcare, and 80% of newly positive patients are outside known contact lists, signaling undetected transmission. Congolese Health Minister Roger Kamba visited Bunia to reassure frontline workers and stressed payroll accuracy. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant has no approved medicine or vaccine. International aid groups assist amid major logistical and operational challenges; Ituri's eight million residents include about one million displaced by conflict over land and gold mines.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でストライキがエボラ対応を揺るがす中、ウイルスは記録的な速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し、約2000人感染・700人以上死亡と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、医療従事者のストライキで対応が機能不全に陥っているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないブンディブギョ株であり、感染者の80%が既知の接触者リスト外という点は、未検出の伝播が広がっていることを示唆し、国際的拡大リスクを高めている。また、医療従事者への未払い賃金によるストライキが対応能力を著しく損なっている点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: कैथल के सजूमा गांव में पीलिया का कहर, दूषित पानी से फैला संक्रमण; डर के मारे बच्चों को स्कूल नहीं भेज रहे ग्रामीण - jaundice outbreak in kaithal sajuma village villagers not sending children to school out of fear
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaundice outbreak in Kaithal's Sajuma village; infection spread through contaminated water; villagers not sending children to school out of fear.
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak in Sajuma village, Kaithal, Haryana, is linked to contaminated drinking water. Initial health department sampling (25) showed no chlorine; 21 leaks were found in the potable-water pipeline, and residents obtain water from nearby Divāl. As of July 14, 2026, 89 children are clinically suspected of jaundice, with 33 confirmed Hepatitis A and 9 Typhoid cases; 10 children are hospitalized (9 in government facilities, 1 in a private hospital). A fatal case, Ritika, is reported after long treatment across Kaithal, Kurukshetra, and PGI Chandigarh, with costs borne by villagers. Some villagers allege underreporting by authorities. On Monday, 30 samples reportedly returned negative; on Tuesday, 18 more samples were sent for lab testing, with results pending. Chandigarh public health teams and 14 village teams have been deployed; negligent staff will face departmental action, pending higher-level review.}

triage.headline_ja: カイタルのサジュマ村で黄疸(肝炎)が猛威、汚染水により感染拡大；恐怖から子どもを学校に行かせない村人たち
triage.triage_reason: 汚染された飲料水を原因とするA型肝炎・腸チフスの集団感染で、89人の疑い例、33人のA型肝炎確定、9人の腸チフス確定、10人入院、1人死亡と規模・重症度があり、住民の不安と行政の対応（保健チーム派遣、職員処分）から社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 水道管の漏水(21カ所)による汚染水供給が原因とされ、地元保健当局とチャンディーガルの公衆衛生チームが対応中。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、インフラ不備による長期的な曝露リスクが残る。

article.articleHeadline: Stakingen doen ebolarespons in Congo wankelen, terwijl het virus zich in recordtempo verspreidt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strikes undermine Congo's Ebola response as the virus spreads at record speed.
article.articleSummary: Strikes by Ebola response staff in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo hampered containment as the virus spreads at record speed, with Ituri province the epicenter, accounting for about 95% of infections. In multiple Ebola treatment centers, workers protested unpaid salaries and poor working conditions, underscoring the precarious frontline capacity. At Rwampara Hospital, where an Ebola treatment center operates, a large banner reading 'Stop Ebola' and depicting symptoms adorns the entrance, but on Monday the gate remained closed as dozens of angry staff blocked the door and the surrounding street. The disruption comes as authorities warn the outbreak is spreading faster than ever and the peak remains unseen. The stakeholders emphasize the need for adequate staffing, pay, and safety measures to sustain the response and prevent further transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのストライキがエボラ対応を揺るがす中、ウイルスは記録的な速度で拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ・イトゥリ州で記録的速度で拡大しており、対応スタッフのストライキが封じ込め対応を阻害している。公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 対応スタッフのストライキにより現場の医療対応能力が低下しており、感染拡大がピークに達していないとの当局の警告がある。人員不足・賃金未払い等の構造的問題が response の持続可能性に影響している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo alerta para avanço de bactéria em criações de peixes para consumo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study warns about the spread of bacteria in fish farms for consumption.
article.articleSummary: Brazil-based study published in Microbial Pathogenesis identifies presence of multiple Flavobacterium species in fish farmed for human consumption, marking first report in Brazil. Infected species include tilapia and native Brazilian fish such as tambaqui, pacu, lambari, and pintado-da-amazônia. The bacteria cause skin and fin lesions, destroy gills, and can rapidly kill young fish. Isolations and microbiological analyses of samples collected from 2018–2024 in tilapia farms and native species confirmed these pathogens. At ~28°C, several Flavobacterium strains exhibited enhanced biofilm formation, increasing survival in aquaculture equipment and facilities. The study notes no current evidence of direct human transmission. Authors call for epidemiological surveillance, stricter biosafety measures, and vaccine development to mitigate impacts on Brazil’s aquaculture production.

triage.headline_ja: 研究、食用養殖魚における細菌の拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 魚類の細菌感染症であり人への直接感染の証拠はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 動物（魚類）の病原体に関する研究報告であり、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されていない。公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola, estrecho de Ormuz, precios del café y el té, Corte Penal Internacional... Las noticias del martes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Strait of Hormuz, Coffee and Tea Prices, International Criminal Court... Tuesday's News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to accelerate. By July 11, nearly 2,000 cases and over 700 deaths have been reported across five provinces, making it the third-largest Ebola epidemic to date. The WHO notes substantial improvements in response capacity: treatment beds expanded to nearly 800, laboratory network increased from 1 to 14 centers, and contact tracing reaches about 80%. Despite these gains, many patients die in communities without care, underscoring gaps in access. The agency has requested $115 million to fund the response, but a shortfall of about $70 million remains. The situation was discussed in Geneva following a visit to Bunia by WHO Emergencies Programme Director Chikwe Ihekweazu. Ongoing containment will depend on early case detection, rapid referral, and community trust.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、ホルムズ海峡、コーヒー・紅茶価格、国際刑事裁判所…火曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが加速しており、約2000症例・700人超の死亡者を記録し史上3番目の規模となっている。資金不足（約7000万ドル）も深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ジュネーブ・スイスは会議開催地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。資金不足（$115M要求中$70M不足）が国際支援の必要性を強く示している。

article.articleHeadline: Holidaymakers told to do 4 things to protect themselves from deadly virus
article.articleSummary: As of Jan–Jun 2026 in England, imported dengue reached 137 cases, concentrated in South-East Asia and South Asia, with 27 linked to Thailand and 19 to the Maldives. Chikungunya totaled 59 cases, Sri Lanka accounting for 18. Malaria cases were 557 across England, Wales and Northern Ireland through May, up from 548 in 2025. Typhoid and paratyphoid fever totaled 287 in Jan–Jun, caused by Salmonella and usually spread via contaminated food or water. Mosquitoes breed in standing water; eggs hatch when temperatures rise. Public Health guidance via TravelHealthPro advises vaccines/medications as appropriate, insect repellent with Deet, Icaridin or PMD, cover exposed skin, and practice food/water hygiene. Pregnant travelers should seek medical advice before travel. Which? tests noted some repellents protect up to 10 hours.

triage.headline_ja: 旅行者へ、命に関わるウイルスから身を守るための4つの対策
triage.triage_reason: 英国内における輸入感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア、腸チフス等）の定例統計と渡航者向け予防啓発記事であり、対象国での発生状況を報じるものではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国（イングランド・ウェールズ・北アイルランド）における輸入感染症統計と渡航者向け予防勧告。タイ、スリランカ、モルディブは感染経路（旅行先）として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生状況を報じるものではないため対象国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: 中港澳新冠病例上升 专家警示病毒继续演化风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau; experts warn of the risk of continued viral evolution.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, Mainland China recorded 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (with underlying conditions). Sentinel data show influenza-like illness SARS-CoV-2 positivity rising from 2.9% in early June to 6.4% by late June; Omicron NB.1.8.1 and its PQ.16.1.1 sublineage remain dominant. Hong Kong’s COVID activity remains elevated: week 27 positives reached 477; week 28 daily positives 62–95; overall positivity up to 8.52%; 16 severe/death cases in week 27; school and care-home outbreaks 13 events (57 people) in week 27 and 15 events (76 people) in the first four days of week 28. Macau shows 25% positivity among symptomatic residents; cases up 277.4% YoY; influenza-like positivity up 333.2%. PQ.16.1.1 accounted for 100% of May 24–30 samples and remained prevalent by week 27. Genomic surveillance detects RF.5, RV.1, PQ.16.1.1, RE.1.1.5 lineages, signaling ongoing SARS-CoV-2 evolution with potential multi-organ effects; clinicians urge vigilance for fatigue, headaches, GI symptoms, and possible diphtheria co-infections.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土・香港・マカオで新型コロナウイルス感染症例が増加、専門家はウイルスの継続的な進化リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節性増加と変異株監視の定期報告であり、新規性・国際的拡大の明確な根拠はないが、重症例・死亡例や地域的な感染拡大が継続しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19の季節的増加と変異株（NB.1.8.1、PQ.16.1.1等）の監視データに基づく定期的な公衆衛生報告。ジフテリア重複感染の可能性への言及があるが具体的症例は未確認。中国本土・香港・マカオはいずれもChina(1814991)として集約。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 中港澳新冠病例上升 專家警示病毒繼續演化風險
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in Mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau; experts warn of ongoing risk of viral evolution.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China reported 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June 2026, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (associated with underlying conditions). Sentinel surveillance shows influenza-like illness with SARS-CoV-2 positivity rising from 2.9% to 6.4%, and the dominant strains NB.1.8.1 and its PQ.16.1.1 sublineage. Hong Kong’s COVID activity continues to climb: week 27 data show 477 new nucleic acid positives and a respiratory-sample positivity of 8.52%, with 16 severe/death cases and outbreaks in schools and care homes. Macau reports 25% positivity among patients with respiratory symptoms, with May 24–30 samples 100% PQ.16.1.1; PQ.16.1.1 remains predominant by week 27. Experts warn ongoing SARS-CoV-2 evolution, noting new lineages RF.5, RV.1, PQ.16.1.1, RE.1.1.5 detected globally, including Southeast Asia, East Asia, parts of Australia and New Zealand, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Europe. Potential co-infections with diphtheria, influenza, RSV, pneumococcus, and pertussis may worsen outcomes; seek evaluation for new or unusual symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土・香港・マカオで新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）症例が増加、専門家はウイルス変異継続のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 中国本土・香港・マカオでCOVID-19症例と新変異株（PQ.16.1.1等）の検出が増加しているが、重症・死亡率は低く季節性の流行パターンと見られるため、直ちにIHR基準を満たす深刻な公衆衛生事象とは言えないが、変異株の継続的進化と流行状況は経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港・マカオの症例は中国（People's Republic of China, 1814991）に統合。米国・豪州・NZ・英国は対象国リスト外のため除外。記事は季節性COVID増加と新変異株監視についての定期サーベイランス報告であり、重症化率や死亡率は低水準。

article.articleHeadline: 80% de los nuevos casos de ébola en el Congo provienen de cadenas de transmisión desconocidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 80% of the new Ebola cases in the Congo come from unknown transmission chains.
article.articleSummary: 80% of new Ebola cases detected in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo arise from transmission chains not on monitored lists, according to WHO emergencies chief, signaling ongoing transmission outpacing containment in Africa's fastest-growing outbreak. The Congo faces a rare Bundibugyo variant with no approved treatments or vaccines. Congo has 1,926 confirmed infections and 702 deaths across three provinces, with cases also reported in neighboring Uganda. Bunia, Ituri province, is among the hardest-hit cities. Many deaths have occurred in communities without access to health facilities. Capacity has expanded to about 800 beds and diagnostics to 14 laboratories, but the response pace remains insufficient. Obstacles include funding gaps, attacks on health facilities, armed conflict in the east, and community distrust. Clinical trials for potential treatments are underway; outbreak officially declared May 15, with circulation weeks earlier. On July 11, a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ新規感染例の80%が未知の感染連鎖に由来
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で希少なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が拡大し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、ウガンダへの越境や米国人感染者の発生など国際的拡大の兆候がある。IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告や米国人感染者の発生は国際的拡大リスクを示すが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: L'intense mobilité et le déni de la population accélèrent la propagation d'Ebola dans le Haut-Uele
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Intense mobility and the population's denial accelerate the spread of Ebola in Haut-Uele.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), now affecting 37 health zones nationwide; in Haut-Uele province, Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu warned on July 13 that intense mobility of people and goods, especially around mining hubs and commercial zones near Nyanza and the Wamba territory, is driving transmission and hindering containment. Unlike Isiro, a more urban center where awareness campaigns are easier, mining areas with artisanal activity complicate response efforts. A socio-psychological barrier compounds the outbreak: a portion of the population denies the virus's existence, labeling it a "montage" and refuses to be tested, skip temperature checks, or comply with handwashing and other protocols. The governor emphasized that this resistance challenges health authorities, who must balance risky health messaging with ongoing economic activities in the province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:住民の移動の活発化と否認がハウトウエレ州でのエボラ拡大を加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC全土37保健区に拡大しており、住民の否認・検査拒否など対応を阻害する要因が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのハウトウエレ州における拡大状況に焦点を当てており、ケニアは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo inicia testes clínicos de antiviral experimental da Gilead contra Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo begins clinical trials of Gilead's experimental antiviral against Bundibugyo ebolavirus.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches recruitment for a clinical trial testing obeldesivir, Gilead’s experimental antiviral, as post‑exposure treatment for a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Led by the National Institute for Biomedical Research of Congo and ANRS with humanitarian partners in Ituri province, the study aims to enroll about 1,000 people aged 12+ who had high‑risk exposure to a confirmed case within the last five days but are asymptomatic. Participants will be monitored daily for 21 days, with a final follow‑up at 42 days. Obeldesivir has shown activity against filoviruses, including Bundibugyo Ebola, in preclinical studies. Funding totals €3.4 million from Global Health EDCTP3 (EU) and $1 million from the Africa CDC, with an additional $5 million commitment secured by CDC Africa from South Africa and DR Congo. A separate compassionate‑use protocol would administer injectable remdesivir to children under 12 and to pregnant or breastfeeding exposed women.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが吉利徳(Gilead)の抗ウイルス実験薬をブンディブジョ・エボラウイルスに対する臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでブンディブジョ型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率の高い感染症で国際的拡大の可能性があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国(イトゥリ州)とウガンダにまたがるブンディブジョ型エボラのアウトブレイクへの臨床試験開始を報じているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。南アフリカは資金提供者として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la majorité des acteurs de la riposte contre Ebola déjà rémunérés (Coordonnateur du centre des opérations d'urgence de santé publique) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Most actors involved in the Ebola response have already been paid (Coordinator of the Public Health Emergency Operations Center) - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola virus disease response is centered in Bunia. The coordinator of the Public Health Emergency Operations Center reports that most response actors, including those at treatment centers, have already been paid; remaining delays involve personnel funded by certain partner organizations. Six health zones now account for about 90% of Ebola notifications and confirmed cases, enabling a focused response on main transmission foci. The outbreak remains centered in the epicenter, with ongoing efforts to prevent secondary cases in neighboring provinces after imported cases were detected in Tshopo and Wamba. Rapid response teams were deployed early, reaching 58 days since the outbreak began, and more teams have been deployed than in any previous outbreak, aiming to end the epidemic quickly.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:エボラ対応関係者の大半に既に報酬支払い済み(公衆衛生緊急対応センター調整官)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが58日目に達し、新たにチョポ州・ワンバへの二次感染例が確認されており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う継続的シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応チームへの報酬支払い状況に関する内容だが、アウトブレイクが継続中(58日目)であり、イトゥリ州の6つの保健地域が症例の約90%を占める一方、周辺州(チョポ、ワンバ)への輸入症例も確認されている。既存の進行中アウトブレイクの続報として継続的な監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mujer viajó a India y años después descubrió 38 parásitos en su cerebro: una sola comida desencadenó una pesadilla de salud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman traveled to India and years later discovered 38 parasites in her brain: a single meal triggered a health nightmare.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis diagnosed in Lowri Denman, 42, from Wales, after a tapeworm segment and subsequent seizures, severe headaches, and psychosis. Doctors found 38 parasites in her brain, a rare presentation in the United Kingdom. Likely contracted Taenia solium during a 2007 three-month trip to India, via ingestion of eggs from contaminated food, despite avoiding pork. Three years after travel she learned she had a tapeworm, but stool tests were normal then. In 2011 she developed severe headaches and her first seizure, with language difficulties. MRI/CT confirmed 38 brain cysts; toxoplasmosis was initially suspected, then confirmed as neurocysticercosis. The larvae form cysts in the brain; the infection later calcified, allowing treatment to stop active infection without surgery. She received antiparasitics and steroids; inflammatory flare years later caused confusion, paranoia, and six weeks in a neuropsychiatric hospital. Last seizure occurred in 2017; lifelong anticonvulsants required.

triage.headline_ja: インドを旅行した女性、数年後に脳内で38匹の寄生虫を発見:一度の食事が健康の悪夢を引き起こした
triage.triage_reason: 2007年に感染した単一個人の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、社会的関心も個人の体験談レベルにとどまる。
triage.notes: 単一個人の過去（2007年）の渡航歴に基づく神経嚢虫症の症例報告。公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクではなく、英国ウェールズ在住者の個人的な健康ニュース記事。インドでの感染が疑われるが公衆衛生イベントではないため対象国に該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda seeks sustained international support in Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Uganda on 14 July 2026 seeks sustained international support as it assists the Democratic Republic of the Congo in responding to an ongoing Ebola outbreak. Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi, speaking at an Ebola Accountability Forum in Kampala co-hosted with the World Health Organization, reviewed mobilized resources, expenditures, and the implementation of the national Ebola response and preparedness plans. He thanked partners for helping Uganda bring its outbreak under control since it was declared on May 15, and urged continued collaboration to prevent cross-border transmission. Uganda has deployed health personnel and equipment to eastern DRC to bolster its neighbour's response. Permanent Secretary Diana Atwine praised countries that refrained from travel restrictions. Official data show 20 confirmed Ebola cases in the current outbreak in Uganda, including 15 imported from the DRC; 17 recovered, 1 hospitalized, 2 dead.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対応で継続的な国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが国境を越えてウガンダに拡大しており、死亡例・入院例も報告されているためIHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ保健省がDRCのエボラ対応を支援している状況と、ウガンダ国内での輸入症例（DRCから15例）を報告している。アウトブレイクの発生源はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ заявила, что число зараженных вирусом Эбола в 2-4 раза выше, чем известно врачам
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO said that the number of people infected with the Ebola virus is 2-4 times higher than what doctors know.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be undercounted by 2–4×, according to WHO. As of 14 July 2026, official data report 1,963 cases and 719 deaths, with most fatalities occurring at home and about 80% of new infections not linked to known contacts, indicating undetected transmission chains. Approximately 800 beds are available in specialized treatment centers and 14 laboratories for rapid testing, yet only 40% of the $115 million funding needed has been received. Separately, Gilead Sciences is recruiting about 1,000 participants aged 12+ for a trial of an experimental antiviral, obeldesivir, intended for post-exposure prophylaxis against the Bundibugyo strain. The study is led by Congo's National Institute of Biomedical Research and the ANRS (France), with ALIMA and Doctors Without Borders.

triage.headline_ja: WHOは、エボラウイルス感染者数が医師の把握している数の2〜4倍に上ると発表した
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が過小評価されている可能性があり、新規感染の約80%が既知の接触者と関連しないなど未検出の感染連鎖が示唆される。資金不足（必要額の40%のみ確保）も重なり、国際的対応が必要な重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: フランスは研究協力機関（ANRS）の所在地であり、発生地域には該当しないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Pasien Ebola Asal AS Diterbangkan ke Jerman, Trump Blokir Penerbangan Komersial dari Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola patient from the United States was flown to Germany, Trump blocks commercial flights from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen, aged around 60, infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived in Frankfurt for intensive care. The patient, a Samaritan's Purse employee working as a warehouse manager in Bunia, Ituri Province, was evacuated after WHO medical monitoring. The Ituri outbreak, the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, began in mid-May and is caused by the Bundibugyo strain; no vaccine or specific treatment exists. WHO reports over 1,900 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths. German health authorities say the patient’s presence poses very low risk to the public and other hospital patients. This follows a late-May case of another American Ebola patient quarantined at Charité Berlin, who recovered after about two weeks. In parallel, Trump’s administration blocked commercial flights from the DRC to the United States, with a 21-day waiting period in a third country for affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 米国籍のエボラ患者がドイツへ搬送、トランプ大統領はコンゴからの商業便を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRC第17次エボラ流行で確定症例1,900例超・死亡700例超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際搬送・渡航制限措置も発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 患者搬送先のドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS estima entre 4.000 y 8.000 los casos reales de ébola en RDC, el doble que los oficiales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO estimates between 4,000 and 8,000 actual Ebola cases in the DRC, twice as many as the official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is likely undercounted: WHO estimates real cases may be 4,000–8,000 versus official figures of just over 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths since the outbreak was declared two months ago. The case fatality rate is about 50%. The outbreak ranks as the third largest Ebola outbreak on record and the most severe since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Ongoing violence in eastern DRC hampers access and surveillance, contributing to underreporting of cases and deaths. Cross-border movement raises the risk of regional spread to neighboring countries. WHO is calling for more international funding to contain the outbreak and to bolster surveillance amid weak health infrastructure and security constraints in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ実際の症例数を4,000〜8,000人と推定、公式発表の2倍
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上3番目の規模の流行となっており、致死率約50%、公式統計の大幅な過小報告と越境拡大リスクが指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として挙げられているが、記事本文では言及されておらず越境拡大の懸念のみのため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Проф. Ива Христова предупреди: Един болен в кухнята на ресторанта може да зарази стотици на морето
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor Iva Hristova warned: A single sick person in the restaurant's kitchen could infect hundreds at the seaside.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, Bulgaria reports a seasonal rise in gastroenteritis and enterocolitis, the so-called 'diseases of dirty hands,' driven in part by noroviruses, which spread from an infected person. Hygiene after toilet use must be impeccable, especially in restaurants; a single ill employee can contaminate many meals in hot weather. Summer infections also come from animal-origin foods (meat, eggs, dairy) that require thorough cooking, and from raw leafy greens washed with possibly contaminated water. Home preparation is controllable, but avoid leaving cooked food outdoors and refrigerate promptly. Children remain most vulnerable. Separately, tick-borne diseases persist: Lyme disease activity remains within last year’s range, with humid conditions favoring ticks. Tularemia occurs mainly in Southern Bulgaria and along the Black Sea coast. Globally, Ebola in Congo approaches 2,000 cases with mortality above 30%, many undiagnosed.

triage.headline_ja: イヴァ・フリストヴァ教授の警告：レストランの厨房にいる一人の感染者が海辺で数百人に感染を広げる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 記事本体はブルガリアの食品衛生・ライム病・野兎病に関する内容だが、末尾でコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ出血熱が症例数約2000人・致死率30%超・多数未診断という深刻な状況に言及しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はブルガリア国内の食中毒・ライム病・野兎病に関する季節的注意喚起であり、ブルガリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、末尾で言及されたDRCのエボラ出血熱（約2000症例、致死率30%超、多数未診断）は深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、詳細情報（発生時期・地域・ヒトヒト感染状況等）の確認のため追加調査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La violencia en el este de la RDC agrava los brotes de ébola y cólera, alerta la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Violence in eastern DRC worsens Ebola and cholera outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, armed violence in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is worsening Ebola and cholera outbreaks. An active Ebola epidemic has persisted for weeks in eastern DRC, with armed groups hindering contact tracing, vaccination, and treatment as thousands flee to overcrowded camps and water supplies run scarce. Health facilities have been attacked and supply routes cut, rendering outbreak control measures ineffective. The World Health Organization warns that without security and humanitarian corridors, response efforts cannot proceed. The report also notes concurrent cholera activity in Sudan and Yemen, but Congo remains the focus. Cross-border spread to Rwanda and Uganda is a regional concern given porous frontiers, though no exported cases have been confirmed to date. WHO urges protection of medical staff and safe access to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部での暴力がエボラ出血熱とコレラの流行を悪化させている、とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で活動中のエボラ流行が武力紛争により制御不能となり、コレラも併発。WHOが国際的な支援・安全回廊の必要性を訴えており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はスーダン・イエメンでのコレラ流行にも言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ルワンダ・ウガンダへの越境拡大は懸念事項として言及されているが確認された症例はなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला को लेकर जिला स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट, सभी अस्पतालों को जारी हुई एडवाइजरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: District Health Department issues an Ebola alert; advisory issued to all hospitals.
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026: Nalanda district in Bihar issues an Ebola alert and a comprehensive health advisory to all health facilities after the WHO designated the Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola is highly contagious with mortality 50% or higher, transmitted by direct contact with infected blood, saliva, sweat, vomit, feces, or urine; via contact with infected wildlife or meat; and during funerals. Under IDSP, facilities must monitor fever, red eyes, rashes, abdominal pain, and recent travel to affected countries. Hospitals should ensure isolation wards, ambulances, PPE, N-95 masks, labs, and critical care; training for staff is required. Suspected samples are sent to NIV Pune. Rapid Response Teams remain active; coordinate with airport and land-port nodal officers. Suspected cases, after initial treatment, are referred to Sadar Hospital, Bihar Sharif, and BIMIMS Pawapuri. Each facility designates a nodal officer for media and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒でナーランダ県保健局が全病院に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダのエボラ流行をPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定したことを受け、インド・ビハール州が病院向けに警戒アドバイザリーを発出。IHR基準（重大性・異常性・国際拡大）を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ビハール州の予防的アドバイザリーであり、インド国内での実際の症例発生は報告されていない。実際の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ（ウガンダは対象国リスト外）。Nipahの疾患タグは記事内容と関連性が見られず、誤タグの可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός ΠΟΥ για τον Έμπολα: Η επιδημία μπορεί να είναι έως και τέσσερις φορές μεγαλύτερη απ' ότι πιστεύουμε
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO alert on Ebola: The epidemic may be up to four times larger than we think.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be 2–4 times larger than official case counts, following a visit to Ituri where Bundibugyo Ebola is active. Authorities report at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. While detection is improving, funding remains critically short, with only about 40% of the $115 million requested secured. The response requires resources commensurate with challenges, and donors are urged to sustain support. The Bundibugyo strain has no proven therapy or vaccine. Case transmission has expanded into two additional provinces this week, indicating broader spread beyond initial epicenters. Emphasis is on intensified case finding, isolation, and surveillance to curb transmission and complete the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによるエボラ警告：流行は考えられているよりも最大4倍規模の可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCのエボラ流行が公式報告数の2〜4倍規模である可能性を警告し、感染が新たに2州に拡大、資金不足も深刻であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスには有効な治療法・ワクチンが確立されておらず、資金不足（要請額の約40%のみ確保）が対応の制約要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'ampleur de l'épidémie dépasse "de deux à quatre fois" les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the scale of the outbreak is two to four times higher than official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times larger than official estimates, per WHO emergency program head Chikwe Ihekweazu. The latest SITREP through July 12 reports 1,963 cases and 719 deaths. Declared two months ago, the outbreak now spans four eastern provinces and is the third-largest, as well as the fastest-growing, Ebola epidemic on record. Early cases likely date back to April, before the declaration. A major concern is community deaths and limited access to health facilities, with contact tracing at about 80% vs. a 90% target. Encouragingly, the first clinical trial evaluating a post-exposure prophylaxis began recruiting in Bunia, Ituri, aiming to enroll up to about 1,000 contacts. WHO Director Tedros Gebreyesus is expected in DRC by week’s end, with Ituri as epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:流行の規模は公式推定値の2〜4倍、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部4州に拡大し、史上3番目の規模かつ最速の流行拡大とされ、致死率も高く公衆衛生上深刻な影響がある。WHO事務局長も現地入りするなど国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: コンタクトトレーシングが目標の90%に対し80%程度に留まり、コミュニティでの死亡や医療アクセスの制限が懸念材料。曝露後予防のための臨床試験がイトゥリ州ブニアで開始された。

article.articleHeadline: OMS enciende las alarmas: brote de ébola avanza a velocidad récord
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Sounds the Alarm: Ebola Outbreak Advances at Record Pace
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding at a record pace, becoming the third-largest on record. As of July 11, 2026, the WHO reports 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths. About 80% of new patients are not on established contact lists, signaling transmission chains that remain unidentified and hinder isolation and containment. WHO officials warn the true scale could be 2–4 times higher than official figures. Many deaths occur in communities without access to medical care, heightening transmission risk. Response efforts include 700+ beds, 14 diagnostic laboratories, and 21,000 trained community workers, but the outbreak continues to outstrip capacity. The crisis unfolds amid armed conflict, displacement, and economic hardship in eastern DRC. Funding remains insufficient: only about 40% of the $115 million appeal has been received. Bundibugyo virus is spreading to new provinces, pressuring frontline teams.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警鐘を鳴らす：エボラ出血熱の流行が記録的な速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ流行が史上3番目の規模に拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占めるなど制御が困難な状況。IHR基準に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 資金は必要額の約40%しか集まっておらず、武力紛争や住民の避難も感染拡大の一因。Bundibugyoウイルスが新たな州へ拡大している点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Η επιδημία μπορεί να είναι έως και τέσσερις φορές μεγαλύτερη από τις επίσημες εκτιμήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over Ebola in Congo: The outbreak could be up to four times larger than official estimates.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times larger than confirmed cases, according to WHO. The eastern region, especially Ituri province, remains the hardest hit. The Bundibugyo strain has no proven treatment or vaccine. As of authorities, at least 1,926 people have been infected and 702 deaths reported. New cases have appeared in two additional provinces, heightening efforts to rapidly detect, isolate, and treat patients. WHO appeals for international support; funding raised is about 40% of the $115 million required for the outbreak response. The situation is described as critical over the coming weeks, with response capacity needing strengthening to determine containment versus continued spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ警報：流行は公式推定の最大4倍規模の可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（Bundibugyo株）による大規模流行が疑われ、致死率が高く新規州への拡大とWHOの国際支援要請があるため、IHR・WPRO基準の複数該当でフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 治療法・ワクチン未確立のBundibugyo株による流行で、公式報告の数倍規模の可能性があるとWHOが警告。資金は必要額の約40%のみ確保されており、封じ込めの成否は今後数週間が鍵とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha ready to tackle any Covid situation: Minister
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Odisha: On 14 July 2026, Odisha declares readiness to tackle any COVID situation amid reports of coronavirus cases in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh. Odisha Health Minister Mukesh Mahaling chaired a review with senior officials to assess the national COVID-19 scenario. Districts bordering Andhra Pradesh have been placed on alert, and the state is in continuous coordination with the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, pledging to follow Centre guidelines. The public health message urges vigilance, adherence to safety protocols, and reliance on official information sources. Ahead of the Rath Yatra in Puri on 16 July, about 1,000 healthcare personnel—including doctors, nurses, and paramedical staff—have been deployed to bolster readiness. No case counts are reported in Odisha in this article.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、COVID対応に万全の態勢：大臣
triage.triage_reason: 隣接するアンドラプラデシュ州での症例報告を受けた行政的な準備態勢の表明に過ぎず、オディシャ州内での症例数増加や異常な事象は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はオディシャ州保健相による行政レビューと祭事（ラート・ヤートラ）に向けた医療従事者配備の報告であり、具体的な症例数や異常な感染拡大の記述はない。隣接州の状況への言及はあるが、対象国(India)自体の主題としての具体的アウトブレイク情報がないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Bars Americans From Returning From Congo Amid Widening Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: U.S. bars Americans who recently visited the Democratic Republic of Congo from returning to the United States until they spend 21 days in a third country, citing a widening outbreak of deadly Ebola in Congo. The policy, announced in Washington, targets travelers with Congo exposure to curb potential international spread by enforcing a 21-day stay outside the U.S. before re-entry. The article identifies Ebola as the disease and Congo as the outbreak location, but provides no specific case counts or laboratory confirmation details in the excerpt. The measure underscores heightened screening and post-travel quarantine amid ongoing transmission in Congo, highlighting imported/exported risk concerns as public health authorities respond. Published 2026-07-14.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴでのエボラ流行拡大を受け、コンゴ渡航者の帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の拡大流行を受けて米国が渡航制限を実施しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国外だが、発生源であるコンゴが対象国リストに含まれるため列挙。具体的な症例数や検査確認情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'ampleur de l'épidémie dépasse "de deux à quatre fois" les estimations officielles, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the scale of the outbreak exceeds two to four times the official estimates, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is now the third-largest and fastest-growing on record, with four eastern provinces affected. The World Health Organization says the scale may be two to four times higher than official estimates. Community deaths are alarmingly high due to limited healthcare access, and contact tracing stands at about 80% versus the 90% target. The outbreak was declared two months ago; first cases likely date back to April. A first clinical trial evaluating post-exposure prophylaxis began recruiting Tuesday in Bunia, Ituri, potentially enrolling up to 1,000 contacts. WHO Director-General Tedros Gebreyesus is set to visit the DRC by week’s end, with Ituri remaining the epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:WHOによると流行の規模は公式推計の2~4倍に達している
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ流行が過去3番目の規模・最速拡大とされ、公式推計を大幅に上回る可能性がWHOにより指摘されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的懸念が明確なためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長のDRC訪問予定や臨床試験開始など、国際的関与・支援の動きが顕著。続報でのケース数・地理的拡大の推移に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Samar logs 225 suspected chikungunya cases, surveillance up
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya suspected outbreak in Samar, Philippines: 225 cases across Basey (124), Gandara (98), Paranas (3). Health authorities have intensified surveillance and vector control. Twelve blood samples (six from Basey, six from Gandara) were sent to the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine (RITM); results expected in two to three weeks. First suspected cases were reported February 5 in Gandara (nine infections); the disease resurfaced last month, raising concerns of renewed local transmission. Chikungunya is a viral disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes—the same as dengue and Zika. Symptoms include sudden fever, severe joint pain, muscle pain, headache, rash, and fatigue; it is rarely fatal, but joint pain can persist for weeks or months. Advisories urge residents of Basey, Gandara, and Paranas to eliminate stagnant water and breeding sites, rely on PHO information, avoid self-medication, and seek medical consultation if symptoms develop. Rural health units will coordinate with barangays to strengthen monitoring, education, and vector control.

triage.headline_ja: サマール州でチクングニア熱疑い症例225件、サーベイランス強化
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・サマール州でチクングニア熱疑い225例が確認され、当局がサーベイランスとベクター対策を強化しており、地域的なヒト-蚊-ヒト感染拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱は稀に致死的だが関節痛が長期化する可能性あり。RITMでの検査結果待ちのため、続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: ebola, in congo la protesta di medici e infermieri perche' non vengono pagati. e i becchini...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, in Congo doctors and nurses protest because they are not being paid. And the gravediggers...
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, the Ebola virus disease outbreak declared on May 15 is spreading rapidly, with at least 702 deaths among 1,926 confirmed cases over the past two months. Healthcare workers at Rwampara General Hospital have gone on strike due to unpaid salaries, with drivers and gravediggers blocking access to facilities amid equipment shortages and overwhelmed clinics. The government cites payroll verifications to ensure payments reach the right people; Health Minister Roger Kamba pledged resolution. Ituri's conflict between government forces and Tutsi rebels has driven more than 100,000 displaced people, limiting access to clean water and sanitation and damaging health infrastructure, facilitating transmission. A May incident saw an enraged crowd burn the isolation ward in search of the body of a presumed Ebola victim, described by hospital director Isaac Mugenyi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで医師・看護師が未払い給与に抗議、埋葬人夫も抗議参加
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが急速に拡大しており（2ヶ月で1926症例・702死亡、致死率約36%）、医療従事者のストライキや紛争による医療インフラ崩壊が感染拡大を助長しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 紛争による10万人以上の避難民発生、清潔な水・衛生設備へのアクセス制限、医療従事者の未払い賃金によるストライキ、隔離病棟焼き討ち事件など、感染拡大リスクを高める複合的要因が存在。致死率が高く公衆衛生上深刻な影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies-infected beaver 'out for blood' puts two swimmers in hospital
article.articleSummary: Rabies-confirmed beaver attack near Turtle Island, Lake George, New York, left two swimmers hospitalized after being bitten and scratched on July 4. The beaver charged the swimmers in the water; authorities euthanised the animal and laboratory tests confirmed rabies. Both men began urgent post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) in hospital, and the treatment was completed successfully as they started the rabies vaccination course in time. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms emerge, but quick PEP during the incubation period (typically 3–12 weeks) can prevent disease. Beavers are normally shy and avoid people, making this incident highly unusual. No fatalities reported in connection with this case. The report notes that the UK is rabies-free for classic rabies in dogs and foxes since 1922, with some rabies-like risk from European Bat Lyssavirus (EBLV) in bats and pet-import vaccination rules for travel.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病感染ビーバーが「血を求めて」襲撃、遊泳者2人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 米国ニューヨーク州で発生した単発の動物咬傷事例であり、暴露後予防が奏功し死亡例もない。対象国（フィリピン等）とは無関係で、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにフィリピン（Turtle Islands, ARMM）が含まれるが、記事本文の実際の発生地は米国ニューヨーク州Lake George近郊であり、フィリピンとは無関係の地名の偶然の一致とみられる。対象国での発生は確認されないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: El Salvador Eliminates Trachoma as a Public Health Problem
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the World Health Organization validated El Salvador as eliminating trachoma as a public health problem. Trachoma is the world’s leading infectious cause of blindness. El Salvador met elimination criteria: (i) a prevalence of trachomatous trichiasis (TT) 'unknown to the health system' of < 0.2% in ≥15-year-olds; (ii) a prevalence of trachomatous inflammation - follicular (TF) in children aged 1-9 years of < 5%, in each formerly endemic district; and (iii) the existence of a system to identify and manage incident cases of TT. El Salvador is the first country in Central America and the second in the Americas to reach this milestone. Other countries validated by WHO include Algeria, Australia, Benin, Burundi, Cambodia, China, Egypt, Fiji, Gambia, Ghana, India, Iraq, Islamic Republic of Iran, Lao PDR, Libya, Malawi, Mali, Mauritania, Mexico, Morocco, Myanmar, Nepal, Oman, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Saudi Arabia, Senegal, Togo, Tunisia, Vanuatu and Viet Nam.

triage.headline_ja: エルサルバドル、トラコーマを公衆衛生上の問題として排除
triage.triage_reason: エルサルバドルがトラコーマ排除をWHOに認定されたという肯定的な公衆衛生成果の報告であり、公衆衛生上の脅威やリスクは存在しない。
triage.notes: 記事はエルサルバドルにおけるトラコーマ排除達成の報告であり、エルサルバドルは対象国リストに含まれない。他にも過去に排除認定された国々（中国、インドなど対象国含む）が列挙されているが、これらは過去の実績紹介であり、現在進行形の発生事象ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo reforça alerta para diagnóstico precoce das hepatites virais - Imprensa e Mídia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July reinforces the call for early diagnosis of viral hepatitis - Press and Media
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the WHO highlights Brazil’s progress against viral hepatitis, but emphasizes that early diagnosis and expanded prevention remain major challenges. Globally, hepatitis causes about 1.3 million deaths each year, mainly from cirrhosis and liver cancer associated with hepatitis B and C. In Brazil, access to diagnostics has widened, vaccination coverage has improved, and highly effective treatments for hepatitis C have been introduced, yet early diagnosis, broader vaccination, and follow-up of diagnosed patients remain critical gaps. Hepatitis A and E transmit mainly through contaminated water and food and typically cause acute illness, while hepatitis B, C, and D are largely blood- and sexually transmitted and can become chronic, silently damaging the liver. Preventive actions include vaccination against A and B (via SUS), safe sex, avoiding blood-contaminated instruments, sterile procedures for tattoos and piercings, and good hygiene. World Hepatitis Day is July 28.

triage.headline_ja: 「黄色い7月」キャンペーン、ウイルス性肝炎の早期診断を呼びかけ - Imprensa e Mídia
triage.triage_reason: 世界肝炎デー啓発に関する一般的な公衆衛生広報記事であり、異常事態や急性アウトブレイクの報告はない。
triage.notes: 啓発キャンペーン記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な症例増加の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: DRC Ebola outbreak two to four times bigger than official scale
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is at least two to four times bigger than official counts. DR Congo’s latest figures exceed 1,960 infections and 700 deaths since the outbreak was detected about two months ago. WHO emergencies director Chikwe Ihekweazu warned the true scale is larger, with modelling indicating 2–4x as many cases as found. This marks the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with the fastest month-to-month growth seen among outbreaks managed by WHO. The 17th DRC Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 after several deaths in Ituri, a northeastern province affected by armed groups. Cases have been identified in five DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda. Ebola spreads through close contact and infected bodily fluids; continued surveillance and cross-border coordination are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、公式統計の2〜4倍の規模か
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、複数州及び隣国ウガンダにも波及、致死率も高く国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは実際の感染規模が公式統計の2〜4倍と推定しており、第17次DRCエボラ流行として過去最速の拡大速度を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Measles can trigger fatal brain disorder years later, says Hyd Research Institute
article.articleSummary: SSPE, a rare, progressive and fatal neurological complication of measles with no cure, is the focus of a new Hyderabad-based multi-omics study by Resplice Autism Research Foundation & Institute to understand why only a subset of children develop the condition and to explore early prediction and prevention. Announced July 14, 2026, the initiative includes a free medical camp for children with a history of measles, suspected SSPE, vaccine reactions, or developmental regression on August 9, 2026, from 10:00 to 17:00 at the Resplice Autism Research Foundation in Shivapuri Colony, Manikonda, Hyderabad. Three children—one from Delhi and two from Maharashtra—are currently enrolled. Research aims to characterize clinical features, immune responses, genetic and environmental factors, and other biomarkers to illuminate susceptibility to SSPE and guide preventive strategies. The program emphasizes no available cure for SSPE.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹は数年後に致命的な脳障害を引き起こす可能性がある、とハイデラバードの研究機関が発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は麻疹の稀な合併症であるSSPE（亜急性硬化性全脳炎）に関する研究プロジェクトの発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の合併症研究（SSPE）に関する研究機関の取り組みと医療キャンプの告知であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや緊急事態を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象としての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola s'accélère, l'OMS réclame 70 millions de dollars
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola accelerates, WHO calls for $70 million.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths as of July 11, 2026, marking the third-largest in the country's history. Transmission spans five provinces—Ituri (epicenter with ~26 health zones, about a dozen in critical condition), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—with 42 health zones affected. Daily confirmations have exceeded 80; many patients die at home, and 80% of new cases are not on contact lists, signaling untracked transmission chains. Response capacity is expanding to 700 hospital beds, 14 laboratories (vs. one initially), ~80% contact follow-up, and over 21,000 trained community agents. Clinical research includes the EBO-PEP trial by INRB and ALIMA evaluating obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis for contacts. Despite progress, a $70 million financing gap remains of the $115 million needed for surveillance, tracing, diagnostics, vaccines, and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラが加速、WHOが7000万ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例1,926例・死亡702例、5州42保健地区に拡大し、新規症例の80%が接触者リスト外という制御困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 国内史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行で、WHOが1億1500万ドルのうち7000万ドルの資金ギャップを訴えている。新規症例の80%が接触者未追跡であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の制御が困難な状況。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Resplice Foundation Launches Research Project to Study Rare, Fatal Measles Complication SSPE
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, India—As of 14 July 2026, Resplice Autism Research Foundation and Institute launches a project to understand why only a small fraction of children exposed to measles develop subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a fatal progressive brain disease with no cure. The study will probe host susceptibility factors—genomic, immune, epigenetic, microbiome, nutritional and metabolic—along with neuroinflammation, cytokines, and blood-brain barrier markers to explain vulnerability. Three children were enrolled for evaluation: one traveled from Delhi at an early stage, and two from Hingoli, Maharashtra arriving in the later stages, with minimal improvement in those already bedridden. No established cure exists; current care is supportive, though researchers hope early interventions could slow deterioration. A free medical and research camp for affected or at-risk children will be held August 9 in Manikonda, Hyderabad, 10 am to 5 pm; registrations: 9100065552 or 8433529769.

triage.headline_ja: Resplice財団、麻疹の稀な致死性合併症SSPEを研究するプロジェクトを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究プロジェクトの発足に関する報道であり、麻疹のアウトブレイクや急増を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はSSPE(亜急性硬化性全脳炎)研究プロジェクトの発足を報じるもので、麻疹の流行状況やアウトブレイクに関する情報は含まれていない。既存の3症例が言及されているのみで、公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ԱՀԿ. Կոնգոյի Դեմոկրատական ​​Հանրապետությունում Էբոլայի դեպքերի թիվը կարող է ավելի բարձր լինել, քան պաշտոնական տվյալները
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: OSCE. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of Ebola cases may be higher than official data.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease case numbers may be up to four times higher than official data, which report about 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths. WHO Health Emergencies Programme Director Chikwe Ihekweazu said that based on mathematical models, the outbreak scale is at least two to four times larger than detected. He noted that about 80% of new cases are identified from contacts outside known transmission chains, indicating many transmissions occur through unknown pathways. Additionally, many patients die at home without reaching medical facilities. The remarks underscore substantial underreporting and gaps in case finding, highlighting the challenge of detecting and responding to the ongoing outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ症例数は公式データより多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式統計の2〜4倍のエボラ症例が存在する可能性を指摘しており、報告体制の不備と伝播経路不明の症例が多いことから公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: WHO幹部の発言に基づき、報告されている症例・死亡数が実際の規模を大幅に過小評価している可能性が指摘されている。感染経路不明の症例が8割を占める点は流行拡大リスクとして重要。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Στη Γερμανία μεταφέρθηκε Αμερικανός που νόσησε με τον ιό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: An American who contracted the virus was transported to Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been evacuated to Germany for specialized care, the second such repatriation in weeks. The patient, about 60 years old, works as a warehouse manager for Samaritan's Purse in Bunia, Ituri Province, and arrived by air in Frankfurt, then was transferred to the University Hospital under strict isolation. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the patient was under close monitoring and posed no risk to the public. The Ituri outbreak, centered on Bunia, began in mid-May and marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC; the strain involved is Bundibugyo, with no approved vaccine or specific therapy. The disease spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids. U.S. authorities announced travel restrictions requiring Americans in DRC or recently departed to spend 21 days in a third country before flying to the United States.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で感染した米国人がドイツへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（イトゥリ州、ブンディブギョ株）で感染者が国外（ドイツ）へ搬送され、米国が渡航制限を発表するなど国際的拡大と渡航制限の両基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 患者はドイツとアメリカへ搬送されたが、発生地・アウトブレイクの主体はDRC（イトゥリ州ブンニア）。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ブンディブギョ株は承認されたワクチン・特効薬がなく、DRCで17回目のアウトブレイクという点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta que el brote de ébola en Congo podría llegar a ser hasta cuatro veces mayor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in Congo could be up to four times larger.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be two to four times higher than official counts. By July 12, 2026, the WHO reported 1,963 cases and 719 deaths, with predictive models noting substantial underreporting, especially in rural and hard‑to‑reach areas. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, a rare strain for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; this is the first major Bundibugyo-driven emergency in more than a decade. Security instability in eastern DRC compounds response, with armed groups, mass displacement, and limited access to affected communities. Health workers face wage delays and potential strikes, though many continue treating patients. Oxford University has begun early human trials of a candidate vaccine using the same technology as the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Overall global risk remains low, and the WHO sustains the public health emergency and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が最大4倍規模になる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式集計の2〜4倍の過小報告を指摘し、稀なブンディブギョ株（ワクチン・治療法未承認）による大規模流行かつ治安不安定による対応困難という複合的リスクが認められるため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: COVID-19はワクチン技術の比較対象として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題はエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行。過小報告の可能性、治安不安、医療従事者の賃金未払いによるストライキリスクなど対応能力に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Παγκόσμια ανησυχία για τον Έμπολα: Ο ΠΟΥ προειδοποιεί ότι η επιδημία μπορεί να είναι έως και τέσσερις φορές μεγαλύτερη από τις εκτιμήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global concern over Ebola: WHO warns that the outbreak could be up to four times larger than estimates.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in the eastern region with Ituri province hardest hit. The World Health Organization warns the epidemic could be up to four times larger than officially reported, estimating at least 2x–4x the confirmed cases. Government figures show about 1,926 infections and 702 deaths to date, amid spread into two additional provinces this week. The Bundibugyo strain has no proven treatment or vaccine. WHO notes improved detection of new cases, but financial support remains critically low, with roughly 40% of the $115 million appeal funded and under 50% of expected resources secured. Donors are urged to maintain backing during this critical phase. Effective control depends on intensified case detection, isolation, and rapid response across eastern provinces, amid ongoing transmission and limited therapeutics.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的懸念:エボラ出血熱 - WHOは流行が推定の4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が拡大中で、WHOが公式報告の最大4倍の規模になり得ると警告し、資金不足も深刻なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: Ituriは国ではなくDRC国内の州(ADM1)であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。ワクチン・治療薬未確立で人-人感染が継続しており、資金調達も不足しているため国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Kiadták a riasztást: sokkal súlyosabb lehet a járvány, mint eddig hitték
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An alert has been issued: the outbreak could be much more severe than previously believed.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) is considered potentially more severe than previously believed, with official counts possibly 2–4 times higher than reported. The DRC government lists at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths, though WHO cautions numbers are undercounted. The virus has spread to two additional provinces this week, increasing transmission risk. Critical response hinges on rapid case finding, isolation, and contact tracing, as there is no widely available effective treatment or licensed vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant. The situation is described as entering a critical phase, with funding for outbreak response severely short, about 40% of the $115 million budget received. WHO crises chief Chikwe Ihekweazu, after visiting Ituri, called on donors to boost support and stressed the need for long-term, sustained effort.

triage.headline_ja: 警告発令：流行はこれまで考えられていたよりもはるかに深刻な可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行がDRCで拡大し、感染者・死者数が公式発表より過小評価されている可能性があり、複数州への拡大、治療薬・ワクチン未承認、資金不足など公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がありIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: WHOが実際の感染者数は報告の2〜4倍の可能性があると警告。治療薬・ワクチンが未承認のブンディブギョ型であり、資金不足（必要額の40%のみ確保）で対応が逼迫している。

article.articleHeadline: Rémisztő adatokat közölt a WHO: kétszer annyi az ebolafertőzöttek száma, mint eddig hitték
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming data from the WHO: the number of Ebola infections is twice as high as previously thought.
article.articleSummary: Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO emergencies chief, said Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times higher than official counts, as the Ituri province outbreak intensifies and has spread to two additional provinces this week. Congolese government data report at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths. Separately, the Bundibugyo outbreak in Uganda has attracted about 115 million USD in pledges, with roughly 40% funded; there remains no proven treatment or vaccine. WHO warns that resources must match the scale of the challenge and urges donors not to abandon the country during this critical phase, calling for intensified case finding and isolation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが衝撃的なデータを発表：エボラ感染者数はこれまで考えられていたより2倍多い
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行が拡大し複数州に拡大、実際の感染者数が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性があるとWHOが警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州のエボラ流行拡大とWHOによる過小報告の警告が主題。ウガンダ・ブンディブギョの流行にも言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。有効な治療法・ワクチンが未確立で、資金調達も40%に留まる点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 3 children dead, 4 on life support as Chandipura virus outbreak hits Gujarat
article.articleSummary: Three children have died and four others are on ventilator support as Gujarat faces a Chandipura virus outbreak. Over the past 14 days (since July 1, 2026), 32 suspected cases have been reported; test results for 23 patients show seven positives and 16 negatives. All seven confirmed cases are under 10 years old; two recovered and discharged, while three deaths have occurred and four remain on ventilators. A two-year-old girl from Meghraj taluka in Aravalli district is the latest suspected case, admitted to Himmatnagar Civil Hospital. Authorities have issued paediatric guidelines, intensified surveillance, and involved the Indian Medical Association and child specialists. Doctors in smaller clinics are instructed to refer suspected cases to hospitals with oxygen and ventilators promptly. Preventive measures include fogging, spraying and sanitisation. CHPV is sand fly–borne, causes fever and acute encephalitis syndrome; vectors include mosquitoes, ticks and sandflies; first isolated in Chandipura village, Maharashtra, in 1965.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症が拡大、子ども3人死亡・4人が生命維持装置管理下
triage.triage_reason: インドのグジャラート州で子どもを中心に重症・死亡例が発生しているベクター媒介性ウイルス感染症であり、メディア・行政の注目度も高いため、フルリスク評価に進める必要がある。
triage.notes: Chandipura virus（サシチョウバエ媒介）は毎年モンスーン期にグジャラート州周辺で散発的に発生することが知られており、今回の流行が例年と比べ異常に大規模かどうかは記事から判断できないため『不明』とした。致死率の高さと小児への重症化は注視すべき点。

article.articleHeadline: Diadema inicia campanha Julho Amarelo contra hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diadema launches the Yellow July campaign against viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Diadema, Brazil, launches the Yellow July campaign to raise awareness and prevent viral hepatitis. Throughout July 2026, residents can access guidance, rapid testing, and vaccination at Basic Health Units (UBSs) and other health services. The initiative aims to expand early diagnosis of viral hepatitis and underscores that testing is quick, free, and safe. Residents are encouraged to visit their designated UBS to participate and obtain information on prevention, diagnosis, and immunization. UBS locations can be found via the Diadema municipal portal (UBS by neighborhood). Link: https://portal.diadema.sp.gov.br/ubs-por-bairro/. The campaign emphasizes accessibility to screening and immunization to reduce disease burden. No case counts or outbreaks are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ディアデマ市、ウイルス性肝炎対策「イエロージュライ」キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は啓発キャンペーンの案内であり、症例数や集団発生の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ディアデマ市における肝炎予防啓発キャンペーンの告知であり、アウトブレイクや症例報告は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: High-level health meeting to tackle Covid spread | Bhubaneswar News
article.articleSummary: Odisha's health and family welfare department has stepped up preparedness for Covid-19 amid rising cases in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, ahead of Rath Yatra in Bhubaneswar. In a high-level meeting chaired by Health and Family Welfare Minister Mukesh Mahaling, senior officials and the director of health services reviewed surveillance strengthening and preventive measures. Officials warned that Covid-19 cases have been reported in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, but Mahaling assured residents there is no cause for panic and that the state is fully equipped to handle any situation. The chief district medical and public health officer directed all healthcare facilities—City Hospital, sub-divisional hospitals, community health centres and primary health centres—to remain on high alert. The emphasis is on preventing spread during the Rath Yatra period in Odisha.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ感染拡大対策のため保健当局が緊急会議を開催｜ブバネーシュワールニュース
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の感染症であり異常性は低いが、Rath Yatraという大規模集会を控え近隣州で感染増加が報告されているため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Odisha州、Andhra Pradesh州、Tamil Nadu州でCOVID-19症例増加が報告されているが、重症度や死亡者数の情報はなし。Rath Yatra（大規模宗教行事）前の予防的対応として州保健当局が会議を実施した内容。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة عمون : الصحة العالمية: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو أضعاف الأرقام الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ammon News: World Health Organization: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are several times higher than official figures.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization says Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are at least double, and possibly up to quadruple, the official figure. Citing models, WHO's Emergency Programme Director Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu told reporters in Geneva after a visit to eastern DRC that the outbreak size is at least 2–4 times the detected cases. On July 12, 2026, the DRC reported 1,963 confirmed Ebola cases and 719 deaths. The ongoing outbreak remains active, with laboratory-confirmed case counts showing the disease's persistence across the country. The article notes the true burden may be substantially higher than official tallies, underscoring surveillance gaps. No information on specific infection sources or imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: アモン・ニュース：世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数は公式統計の数倍に上ると発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のDRCでの継続的アウトブレイクにおいて、WHOが実際の感染者数は公式発表の2〜4倍に上ると警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関心の高さからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO関係者のジュネーブでの発言を報じているが、アウトブレイクの実際の発生地はDRCのみであるため、Genève/SwitzerlandはVerified locationsから除外した。致死率は約37%（719/1963）と高く、サーベイランスの不備による過小報告が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak two to four times bigger than official scale: WHO
article.articleSummary: Two to four times bigger than official scale, the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak is the third-largest on record, with the fastest monthly growth among outbreaks managed by WHO. Declared May 15 in Ituri, a mineral-rich northeastern province, cases have been detected in five DRC provinces and in Uganda, though more than 90% of cases are in Ituri. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Many newly reported cases died in communities before reaching health facilities. Response capacity now exceeds 700 treatment beds, laboratory capacity has expanded dramatically, and contact follow-up rates approach 80%. In the past days, over 80 cases were confirmed in a single day, a sign that fewer cases are escaping detection and that the response is maturing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、公式統計の2〜4倍規模か:WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）が公式発表の2〜4倍規模であり、既にウガンダへ越境拡大していることから国際的拡大リスクが顕在化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる流行であり、コミュニティ内死亡例が多い点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ЕБОЛА СЕ ШИРИ ВО КОНГО: СЗО стравува дека бројот на заразени е многу поголем
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo: WHO fears that the number of infections is much higher.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times higher than officially reported, with infections potentially far above 1,926 cases and 702 deaths to date. While detection capacity is improving daily, the response is in a critical phase as new cases emerge in two additional provinces. The organization has received only about 40% of the $115 million it sought to contain the Bundibugyo virus outbreak, leaving substantial funding gaps for surveillance, isolation, and care. There is currently no proven treatment or vaccine for this Ebola strain. Authorities emphasize that the scale requires resources commensurate with the problem and that the DRC cannot shoulder it alone. Donor support is urged to continue through the critical period.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大：WHOは感染者数がはるかに多いのではないかと懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが公式報告の2〜4倍の可能性があり、複数州への拡大、治療法・ワクチン未確立、資金不足という深刻な状況でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、WHOは資金不足（要請額の約40%のみ確保）を強調。新たに2州で症例発生と拡大傾向。

article.articleHeadline: As syphilis cases surge in Latin America, experts urge prevention
article.articleSummary: Syphilis cases surge across Latin America and the Caribbean, with PAHO reporting 4.2 million new syphilis cases in the Americas in 2024, 90% of them in Latin America and the Caribbean, mostly among people aged 15–49. Chile’s syphilis rate rose 2.4-fold from 2016 to 2025, to 55.2 per 100,000, with infections concentrated in men 15–39; poor awareness and low condom use contribute, though screening has expanded. Argentina recorded 46,779 syphilis cases in 2025 (117.2 per 100,000), a 75.6% increase from 2022; a 2026 first report shows a 109% rise versus prior years. Uruguay labels congenital syphilis as an epidemiological problem, with first-half-2026 cases up 40% vs 2025 and a cumulative incidence of 105.19 per 100,000 (75.17 previously). Brazil highlights rising vertical transmission, with over 810,000 syphilis cases among pregnant women from 2005–2025. Mexico logged 18,384 cases in 2024 and 21,617 in 2025. Experts link prevention declines and reduced condom use to the trend, noting many infections are asymptomatic and undiagnosed without testing.

triage.headline_ja: ラテンアメリカで梅毒症例が急増、専門家が予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 梅毒はよく知られた性感染症であり、既存の疫学データに基づく緩やかな増加傾向の報告であって、突発的・異常な感染症イベントではないため、フルRRAの対象とはしない。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（チリ、アルゼンチン、ウルグアイ、メキシコ、ブラジル等）にまたがるラテンアメリカ全体の梅毒・先天性梅毒増加傾向を扱う内容。対象国リストの中ではブラジルのみが該当。急性の公衆衛生危機ではなく、既知の性感染症の慢性的増加トレンドであるためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Rapid survey found a mosquito hotspot every minute | Surat News
article.articleSummary: Surat's monsoon rains and floods intensified mosquito breeding, prompting a rapid citywide survey by the Surat Municipal Corporation’s health department. Between July 1 and July 9, 2026, around 550 vector-borne disease control staff identified about 1.9 million potential breeding spots across the city. The drive surveyed 554,000 homes and found more than three water-accumulation points per household on average, equaling roughly one breeding location every minute. Officials said the operation aimed to curb dengue and malaria risks amid heavy rainfall that began July 7 and left several localities waterlogged through July 9. Construction sites emerged as a major challenge, with multi-storey projects offering numerous water-collection points (open slabs, basements, curing pits, stored materials, unattended containers). Counting rules noted: a water-filled flowerpot counts as one spot at homes; at construction sites, water on a single floor counts as one spot despite multiple floors.

article.articleHeadline: J&K declares leprosy 'Notifiable Disease'
article.articleSummary: Jammu and Kashmir (UT) has declared leprosy a notifiable disease with immediate effect, requiring all government and private healthcare facilities to report every diagnosed case to the Chief Medical Officer, with copies to the District Leprosy Officer and State Leprosy Officer in the prescribed format. Leprosy, caused by Mycobacterium leprae, is a chronic infectious disease affecting the skin, peripheral nerves, mucosa of the upper respiratory tract, and eyes. While curable, delayed diagnosis can lead to permanent disabilities and ongoing transmission. The notification follows a May 2025 MoHFW recommendation and aligns with India's National Leprosy Eradication Programme, the National Strategic Plan 2023-2027, and the Global Leprosy Strategy 2021-2030, aiming for a Leprosy-Free India. It invokes the Epidemic Diseases Act 1897 and the Clinical Establishments Act 2010, coming into force immediately and remaining until further orders.

article.articleHeadline: IMA issues diectives on Chandipura virus in Gujarat
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak warnings issued in Gujarat (Ahmedabad). As of 14 July 2026, Gujarat has confirmed three child deaths with several more suspected cases awaiting laboratory confirmation. The Gujarat State Branch of the Indian Medical Association (GSB-IMA) issued urgent medical advisories for general public and pediatricians. Clinicians are urged to maintain a high index of suspicion, meticulously evaluate epidemiological history, track past outbreaks and local transmission, and vigilantly monitor symptoms—sudden high-grade fever, acute encephalitis, and severe convulsions—for early detection. For the public, preventive measures are advised and parents are urged to seek immediate medical care if distress signs appear, as early detection is critical to reduce fatalities during this sandfly-transmitted viral surge.
