article.articleHeadline: Waterborne diseases continue to surge in city, 345 cases reported in 12 days
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad reports a continuing surge in waterborne illnesses during the monsoon, with 345 fresh cases in the first 12 days of July (July 1–12): 196 diarrhoea with vomiting, 127 typhoid, and 22 jaundice. The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation flagged water quality concerns: among 20,675 tested samples for chlorine, 22 lacked residual chlorine; bacteriological testing of 2,990 samples found 26 unfit for consumption. Vector-borne cases during the period included 10 malaria and 8 dengue. Cumulative figures up to July 12 show 3,330 diarrhoea-vomiting, 1,061 typhoid, and 386 jaundice, plus 135 malaria (including 14 falciparum), 167 dengue, and 2 chikungunya infections. The data highlight water safety risks and ongoing outbreaks in the monsoon season, with health authorities continuing water surveillance and disease monitoring in Ahmedabad. Imported/exported cases details are not provided.

article.articleHeadline: CDC warns about likely COVID-19 surge in summer
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 set for a likely summer surge as CDC reports a fifth consecutive week of rising COVID-19-related emergency department visits, totaling 2,811 last week, up 34.4% from the prior week. Authorities in China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore report comparable spikes. Up-to-date vaccination is advised to fend off the seasonal wave. Despite relatively low ER figures, projections indicate an outbreak of as many as 5,000 critical patients per week over the next three weeks, with peak hospitalizations not exceeding 50,000 per week one to two months after the initial local rise. Herd immunity and summer vacations may help limit spread. The CDC extends its free vaccination program to all residents older than six months through month-end, with 450,000 Moderna single-dose and 6,000 Novavax shots in stock. Since October last year, 136 severe cases and 18 deaths have been recorded; 72.1% of severe cases were 65+, 83.8% had chronic illness, and 94.9% were not up to date with vaccines. Elderly and immunocompromised people should seek vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: 《TAIPEI TIMES》 CDC confirms this year's first Zika virus infection
article.articleSummary: Taiwan confirms this year’s first Zika infection, alongside three new local Japanese encephalitis (JE) cases reported last week. The Zika patient is a man in his 30s from northern Taiwan who traveled to Thailand; fever, dizziness and a rash developed after returning, and the case is imported. Taiwan has had 31 Zika infections since 2016, all imported, most from Southeast Asia; 13 cases occurred in 2016, with zero to four cases in other years. The JE cases are in Taoyuan’s Guanyin and Taoyuan districts and Changhua County’s Huatan, all in their 70s, who began symptoms last month and tested positive. JE can progress to acute encephalitis with up to 30% fatality and permanent neurological damage in survivors; transmission is May–October, higher near rice paddies, pig pens, or pigeon lofts. Two-dose JE vaccine is in the Childhood Immunization Schedule; high-risk individuals should consult a doctor about vaccination. Pregnant women should avoid areas with Zika.

article.articleHeadline: CDC confirms this year's first Zika virus infection
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-15, Taiwan reports this year’s first Zika virus infection: a man in his 30s who was bitten in Thailand; Zika cases in Taiwan total 31 since 2016, all imported, most from Southeast Asia. Zika symptoms include fever, dizziness, and rash; adults usually mild, but infection can cause birth defects, so pregnant women or those planning pregnancy should avoid affected areas. Three new local Japanese encephalitis cases were confirmed in Taoyuan's Guanyin and Taoyuan districts and Changhua County's Huatan Township; all are in their 70s, onset last month. JE can be asymptomatic; up to 30% progress to acute encephalitis with fatality up to 30% and 30–50% of survivors with permanent neurological damage. Transmission is mosquito-borne; season is May–October, with peaks in June–July. Prevention includes avoiding dawn/dusk outdoor activities near high-risk environments (rice paddies, pig pens, pigeon lofts) and vaccination—two JE doses are in the Childhood Immunization Schedule; high-risk individuals should consider vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola, estrecho de Ormuz, precios del café y el té, Corte Penal Internacional... Las noticias del martes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the Strait of Hormuz, Coffee and Tea Prices, the International Criminal Court... Tuesday's News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to accelerate. As of July 11, nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been reported across five provinces, marking it as the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The World Health Organization notes substantial response gains: treatment capacity expanded to about 800 beds, the laboratory network increasing from 1 to 14 centers, and contact tracing around 80%. Despite progress, many patients still die in communities without access to care. The WHO has requested $115 million for the response but faces a $70 million funding shortfall. Emphasis is placed on early case detection and rapid referral to facilities, building community trust in care, and ensuring accessible treatment sites to reduce transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Alemanha recebe cidadão norte-americano infetado com Ébola na RDCongo para tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany receives an American citizen infected with Ebola in the DRC for treatment.
article.articleSummary: Germany received a second American Ebola patient from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, transferring him from Bunia, Ituri, to Frankfurt for treatment, after a prior US case was treated in Berlin. The current outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is the third-largest Ebola epidemic and has caused 702 deaths among 1,926 confirmed cases in the DRC, with the outbreak now reaching North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé. Uganda has reported 20 cases linked to the surge. The patient is a humanitarian worker in Ituri near the Sudanese and Ugandan borders; the World Health Organization noted clinical monitoring before transfer, and he will continue care at a German hospital. Bundibugyo Ebola has a case fatality rate of 30-50% and there is no vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO considers the outbreak high risk in sub-Saharan Africa, but low globally, with conditions that could fuel further spread.

article.articleHeadline: 'This Is a Fire': WHO Says Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Spreading Faster Than Any Ever Seen | Common Dreams
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak. As of 2026-07-14, the DRC reports nearly 2,000 confirmed infections and more than 700 deaths, with true numbers possibly 2-4 times higher due to undetected cases. 95% of new cases are in Ituri province, where it began in May, with spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The WHO notes the fastest monthly growth and daily new infections, including over 80 cases confirmed in a single day. About 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains. Uganda has around 20 infections and at least two deaths. Ebola mortality ranges 25-90% depending on strain and care. Healthcare workers: 112 infected, 32 dead; treatment capacity >700 beds; lab capacity expanding; contact follow-up ~80%. Strikes and funding shortages hinder response; root causes include conflict, displacement, fear, misinformation; calls for regional support.

article.articleHeadline: Vai viajar? Veja como evitar focos da dengue antes de sair de casa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are you traveling? See how to avoid dengue hotspots before leaving home.
article.articleSummary: Belém, Brazil, urges travelers to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya by targeting Aedes aegypti before leaving. With July holiday travel rising, the Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesma) recommends a pre-departure home inspection to eliminate breeding sites. Key measures: seal water tanks, remove containers that collect water, clean gutters and drains, place sand in plant saucers or remove them, store tires in covered areas, and keep pools clean and treated. Sesma’s endemic-control teams conduct house visits, remove breeding sites, advise residents, perform focal treatment when needed, and monitor areas. Coordinator Shirley Santos warns that lower rainfall during the Amazonian summer does not erase risk; the mosquito will still find places to breed. Before traveling, inspect water tanks, gutters, drains, plant pots, and any container that can hold water, and arrange for a neighbor to monitor the property. Report suspected foci via Vigilância em Saúde form or Disk Endemias at (91) 98402-0894.

article.articleHeadline: Nagpur Sees Surge In Viral Infections Amid Monsoon Lull, Say Doctors | Nagpur News
article.articleSummary: Nagpur sees a surge in seasonal viral infections amid monsoon lull, with hospitals reporting more school-age children presenting with high fever, headaches, vomiting, diarrhoea and body pains. Doctors link the spike to weather changes, school reopenings, and circulation of multiple seasonal viruses. Influenza cases have risen, with high-grade fever for three to four days and marked weakness. Etiologies cited include influenza, dengue, enteroviruses and RSV; adenovirus, rotavirus and norovirus are also common, particularly in young children. Bacterial illnesses such as typhoid and urinary tract infections may present similarly and require timely diagnosis. Most infections are self-limiting and managed with rest and hydration; ORS advised. Warn signs include fever beyond three days, breathing trouble, persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, seizures, bleeding, or reduced urination. Emphasize hygiene and safe water; avoid self-medication and unnecessary antibiotics.

article.articleHeadline: Eatery in Kochi shut down after nearly 50 hit by suspected food poisoning
article.articleSummary: Kochi, India – Approximately 50 people who dined at Al-Reem, an Arabic restaurant on Thammanam-Pulleppady Road, have been diagnosed with suspected food poisoning after meals consumed July 10. Complaints surfaced on July 13, and several patients remain admitted in hospitals across Kochi. Food safety officials shut down the restaurant and suspended its licence as the investigation proceeds. Samples collected from the eatery have been sent to laboratory for examination. Kuzhi Manthi and alfam are among the main dishes served and initially linked to the illnesses. Reported symptoms include fever, vomiting and dysentery. The Food Safety department expects additional complaints in the coming days and has recorded statements from those currently under treatment. No laboratory-confirmed pathogen is reported yet; investigation ongoing, with source suspected to be linked to a single establishment.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province’s Bunia, is intensifying. As of May through July 11, laboratory-confirmed cases reached 1,976 with 702 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. article.articleHeadline: GENEVA / EBOLA UPDATE
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a major Ebola outbreak spanning five provinces with close to 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths. The World Health Organization calls it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and notes the fastest month-to-month growth of any outbreak to date. In recent days, more than 80 cases were confirmed in a single day. Alarmingly, many deaths occurred in communities without health facility access, and about 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains outside established contact lists. Two new affected provinces, Haut-Uele and Tshopo (Kisangani), have reported cases. Authorities urge earlier detection and rapid care to reduce transmission, and stress building community trust through visible care, food support, and family access at facilities. The footage includes an Ebola Treatment Centre at Evangelical Medical Centre in Bunia, Ituri Province.

article.articleHeadline: Un hongo en gatos pone en alerta a Sudamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Fungus in Cats Puts South America on Alert.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, a virulent fungal variant of Sporothrix schenckii, is spreading via cats across South America, prompting regional and global concern. Brazil has faced a long-running outbreak since the 1990s, with the World Health Organization noting more than 11,000 human cases linked to this species in the past decade, predominantly in Brazil. The fungus is dimorphic: environmental mold at ~25°C and yeast-form inside mammals at ~37°C, enabling environmental survival and mammalian infection. Infected cats develop ulcers, cutaneous nodules, lymphadenitis, and facial or limb lesions; without antifungal treatment, disease can progress to the respiratory tract and disseminate. Human transmission occurs mainly through scratches, with bites and contact with lesion secretions or contaminated fluids also posing risks. Stray cats facilitate spread; Brazil, Paraguay, Argentina, Chile, and Uruguay have reported cases, including a 2026 zoonotic case in a Chilean veterinarian. At ASM Microbe (June 2026), CDC’s Shawn Lockhart warned the United States’ arrival is ‘only a matter of time.’

triage.headline_ja: 猫由来の真菌が南米に警戒を促す
triage.triage_reason: ヒトー動物（猫）間で感染するSporothrix brasiliensisが南米複数国に拡大し、CDC専門家が米国への波及を警告するなど国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルを中心に、アルゼンチン・チリ・ウルグアイ・パラグアイでの症例拡大とCDCの米国上陸警告に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Estado passa a recomendar dose zero contra o sarampo em São Bernardo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Now Recommends Zero-Dose Measles Vaccine in São Bernardo
article.articleSummary: On July 14, 2026, SES-SP advised a zero-dose measles vaccination for babies aged 6 to 11 months 29 days in São Bernardo, with similar guidance for residents of São Paulo and Guarulhos, in response to suspected measles cases. The aim is to expand protection for children under one year, the most vulnerable to severe disease. The zero-dose does not replace the routine schedule; after receiving it, children should complete the standard schedule: first dose of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine at 12 months and a second dose (preferably tetraviral) at 15 months. Families should check vaccination cards and visit a health unit to update schedules. The measure may be used in vaccination-block campaigns around suspected/confirmed cases; adults should also regularize their vaccination status.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、サンベルナルドで麻疹ゼロ回接種を推奨開始
triage.triage_reason: 疑い麻疹症例への対応としてゼロ回接種を推奨しているが、確定症例数や規模等の詳細情報が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は疑い症例への予防的措置（ゼロ回接種推奨）を報じているが、確定症例数や発生規模の詳細は記載なし。麻疹は感染力が強くワクチン未接種の乳児に影響しやすいため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo: OMS advierte que brote de ébola podría ser hasta cuatro veces mayor de los reportado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak could be up to four times larger than reported.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be three to four times larger than official figures. The undercount is attributed to resource shortages and ongoing violence in the affected region, which hinder containment and case-finding. The rapid transmission rate is outpacing the region’s response capacity, complicating surveillance and control measures. The warning signals a substantially higher outbreak burden than reported and underscores the need for intensified international support, resources, and security measures to bolster outbreak response in DR Congo. It also calls for strengthened surveillance, logistics, and protection of frontline health workers to address the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行が報告数の最大4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がWHOにより過小報告と警告されており、暴力や資源不足による対応能力の限界、国際支援の必要性が示されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 報告数が過小評価されている可能性が高く、実際の感染規模やヒト-ヒト感染の広がりについて続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas registra 20ª morte por gripe em 2026 com 247 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas records its 20th influenza death in 2026 with 247 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports 247 influenza-related Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases and 20 deaths in 2026, all with preexisting conditions. Three recent fatalities: a 69-year-old man (comorbidities, vaccinated) on June 7; an 82-year-old man (comorbidities, vaccinated) on June 12; an 85-year-old woman (comorbidities, unvaccinated) on June 28. Vaccination is available to all residents aged six months and older at 69 health centers, with no appointment needed. The 2026 vaccine protects against influenza A (H1N1, H3N2) and influenza B, and can be given alongside other vaccines. Since March 28, the city has administered 318,032 doses; access expanded to all residents on June 1. Coverage: seniors 55.78% (124,775 doses); children 6 months–<6 years 46.17% (31,548 doses); pregnant 68.94% (5,928 doses). Preventive measures include hand hygiene, well-ventilated spaces, hydration, balanced nutrition, and masking when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス市、2026年のインフルエンザ死亡者が20人に、確認症例247件
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる死亡・症例報告であり、死亡者は全員基礎疾患を有する既知の病原体（H1N1、H3N2、B型）。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、ワクチン接種等の通常対応が行われている。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する定例的な地方公衆衛生報告。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空。既知病原体、既知対策（ワクチン接種）で管理されており、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dødelig virus sprer seg raskt: Hundrevis er døde | Dagens.no
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus spreading rapidly: Hundreds have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. In the latest 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 new deaths reported. Two additional suspected cases in Kisangani not yet in official counts. WHO notes the outbreak remains in a growth phase; facilities near capacity complicate response. Declared May 15; authorities have intensified contact tracing, surveillance and prevention in affected areas to curb transmission. Ebola, a severe viral disease, presents with fever, fatigue, muscle pains; severe cases may involve internal/external bleeding, organ failure, and death. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of a sick person; rapid identification and isolation are critical to prevent further spread. International health authorities monitor the situation closely.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスが急速に拡大：数百人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、確定症例1,759件・死亡600人、直近24時間で51新規症例・20死亡と拡大局面にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: WHOは増加局面にあると指摘し、医療施設が定員に近づき対応が困難化していると報告。5月15日に発生宣言。キサンガニでの疑い例2件は公式集計未反映。継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : plusieurs structures sanitaires ne disposent pas d'équipements de riposte(Médecin directeur) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: several health facilities do not have outbreak-response equipment (Medical Director) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Haut-Uele, Democratic Republic of the Congo (14 July 2026): multiple health facilities in Isiro lack outbreak-response equipment for Ebola virus disease (EVD). Dr. John Kaingama, medical director of Libiki Clinic, reports no briefing invitation or provision of appropriate materials from the provincial outbreak-response team, leaving facilities to emphasize preventive measures while awaiting support. Critical gaps include PPE and protective gear for healthcare workers, creating risk during interventions where Ebola signs may be absent initially. The Libiki Clinic cannot manage potential EVD cases and redirects suspected patients to Isiro General Referral Hospital; the Red Cross disinfected a patient bed when a suspected case arrived. The suspected case originated from Ituri Province (PK 51, Nia-Nia) and was transferred accordingly. Kaingama calls for broad sensitization (civil society, media, churches) and urges central and provincial authorities to supply equipment and guidance to sustain infection-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：複数の医療施設が対応装備を欠く（医療部長）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い症例が発生し、医療施設でPPE等の対応装備が不足しているため、院内感染や地域拡大のリスクが高い。WPRO基準を複数満たしており、外部支援の必要性も示唆される。
triage.notes: 疑い症例はイトゥリ州（Nia-Nia, PK51）からの転送例であり、オー・ウエレ州イジロの医療施設ではPPE等の防護具・対応資機材が不足している。エボラはDRCで既知の疾患だが、装備不足による院内感染リスクと地域拡大の懸念からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: Число зараженных вирусом Эбола в 2-4 раза выше, чем известно врачам
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus is 2-4 times higher than what doctors know.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: WHO emergencies chief Chikwe Ihekweazu stated in Geneva that 1,963 people are infected and 719 have died to date. Most patients die at home, elevating transmission risk, and four of five newly infected individuals were not previously on contact lists, indicating undetected transmission chains. Health capacity features about 800 beds in treatment centers and 14 laboratories capable of rapid testing, yet only 40% of the $115 million needed has been funded. Gilead Sciences has launched recruitment for a clinical trial of an experimental antiviral, obeldesivira, intended for post-exposure prophylaxis against the Bundibugyo strain. The Congo-led study, organized with France’s ANRS and supported by ALIMA and Doctors Without Borders, aims to enroll ~1,000 people aged 12+ with high-risk exposure within five days of contact to assess whether the drug reduces progression to disease.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラウイルス感染者数は医師が把握している数の2〜4倍に上る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（感染者1,963人、死者719人）で、未検出の感染連鎖が示唆されており、国際的拡大リスクと資金不足による対応能力の懸念がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerland/Franceが含まれるが、これらはWHO会見開催地・研究協力機関の所在地であり、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。資金不足（必要額の40%のみ確保）と未検出の感染連鎖（新規感染者の4/5が接触者リスト外）が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: "Demokratik Kongo Cumhuriyeti'ndeki Ebola Salgını En Hızlı Dönemini Yaşıyor"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Is in Its Fastest Phase
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in its fastest growth phase to date, according to the World Health Organization. As of July 11, confirmed cases approach 2,000 with deaths over 700 across five provinces, centered in Ituri Province in eastern DRC, and now extending to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The outbreak is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. In the latest 24-hour period, more than 80 new confirmed cases were reported, the highest daily total so far. About 80% of cases have no link to known contacts, indicating undiscovered transmission chains. The response runs two parallel tracks: containing the Ituri outbreak and mapping risk in new areas. There is no approved Bundibugyo-specific treatment; early supportive care improves survival. Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, and in late stages internal and external bleeding; transmission is via direct contact with body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、これまでで最も急速な拡大局面に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上3番目の規模に拡大し、感染者2000人・死者700人超、複数州へ拡大中で未知の感染連鎖も多く、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に急速拡大を発表しており、史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行。80%の症例が既知の接触者と無関係で、未発見の感染連鎖が疑われる点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Covid Returns? Odisha Issues Alert After Fresh Cases in Andhra Pradesh | Health Update
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 alert: Odisha tightens readiness after fresh infections are reported in neighbouring Andhra Pradesh as of 14 July 2026. The Health Department has instructed hospitals to remain prepared, with a focus on Ganjam district, to operate dedicated Covid wards, ensure oxygen facilities, available medicines, and other essential treatment arrangements. Doctors say the circulating variant currently is not as severe as earlier strains, but authorities call for continued hygiene, adherence to health advisories, and cautious behavior. The update implies precautionary measures rather than a confirmed local outbreak, underscoring cross-border transmission risk. No specific case or death tallies are provided in the report. Public messaging emphasizes vigilance, timely reporting of symptoms, and readiness of health facilities to manage potential cases.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ再来？オディシャ州がアンドラプラデシュ州での新規感染確認を受けて警戒発令 | 健康アップデート
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新規感染例を受けた予防的な警戒態勢の発表であり、重症度は低いとされ具体的な症例数・死亡数も不明のため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 既存の流行株であり重症度も低いとされる。現時点では確認された地域アウトブレイクではなく予防的措置。具体的な症例数・死亡数のデータなし。

article.articleHeadline: Eurofarma firma parceria para trazer vacina contra chikungunya ao Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eurofarma signs a partnership to bring a Chikungunya vaccine to Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccine CHIKV VLP secures exclusive Brazilian commercialization rights for Eurofarma in a partnership with Bavarian Nordic, with optional expansion rights for other Latin American markets. Eurofarma submitted the product to Anvisa in June 2026 as part of Brazil’s ongoing response to chikungunya, a disease burdening health systems. Global 2025 data show over 490,000 cases and about 200 deaths; Brazil alone reported nearly 130,000 cases and 120 deaths in the same period. CHIKV VLP is a single-dose recombinant vaccine using virus-like particles, non-infectious, with a favorable safety profile and rapid neutralizing antibody responses across adolescents, adults and older adults. It is already approved for active immunization from age 12 in the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Switzerland and Canada under the brand VIMKUNYA. The deal supports Brazil’s National Contingency Plan for dengue, chikungunya and zika, and positions vaccination as a complement to surveillance and vector-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: Eurofarma社、チクングニアワクチンをブラジルに導入するためのパートナーシップを締結
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン導入に関する商業提携のニュースであり、新たな公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急対応を要する内容ではない。
triage.notes: チクングニアの流行状況自体は既知の継続的公衆衛生課題であり、本記事はワクチン商業化・規制承認に関する内容。米国・EU・英国・スイス・カナダは既承認地域として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: اتساع رقعة تفشي إيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expansion of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding rapidly as of 14 July 2026, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, described as the fastest-spreading since the outbreak began. The World Health Organization says the outbreak continues to outpace response efforts, with 80% of new Ebola infections occurring outside the organization’s contact lists. Ebola, first identified in 1976, is a deadly viral disease transmitted by direct contact with body fluids and is believed to be a spillover from bats. The virus can cause severe bleeding and multi-organ failure. The article notes no specific case or death counts, and highlights surveillance gaps reflected by infections beyond traditional contact tracing, underscoring challenges in containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大とサーベイランス体制の限界（新規感染の80%が接触者リスト外）が示されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。ブンディブギョ株による急速拡大とWHOの対応が追いついていない点が主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό - Φόβοι για χιλιάδες αδήλωτα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in the DRC - fears of thousands of unreported cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) intensifies, with Ituri Province hardest hit as cases spread to two additional provinces. The WHO raises the alert for Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, noting the true scale may be two- to four-times higher than official tallies. Authorities report at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths; delayed detection and limited access in affected areas suggest substantial underreporting. Health teams are now identifying more cases, underscoring the need for rapid case finding, immediate isolation, and tighter contact tracing to curb transmission chains. Financial shortfalls hamper response: the WHO has secured only about 40% of the $115 million requested. Officials warn the country cannot shoulder this burden alone and urge sustained international support. The outbreak is at a critical stage— improved detection reveals a larger, more dangerous epidemic than previously thought.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ警戒 - 数千件の未報告症例への懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,926症例、702死亡）で複数州に拡大し、資金不足も深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOは公式集計の2〜4倍の実際の症例数を懸念しており、資金は要請額の約40%しか確保されていない。複数州への拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas chega a 20 mortes por gripe em 2026 - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas reaches 20 flu deaths in 2026 - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports 247 influenza-linked severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases and 20 deaths in 2026, with the latest confirmations highlighting higher risk among individuals with comorbidities. Two male victims aged 69 and 82 were vaccinated; a female, 85, was unvaccinated. Health authorities urge vaccination, available to everyone over 6 months old at 69 health centers; no appointment needed. Since March 28, Campinas has administered 318,032 flu vaccine doses, with expanded access to the entire population over 6 months on June 1. The vaccine protects against influenza A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and influenza B and can be given alongside other vaccines in the National Immunization Schedule. In 2025, the city recorded 561 SRAG cases and 69 deaths, with 54 unvaccinated victims, underscoring vaccination's role in preventing severe disease and death.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナス市、2026年のインフルエンザ死者数が20人に到達 - ACidade ON Campinas
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる通常の重症化・死亡例の報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。前年比でも件数は減少傾向にあり、既存の予防接種プログラムで対応中。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A/H1N1, A/H3N2, B型）による地域的な報告。ワクチン接種の呼びかけが中心の公衆衛生広報記事であり、前年（2025年）と比較しても死亡率は改善傾向。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS annonce le premier essai d'un antiviral contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces the first trial of an antiviral against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO launches the first trial of an Ebola antiviral in the Democratic Republic of Congo to counter Bundibugyo Ebola virus transmission. The EBO-PEP study tests oral obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis in people exposed to confirmed Bundibugyo cases. The experimental antiviral from Gilead Sciences showed efficacy in preclinical filovirus models. The trial began on Tuesday, as announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus via X, who cautioned that if effective it could prevent disease among contacts. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo variant. In the DRC, this rare Ebola species has infected over 1,960 people and caused more than 700 deaths, according to authorities. The study aims to determine if early post-exposure antiviral administration can halt disease progression in exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスに対する初の抗ウイルス薬治験を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で希少なブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスにより1,960人超が感染、700人超が死亡している深刻な流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスには承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、WHO主導で曝露後予防としての抗ウイルス薬（obeldesivir）の治験が開始された。感染者数・死者数の規模から既に大規模流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": عدد إصابات إيبولا ضعف الحصيلة الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The number of Ebola infections is twice the official tally.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), especially in its eastern regions. The World Health Organization states that the true number of Ebola infections is at least twice, and perhaps four times, the official tally. The claim was made by the WHO Emergency Programme Director for Health Emergencies, speaking to reporters in Geneva after a visit to eastern DRC. Based on available support and modeling, the outbreak’s scale likely exceeds detected cases by two to fourfold. No specific case counts or dates are provided in the article. The remarks underscore undercounting in ongoing transmission and the reliance on models to gauge outbreak size.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO):エボラ感染者数は公式集計の2倍
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のコンゴ民主共和国東部での流行が、WHOにより公式集計の2〜4倍と過小評価されている可能性が指摘されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: スイス・ジュネーブはWHOの発表場所であり、発生地域ではないため除外。具体的な症例数・日付は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Trial of potential Ebola antiviral under way -- WHO
article.articleSummary: First clinical trial of obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis (EBO-PEP) is under way in the Democratic Republic of Congo to assess its effectiveness in people exposed to Bundibugyo Ebola. Participants 12+ are being recruited at PEP centers beside Ebola treatment centers in Bunia and Rwampara, Ituri. Nearly 1,000 high-risk contacts who have had direct exposure within previous five days but are asymptomatic will be monitored daily for 21 days, with a final visit at 42 days. Bundibugyro, a rare Ebola species, has infected more than 1,960 people and killed over 700 since the outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri. Cases have been detected in five DRC provinces and in Uganda; about 80% of new cases are outside known contact lists. No approved vaccines or therapies exist yet; obeldesivir was developed by Gilead and shows preclinical efficacy against filoviruses. Separately, MBP134 and remdesivir trials began July 2 in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療薬候補の治験開始 -- WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のBundibugyoエボラアウトブレイク（感染者1,960人超、死亡700人超）に関する報告で、複数国への拡大や接触者追跡困難な状況が続いており、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・Ituri州で継続中のBundibugyo種エボラアウトブレイクに対する治療薬（obeldesivir等）の治験開始に関する続報。ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: U ajmeyajilo'ob u kúuchil tu'ux ku ts'a'akal ébola tu lu'umil Congoe' tu jáawso'ob meyaj tumen ma' bo'ota'ako'obi'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health workers struggle to contain Ebola in the Congo as new cases rise with no vaccine available.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with cases detected in a fourth province and the death toll rising to about 600 as of July 14, 2026. Total reported cases exceed 1,900 (1,926 cited). Health workers and epidemiologists at Ituri’s General Hospital of Rwampara are coordinating case investigations, contact tracing, and response efforts to curb transmission. The report underscores ongoing challenges in containment despite Africa CDC and partner public health actions. On Monday, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called for intensified international cooperation and vigilance amid the surge. The article notes that there is no Ebola vaccine available at the time, heightening the need for rapid case finding, isolation, and strict adherence to control measures to limit spread within Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例増加、ワクチンなしで医療従事者が対応に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で第4州に拡大し死者約600人・症例1,900人超と深刻化、WHO事務局長も国際協調を呼びかけており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda(Kigali Province)が含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州含む4州）での発生に焦点を当てており、ルワンダでの発生は記述されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в Конго: американцы под угрозой -- возвращение домой под запретом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Americans at risk — returning home is prohibited.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, the United States restricts entry for Americans who recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to an Ebola outbreak. The administration has prohibited boarding U.S.-bound flights for those who traveled to DRC, requiring a 21-day period in a third country before returning home. The outbreak has produced a death toll exceeding 700, according to local ministry sources; the World Health Organization has declared the situation an international emergency, with the regional risk of spread deemed high. The measures aim to safeguard public health and prevent cross-border transmission, with authorities maintaining a list of affected citizens to enforce restrictions. The policy signals heightened vigilance and coordination to avoid introduction of the virus into the United States.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：アメリカ人にリスク——帰国は禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱でWHOが国際的緊急事態を宣言し、死者700人超、渡航制限措置が実施されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域として記載されているが、実際のアウトブレイクはDRCで発生しており、米国は渡航制限を実施している側であるためverified_locationsには含めない。死者数700人超という情報は現地保健省情報源によるもので、WHOの正式発表との整合性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: US to Block Citizens in Congo From Immediate Travel Home, Citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: US travel restrictions under Title 49 bar American citizens in the Democratic Republic of Congo from returning to the United States on commercial flights, placing them on a do-not-board list until they spend 21 days in a third country. The move accompanies a widening Ebola outbreak across multiple provinces in DRC, with 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths reported as of late Sunday. Ebola symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and bleeding; Bundibugyo Ebola virus infection has been reported in a US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo, and one American infected there was admitted to Frankfurt University Hospital in Germany, with another American, Dr. Peter Stafford, moved to Germany for treatment. The U.S. has pledged hundreds of millions for the response and is building a quarantine center in Kenya; CDC notes rising risk near Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラを理由にコンゴの自国民の即時帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCで複数州にまたがるエボラ流行が拡大し(1,926症例、702死亡)、米国が渡航制限措置を発動、国際的な人的移動・医療対応が発生しているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ドイツ・米国・ケニアは感染者搬送・支援拠点として言及されているが、発生自体はDRCが主題であるため対象国としてはDRCのみを列挙。致死率(約36%)が高く、国際的な渡航制限措置が既に発動している点は重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: В США ввели ограничения для возвращающихся из Конго американцев из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Restrictions were imposed in the United States on Americans returning from Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts U.S. travel restrictions: Americans who recently traveled to the DRC are barred from flying to the United States until they spend up to 21 days in a third country, under a federal transportation statute, to prevent importation of the virus amid ongoing transmission. Politico cited official sources. The policy follows a contrast with the 2013 West Africa Ebola outbreak when travel bans were not imposed. As of July 6, the Congolese press agency ACP reported 1,561 confirmed Ebola cases and 506 deaths, with 253 recoveries; case fatality rate 32.4% and contact tracing completion at 81.6%. A July 4 report from Congo’s Ministry of Communications put deaths at 473 and confirmed cases at 1,502. Measures reflect continued transmission in the DRC and efforts to mitigate imported risk.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行を受けてコンゴから帰国する米国人に渡航制限を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラの継続的な感染拡大（症例1,561件、死亡506件、致死率32.4%）が確認され、米国が渡航制限を導入するなど国際的対応が発生しており、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国及びアンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの感染拡大が主題であり、致死率32.4%、接触者追跡完了率81.6%という高い重症度・管理必要性を示す。報告元により症例数・死亡数に差異あり（ACP:1,561例/506死亡 vs コンゴ通信省:1,502例/473死亡）。

article.articleHeadline: हेंदलजुड़ी : मलेरिया से छात्रा की मौत, दहशत में लोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hendaljudi: A female student dies of malaria, people in panic.
article.articleSummary: 14-year-old Kiran Hansda, daughter of Rohit Hansda, died from cerebral malaria in Kenddanga village, Hindaljudi Panchayat, Ghatshila Block, Jharkhand. She had headache and fever for several days and was initially admitted to a private nursing home in Ghatsila; her condition worsened, and she was later transported to Jhargram hospital, where she died around 12:00 AM on Monday night. Kiran was an eighth-grade student at Utkrimit Madhya Vidyalaya Kakardishol. The death has sparked fear in the community as officials report a rapid uptick in malaria cases in the area. Local leaders, including sarpanch Mirza Hansda and ward member Durlabh Soren, visited the family to offer support. The incident underscores ongoing malaria concerns and the need for vigilance in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ヘンダルジュディ：マラリアで女子学生死亡、住民に不安広がる
triage.triage_reason: 単一の脳マラリア死亡例だが、地域でのマラリア症例増加が報告されており続報を注視する必要がある。国際的拡大等の重大基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 地元住民に恐怖が広がっているとの記載があるが、地域全体の症例数や公的対応の詳細は不明。ジャールカンド州の地域限定的な事象。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: DRC Ebola outbreak fastest-growing ever, third-largest in history
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) is the fastest-growing and third-largest on record. As of July 11, confirmed cases near 2,000 with over 700 deaths across five provinces, led by Ituri and recently extending to Haut-Uele and Tshopo, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu and neighboring Uganda. More than 80 cases were reported in 24 hours; many deaths occurred in communities without access to care. About 80% of new cases are outside contact lists, from unknown transmission chains, suggesting the true scale could be two to four times the reported figure. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; early supportive care improves survival. Diagnostics have improved and contact tracing is high, but containment requires mapping travel routes and at‑risk areas. Outbreak began May 15, the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, with transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids and symptoms starting with fever, fatigue, headache, progressing to vomiting and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：DRCのエボラ出血熱流行は史上最速の拡大、史上3番目の規模
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大・史上3番目規模のエボラ流行が発生し、近隣国ウガンダへの越境拡大、未知感染経路が8割を占めるなど国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であり、感染経路不明の症例が多数を占める点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : près de 80 % des contacts pris en charge (OMS) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: nearly 80% of contacts monitored (WHO) - ACP
article.articleSummary: On Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 14 July 2026, the World Health Organization reports that nearly 80% of contacts of confirmed Ebola cases are being followed. Since the last mission four weeks earlier, WHO notes significant advances: more than 700 hospital beds available, 14 laboratories operational (up from one), and over 21,000 community health workers trained. An important clinical trial named EBO-PEP has been launched to assess the efficacy of post-exposure prophylaxis with the antiviral obeldesivir for contacts of confirmed cases, led by INRB, ALIMA, and partners. The country faces a $70 million funding gap of the $115 million sought for the response, threatening surveillance, testing, contact tracing, patient care, vaccine deployment, treatments, and diagnostics. The outbreak is affecting five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:接触者の約80%が追跡調査を受ける(WHO)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州に拡大しており、資金不足が対応に影響する等公衆衛生上深刻な影響がある継続中のアウトブレイクであるため。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中エボラアウトブレイクの進捗報告。WHOによる資金不足の警告あり、対応の継続的モニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde alerta para circulação dos vírus Influenza A e B em Montes Claros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health warns of the circulation of Influenza A and B viruses in Montes Claros.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the Montes Claros Municipal Health Department warns of circulation of Influenza A and Influenza B viruses in the municipality. Reported cases are concentrated mainly among ages 10–19 (21.4%) and 20–39 (20%), indicating broad transmission. The department stresses that influenza vaccination is available at all health units and remains the most effective measure to prevent severe illness, hospitalizations, and deaths. Annual vaccination updates reflect circulating strains; vaccines are updated each campaign to ensure protection. Residents are advised to seek immediate care for fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, or breathing difficulties, especially children, the elderly, pregnant individuals, and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: モンテス・クラロス市保健局、インフルエンザA型・B型ウイルスの流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA/Bの通常の流行に関する公衆衛生広報であり、異常性や重篤性の報告はなく、ワクチン接種を呼びかける定例的な内容である。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況に関する地域保健局からの注意喚起であり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS annonce le premier essai d'un antiviral contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces the first trial of an antiviral against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO has launched the first clinical trial evaluating an antiviral for people exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The EBO-PEP trial assesses obeldesivir, an oral antiviral from Gilead Sciences, as post-exposure prophylaxis for contacts of confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases. Initial recruitment is underway at PEP centers near Ebola treatment sites operated by ALIMA in Bunia and Rwampara, Ituri Province. About 1,000 participants aged 12 years and older who had direct contact within five days and are asymptomatic will receive the drug to evaluate its ability to prevent disease. Participants are followed daily for 21 days, with a final visit at 42 days. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or treatment; since the outbreak was declared May 15, over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths have been reported in five DRC provinces and Uganda. Transmission chains remain unknown, with 80% of cases not on contact lists.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱に対する抗ウイルス薬の初の臨床試験開始を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱で1,960人超の感染、700人超の死亡が報告され、ウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染経路の80%が追跡不能であり、ヒト-ヒト感染継続のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 台陸日新冠連5升 專家：這波恐不小
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases in Taiwan, Mainland China, and Japan have risen for five consecutive days; experts say this wave could be substantial.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Taiwan continues rising for five consecutive weeks. Last week’s outpatient/ED visits were 2,811, up 34.4% from the prior week, with 17 new severe cases and no deaths. Since October 2025, 136 severe cases and 18 deaths have occurred; about 94.9% of severe cases were in people 65+ or with chronic disease and unvaccinated this season. Experts expect the wave to enter the epidemic phase soon, with a peak likely in mid-to-late August and weekly cases possibly reaching 50,000 at the peak. Nearby regions—Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Japan—have risen for five to six weeks; globally, NB.1.8.1 is dominant, followed by JN.1 and XFG. The updated XFG vaccine isn’t due until October; in the meantime, vaccines remain protective for high-risk groups. Public funding covers residents over 6 months through July 31, 2026, with about 456,000 doses in stock (Moderna single-dose 450,000; Novavax 6,000).

triage.headline_ja: 台湾・中国大陸・日本で新型コロナ感染者数が5日連続増加、専門家「今回の流行は侮れない」
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19流行だが、重症例・死亡例の増加、複数地域（台湾・中国・香港・日本）での連続的な増加、8月中旬〜下旬にピークを迎える見込みなどWPRO基準に複数該当し、社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾を主対象としているが、台湾・香港は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国大陸（Mainland China）が同様の増加傾向にあると明記されているため中国を含めた。既知のCOVID-19季節性流行であり新規性・異常性は低いが、重症化・死亡例の継続やピーク予測（週5万件）を踏まえ経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया और टीबी से जूझ रही बच्ची, परिजनों ने रिम्स जाने से किया इनकार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl battling malaria and TB, family refused to go to RIMS.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, two-and-a-half-year-old Ariyana Champiya from Boikada village in the Sonua area, East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand, is battling malaria and tuberculosis that has spread to multiple body parts. She was referred to Ranchi's Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) on Monday evening after seven days of treatment by a village practitioner, and had previously been admitted to MGM Medical College and Hospital for further care. Her symptoms include malaria, abdominal pain with fluid accumulation, and weakness. Earlier she was moved from a rural clinic to a sub-divisional hospital before being sent to MGM for advanced treatment. If RIMS cannot provide adequate care, her father, Shri Ram Champiya, said he will take her back to the village.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアと結核と闘う少女、家族はRIMSへの搬送を拒否
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発生や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個別患者の医療アクセスや治療拒否に関する事例報道であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : la décontamination des ménages recommandée pour stopper la propagation du virus - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: Household Decontamination Recommended to Stop the Spread of the Virus - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts household decontamination to halt transmission. In Beni, North Kivu, on July 14, 2026, officials recommended decontaminating households to cut the virus’s spread after a patient has stayed at home before confirmation; once symptoms begin and the patient seeks care, the virus may be shed via vomiting, diarrhea, or sweating and contaminate surfaces. Désiré Buyana, provincial coordinator of the National Program for Health Promotion (PNCPS), says decontamination destroys virus left behind and breaks transmission chains. The response uses a multimodal Ring approach, targeting 10-15 households around a confirmed case for decontamination to substantially reduce new infections. Authorities urge public cooperation with decontamination teams. Since the outbreak’s official declaration on May 15, 2026, North Kivu has seen Ebola affect 11 health zones.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：ウイルス拡散阻止のため家庭内の除染を推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で2026年5月15日に公式宣言されたエボラ出血熱が11の保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日公式宣言）の継続報道。11保健地区に拡大していることから既に大規模な公衆衛生上の懸念事案であり、続報・支援状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les équipes de la riposte reprennent du travail à Rwampara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Response teams resume work in Rwampara.
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 – Ebola Treatment Center at Rwampara, about 12 km from Bunia in Ituri province, DRC, resumes operations after a one-day strike over staff prime payments. Response teams returned to work, but the civil society of Bahema d'Irumu warns the reopening is conditional, giving the government a 72-hour ultimatum to pay the responders’ allowances. Isaac Nyakulinda, head of the local civil group, says the stoppage already harmed patients, with some unable to access care and others dying at home during the disruption. The government had promised to settle prime payments, but no action had materialized by 14 July. If the centre shuts again, the civil society says it will hold the government responsible for potential loss of life.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：対応チームがルワンパラで活動を再開
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターでのストライキにより患者ケアが中断し死亡者が発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と対応体制の脆弱性が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州ブニア近郊のルワンパラ治療センターにおけるエボラ対応活動の中断とその再開について報じている。ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、実際の発生地としては確認できないため除外した。医療従事者への手当未払いが対応継続の障害となっており、政府への72時間の最終通告が出されている点は社会的・政治的関心の高まりを示す。

article.articleHeadline: How many positive rabies cases have there been across Capital Region?
article.articleSummary: Rabies surveillance centers on Turtle Island, Lake George, after a beaver tested positive for rabies; the beaver was found dead in the water near Turtle Island on July 9. A swimming advisory will end end of day Tuesday, July 14, 2026. Two people were bitten by a beaver in the area on July 4, but officials could not confirm if the same animal caused both incidents. Warren County has recorded nine positive rabies cases in the last five years, including three in 2025; statewide counts show Albany County 59, Saratoga 23, Rensselaer 23, and Washington 18 in the same period, with no strong year-to-year trend. The beaver could have infected others in the colony. Rabies exposure is treated with a four-shot series administered promptly; contact a doctor immediately. For more information, call Warren County Public Health at 518-761-6580.

triage.headline_ja: 首都圏で狂犬病陽性例はこれまでに何件あったか？
triage.triage_reason: 米国ニューヨーク州における動物（ビーバー）の狂犬病発生に関するローカルなサーベイランス記事であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事本文中の'Turtle Islands'はニューヨーク州レイク・ジョージ近郊の地名であり、フィリピンのTurtle Islandsとは無関係。発生地域リストにPhilippinesが含まれるがサマリー内容と無関係のため除外。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Brits issued warning over deadly mosquito viruses surging in holiday hotspots
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, UKHSA reports more than 750 travel-acquired mosquito-borne infections across England, Wales and Northern Ireland, led by 557 malaria cases Jan–May (up from 548 in the same period last year). Dengue fever has risen to 137 cases Jan–Jun 2026, with highest risk in Southeast and South Asia; 27 linked to Thailand and 19 to the Maldives. Chikungunya accounts for 59 cases, including 18 from travellers returning from Sri Lanka. Zika stands at eight cases in the first six months, already surpassing the total for all of 2025; four cases were caught in Indonesia. Malaria causes severe fever, vomiting and intense muscle pain and can be rapidly fatal if untreated. Zika poses miscarriage and microcephaly risk for pregnant women; dengue and chikungunya cause joint pain and rashes. Prevention centers on bite avoidance: DEET, covering up, bed nets; check NHS Travel Health for malaria prophylaxis and vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 英国当局、観光地で急増する致死性の蚊媒介ウイルスについて英国人に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 英国UKHSAによる海外渡航者の蚊媒介感染症（マラリア・デング・チクングニア・ジカ）の定例サーベイランス報告であり、特定国での異常なアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は英国内での渡航関連感染症の定例統計報告。タイ・インドネシアは感染源国として言及されているが、記事の主題は英国内の症例数動向であり、当該国での流行状況自体を報じるものではない。モルディブ・スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se Expande: Los Contagios Podrían Ser 4 Veces Más a lo Calculado por la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Is Spreading: Infections Could Be Four Times Higher Than WHO Estimates
article.articleSummary: July 14, 2026 — Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, is expanding faster than the response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Official counts exceed 1,960 infections and 700 deaths, with the true toll potentially two to four times higher. The outbreak, already the third largest on record, began in Ituri Province near the border with South Sudan and Uganda and has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Upper Uele, with spillover to Uganda. WHO notes about 80% of new cases occur outside established contact lists, hindering rapid detection; many fatalities never reached health facilities, complicating containment. Researchers are pursuing vaccines and therapeutics for Bundibugyo. The WHO announced the first clinical trial of an antiviral, obeldesivir, under the EBO-PEP program for people exposed to Bundibugyo; developed by Gilead Sciences, oral administration, aiming to prevent severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡大：感染者数はWHO推計の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ(ブンディブジョ株)アウトブレイクは史上3番目の規模に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境も確認されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州発、北キブ・南キブ・チョポ・オートウェレ州へ拡大）が主眼。ウガンダ・南スーダンへのスピルオーバーに言及があるが対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsには含めない。WHOによるオベルデシビルの臨床試験開始など国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 近2年首例境外移入 男赴泰染茲卡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First imported case in nearly two years: man who traveled to Thailand contracted Zika virus.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Zika virus infection in nearly two years: a man in his 30s who returned from Thailand in mid-June developed fever and dizziness; lab confirmation followed. Since 2016, Taiwan has 31 Zika infections, all imported, with Southeast Asia accounting for about 81%. Zika is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and sexual contact; vertical transmission is possible, and infection in pregnancy can cause fetal microcephaly. Contact tracing found no contacts with symptoms. Three domestically acquired Japanese encephalitis cases were confirmed: two men and one woman, all in their 70s, from Taoyuan City (Guanyin, Taoyuan District) and Changhua County (Huatan). They presented with slurred speech and altered consciousness; two remain in intensive care. Nearby high-risk sites include rice paddies, pigeon houses, and pig farms. This year five locally acquired JE cases; May–October is peak. Public health urges vaccination for eligible children and avoiding high-risk areas during vector-active hours.

triage.headline_ja: 近2年で初の輸入例：タイ渡航中にジカウイルスに感染した男性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入ジカ熱症例であり、接触者調査で二次感染者は確認されていない。対象国であるタイでの流行拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は台湾国内の輸入ジカ熱症例および国内感染の日本脳炎症例だが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源とされるタイのみ対象国として記載。単発の輸入例であり、地域的な流行拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Η επιδημία Έμπολα μπορεί να είναι έως & τέσσερις φορές μεγαλύτερη
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic may be up to four times larger.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 July 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, may be two to four times larger than the reported 1,926 cases and 702 deaths. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Although new case detection has improved, models estimate a much higher true burden. The WHO has raised concerns about underfunding, with only about 40% of the requested $115 million allocated to curb the crisis. The organization appeals for sustained international support; the response must be ongoing until the outbreak is controlled, described by officials as a marathon rather than a sprint, while the region experiences intensified transmission despite improved surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ出血熱の流行は報告数の最大4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCイトゥリ州で拡大しており、WHOが実際の症例数は報告の2〜4倍と警告、資金不足も深刻でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株のアウトブレイクであり、資金不足($115M要求中約40%のみ充足)が response の持続性に懸念を与えている。

article.articleHeadline: Americans in Congo barred from returning home amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Americans in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are barred from returning to the United States amid an Ebola outbreak outpacing response efforts. A Title 49 'do-not-board' order requires travelers known or suspected to have Ebola to spend 21 days in a third country before re-entry; about two dozen Americans scheduled to fly home were blocked. It is unclear whether the rule applies to U.S. government staff; the CDC employs at least two dozen in the DRC. Critics say such travel restrictions hinder transparency, response, economies, and humanitarian aid workers. Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids of the sick or recently deceased, not casual contact. In past outbreaks, eight repatriated cases received high-level care and did not transmit. WHO warns the outbreak is underfunded; as of July 14, the DRC reports 1,963 cases and 719 deaths; four of five new cases have no link to known cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行の中、コンゴ在住アメリカ人の帰国が禁止される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が拡大し(1,963例、719死亡)、渡航制限(Title 49 do-not-board order)が既に発動されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOは資金不足を警告しており、新規感染の多くが既知の感染者と関連がないことから市中感染拡大の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例!茲卡境外移入確診 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case! Imported Zika virus infection confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan confirms its first imported Zika virus infection in 2026. A man in his 30s from northern Taiwan returned from Thailand in mid-June, developed fever and dizziness, with rash by late June; laboratory confirmation followed. Household members and contacts are asymptomatic. Pregnant women should avoid travel to Zika-endemic areas due to fetal risk. As of July 13, 2026, Taiwan has 1 imported Zika case this year; since 2016, 31 infections, all imported, mainly from Southeast Asia (Thailand 8, Vietnam 6, Philippines 3, Myanmar 3, Malaysia 3, Maldives 2; Indonesia, Singapore, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saint Lucia, Florida/USA (Miami), Angola each 1). Globally, 97 countries affected since 2016; Americas >11,000 cases by late June; Thailand 76 this year; Singapore 7; Africa and others affected. Prevention emphasizes mosquito protection (light clothing, government-approved repellent, screens/AC) and post-return safe sex (men 3 months, women 2 months) or abstinence; blood donation deferred for 1 month.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初のジカウイルス感染例!海外からの輸入症例確定 | 中華日報
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における2026年初の輸入ジカウイルス感染例1件で、軽症かつ接触者は無症状。毎年発生している既知の輸入パターンであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での輸入例(感染源はタイ渡航中)についての報道。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイは今年の現地感染データ(76例)が言及されており発生国として含めた。ベトナム・フィリピン・ミャンマー等は過去累計の統計データのみで今回のイベントの主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS annonce le premier essai d'un antiviral contre Bundibugyo, le variant du virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces the first trial of an antiviral against Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus variant.
article.articleSummary: First clinical trial of an antiviral against Bundibugyo Ebola variant begins in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The WHO announced on July 14, 2026, the EBO-PEP trial will assess obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis in roughly 1,000 asymptomatic individuals aged 12+ who had direct contact with confirmed Bundibugyo cases within five days. The oral antiviral from Gilead Sciences aims to prevent progression to Ebola; participants will be followed daily for 21 days with a final visit at day 42. No vaccine or treatment is currently approved for Bundibugyo. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri, with over 1,960 infections and more than 700 deaths; cases span five DRC provinces and Uganda, though >90% are in Ituri. Recruitment centers include Bunia and Rwampara near ALIMA-managed Ebola treatment centers. Earlier July 2, tests of MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir began in Ituri; results may extend into next year.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスの変異株ブンディブギョに対する初の抗ウイルス薬試験を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ変異株）流行は感染者1,960人超、死者700人超に達し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心・国際支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州中心、5州に拡大）とウガンダへの越境例に言及。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 連5週上升 新冠病例激增34.4% | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases surge 34.4% over five consecutive weeks | Zhonghua Daily | Zhonghua News Cloud
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's COVID-19 activity has risen for five straight weeks. Last week, emergency department and outpatient visits for COVID-19 totaled 2,811, up 34.4% from the prior week. The CDC reports 17 new domestically acquired severe cases, bringing cumulative domestic severe cases since October 2025 to 136, with 18 deaths. Severe cases remain concentrated among those aged 65 and older (72.1%) and with chronic conditions (83.8%); 94.9% of severe cases were unvaccinated this season. Taiwan warns the epidemic is entering a rising phase; neighboring regions including China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, and Singapore are also rising. If weekly visits exceed 5,000, a new wave would be officially underway, with a projected peak near 50,000 weekly visits. The national vaccination program covers those aged six months and older through July 31, 2026, with about 456,000 doses in stock (Moderna monodose 450,000; Novavax 6,000). High-risk groups are urged to vaccinate.

triage.headline_ja: 5週連続上昇、新型コロナ感染者が34.4%急増 | 中華日報
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で新型コロナの季節的な感染拡大が続いているが、新規変異株や異常な病原性等の情報はなく、対象国リストにも該当しないため、フルリスク評価には進めず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾におけるCOVID-19の季節的増加を報告しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には台湾が含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。中国・香港等も『上昇傾向にある』と言及されているが、記事の主題は台湾であり、これらの国は主題として扱われていないため除外。
